papers.title: Interaction corrections to topological density three-point functions in two-dimensional Fermi liquids: a coadjoint orbit perspective
papers.abstract: Density three-point correlations are known to probe the topology of the Fermi sea in two-dimensional noninteracting systems. Here, we study how these correlations are modified by interactions using the coadjoint-orbit effective field theory. A key advantage of the coadjoint-orbit formulation is that it provides a systematic way to incorporate generalized Landau interactions in terms of bosonized degrees of freedom, mapping fermionic loop contributions onto simpler tree-level diagrams. We show that, for a general isotropic dispersion $ε(p)$, even at linear order in the generalized Landau interaction, $\mathcal{O}(\mathcal{F}^{(2,0)})$, there exists a contribution proportional to the band curvature $ε''(p_F)$ that changes the nonanalytic structure of the free density three-point correlation function. This contribution introduces a distinct nonanalytic structure beyond that found in either the noninteracting case or an interacting Galilean-invariant system, showing that interaction effects can modify the topology-detecting density three-point correlation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“有效场论”“玻色化”“树级图”等理论工具，属于凝聚态理论/场论研究。；研究对象：二维费米液体中的密度三点关联函数，特别关注其非解析结构如何受相互作用修正，以及该关联函数对费米海拓扑性质的探测能力。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在一般各向同性色散 ε(p) 下，即使在线性阶的广义朗道相互作用 O(F^(2,0)) 内，也存在正比于能带曲率 ε''(p_F) 的贡献，会改变自由费米气体密度三点关联函数的非解析结构。该结构既不同于无相互作用情形，也不同于伽利略不变相互作用体系，表明相互作用可以修正用于探测拓扑的密度三点关联函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在一般各向同性色散 ε(p) 下，即使在线性阶的广义朗道相互作用 O(F^(2,0)) 内，也存在正比于能带曲率 ε''(p_F) 的贡献，会改变自由费米气体密度三点关联函数的非解析结构。该结构既不同于无相互作用情形，也不同于伽利略不变相互作用体系，表明相互作用可以修正用于探测拓扑的密度三点关联函数。；创新点：首次在余伴随轨道有效场论框架下系统研究密度三点关联函数的相互作用修正，并发现能带曲率项在一般色散下会引入新的非解析结构，突破了此前仅在伽利略不变体系或自由费米子情形下的认识。
papers.method_zh: 采用余伴随轨道（coadjoint orbit）有效场论框架，将广义朗道相互作用系统地纳入玻色化自由度中，将费米子圈图贡献映射为更简单的树级图，从而计算密度三点关联函数的相互作用修正。

papers.title: Layer-Controlled Intermolecular Coupling and Many-Body Effects in C$_{60}$ Films
papers.abstract: Crystalline C$_{60}$ is a molecular solid whose electronic properties emerge from the interplay of intermolecular hopping, electron correlations, and electron-vibration coupling. Unlike moir$\rm\acute{e}$ van der Waals heterostructures, where interaction strength is commonly tuned by twist angle, molecular materials offer a complementary route in which layer number, molecular orientation, and substrate registry provide experimentally accessible control parameters. Here we present a systematic thickness-dependent angle-resolved photoemission study of C$_{60}$ films, spanning the monolayer to the bulk limit. The HOMO-derived band exhibits a non-monotonic evolution: the intermediate-thickness film shows larger bandwidth, reduced effective mass, and pronounced gap-like and sub-band features. The experimental trends, together with Holstein-model simulations, point to strengthened effective intermolecular electronic coupling and enhanced electron-phonon-induced spectral renormalization in the intermediate-thickness regime. These results identify a dimensional crossover in C$_{60}$ films and establish layer number as an effective knob for engineering electronic structure and many-body interactions in molecular thin films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合理论模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“thickness-dependent angle-resolved photoemission study”（厚度依赖的角分辨光电子能谱实验），并辅以“Holstein-model simulations”（Holstein模型模拟）进行对比分析。；研究对象：C₆₀（富勒烯）分子晶体薄膜，具体研究从单层到体相极限的厚度演变过程中，HOMO（最高占据分子轨道）衍生态的电子结构、分子间耦合强度以及多体效应（电子-声子耦合）的变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: C₆₀薄膜的HOMO带随厚度呈非单调演化：中等厚度薄膜表现出更大的带宽、更小的有效质量，以及明显的类能隙和子带特征，表明该厚度区间内有效分子间电子耦合增强且电子-声子诱导的光谱重整化效应显著，对应一个维度交叉（dimensional crossover）行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：C₆₀薄膜的HOMO带随厚度呈非单调演化：中等厚度薄膜表现出更大的带宽、更小的有效质量，以及明显的类能隙和子带特征，表明该厚度区间内有效分子间电子耦合增强且电子-声子诱导的光谱重整化效应显著，对应一个维度交叉（dimensional crossover）行为。；创新点：不同于常见的通过扭转角调控莫尔范德华异质结中相互作用强度的思路，该工作提出并验证了在分子材料中以“层数”（layer number）作为调控电子结构和多体相互作用的有效手段，并首次系统揭示了C₆₀薄膜中由厚度驱动的维度交叉现象。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用厚度依赖的角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES），覆盖从单层到体相极限的厚度范围；理论上采用Holstein模型进行数值模拟，用于解释实验观测到的带宽、有效质量及谱形演化趋势。

papers.title: Solvable relaxation in discrete unitary systems: Ruelle-Pollicott resonances and CMV matrices
papers.abstract: Leading eigenvalues of the truncated propagator, known as Ruelle-Pollicott (RP) resonances, are an elegant way of addressing the dynamics of unitary many-body systems. We study unitary propagators in their canonical form, known in the mathematical literature as the CMV matrices, and obtain a number of exact results for RP resonances and the associated norm-diverging eigenvectors. For the simplest CMV class describing a unilateral shift with an impurity, motivated by operator dynamics in dual-unitary circuits, we obtain closed-form results and in particular show that the three independent ways of obtaining RP resonances -- the truncated propagator, analytic continuation of the resolvent, and the rigged Hilbert space approach -- all give the same results. In more realistic CMV matrices, in which shift-like operator dynamics characteristic of chaotic systems is only asymptotic, we rely on the rich theory of orthogonal polynomials on the unit circle and identify two phases. In the first phase, relaxation occurs due to local operators effectively evolving into increasingly nonlocal ones with negligible backflow. Especially interesting is the second phase, which, surprisingly, exhibits faster relaxation because of contributions from the backflow of large operators. Additionally, in the second phase, RP resonances are not equal to the eigenvalues of the truncated propagator, instead, they are ``hidden'' within a ring of ill-conditioned eigenvalues.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“exact results”“analytic continuation”“rigged Hilbert space approach”等纯理论推导关键词，未提及任何实验或数值模拟手段。；研究对象：离散幺正系统中的弛豫动力学，具体为CMV矩阵（幺正传播子的正则形式）及其对应的Ruelle-Pollicott（RP）共振。物理背景包括dual-unitary电路中的算符动力学，以及单位圆上的正交多项式理论。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CMV矩阵框架下，对于最简单的单边移位加杂质的幺正系统，三种独立计算RP共振的方法（截断传播子、解析延拓、rigged Hilbert space）给出完全一致的结果。对于更现实的CMV矩阵，存在两个弛豫相：第一相中弛豫源于局域算符演化为非局域算符且回流可忽略；第二相中由于大算符回流的贡献，弛豫反而更快，且此时RP共振不等于截断传播子的本征值，而是“隐藏”在病态本征值环中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CMV矩阵框架下，对于最简单的单边移位加杂质的幺正系统，三种独立计算RP共振的方法（截断传播子、解析延拓、rigged Hilbert space）给出完全一致的结果。对于更现实的CMV矩阵，存在两个弛豫相：第一相中弛豫源于局域算符演化为非局域算符且回流可忽略；第二相中由于大算符回流的贡献，弛豫反而更快，且此时RP共振不等于截断传播子的本征值，而是“隐藏”在病态本征值环中。；创新点：首次在CMV矩阵这一幺正系统的规范形式中系统求解RP共振，并严格证明了三种独立方法在简单情形下的等价性；发现了第二相中“回流加速弛豫”这一反直觉现象，并揭示了RP共振与截断传播子本征值在病态本征值环中的分离关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：CMV矩阵（幺正算符的正则矩阵表示）、Ruelle-Pollicott共振分析、截断传播子本征值方法、预解式解析延拓、rigged Hilbert space方法，以及单位圆上正交多项式理论。

papers.title: Super-resolution Control of Two-dimensional Quantum Emitters
papers.abstract: Localized interlayer excitons in semiconducting transition-metal dichalcogenide heterobilayers are quantum emitters with a static electric dipole moment, making them excellent nanoscale charge sensors to probe correlated quantum phases in a proximal layer. These emitters are electrically tunable and inherit spin-valley selection rules, yet their deterministic spatial control remains challenging due to subwavelength confinement. Here, we present a platform that combines cryogenic optical spectroscopy with scanning probe microscopy to investigate trapped interlayer excitons in WSe$_2$/MoSe$_2$ bilayers. By exploiting AFM-based local Stark shift, we achieve super-resolution localization of emitters separated by only a few tens of nanometers and demonstrate deterministic control of individual charge states, including trion formation, opening a path towards coherent inter-dot coupling. Time-resolved measurements reveal tip-induced modification of the electromagnetic vacuum around individual emitters, thus controlling their radiative emission. Our multi-point charge sensing platform with optical readout is particularly well-suited to study fractionalization and anyon dynamics in semiconducting FCIs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“cryogenic optical spectroscopy”“scanning probe microscopy”“AFM-based local Stark shift”“Time-resolved measurements”等实验手段。；研究对象：WSe₂/MoSe₂异质双层中的局域层间激子（量子发射体），以及其作为纳米尺度电荷传感器探测近邻层关联量子相（如分数量子霍尔态）的潜力。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过AFM针尖诱导的局域斯塔克位移，实现了对相距仅数十纳米的量子发射体的超分辨定位，并能确定性调控单个电荷态（包括三子形成），同时针尖可改变单个发射体周围的电磁真空从而调控其辐射发射。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过AFM针尖诱导的局域斯塔克位移，实现了对相距仅数十纳米的量子发射体的超分辨定位，并能确定性调控单个电荷态（包括三子形成），同时针尖可改变单个发射体周围的电磁真空从而调控其辐射发射。；创新点：实现了对亚波长受限的层间激子发射体的确定性空间控制与电荷态调控，并展示了针尖对单个发射体辐射寿命的主动调控，为研究半导体分数量子霍尔态中的分数化与任意子动力学提供了多点多电荷传感平台。
papers.method_zh: 低温光学光谱与扫描探针显微镜联用平台；基于AFM的局域斯塔克位移实现超分辨定位；时间分辨光学测量研究针尖对电磁真空的调控。

papers.title: A Three-Fluid Model of Dissipation at Surfaces in Superconducting Radiofrequency Cavities
papers.abstract: Experiments on superconducting cavities have found that under large RF fields the quality factor can improve with increasing field amplitude, a so-called ``anti-Q slope.'' We numerically solve the Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations at a superconducting surface in a parallel magnetic field, finding at large fields there are surface quasiparticle states with energies below the bulk superconducting gap that emerge and disappear as the field cycles. Modifying the standard two-fluid model, we introduce a ``three''-fluid model where we partition the normal fluid to consider continuum and surface quasiparticle states separately. We compute dissipation in a semi-classical theory of conductivity, where we provide physical estimates of elastic scattering times of Bogoliubov quasiparticles with point-like impurities having potential strengths informed from complementary \textit{ab initio} calculations of impurities in bulk niobium. We show, in this simple yet effective framework, how the relative scattering rates of surface and continuum quasiparticle states can play a role in producing an anti-Q slope while demonstrating how this model naturally includes a mechanism for turning the anti-Q slope on and off.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。依据：摘要明确提到“numerically solve the Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations”以及“semi-classical theory of conductivity”，属于数值求解与理论建模结合的工作。；研究对象：超导射频腔（SRF cavities）表面在强平行磁场下的耗散行为，具体涉及铌（niobium）超导表面、表面准粒子态、体态准粒子连续谱，以及“反Q斜率”（anti-Q slope）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在强射频场下，超导表面会出现能量低于体超导能隙的表面准粒子态，这些态随场周期性地出现和消失；通过将正常流体进一步划分为连续谱态和表面态的三流体模型，发现表面态与连续谱态的相对散射率差异可以产生“反Q斜率”效应，且该模型天然包含开启/关闭该效应的机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在强射频场下，超导表面会出现能量低于体超导能隙的表面准粒子态，这些态随场周期性地出现和消失；通过将正常流体进一步划分为连续谱态和表面态的三流体模型，发现表面态与连续谱态的相对散射率差异可以产生“反Q斜率”效应，且该模型天然包含开启/关闭该效应的机制。；创新点：将标准二流体模型扩展为三流体模型，明确区分表面准粒子态与连续谱态，并首次在该框架下将表面态与连续谱态的相对散射率与“反Q斜率”的产生机制直接联系起来，同时提供了一个可调控该效应的物理机制。
papers.method_zh: 数值求解Bogoliubov-de Gennes（BdG）方程（平行磁场下的超导表面）；采用修正的三流体模型（将正常流体分为连续谱态与表面态两部分）；基于半经典电导理论计算耗散；弹性散射时间通过点状杂质模型估算，杂质势强度参考了体铌中杂质的从头计算（ab initio）结果。

papers.title: Machine learned designs of functional colloidal foldamers
papers.abstract: A protein's function follows from the structure it adopts, and which structure that is depends on the pathway taken. In programmable matter the target is fixed before assembly, and whatever else forms is treated as error. Here we show that pathways themselves form a design space. Using reinforcement learning, we fold model DNA-coated droplet chains into rigid two-dimensional geometries, uncovering two classes of pathways: downhill, in which bonds are only added, and detour, in which bonds are broken and remade before the target is reached: for some the only route that exists. Coarse-graining pathways by interactions gives experimentally realizable protocols. Some produce one geometry, others several: structures sharing a detour route can be cycled between, while those that coexist assemble into superstructures inaccessible to a uniform product. Function emerges from the pathways rather than being designed. Designing the process instead of the components could give colloidal materials that reconfigure and repair themselves on demand.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/模拟文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“using reinforcement learning”（使用强化学习）、“fold model DNA-coated droplet chains”（折叠模型DNA包被液滴链），属于计算模拟研究。；研究对象：DNA包被的液滴链（DNA-coated droplet chains）作为胶体折叠体（colloidal foldamers），研究其折叠路径（folding pathways）与最终二维几何构型之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 折叠路径本身构成一个可设计空间，存在两类路径——“下坡路径”（只成键）和“绕行路径”（先断键再成键），后者是某些目标构型的唯一可行路径。功能（如可重构性、自修复能力）源于路径设计而非组分设计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：折叠路径本身构成一个可设计空间，存在两类路径——“下坡路径”（只成键）和“绕行路径”（先断键再成键），后者是某些目标构型的唯一可行路径。功能（如可重构性、自修复能力）源于路径设计而非组分设计。；创新点：将设计对象从“目标结构”转变为“折叠路径本身”，提出通过设计过程（而非组分）来实现胶体材料的按需重构与自修复。摘要未突出说明与已有折叠体设计工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 强化学习（reinforcement learning）用于搜索折叠路径；通过相互作用粗粒化（coarse-graining by interactions）将路径转化为实验上可实现的协议。

papers.title: Switchable chiral antiferromagnetism through nonlinear magnetic susceptibility
papers.abstract: Antiferromagnets (AFM) have attracted considerable attention in recent years because a number of nontrivial, technologically relevant properties associated with time-reversal symmetry (TRS) breaking are discovered in many materials. However, time-reversal (TR) partners of AFM states are generally challenging to be selected deterministically except in a few cases with nonzero net magnetization. Recently, it has been shown that the TR partners of the kagome spin ice ground state in HoAgGe with strictly zero net magnetization can be selected through a nonlinear magnetic susceptibility $χ^{(1)}$. In this work, we generalize this scenario to a broad class of chiral AFM with zero net magnetization but field-switchable ground states through $χ^{(1)}$. After a general discussion of $χ^{(1)}$ and its symmetry constraints, we first present a first-principles formalism for calculating it including both mean-field and self-consistent corrections, and then apply the approach to the noncollinear AFM family Mn$_3X$N ($X=$ Ni, Ag, Ga, Zn, Sn) in the $Γ_{5g}$ phase. An intuitive picture of the origin of $χ^{(1)}$ in similar noncollinear AFM is illustrated using 3-sublattice toy model. The model also predicts a nontrivial temperature dependence of $χ^{(1)}$ due to competitions between the longitudinal and transverse single-spin susceptibilities. Our work shows that nonlinear susceptibility can serve as a general protocol for accessing and switching TR partners in fully compensated AFM.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first-principles formalism”（第一性原理方法）、“mean-field and self-consistent corrections”（平均场与自洽修正）以及“toy model”（玩具模型），属于理论计算研究。；研究对象：具有零净磁化强度但可通过非线性磁化率χ^(1)实现场切换的手性反铁磁体。具体材料体系为Mn₃X N（X = Ni, Ag, Ga, Zn, Sn）家族中的Γ₅g相非共线反铁磁体，以及作为概念模型的3-子格玩具模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非线性磁化率χ^(1)可以作为通用协议，在完全补偿（零净磁化）的反铁磁体中实现时间反演（TR）伙伴态的选择与切换，将该机制从HoAgGe的kagome自旋冰基态推广到更广泛的手性反铁磁体类别。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非线性磁化率χ^(1)可以作为通用协议，在完全补偿（零净磁化）的反铁磁体中实现时间反演（TR）伙伴态的选择与切换，将该机制从HoAgGe的kagome自旋冰基态推广到更广泛的手性反铁磁体类别。；创新点：将非线性磁化率χ^(1)作为时间反演伙伴态选择机制，从特定材料（HoAgGe）推广到一类广泛的手性反铁磁体，并建立了第一性原理计算框架；玩具模型揭示了χ^(1)的非平凡温度依赖关系。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新点。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算框架（包含平均场和自洽修正）用于计算χ^(1)；结合对称性分析讨论χ^(1)的约束条件；使用3-子格玩具模型直观说明χ^(1)的起源，并预测其温度依赖关系（源于纵向与横向单自旋磁化率之间的竞争）。

papers.title: Hierarchical organization governs nonlinear mechanical reversibility in $ι$-carrageenan gels
papers.abstract: Carrageenan gels are thermoreversible polysaccharide networks whose mechanical properties emerge from ion-mediated helix association, yet how their molecular organization controls nonlinear deformation remains poorly understood. Here, we investigate the temperature-dependent rheology of $ι$-carrageenan gels formed in KCl solutions using linear and nonlinear oscillatory rheology combined with normal-force measurements. $ι$-carrageenan forms homogeneous and mechanically reversible gels whose elastic modulus increases continuously with quench depth. Deep quenches generate pronounced strain stiffening before yielding, associated with the development of internal stresses revealed by negative normal forces. Remarkably, large deformations preserve the small-strain elastic modulus while progressively suppressing strain stiffening, demonstrating a partial mechanical reversibility of the network. We interpret these observations using a hierarchical network picture in which a persistent intermolecular network controls linear elasticity, while a more fragile mesoscale organization enables cooperative alignment and stress amplification under deformation. Our results highlight that nonlinear mechanics of thermoreversible polysaccharide gels are governed not only by molecular connectivity, but also by the reversible formation and eventually destruction of mechanically adaptive hierarchical structures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“rheology”（流变学）、“oscillatory rheology”（振荡流变）、“normal-force measurements”（法向力测量）等实验手段。；研究对象：ι-卡拉胶（ι-carrageenan）在KCl溶液中形成的热可逆多糖凝胶，重点研究其层级分子组织对非线性力学响应（应变硬化、屈服、力学可逆性）的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: ι-卡拉胶凝胶的弹性模量随淬火深度增加而连续增大；深淬火产生显著应变硬化并伴随负法向力（内应力发展）。大变形后小应变弹性模量保持不变但应变硬化被抑制，表明网络具有部分力学可逆性，其非线性力学由持久分子间网络与脆弱介观组织的层级结构共同控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：ι-卡拉胶凝胶的弹性模量随淬火深度增加而连续增大；深淬火产生显著应变硬化并伴随负法向力（内应力发展）。大变形后小应变弹性模量保持不变但应变硬化被抑制，表明网络具有部分力学可逆性，其非线性力学由持久分子间网络与脆弱介观组织的层级结构共同控制。；创新点：提出层级网络图像：持久分子间网络控制线性弹性，而更脆弱的介观组织在变形下实现协同排列与应力放大，从而揭示热可逆多糖凝胶的非线性力学不仅由分子连接性决定，还受可逆形成/破坏的力学自适应层级结构调控。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比。
papers.method_zh: 线性与非线性振荡流变学（oscillatory rheology）结合法向力测量（normal-force measurements），研究温度依赖的流变行为。

papers.title: Modifying van der Waals Materials via Cavity Vacuum Fluctuations
papers.abstract: In the field of cavity quantum materials, vacuum fluctuations of optical cavities are used for modifying ground-state properties of quantum materials without external driving. Here, one example is the van der Waals (vdW)/dispersion interaction in layered 2D vdW materials, where non-additive long-range correlations can dominate the interlayer binding. While cavity-induced changes of such interactions have been predicted and described using ab initio methods for molecular systems, no efficient description exists yet for extended materials. In this Letter, we close this gap by introducing a periodic formulation of the photon many-body dispersion (pMBD) functional within quantum electrodynamical density-functional theory (QEDFT). Applying this method with efficient $\textbf{q}$-point sampling to bilayer hBN and graphene, we predict cavity-modified stacking, increased equilibrium interlayer distances, and softened layer breathing modes with increasing light-matter coupling strength. Our results establish cavity vacuum fluctuations as a tuning knob for the structural properties of vdW materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：functional、density-functional theory、ab initio、predict。；研究对象：范德华（vdW）层状二维材料，具体为双层六方氮化硼（bilayer hBN）和双层石墨烯（bilayer graphene），研究光学腔真空涨落对其层间结构性质（堆叠、层间距、层呼吸模式）的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着光-物质耦合强度增大，腔真空涨落可改变双层hBN和石墨烯的层间堆叠方式、增大平衡层间距，并软化层呼吸模式，从而将腔真空涨落确立为调控vdW材料结构性质的新旋钮。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着光-物质耦合强度增大，腔真空涨落可改变双层hBN和石墨烯的层间堆叠方式、增大平衡层间距，并软化层呼吸模式，从而将腔真空涨落确立为调控vdW材料结构性质的新旋钮。；创新点：首次为扩展材料（而非仅分子体系）提供了腔诱导vdW/色散相互作用的周期性高效描述（pMBD泛函），并预测了腔对实际二维vdW材料结构性质的可调效应。
papers.method_zh: 在量子电动力学密度泛函理论（QEDFT）框架内，提出了光子多体色散（pMBD）泛函的周期性形式，并结合高效的$\mathbf{q}$点采样对双层hBN和石墨烯进行第一性原理计算。

papers.title: Automated Dislocation Detection in Electron Channelling Contrast Imaging: A Comparative Study of Rule-Based, Neural Network, and Deep Learning Approaches
papers.abstract: Quantifying threading dislocations in semiconductor materials via electron channelling contrast imaging (ECCI) is heavily bottlenecked by slow manual analysis. This work benchmarks three automated detection pipelines on ECCI micrographs of gallium nitride (GaN) against a statistical ground truth. A classical rule-based computer vision approach proved unreliable due to extensive per-image tuning requirements, while a convolutional neural network (CNN)-based multi-stage classification and locator method achieved 87% accuracy but required significant time for a test image and was less efficient in high-density regions. By contrast, a unified single-stage you only look once (YOLOv8) architecture achieved a counting accuracy of 98.6%, alongside 98.7% precision and 98.7% recall across 7451 dislocations over multiple images, with rapid inference times. Successful deployment of YOLOv8 required addressing two domain-specific machine learning challenges. First, to mitigate the model's scale sensitivity, an adaptive gaussian tile-sizing algorithm was developed to optimise the field of view per image. Second, the deployed confidence threshold (0.025) differed substantially from the suggested inference default value for YOLOv8 (0.25), raising counting accuracy from 90.8% to 99.3% on a subsection of the benchmark image. In this case, low confidence scores represented physical signal strength rather than classification ambiguity. This unified, scale-adaptive approach demonstrates practical viability for high-throughput, quantitative semiconductor defect characterisation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算方法）。判断依据：论文涉及ECCI实验显微图像，同时包含算法开发与性能基准测试，属于实验数据驱动的计算方法研究。；研究对象：氮化镓（GaN）半导体材料中的穿透位错（threading dislocations），具体通过电子通道衬度成像（ECCI）显微图像进行缺陷量化表征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 统一单阶段YOLOv8深度学习架构在GaN的ECCI图像位错自动计数中达到98.6%的计数准确率（7451个位错），显著优于传统规则方法（不可靠）和CNN多阶段方法（87%准确率且耗时）。通过自适应高斯分块算法和将置信度阈值从默认0.25降至0.025，解决了模型尺度敏感性和低置信度物理信号问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：统一单阶段YOLOv8深度学习架构在GaN的ECCI图像位错自动计数中达到98.6%的计数准确率（7451个位错），显著优于传统规则方法（不可靠）和CNN多阶段方法（87%准确率且耗时）。通过自适应高斯分块算法和将置信度阈值从默认0.25降至0.025，解决了模型尺度敏感性和低置信度物理信号问题。；创新点：首次系统对比三类自动检测方法于ECCI位错计数任务；提出自适应高斯分块算法解决深度学习模型对图像尺度的敏感性；揭示低置信度分数在此类物理图像中代表真实信号强度而非分类不确定性，并据此大幅提升计数准确率（90.8%→99.3%）。
papers.method_zh: 三种自动检测管线对比：（1）经典基于规则的计算机视觉方法；（2）CNN多阶段分类+定位方法；（3）单阶段YOLOv8目标检测架构。针对YOLOv8开发了自适应高斯分块（adaptive gaussian tile-sizing）算法优化视野，并调整推理置信度阈值至0.025。

papers.title: Wyckoff-Resolved Oxidation-State Atlas and Anion-Conditioned Priors for Materials Discovery
papers.abstract: We introduce a Wyckoff-resolved oxidation-state atlas and assignment utility for probabilityranked, charge-neutral assignment from compositions or Wyckoff grammars. The atlas is constructed from a May 2026 snapshot of 154,879 Materials Project-derived structures by staged exact-neutral enumeration over common and known nonzero oxidation states. The learned prior assigns 106,053 materials in composition mode and 114,403 in Wyckoff mode, compared with a broad MP all-integer possible species count of 108,642. A matched MP baseline requiring at least one charge-neutral assignment with exactly one nonzero integer oxidation state per element contains 89,374 materials; relative to this baseline, composition and Wyckoff modes increase coverage by 18.7% and 28.0%. Of the 14,665 materials recovered only in Wyckoff mode, 99.98% exhibit distinct formal oxidation states for the same element on different site tokens. The CSV/Python workflow provides a reproducible prior for structure decoration, generative crystal models, and symbolic Wyckoff-grammar workflows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数据驱动型文章。判断依据关键词：atlas（数据集）、assignment utility（工具）、Materials Project-derived structures（数据库）、CSV/Python workflow（计算工作流）。；研究对象：材料无机晶体结构中的氧化态（oxidation states）分配问题，具体针对由Wyckoff位置语法或化学组成描述的晶体材料，涵盖154,879个由Materials Project导出的结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作构建了一个基于Wyckoff位置分辨的氧化态图谱，通过精确电中性枚举实现了对材料氧化态的高覆盖概率分配；在Wyckoff模式下，材料覆盖数比匹配的MP基线提高28.0%，且Wyckoff模式独有的14,665种材料中99.98%具有同一元素在不同Wyckoff位点上呈现不同形式氧化态的特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作构建了一个基于Wyckoff位置分辨的氧化态图谱，通过精确电中性枚举实现了对材料氧化态的高覆盖概率分配；在Wyckoff模式下，材料覆盖数比匹配的MP基线提高28.0%，且Wyckoff模式独有的14,665种材料中99.98%具有同一元素在不同Wyckoff位点上呈现不同形式氧化态的特征。；创新点：首次引入Wyckoff位置分辨的氧化态图谱，能够捕捉同一元素在不同晶体学位点上的不同氧化态（这是传统组成级分配无法区分的），并将该先验用于结构装饰、生成式晶体模型和符号Wyckoff语法工作流。摘要未突出说明与已有氧化态分配工具（如pymatgen默认方法）的具体性能对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用分阶段精确电中性枚举（staged exact-neutral enumeration）方法，基于2026年5月Materials Project快照（154,879个结构），对常见及已知非零氧化态进行穷举；构建了概率排序的氧化态分配工具，支持组成模式（composition mode）和Wyckoff语法模式（Wyckoff mode）两种分配方式；提供CSV/Python工作流作为可复现的先验工具。

papers.title: Gauge invariance, collective modes, and the justification of normal-state subtraction in Dirac superconductors
papers.abstract: In Dirac superconductors, the unbounded spectrum of low-energy Dirac models is known to give rise to unphysical interband contributions from deep-lying states to the electromagnetic response. To eliminate these contributions, normal-state subtraction (NSS), in which the normal-state response is subtracted from the superconducting-state response, has been widely employed. However, the relation between NSS and a gauge-invariant electromagnetic response, particularly the role of the vertex correction required by the Ward identity, has remained unclear. In this work, we consider a massive-Dirac model with $s$-wave pairing and analytically investigate the electromagnetic response at zero temperature by solving the Bethe--Salpeter equation and incorporating the collective-mode contribution to the electromagnetic vertex. We show that, in the static long-wavelength limit, the vertex correction exactly cancels the bare longitudinal response with NSS, yielding the vanishing longitudinal response required by gauge invariance. In contrast, the transverse component of the vertex correction vanishes in the long-wavelength limit, so that the gauge-invariant Meissner weight coincides with that obtained from the bare transverse response with NSS. Moreover, within the class of isotropic and analytic UV regularization terms, we show that gauge invariance uniquely fixes the regularization term in the static long-wavelength limit to the value prescribed by NSS. Our results thus provide a microscopic justification for NSS.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：analytically investigate、solving the Bethe–Salpeter equation、gauge invariance。；研究对象：具有s波配对的massive-Dirac超导体（Dirac超导体）中的电磁响应，特别是正常态扣除（NSS）方案与规范不变性之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在静态长波极限下，顶点修正恰好抵消了带NSS的裸纵向响应，从而给出规范不变性所要求的零纵向响应；而横向分量在长波极限下为零，因此规范不变的迈斯纳权重与带NSS的裸横向响应一致。此外，在各向同性且解析的紫外正则化项类别中，规范不变性唯一地将正则化项固定为NSS所规定的值，从而为NSS提供了微观依据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在静态长波极限下，顶点修正恰好抵消了带NSS的裸纵向响应，从而给出规范不变性所要求的零纵向响应；而横向分量在长波极限下为零，因此规范不变的迈斯纳权重与带NSS的裸横向响应一致。此外，在各向同性且解析的紫外正则化项类别中，规范不变性唯一地将正则化项固定为NSS所规定的值，从而为NSS提供了微观依据。；创新点：首次从微观层面阐明了NSS与规范不变电磁响应之间的严格关系，明确指出顶点修正（由Ward恒等式要求）在纵向和横向通道中的不同作用，并证明规范不变性唯一确定了静态长波极限下的正则化项取值，从而为NSS提供了第一性原理的微观证明。
papers.method_zh: 解析求解Bethe–Salpeter方程，将集体模贡献纳入电磁顶点，在零温下对massive-Dirac模型（含s波配对）的电磁响应进行解析计算，并分析静态长波极限下的纵向与横向响应。

papers.title: ScatterWorks: A Python package for building and solving scattering network models
papers.abstract: Network models provide an efficient framework for studying non-interacting transport and wave-propagation phenomena in disordered and topological systems. We introduce ScatterWorks, an open-source Python package for building and solving network models. The package uses a compact network representation with composable transformation operations (tile, cut, relink, and union) to enable flexible construction of periodic and finite networks. Local scattering matrices on nodes can be assigned by node labels or explicit indexing, assembled into global scattering equations, and used to compute quasienergies and transport observables. The package supports sparse scattering matrices, allowing transport observables to be evaluated with Schur-based solvers. We demonstrate the package workflow on a symbolic Fabry-Perot interferometer and a numerical Chalker-Coddington model, recovering analytical expressions and the expected near-critical transport behavior of the quantum Hall transition. Plotting utilities with label-aware rendering are included to streamline debugging and reproducible setup for larger, custom network geometries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/软件方法文章。关键词：Python package、building and solving network models、numerical Chalker-Coddington model。；研究对象：无序和拓扑体系中的非相互作用输运与波传播现象，具体以网络模型（network models）为框架，演示对象包括法布里-珀罗干涉仪（符号化）和Chalker-Coddington模型（数值，对应量子霍尔相变）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作本身是软件工具介绍，核心结论是：所开发的ScatterWorks包能够灵活构建周期/有限网络模型，并正确恢复法布里-珀罗干涉仪的解析表达式以及量子霍尔转变的预期近临界输运行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作本身是软件工具介绍，核心结论是：所开发的ScatterWorks包能够灵活构建周期/有限网络模型，并正确恢复法布里-珀罗干涉仪的解析表达式以及量子霍尔转变的预期近临界输运行为。；创新点：提供了一个开源、紧凑且可组合的网络模型构建框架，支持稀疏矩阵与Schur求解器，并内置标签感知的绘图工具，便于调试和复现大型自定义网络几何。摘要未突出说明与已有网络模型软件（如Kwant等）的具体性能对比或独特算法优势。
papers.method_zh: 基于散射矩阵的网络模型方法。具体包括：可组合的变换操作（tile、cut、relink、union）构建网络；节点局部散射矩阵按标签或索引赋值；组装全局散射方程；使用稀疏散射矩阵和基于Schur分解的求解器计算准能量与输运观测量。

papers.title: Magnonic Combinatorial Memory based on a network of coupled active ring circuits
papers.abstract: Magnonic Combinatorial Memory (MCM) is a type of memory where the bits of information are encoded in the signal propagation paths in the network. In this work, we consider MCM based on the network of a coupled active ring circuit (ARC). Each circuit includes a broadband amplifier, a magnonic delay line, an adjustable frequency filter, an adjustable phase shifter, and a power detector. The coupling between the circuits is via spin waves propagating in the common delay line - ferrite film. There may or may not be auto-oscillations in the active ring circuits, depending on the combination of circuit parameters and circuit coupling. The address of MCM is defined as the combination of the states of the phase shifters and frequency filters, while the MCM state is defined as the presence/absence of the auto-oscillations. The coupling between the circuits is achieved by placing micromagnets on top of the ferrite film. The number of bits that can be encoded in the network increases quadratically with the number of coupled circuits. This scaling provides a fundamental advantage over conventional memory. We present experimental data obtained for three magnonic ARCs connected via a single-crystal yttrium iron garnet Y3Fe2(FeO4)3 (YIG) film. The data illustrate an example of encoding a 27-bit binary response pattern, corresponding to the 27 experimentally accessible phase combinations. The results demonstrate a robust operation of MCM with an On/Off ratio exceeding 30 dB at room temperature. The advantages and shortcomings of the proposed approach are discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We present experimental data obtained for three magnonic ARCs”，并给出了具体的实验测量结果（如On/Off ratio超过30 dB）。；研究对象：基于耦合有源环形电路（ARC）网络的Magnonic Combinatorial Memory（MCM）系统。具体材料为单晶钇铁石榴石（YIG, Y₃Fe₂(FeO₄)₃）薄膜，其中自旋波在公共延迟线（铁氧体薄膜）中传播，并通过在薄膜上放置微磁体实现电路间耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过三个耦合的磁振子ARC网络，成功实现了27位二进制响应模式的编码，且该MCM在室温下具有超过30 dB的On/Off比，展示了稳健的工作性能。此外，网络可编码的比特数随耦合电路数量呈二次方增长，优于传统存储器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过三个耦合的磁振子ARC网络，成功实现了27位二进制响应模式的编码，且该MCM在室温下具有超过30 dB的On/Off比，展示了稳健的工作性能。此外，网络可编码的比特数随耦合电路数量呈二次方增长，优于传统存储器。；创新点：提出并实验验证了一种基于耦合有源环形电路网络的磁振子组合存储器（MCM），其信息编码在信号传播路径中，且存储容量随电路数量呈二次方扩展，这一标度行为相对于传统存储器具有根本性优势。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上构建了包含宽带放大器、磁振子延迟线、可调频率滤波器、可调移相器和功率探测器的有源环形电路。电路间通过自旋波在公共YIG薄膜延迟线中的传播实现耦合，耦合通过放置在薄膜上的微磁体实现。通过组合移相器和频率滤波器的状态定义MCM地址，以自激振荡的存在/缺失定义MCM状态，并测量了27种相位组合对应的二进制响应模式。

papers.title: Quantum transport and unified scaling law in graphene with polyadic Cantor electrostatic barriers
papers.abstract: We study the quantum transport of Dirac electrons in graphene subjected to a polyadic Cantor-structured electrostatic potential. Using the superperiodic potential formalism, we obtain a closed-form expression for the transmission probability. As the Cantor stage increases, the transmission spectrum evolves from a sparse set of superlattice resonances to a near-transparent regime, with the polyadic order setting the rate of this evolution. The angular response depends on the doping configuration, showing distinct behavior in the $n$--$n$--$n$, $n$--$p$--$n$, and Dirac-point cases. In the near-transparent regime, the transmission follows double-logarithmic scaling laws with respect to four independent control parameters: the Cantor stage, the potential height, the initiator length, and the angle of incidence. By combining these individual scaling relations, we establish a unified scaling law governing quantum transport. These results show that the hierarchical self-similarity of the potential governs the transport properties of such systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“superperiodic potential formalism”获得解析表达式，并研究“transmission probability”和“scaling laws”，属于理论推导与数值分析。；研究对象：石墨烯中受polyadic Cantor静电势调制的狄拉克电子量子输运。具体为Cantor分形静电势垒结构下的电子隧穿行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着Cantor级数增加，透射谱从稀疏的超晶格共振演化为近透明输运区，且该演化速率由polyadic阶数决定；在近透明区，透射率对四个独立控制参数（Cantor级数、势垒高度、初始长度、入射角）分别满足双对数标度律，并可统一为一个标度律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着Cantor级数增加，透射谱从稀疏的超晶格共振演化为近透明输运区，且该演化速率由polyadic阶数决定；在近透明区，透射率对四个独立控制参数（Cantor级数、势垒高度、初始长度、入射角）分别满足双对数标度律，并可统一为一个标度律。；创新点：首次将polyadic Cantor分形势垒应用于石墨烯量子输运，并建立了涵盖四个控制参数（Cantor级数、势垒高度、初始长度、入射角）的统一标度律，揭示了势垒的分形自相似性对输运性质的直接调控作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用超周期势形式论（superperiodic potential formalism），推导出透射概率的闭式解析表达式；通过分析不同掺杂构型（n-n-n、n-p-n、Dirac点）下的角度响应，并结合数值计算提取双对数标度律。

papers.title: Electrically Tunable Two-Component Exciton Condensate in a Coulomb-Coupled Graphene Trilayer
papers.abstract: Multicomponent condensates possess internal phase degrees of freedom unavailable to a single-component condensate, yet their components are rarely controllable in solids. Here we realize a graphene trilayer with negligible interlayer tunnelling in which the layer-specific carrier densities are continuously tuned by electrostatic gating. Quantum-capacitance measurements demonstrate that charge-incompressible quantum Hall states at total filling factors 1 and 2 persist across the full range of layer-filling configurations and continuously connect the three bilayer exciton-condensate limits. This persistence provides evidence for a trilayer excitonic state. Static Hartree-Fock and time-dependent Hartree-Fock calculations yield two independent finite phase-stiffness eigenmodes and two linearly dispersing Goldstone modes, respectively, when all three layers are partially filled, whereas only one phase-stiffness eigenmode and one linear Goldstone mode remain when one layer is unfilled. The stiffness eigenmodes rotate continuously between the two adjacent-layer exciton bases as charge is transferred among the layers, revealing electrical control of the condensate-mode composition. Together, the experimental and theoretical results support the identification of a two-component exciton condensate with a continuously tunable internal structure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“Quantum-capacitance measurements”（实验测量）和“Static Hartree-Fock and time-dependent Hartree-Fock calculations”（理论计算）。；研究对象：库仑耦合石墨烯三层结构（Coulomb-coupled graphene trilayer），具体为层间隧穿可忽略、层间载流子密度可独立调控的双组分激子凝聚体（two-component exciton condensate）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在总填充因子为1和2时，电荷不可压缩的量子霍尔态在所有层填充构型下持续存在，并连续连接三个双层激子凝聚极限，表明该体系形成三层的双组分激子凝聚体；理论计算进一步揭示该凝聚体具有两个独立的相位刚度本征模和两支线性色散的Goldstone模，且其模组成可通过静电门控连续旋转调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在总填充因子为1和2时，电荷不可压缩的量子霍尔态在所有层填充构型下持续存在，并连续连接三个双层激子凝聚极限，表明该体系形成三层的双组分激子凝聚体；理论计算进一步揭示该凝聚体具有两个独立的相位刚度本征模和两支线性色散的Goldstone模，且其模组成可通过静电门控连续旋转调控。；创新点：首次在固体中实现对多组分激子凝聚体内部相位自由度的连续电学调控——通过层间电荷转移使凝聚体模组成在相邻层激子基之间连续旋转，突破了以往多组分凝聚体中组分难以调控的限制。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用静电门控连续调节各层载流子密度，并进行量子电容（quantum-capacitance）测量以探测电荷不可压缩态；理论上采用静态Hartree-Fock（计算相位刚度本征模）和含时Hartree-Fock（计算Goldstone模色散）方法。

papers.title: Nonholonomic collective flows: velocity--orientation locking in a continuum with microstructure
papers.abstract: We develop a continuum theory for a fluid of elongated particles that advance along their own axes. The same kinematics is ideally shared by flocks of sheep, self-propelled rods, vehicular traffic, and turning flocks of birds. Within the framework of continua with vectorial microstructure, in which each point also carries an orientation, we impose the no-side-slip (skate) condition $\vv=u\,\nn$ as an ideal, non-integrable internal constraint. We derive the pure equations of motion and the equation governing the constraint reaction from the principle of virtual power. Using a constitutive closure provided by the Ericksen-Leslie theory of nematic liquid crystals, we show how the constraint also shapes collective effects. It turns parabolic orientational diffusion into hyperbolic orientation-density waves and forbids any steady simple shear. It fixes the empirical Toner-Tu convective coefficient to the flow-alignment ratio measured in colloidal rollers, thereby providing a mechanical foundation for angular sound in micropolar active hydrodynamics. It also recovers the inertial spin model of bird flocks, with the addition of a banking force and a turn-density coupling. Finally, it recovers the classical macroscopic models of one-dimensional traffic flow, while describing steering, lateral tyre forces, and road geometry in two dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“develop a continuum theory”“derive the pure equations of motion”“principle of virtual power”等理论推导关键词。；研究对象：具有矢量微结构的连续介质中的非完整集体流动，具体指沿自身轴向推进的细长粒子流体（如羊群、自驱动杆、车辆交通、转向鸟群），并借助向列液晶的Ericsson-Leslie理论进行本构闭合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将无侧滑（滑冰）条件作为理想非完整内约束引入连续介质理论后，该约束将抛物型取向扩散转变为双曲型取向-密度波，禁止稳态简单剪切，并将Toner-Tu对流系数固定为胶体滚子中测量的流动取向比，从而为微极活性流体中的角声学提供力学基础；同时可恢复鸟群的惯性自旋模型及一维交通流经典宏观模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将无侧滑（滑冰）条件作为理想非完整内约束引入连续介质理论后，该约束将抛物型取向扩散转变为双曲型取向-密度波，禁止稳态简单剪切，并将Toner-Tu对流系数固定为胶体滚子中测量的流动取向比，从而为微极活性流体中的角声学提供力学基础；同时可恢复鸟群的惯性自旋模型及一维交通流经典宏观模型。；创新点：将非完整约束（无侧滑条件）系统性地引入活性物质连续介质理论，统一解释了从胶体滚子到鸟群再到交通流的多种集体现象，并为Toner-Tu经验系数提供了力学推导基础。摘要未突出说明与以往非完整约束模型的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用带矢量微结构的连续介质力学框架，通过虚功率原理推导纯运动方程和约束反力方程；使用向列液晶的Ericsson-Leslie理论提供本构闭合；通过约束动力学分析集体效应（取向波、剪切禁止、Toner-Tu系数固定、惯性自旋模型恢复、交通流模型恢复）。

papers.title: Topological Signatures of Hardness and Structural Order in Network-Forming Materials
papers.abstract: Understanding how the topology of network forming materials influences their physical properties remains a longstanding challenge. Here, we investigate the topology of experimentally compatible atomistic models of amorphous silica together with the crystalline polymorphs cristobalite and quartz. By comparing multiple atomistic models of amorphous silica that equally reproduce neutron-scattering data, we show that different microscopic descriptions can imply different topological interpretations of glass stability. To characterize the network beyond conventional geometric descriptors, we introduce the linking valence, which quantifies the average number of topological links per network loop. This topological descriptor separates silica into two distinct classes: the mechanically harder quartz exhibit values more than an order of magnitude larger than those of amorphous silica and cristobalite, despite their common tetrahedral building blocks. Spectral analysis of the loop-linking networks provides a complementary distinction, separating amorphous from crystalline phases and revealing differences in the long-range organization of topological constraints. These results establish topological linking as a new framework for connecting the structure and physical properties of network-forming materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“atomistic models”（原子模型）、“topological descriptor”（拓扑描述符）、“spectral analysis”（谱分析），未涉及实验测量手段。；研究对象：网络形成材料（network-forming materials），具体为无定形二氧化硅（amorphous silica）及其晶体多形体方石英（cristobalite）和石英（quartz）。研究其网络拓扑结构与力学硬度、结构有序性之间的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 引入“连接价”（linking valence）这一拓扑描述符，可定量区分不同二氧化硅相：力学上更硬的石英其连接价数值比无定形二氧化硅和方石英高出一个数量级以上，尽管三者具有相同的四面体基本构筑单元。谱分析进一步区分了无定形与晶相，揭示了拓扑约束长程组织的差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：引入“连接价”（linking valence）这一拓扑描述符，可定量区分不同二氧化硅相：力学上更硬的石英其连接价数值比无定形二氧化硅和方石英高出一个数量级以上，尽管三者具有相同的四面体基本构筑单元。谱分析进一步区分了无定形与晶相，揭示了拓扑约束长程组织的差异。；创新点：首次将拓扑链接（topological linking）概念引入网络形成材料的结构-物性关联框架，证明不同微观模型即使同样复现散射数据，也可能给出不同的玻璃稳定性拓扑解释；连接价作为超越传统几何描述符的新工具，能直接区分力学硬度差异。
papers.method_zh: 对与中子散射实验数据一致的多组无定形二氧化硅原子模型进行比较分析；引入“连接价”（每个网络环的平均拓扑连接数）作为新拓扑描述符；对环-环连接网络进行谱分析（spectral analysis）。摘要未明确说明具体计算软件或理论级别（如DFT、经典分子动力学等）。

papers.title: Crystal-phase quantum dots in AlGaAs nanowires
papers.abstract: Crystal-phase quantum dots (CPQDs)$\unicode{x2014}$quantum dots in nanowires defined by crystal structure rather than material composition$\unicode{x2014}$constitute the only platform capable of fabricating quantum-dot arrays with the ultimate precision of a single atomic layer. This intrinsic control yields perfectly aligned quantum dots with atomically sharp interfaces, providing a unique pathway toward scalable quantum-dot-based photonic quantum technologies. To date, CPQDs have been studied primarily in binary semiconductors, such as InP and GaAs, where their emission linewidths are typically in the meV range, thereby limiting their technological potential. Here, we report, for the first time, CPQDs in AlGaAs nanowires and show bright single-photon emission with linewidths as narrow as 61 $μeV$ and low background emission, demonstrating optical quality well beyond typical CPQDs. We attribute this performance to a type-I band alignment, as suggested by an exciton lifetime of 1 ns, significantly shorter than that typically observed in type-II CPQDs. Additionally, we observe an exciton fine-structure splitting and a Zeeman splitting, as commonly observed in standard type-I self-assembled quantum dots.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we report”“we observe”，涉及单光子发射、激子寿命、精细结构劈裂等实验测量。；研究对象：AlGaAs纳米线中的晶相量子点（Crystal-phase quantum dots, CPQDs），即由晶体结构而非材料组分定义的一维纳米线量子点体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 首次在AlGaAs纳米线中实现晶相量子点，展现出亮度高、线宽窄至61 μeV的单光子发射，光学质量显著优于典型的二元半导体CPQDs；激子寿命约1 ns，表明其为I型能带对齐，并观察到激子精细结构劈裂和塞曼劈裂。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：首次在AlGaAs纳米线中实现晶相量子点，展现出亮度高、线宽窄至61 μeV的单光子发射，光学质量显著优于典型的二元半导体CPQDs；激子寿命约1 ns，表明其为I型能带对齐，并观察到激子精细结构劈裂和塞曼劈裂。；创新点：首次将晶相量子点平台从二元半导体（InP、GaAs）拓展到三元合金AlGaAs，并实现远超典型CPQDs的窄线宽（61 μeV）单光子发射，证明该体系具备I型能带结构，向可扩展光子量子技术迈出关键一步。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体生长与表征手段，但可推断涉及纳米线外延生长（如分子束外延或金属有机气相外延）以及微区光致发光光谱、时间分辨荧光寿命测量、偏振分辨光谱和磁场下的光谱测量（用于观察精细结构劈裂与塞曼劈裂）。

papers.title: Work Function and High-Coverage Adsorption Energy as Hydrogen-Evolution Descriptors on Ag-Au-Pd-Pt Alloys
papers.abstract: Hydrogen-evolution activity is commonly rationalized through hydrogen adsorption energies and the Sabatier principle, yet this descriptor picture becomes ambiguous on multimetallic surfaces, where each composition exposes a distribution of local adsorption environments. Here we investigate whether the bare-surface work function, previously shown to add predictive information for monometallic surfaces, remains an activity descriptor for compositionally complex surfaces. We test this on three combinatorial Ag-Au-Pd-Pt thin-film materials libraries screened for acidic hydrogen evolution by scanning electrochemical cell microscopy. Graph neural networks provide adsorption-energy distributions and work functions for each measured composition. A work-function-only model explained most of the activity variation (mean $R^2_\mathrm{log}$ = 0.903), as did a coverage-corrected adsorption model (mean $R^2_\mathrm{log}$ = 0.955), outperforming dilute adsorption (mean $R^2_\mathrm{log}$ = 0.758). Combining work function and coverage-corrected adsorption yielded the highest fit quality (mean $R^2_\mathrm{log}$ = 0.969), but only a small gain over coverage-corrected adsorption alone. For these four metals the coverage-corrected adsorption energy and work function follow a similar trend, producing similar activity rankings, hence including both adds little beyond either one individually, although both are strong predictors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要提及“thin-film materials libraries screened for acidic hydrogen evolution by scanning electrochemical cell microscopy”（实验筛选）以及“Graph neural networks provide adsorption-energy distributions and work functions”（图神经网络计算）。；研究对象：Ag-Au-Pd-Pt 四元合金薄膜（组合材料库）表面的酸性析氢反应（hydrogen evolution reaction, HER）活性，以及功函数和高覆盖吸附能作为活性描述符的有效性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Ag-Au-Pd-Pt 合金表面上，裸表面功函数和高覆盖（coverage-corrected）氢吸附能均可作为强效的析氢活性描述符（单独使用平均 R²_log 分别为 0.903 和 0.955），两者结合时拟合质量最高（平均 R²_log = 0.969），但相比单独使用高覆盖吸附能提升很小，因为这两种描述符在该四元合金体系中趋势相似。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Ag-Au-Pd-Pt 合金表面上，裸表面功函数和高覆盖（coverage-corrected）氢吸附能均可作为强效的析氢活性描述符（单独使用平均 R²_log 分别为 0.903 和 0.955），两者结合时拟合质量最高（平均 R²_log = 0.969），但相比单独使用高覆盖吸附能提升很小，因为这两种描述符在该四元合金体系中趋势相似。；创新点：首次系统检验了功函数作为成分复杂（多金属）合金表面的析氢活性描述符的适用性，并引入高覆盖吸附能修正，量化了其与功函数在四元合金中的冗余性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用扫描电化学池显微镜（SECCM）对组合薄膜材料库进行酸性析氢活性筛选；计算上使用图神经网络（GNN）预测每种成分的吸附能分布和功函数。对比了三种描述符模型：仅功函数、稀释吸附能（dilute adsorption）、高覆盖吸附能（coverage-corrected adsorption），以及功函数与高覆盖吸附能的组合模型。

papers.title: Evidence for Three-component Interlayer Coherent Exciton Condensation
papers.abstract: Increasing the number of internal components in a quantum many-body system can host collective orders inaccessible to simpler settings. Quantum Hall bilayers provide a canonical realization of interlayer exciton condensation, yet extending such coherence across three independently addressable electronic fluids has remained elusive. Here we report evidence for three-component interlayer coherent exciton condensation in triple-layer graphene system. Using Rydberg excitons in an adjacent WSe2 monolayer as a layer-sensitive optical probe, we resolve interaction-induced incompressibility at zeroth-Landau-level crossings for all three pairwise layer combinations, establishing top-middle, middle-bottom and top-bottom exciton condensate channels within the same device. Independent control of displacement field and interlayer bias continuously tunes these pairwise states towards a regime where Landau levels from all three layers approach simultaneous degeneracy. At their convergence, incompressibility persists while the exciton energy and spectral weight evolve smoothly between the pairwise limits, suggesting coherent participation of all three layers in a single three-component state. More broadly, the ability to independently control layer potentials and engineer interlayer interactions establishes multilayer graphene as a programmable synthetic dimension for exploring higher-component quantum Hall order and simulating strongly correlated quantum matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：report evidence、optical probe、resolve、control。；研究对象：三层石墨烯体系中的三组分层间相干激子凝聚（three-component interlayer coherent exciton condensation），即量子霍尔双层体系中激子凝聚向三组分体系的扩展。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三层石墨烯体系中观测到三组分层间相干激子凝聚的证据：所有三对层组合（顶-中、中-底、顶-底）均出现相互作用诱导的不可压缩态，且在三层朗道能级同时简并的收敛点处，不可压缩性持续存在，激子能量和谱权重在成对极限之间平滑演化，表明三个层共同参与形成单一的三组分相干态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三层石墨烯体系中观测到三组分层间相干激子凝聚的证据：所有三对层组合（顶-中、中-底、顶-底）均出现相互作用诱导的不可压缩态，且在三层朗道能级同时简并的收敛点处，不可压缩性持续存在，激子能量和谱权重在成对极限之间平滑演化，表明三个层共同参与形成单一的三组分相干态。；创新点：首次在实验上实现并表征了三组分（而非仅两组分）的层间相干激子凝聚，将激子凝聚的组分维度从二扩展到三；同时展示了多层石墨烯作为可编程合成维度用于探索高组分量子霍尔序的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 利用相邻WSe2单层中的里德堡激子作为层敏感的光学探针，测量零朗道能级交叉处的相互作用诱导不可压缩性；通过独立控制位移场和层间偏压来调节各层势能和层间相互作用。

papers.title: Nucleation and propagation of brittle fracture as a constrained energy minimization problem
papers.abstract: This paper presents a macroscopic, or continuum, theory aimed at describing when, where, and why cracks nucleate and propagate in nominally elastic brittle materials under monotonic, quasi-static, but otherwise arbitrary mechanical loads. Motivated by recent insights, the proposed sharp theory posits that: \emph{cracks nucleate and propagate exclusively in regions where the strength surface of the material is exceeded, with their evolution dictated by the minimization of the sum of the potential --- the elastic energy minus the work done by the externally applied forces --- and surface energies.} While the theory applies to materials with any elasticity (linear or nonlinear) and any material symmetry (isotropic or anisotropic), attention is restricted here to the most basic case of isotropic elastic brittle materials. For demonstration purposes, the theory is confronted with a set of nine tests that span the entire range of well-settled experimental knowledge on fracture nucleation and propagation --- the so-called ``Nine Circles of Elastic Brittle Fracture'' --- on both a hard material (a silicate glass) and a soft material (a synthetic rubber).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确说明“presents a macroscopic, or continuum, theory”，属于连续介质理论建模。；研究对象：名义弹性脆性材料（包括硬材料如硅酸盐玻璃和软材料如合成橡胶）中裂纹的成核与扩展行为，即脆性断裂的物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 裂纹仅在材料强度面被超过的区域成核和扩展，其演化由势能（弹性能减去外力功）与表面能之和的最小化决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：裂纹仅在材料强度面被超过的区域成核和扩展，其演化由势能（弹性能减去外力功）与表面能之和的最小化决定。；创新点：提出一个统一的宏观连续理论，同时描述裂纹“何时、何处、为何”成核与扩展，并将成核条件（强度面）与扩展准则（能量最小化）纳入同一变分框架；摘要未突出说明与既有相场或格里菲斯理论的定量对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用尖锐界面（sharp）连续介质理论框架，将断裂问题表述为受约束的能量最小化问题；适用于任意线弹性或非线性弹性及任意材料对称性，但本文具体限制在各向同性弹性脆性材料情形。通过九组覆盖断裂成核与扩展全部成熟实验知识的测试（“弹性脆性断裂的九环”）进行验证。

papers.title: A Generalized Model for Disordered Random Sequential Adsorption with Charge-Dependent Deposition
papers.abstract: We generalize a one-dimensional random sequential adsorption model (RSA) of charged unit segments in which the deposition position follows a beta kernel determined by the charges bounding the available gap and those of the incoming particle. The interaction parameter \(0\leqλ<1\) interpolates between uniform car parking and strongly localized deposition. We derive a four component generating function equation that provides exact recursions for the complete occupation statistics, although only the mean and variance are analyzed in detail here. Exact finite-shell solutions serve as benchmarks for the Gauss--Jacobi quadrature and Monte Carlo simulations. We prove that, although boundary charges affect finite size behavior, the four boundary states have the same asymptotic mean and variance densities, consequently, we prove that the jammed density is self-averaging. Numerical results show that charge selectivity increases the coverage, especially for mixtures dominated by opposite endpoint charges, which also exhibit strongly reduced fluctuations near \(λ=1\). The model provides a tractable connection between uniform RSA, dynamically generated disorder, and interaction-driven deposition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“generating function equation”“exact recursions”“Gauss–Jacobi quadrature and Monte Carlo simulations”等理论推导与数值模拟方法，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：一维带电单元段的无序随机顺序吸附（RSA）模型，具体为沉积位置由间隙两端电荷与入射粒子电荷共同决定的β核函数所控制的带电粒子吸附体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电荷选择性可提高最终覆盖密度，尤其在由相反端点电荷主导的混合物中效果显著，且该体系在λ接近1时涨落大幅降低；同时证明了四种边界态在渐近极限下具有相同的平均与方差密度，即堵塞密度具有自平均性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电荷选择性可提高最终覆盖密度，尤其在由相反端点电荷主导的混合物中效果显著，且该体系在λ接近1时涨落大幅降低；同时证明了四种边界态在渐近极限下具有相同的平均与方差密度，即堵塞密度具有自平均性。；创新点：将均匀停车问题与动态生成的无序及相互作用驱动的沉积过程统一到一个可解析处理的广义模型中，并严格证明了边界电荷不影响渐近堵塞密度的自平均性质。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：建立四组分生成函数方程，给出完整占据统计的精确递推关系；数值方法：采用Gauss–Jacobi求积与蒙特卡洛模拟，并以精确有限壳层解作为基准验证。

papers.title: Phenomenological Growth Regimes in Liquid-Precursor CVD of MoS$_2$ on Functional Substrates
papers.abstract: The integration of two-dimensional transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) onto functional substrates remains constrained by stochastic vapor-phase growth dynamics. Here, we show that liquid-phase precursor chemical vapor deposition (CVD) of MoS$_2$ introduces growth conditions that are consistent with a substrate-influenced reaction-diffusion process. By utilizing pre-growth spin-coated MoO$_3$ intermediates across a diverse crystalline library (sapphire, SrTiO$_3$, rutile TiO$_2$, MgO, and 6H-SiC), we find that substrate-dependent variations in precursor wetting, surface chemistry, and inferred mass-transport constraints correlate with distinct growth morphologies. These substrate-dependent growth regimes are interpreted in terms of reduced effective lateral growth length on SrTiO$_3$, possible precursor anchoring on TiO$_2$, likely chemical surface restructuring on MgO, and possible step-edge growth on SiC. Raman and photoluminescence spectroscopy reveal substrate-dependent variations in vibrational and optical response that correlate with differences in strain, charge environment, and dielectric screening. Ultimately, this work highlights a substrate-dependent reaction-diffusion framework as a potentially useful route for tuning the structural and optical properties of large-area 2D materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“utilizing pre-growth spin-coated MoO₃ intermediates”“Raman and photoluminescence spectroscopy”等实验手段。；研究对象：MoS₂二维过渡金属硫化物（TMDC）在多种功能衬底（蓝宝石、SrTiO₃、金红石TiO₂、MgO、6H-SiC）上的液相前驱体化学气相沉积（CVD）生长过程，以及衬底依赖的生长形貌与光学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MoS₂的液相前驱体CVD生长行为可被描述为衬底影响的反应-扩散过程，不同衬底上的前驱体润湿性、表面化学和质量输运约束差异导致截然不同的生长形貌，并伴随应变、电荷环境和介电屏蔽相关的光谱响应变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MoS₂的液相前驱体CVD生长行为可被描述为衬底影响的反应-扩散过程，不同衬底上的前驱体润湿性、表面化学和质量输运约束差异导致截然不同的生长形貌，并伴随应变、电荷环境和介电屏蔽相关的光谱响应变化。；创新点：提出了一个衬底依赖的反应-扩散框架，将液相前驱体CVD中衬底化学/润湿性/质量输运与生长形貌及光学性质系统关联，为在大面积二维材料中调控结构与光学性能提供了新思路。摘要未突出说明与以往CVD生长研究的定量对比或具体机制验证。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法包括：旋涂MoO₃中间层作为液相前驱体进行CVD生长；在五种不同晶格衬底（蓝宝石、SrTiO₃、TiO₂、MgO、6H-SiC）上进行系统生长；使用拉曼光谱和光致发光光谱表征振动与光学响应。

papers.title: Nanolamellar Hybrid High-Entropy Alloys with Superior Micromechanical Properties
papers.abstract: Metallic materials with nanolamellar structures, such as pearlitic steels, exhibit high strength with appropriate ductility. Considering the potential ability of such nanolamellar structures to break the traditional strength-ductility trade-off in metallic alloys, this study aims at developing a unique nanolamellar structure with superior micromechanical properties by combining two different high-entropy alloys (HEAs). Al0.1CoCrFeNi with the face-centered cubic (FCC) structure is combined with TiZrHfNbTa with the body-centered cubic (BCC) structure using high-pressure torsion (HPT) of half discs of each alloy. That way, a layered hybrid structure was formed, with layer thickness down to about 61 nm. The BCC/FCC nanolamellar hybrid structure exhibits an exceptional combination of properties with an ultimate tensile strength of 2.4 GPa, a maximum bending strength of 4.0 GPa, and a hardness of 740 Hv, while retaining some ductility/plasticity under both tensile and bending loads. Detailed analyses by synchrotron diffraction, electron microscopy and atom probe tomography suggests that these high strength and hardness, which are superior to those of nanostructured HEAs, result from: (i) extreme grain boundary strengthening from nanograins with a mean size of 22 nm, (ii) presence of defects such as dislocations in FCC and BCC, stacking faults in FCC and twins in FCC, and (iii) interphase hardening from BCC/FCC nanolamellar boundaries with about 30% contribution to the total hardness. This work demonstrates that combining two HEAs using HPT into a defect-rich hybrid nanolamellar composite forms a promising synergy of ultrahigh strength and reasonable ductility/plasticity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用高圧扭转（HPT）实验制备样品，并采用同步辐射衍射、电子显微镜、原子探针断层扫描等实验表征手段。；研究对象：由两种高熵合金（FCC结构的Al0.1CoCrFeNi与BCC结构的TiZrHfNbTa）通过高压扭转（HPT）复合形成的BCC/FCC纳米层状混合高熵合金。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: BCC/FCC纳米层状混合结构实现了超高强度与一定塑性的优异组合：极限拉伸强度2.4 GPa、最大弯曲强度4.0 GPa、硬度740 Hv，同时保持一定的拉伸和弯曲塑性。其强化机制包括纳米晶界强化（平均晶粒22 nm）、缺陷强化（位错、层错、孪晶）以及BCC/FCC相界强化（约贡献总硬度的30%）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：BCC/FCC纳米层状混合结构实现了超高强度与一定塑性的优异组合：极限拉伸强度2.4 GPa、最大弯曲强度4.0 GPa、硬度740 Hv，同时保持一定的拉伸和弯曲塑性。其强化机制包括纳米晶界强化（平均晶粒22 nm）、缺陷强化（位错、层错、孪晶）以及BCC/FCC相界强化（约贡献总硬度的30%）。；创新点：首次将两种不同晶体结构的高熵合金通过HPT结合，制备出层厚低至约61 nm的缺陷富集型BCC/FCC纳米层状混合复合材料，打破了传统强度-塑性权衡，其强度与硬度优于纳米结构高熵合金。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：高压扭转（HPT）将两种高熵合金半圆片复合制备纳米层状结构；同步辐射衍射、电子显微镜、原子探针断层扫描（APT）进行微观结构表征；拉伸和弯曲力学测试评估力学性能。

papers.title: Rapid Charge Stability Diagram Generation from Device-level Modeling of Semiconductor Quantum Dots
papers.abstract: Self-consistent Schrödinger-Poisson calculations are a powerful tool for predicting the behavior of layered semiconductor quantum dot devices. However, characterization of charge stability diagrams through fully simulated gate-voltage sweeps is computationally expensive. Combining a Multi-Domain Multi-Model (MDMM) approach with an automated tuning routine, we identify gate voltages associated with selected charge configurations. This small set of self-consistent simulations can be augmented with Full Configuration Interaction (FCI) energy calculations to extract charging energies, lever arms, and interdot Coulomb interactions to directly parameterize a Hubbard model for rapid charge stability diagram generation. For an Intel Tunnel Falls Si/SiGe device, we demonstrate the Hubbard model's ability to reproduce charge stability diagrams at a fraction of the computational cost in comparison to voltage bias sweeps. We further compare the simulated diagrams to experimental data and demonstrate qualitative agreement. Our result represents a step towards predictive digital twin models for semiconductor quantum dot devices. Finally, we apply this workflow towards lever arm engineering in a second device, demonstrating that the method extends to multiple architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Self-consistent Schrödinger-Poisson calculations”“Full Configuration Interaction (FCI) energy calculations”“Hubbard model”等理论计算方法，且全程未提及实验测量手段。；研究对象：半导体量子点器件，具体为Intel Tunnel Falls Si/SiGe器件，以及第二个用于杠杆臂工程（lever arm engineering）的器件。研究聚焦于量子点的电荷稳定性图（charge stability diagram）及其快速生成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合多域多模型（MDMM）方法与自动调谐例程，仅需少量自洽模拟即可参数化Hubbard模型，从而以远低于全电压扫描的计算成本快速生成电荷稳定性图，且与实验数据定性一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合多域多模型（MDMM）方法与自动调谐例程，仅需少量自洽模拟即可参数化Hubbard模型，从而以远低于全电压扫描的计算成本快速生成电荷稳定性图，且与实验数据定性一致。；创新点：提出了一种将器件级自洽模拟与Hubbard模型相结合的混合工作流，避免了全栅极电压扫描的高计算成本，实现了电荷稳定性图的快速生成，并展示了该方法向数字孪生模型（digital twin）发展的潜力，且可推广至多种器件架构。
papers.method_zh: 采用自洽薛定谔-泊松（Schrödinger-Poisson）计算，结合多域多模型（MDMM）方法；利用自动调谐例程识别特定电荷构型对应的栅极电压；使用全组态相互作用（FCI）计算提取充电能量、杠杆臂和量子点间库仑相互作用，用于参数化Hubbard模型；最终通过Hubbard模型生成电荷稳定性图。

papers.title: QUBO-Compatible Active Learning for Inverse Design of High-Entropy Alloys
papers.abstract: Machine-learned forward models can rapidly predict alloy properties, but their use for inverse design remains challenging when the search should also retain compatibility with quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO). Here, we develop a QUBO-compatible active-learning framework for inverse design of high-entropy alloys using a pretrained graph-neural-network predictor as a fixed property oracle. A property-guided binary variational autoencoder provides a binary latent representation, while an ensemble of quadratic factorization machines guides candidate selection. We systematically benchmark the framework through controlled latent-space ablations and comparison with direct composition-space optimization. The results show that candidate generation is a major determinant of search performance: local perturbations around previously high-performing latent codes provide the largest workflow-specific improvement, while surrogate-based selection further prioritizes candidates within the enriched search pool. The resulting QUBO-compatible workflow remains competitive with strong classical optimization strategies, although a composition-space genetic algorithm achieves the highest mean score. Finally, the learned quadratic surrogate can be exported directly as a QUBO. These results show that effective data acquisition can be separated from the final QUBO optimization endpoint, providing a benchmarked route for QUBO-compatible data-driven materials inverse design.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/算法研究文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“machine-learned forward models”“graph-neural-network predictor”“binary variational autoencoder”“quadratic factorization machines”等机器学习与优化算法关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：高熵合金（High-Entropy Alloys）的逆向设计问题，具体关注在满足二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）约束条件下的材料成分搜索与优化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 候选生成策略是决定QUBO兼容逆向设计搜索性能的关键因素：对先前高表现潜码进行局部扰动能带来最大的工作流性能提升；该QUBO兼容工作流与强经典优化策略竞争力相当，但成分空间遗传算法取得了最高平均得分。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：候选生成策略是决定QUBO兼容逆向设计搜索性能的关键因素：对先前高表现潜码进行局部扰动能带来最大的工作流性能提升；该QUBO兼容工作流与强经典优化策略竞争力相当，但成分空间遗传算法取得了最高平均得分。；创新点：提出了一种将主动学习与QUBO兼容性相结合的高熵合金逆向设计框架，并证明了数据采集（候选生成与筛选）可以与最终的QUBO优化端点分离，从而为QUBO兼容的数据驱动材料逆向设计提供了可基准化的路线。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新点。
papers.method_zh: 使用预训练的图神经网络（GNN）预测器作为固定属性预言机（oracle）；采用属性引导的二元变分自编码器（binary variational autoencoder）提供二元潜表示；使用二次因子分解机（quadratic factorization machines）集成指导候选选择；通过受控潜空间消融实验和与直接成分空间优化的对比进行系统基准测试。

papers.title: Interplay between crystal structure and magnetism in CeCrB$_4$
papers.abstract: CeCrB$_4$ belongs to the family of MTB$_4$ ternary metal borides, some of whose magnetic phases have recently been identified as quantum spin dimers. Employing density functional theory within the GGA+$U$ framework, this work investigates the key ground-state properties of this system, including its ferromagnetic ground state, the mixed-valence nature of cerium, and the charge transfer from the cationic cerium--chromium layers to the anionic boron layers. In particular, we focus on elucidating the bonding mechanism within the structurally embedded Cr-Cr dimers. Specifically, we evaluate a previously proposed interpretation that the localized Cr $3d_{z^2}$ states are molecular-like bonding and antibonding states. The calculated dependence of the $3d_{z^2}$ electronic structure on the intra-dimer distance correlates with the level-splitting characteristics known for classical homonuclear diatomic molecules.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Employing density functional theory within the GGA+$U$ framework”（采用GGA+$U$框架下的密度泛函理论）。；研究对象：三元金属硼化物CeCrB$_4$，具体关注其晶体结构与磁性之间的关联，尤其是Cr-Cr二聚体内部的成键机制、铈的混合价态以及层间电荷转移。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CeCrB$_4$具有铁磁基态，铈呈混合价态，且阳离子Ce-Cr层向阴离子B层发生电荷转移；Cr-Cr二聚体内局域的Cr $3d_{z^2}$ 态表现为类分子成键/反键态，其能级劈裂随二聚体内原子间距的变化规律与经典同核双原子分子的能级劈裂特征一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CeCrB$_4$具有铁磁基态，铈呈混合价态，且阳离子Ce-Cr层向阴离子B层发生电荷转移；Cr-Cr二聚体内局域的Cr $3d_{z^2}$ 态表现为类分子成键/反键态，其能级劈裂随二聚体内原子间距的变化规律与经典同核双原子分子的能级劈裂特征一致。；创新点：对先前提出的“Cr $3d_{z^2}$ 态为类分子成键/反键态”这一解释进行了定量验证，通过计算展示其能级劈裂对二聚体间距的依赖关系与经典同核双原子分子行为相符，从而将凝聚态体系中的局域磁矩与分子轨道图像联系起来。
papers.method_zh: 采用GGA+$U$框架下的密度泛函理论（DFT+$U$）计算，分析电子结构、磁性基态、电荷转移以及Cr $3d_{z^2}$ 态随二聚体间距的演化。

papers.title: Quantum Geometric Origin of Nonlinear Current Induced Orbital Magnetization
papers.abstract: Electric generation of magnetization is a focus of condensed matter research, and has recently been advanced into the nonlinear regime. However, due to the nonlocal nature of orbital magnetism, how to properly formulate nonlinear current-induced orbital magnetization remains a fundamental challenge. Here, we develop the proper theory for this effect. This is based on the microscopic derivation of field-corrected orbital magnetic moment of a Bloch electron, a critical missing piece in the present theory. We show that the quantum geometric origin of this phenomenon lies in both the anomalous orbital polarizability and the Berry-connection polarizability, which often provide competing contributions. Combining our theory with first-principles calculations, we predict significant, experimentally accessible nonlinear orbital magnetization generated in strained bilayer graphene, monolayer 1T' $\mathrm{MoS_2}$ and $\mathrm{MoTe_2}$. Remarkably, nonlinear orbital magnetization can dominate over its spin counterpart in materials with topological band features, irrespective of the spin-orbit coupling strength.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含第一性原理计算）。判断依据：摘要中出现“microscopic derivation”“develop the proper theory”“first-principles calculations”等关键词，属于理论推导结合第一性原理计算，无实验测量描述。；研究对象：非线性电流诱导的轨道磁化（nonlinear current-induced orbital magnetization）现象，具体材料包括应变双层石墨烯、单层1T'相MoS₂和MoTe₂。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非线性电流诱导轨道磁化的量子几何起源同时来自反常轨道极化率（anomalous orbital polarizability）和Berry联络极化率（Berry-connection polarizability），二者常产生竞争性贡献；在具有拓扑能带特征的材料中，非线性轨道磁化可超越其自旋对应物，且与自旋-轨道耦合强度无关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非线性电流诱导轨道磁化的量子几何起源同时来自反常轨道极化率（anomalous orbital polarizability）和Berry联络极化率（Berry-connection polarizability），二者常产生竞争性贡献；在具有拓扑能带特征的材料中，非线性轨道磁化可超越其自旋对应物，且与自旋-轨道耦合强度无关。；创新点：填补了现有理论中“场修正轨道磁矩”这一关键缺失环节，首次给出非线性电流诱导轨道磁化的正确理论表述；并揭示其与拓扑能带特征相关的普适主导性。
papers.method_zh: 基于Bloch电子场修正轨道磁矩的微观推导，建立非线性电流诱导轨道磁化的完整理论框架；结合第一性原理计算（摘要未指明具体泛函或赝势类型）对候选材料进行预测。

papers.title: Two-dimensional quantum Griffith singularity in three-dimensional ZrN$_x$ superconducting films
papers.abstract: We report the experimental observation of two-dimensional (2D) quantum Griffiths singularity (QGS) in $\sim$200-nm-thick epitaxial ZrN$_x$ superconducting films. The films possess a rock-salt structure and are three-dimensional (3D) with respect to superconductivity. For each film with $x \gtrsim 1.30$, the low-temperature magnetoresistance isotherms under fields perpendicular and parallel to the film plane cross over at a broad magnetic field range independently rather than at a single crossing point. Despite the macroscopic 3D nature of the superconductivity, the magnetoresistance isotherms at selected adjacent temperatures follow the theoretical prediction of power-law scaling for 2D superconducting systems, rather than that for 3D systems. The effective critical exponent $zν$, obtained by analyzing the magnetoresistance isotherms using the 2D power-law scaling, increases with decreasing temperature and diverges as the quantum phase transition is approached. In addition, the resistivity data near the superconductor-insulator or superconductor-metal transitions obey an activated scaling form that describes the quantum phase transition of 2D superconducting systems governed by an infinite-randomness critical point. The QGS in the ZrN$_x$ films is attributed to quenched disorder induced by intrinsic defects, such as Zr vacancies and N interstitials, which creates spatially inhomogeneous superconducting rare regions. The dynamics of these rare regions, which may exhibit effective 2D characteristics near the quantum critical point, dominate the transport properties of the system near the quantum phase transition. Our results provide compelling evidence for the existence of QGS in 3D superconductors and highlight the crucial role of disorder-induced inhomogeneity in determining the critical behavior of quantum phase transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：experimental observation、magnetoresistance isotherms、resistivity data。；研究对象：约200 nm厚的岩盐结构外延ZrNₓ超导薄膜（x ≳ 1.30），以及其中在三维超导背景下出现的二维量子Griffiths奇异（QGS）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在宏观三维超导ZrNₓ薄膜中观测到了二维量子Griffiths奇异：低温柔磁电阻等温线遵循二维超导系统的幂律标度而非三维标度，有效临界指数zν随温度降低而发散，且超导-绝缘体/金属转变附近的电阻率满足无限随机临界点控制的激活标度形式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在宏观三维超导ZrNₓ薄膜中观测到了二维量子Griffiths奇异：低温柔磁电阻等温线遵循二维超导系统的幂律标度而非三维标度，有效临界指数zν随温度降低而发散，且超导-绝缘体/金属转变附近的电阻率满足无限随机临界点控制的激活标度形式。；创新点：首次在三维超导体中提供QGS存在的有力实验证据，表明即使超导在宏观上是三维的，无序诱导的稀有区域在量子临界点附近可表现出有效二维动力学并主导输运行为。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 对ZrNₓ外延薄膜进行低温柔磁电阻测量（磁场分别平行和垂直于膜面），利用二维幂律标度分析磁电阻等温线提取有效临界指数zν，并检验激活标度形式；结合薄膜的岩盐结构及缺陷化学（Zr空位、N间隙）讨论无序来源。

papers.title: Quantum thermodynamics near the border of a one-dimensional Bose gas
papers.abstract: We consider an ultracold Bose gas in a half-open potential well, otherwise confined to a quasi-one-dimensional geometry. The Bogoliubov equations for its elementary excitations are solved in the continuous spectrum to explore the particle and energy content near the edge of the gas, beyond the often applied local density approximation. In particular, gradients in the condensate density enhance density-dominated excitations in the border region. We discuss excess (missing) particles and their energy by comparing to suitable reference solutions for quasi-homogeneous systems. The density profile near the edge shows no Friedel oscillations, but a dipolar feature from the spill-out of thermally excited particles. The calculations are performed in the grand-canonical ensemble and in the thermodynamic limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：摘要中明确提到“Bogoliubov equations are solved in the continuous spectrum”，以及“calculations are performed in the grand-canonical ensemble and in the thermodynamic limit”，属于解析或数值求解理论模型的工作。；研究对象：准一维超冷玻色气体，具体为半开放势阱（half-open potential well）中、边界附近的量子热力学性质。关注的是气体边缘区域的粒子密度分布、能量含量以及元激发行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在气体边界区域，凝聚体密度的梯度会增强以密度涨落为主的激发；边界附近的密度剖面不出现Friedel振荡，而是呈现由热激发粒子溢出导致的偶极特征（dipolar feature）。同时，与准均匀参考系统相比，边界区域存在多余或缺失的粒子及其相应能量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在气体边界区域，凝聚体密度的梯度会增强以密度涨落为主的激发；边界附近的密度剖面不出现Friedel振荡，而是呈现由热激发粒子溢出导致的偶极特征（dipolar feature）。同时，与准均匀参考系统相比，边界区域存在多余或缺失的粒子及其相应能量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其新意在于：在连续谱中精确求解Bogoliubov方程，超越了局域密度近似，从而揭示了边界区域由密度梯度驱动的激发增强以及无Friedel振荡的偶极密度特征。
papers.method_zh: 在连续谱中求解Bogoliubov-de Gennes方程，用于描述元激发；采用巨正则系综并在热力学极限下进行计算；与准均匀系统的参考解进行对比，以量化边界区域的粒子与能量偏差；明确超越了常用的局域密度近似（LDA）。

papers.title: Proximity to Jamming Governs Acoustic Attenuation in Damped Packings
papers.abstract: We use particle-based numerical simulations to address a longstanding question regarding the origins of the linear frequency dependence of attenuation in fluid-saturated granular media. We study both the acoustic modes and wave propagation in damped, disordered particle packings. We calculate the damped vibrational modes of packings as a function of frequency, pressure, and grain-contact dissipation. The spatial structure and dissipation of these modes show a clear transition at a pressure-dependent critical frequency from viscous-like continuum behavior to more localized, scattering modes. We also measure how wavespeed and spatial attenuation rate depend on these same parameters. At the same critical frequency, wave propagation also shifts from coherent motion, where attenuation scales quadratically with frequency and linearly with contact damping, to much more incoherent particle-scale motion, where attenuation scales linearly with frequency and sublinearly with contact damping. All of these features, including the transition frequency, are consistent with a large collection of experimental data, which has not been explained by any framework based on grain-scale physics. We refer to this approach as ``Jammed-Network Scattering'' (JNS), and propose it as a grain-scale framework for understanding the acoustics of fluid-saturated granular media.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“particle-based numerical simulations”（基于粒子的数值模拟）。；研究对象：流体饱和颗粒介质（fluid-saturated granular media）中的声学衰减现象，具体研究阻尼无序颗粒堆积体（damped, disordered particle packings）中的振动模式与波传播。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在压力依赖的临界频率处，阻尼颗粒堆积体的振动模式与波传播从粘性类连续体行为（衰减随频率二次方、随接触阻尼线性变化）转变为局域化散射行为（衰减随频率线性、随接触阻尼亚线性变化），该转变与大量实验数据一致，据此提出“堵塞网络散射”（Jammed-Network Scattering, JNS）框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在压力依赖的临界频率处，阻尼颗粒堆积体的振动模式与波传播从粘性类连续体行为（衰减随频率二次方、随接触阻尼线性变化）转变为局域化散射行为（衰减随频率线性、随接触阻尼亚线性变化），该转变与大量实验数据一致，据此提出“堵塞网络散射”（Jammed-Network Scattering, JNS）框架。；创新点：首次提出一个基于颗粒尺度物理的框架（JNS），能够统一解释此前无法用颗粒尺度机制解释的大量实验数据中声学衰减的线性频率依赖及临界转变行为。
papers.method_zh: 采用粒子数值模拟，计算堆积体的阻尼振动模式（作为频率、压力和颗粒接触耗散的函数），并测量波速与空间衰减率对这些参数的依赖关系。

papers.title: Topological signatures in the curvature-induced energy response
papers.abstract: Relativistic effective field theory predicts a topological energy response to a gravitational field that appears at third order in spatial gradients. Here, we investigate how this response emerges in the nonrelativistic Haldane model using a microscopic lattice formulation of curvature-induced deformations. We find that the leading first-order energy response is nonuniversal and depends on the bond-resolved structure of the deformation; in particular, it vanishes for a symmetric modulation of the three nearest-neighbor hoppings. In contrast, the third-order response exhibits a discontinuity across the topological transition whose magnitude agrees with the relativistic gravitational Chern--Simons prediction. Thus, although the absolute response is nonuniversal, its third-order discontinuity is universal and retains a characteristic topological fingerprint beyond the relativistic limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“Relativistic effective field theory predicts”“microscopic lattice formulation”“investigate how this response emerges”，属于理论推导与模型计算。；研究对象：非相对论Haldane模型中的曲率诱导能量响应，具体研究空间梯度（曲率）形变下该模型的拓扑能量响应行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 曲率诱导的领头阶（一阶）能量响应是非普适的，依赖于形变的键分辨结构，在对称调制最近邻跃迁时为零；而三阶响应在拓扑相变处出现不连续，其幅度与相对论引力Chern–Simons预言一致，表明三阶不连续性是普适的拓扑指纹。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：曲率诱导的领头阶（一阶）能量响应是非普适的，依赖于形变的键分辨结构，在对称调制最近邻跃迁时为零；而三阶响应在拓扑相变处出现不连续，其幅度与相对论引力Chern–Simons预言一致，表明三阶不连续性是普适的拓扑指纹。；创新点：首次在非相对论晶格模型中验证了相对论引力Chern–Simons预言的拓扑能量响应，并揭示了一阶响应的非普适性与三阶响应普适性之间的区别，表明拓扑指纹可超越相对论极限存在。
papers.method_zh: 采用微观晶格模型（Haldane模型的晶格形变实现）对曲率诱导形变进行显式建模，结合相对论有效场论框架进行对比分析，计算能量响应的梯度展开各阶项。

papers.title: Light-induced atomic motion in ionic crystals
papers.abstract: Atomic motion in solids is conventionally driven by elastic collisions between ionizing particles and atoms, which transfer momentum and induce lattice displacements. In this work, we demonstrate a different mechanism for atomic displacement based on optical excitation of scintillating ionic crystals. Ionic crystals are unique systems because of the closed-shell electronic configuration of their constituent ions. In these materials, excitation above the band gap generates a hole that strongly distorts the lattice, resulting in the formation of a self-trapped hole (STH). The STH is Coulomb-attracted to the electron, thereby forming a self-trapped exciton (STE). Here, we demonstrate that in BaF2 - one of the fastest scintillators - the STE structure promotes the formation of long-lived electron and hole traps that persist in the lattice at room temperature. Such trapped electron-hole pairs occupy vacancy-interstitial fluorine pair positions, and can be created indiscernibly using optical or ionizing radiation excitation, as long as the STH is formed. Further, we demonstrate that it is possible to control the defect evolution with light. Selective optical stimulation of the trapped electrons or holes enables the regeneration of the STE at later times. This light-controlled defect engineering allows us to increase the yield of the STE signal appearing as optically stimulated luminescence (OSL) and to image the spatial distribution of the initial energy deposition, holding strong potential for ionizing-radiation detection. These findings provide a common framework underlying scintillation and OSL in ionic crystals of the fluorite structure, allowing for optical manipulation of atomic vacancies-interstitial pairs in similar systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中多次出现“demonstrate”“we demonstrate”“experimental”等表述，且涉及具体材料（BaF2）的光学激发与缺陷演化实验。；研究对象：离子晶体BaF2（氟化钡，一种快闪烁体）中由光激发诱导的原子位移、自陷激子（STE）形成、以及电子-空穴陷阱对的产生与光控演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在BaF2中，带隙以上光激发可形成自陷激子，其结构促进室温下长寿命的电子-空穴陷阱对（占据氟空位-间隙对位置）的生成；通过选择性光激发陷阱电子或空穴，可在后续时间再生自陷激子，从而实现对缺陷演化的光学控制，并增强光刺激发光（OSL）信号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在BaF2中，带隙以上光激发可形成自陷激子，其结构促进室温下长寿命的电子-空穴陷阱对（占据氟空位-间隙对位置）的生成；通过选择性光激发陷阱电子或空穴，可在后续时间再生自陷激子，从而实现对缺陷演化的光学控制，并增强光刺激发光（OSL）信号。；创新点：提出了一种不同于传统弹性碰撞的原子位移机制——基于光激发闪烁离子晶体中自陷激子形成来驱动原子位移；并展示了利用光对缺陷演化进行可控调节，从而将闪烁与OSL统一在同一物理框架下，实现对初始能量沉积空间分布的成像。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 光学激发实验（带隙以上光激发）、电离辐射激发对比实验、选择性光刺激陷阱电子/空穴、OSL信号测量与空间成像。摘要未明确提及具体光谱技术（如时间分辨荧光、热释光等）或理论计算方法。

papers.title: Field-tuned quasiparticles and electronic structure in heavy-fermion YbNi4P2
papers.abstract: We study the Fermi surface topology and quasiparticle properties in the heavy fermion compound YbNi4P2 at high magnetic fields using quantum oscillation measurements. We observe a large decrease of the quasiparticle mass with increasing field and demonstrate good qualitative agreement with the single-ion Kondo model. At the putative Lifshitz transition at 17 T, we observe a sudden change of quantum oscillation frequencies suggesting an abrupt change of the electronic structure and/or quasiparticle characteristics. Our results demonstrate the ability to tune the electronic structure and provide input for theoretical models of YbNi4P2 and correlated electron systems in high magnetic fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。依据：摘要明确提到“quantum oscillation measurements”（量子振荡测量），属于凝聚态物理实验手段。；研究对象：重费米子化合物 YbNi4P2，具体研究其在高磁场下的费米面拓扑和准粒子性质，以及疑似在17 T处发生的Lifshitz相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在YbNi4P2中，随磁场增强准粒子质量显著减小，与单离子Kondo模型定性一致；在约17 T处观测到量子振荡频率的突变，表明电子结构和/或准粒子特性发生突然变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在YbNi4P2中，随磁场增强准粒子质量显著减小，与单离子Kondo模型定性一致；在约17 T处观测到量子振荡频率的突变，表明电子结构和/或准粒子特性发生突然变化。；创新点：首次在高磁场下系统研究YbNi4P2的费米面与准粒子质量随场的演化，并直接观测到疑似Lifshitz相变处电子结构的突变，为高磁场下重费米子体系的电子结构调控提供了实验依据。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 高磁场下的量子振荡（quantum oscillation）测量，用于提取费米面拓扑和准粒子有效质量；实验结果与单离子Kondo模型进行定性比较。

papers.title: Geometry-Controlled Dynamic Tensiometry Resolves Intrinsic Surfactant Adsorption Kinetics
papers.abstract: At short times, interfacial tension depends on experimental geometry because surfactant transport to the interface depends on the mass-transfer conditions.A predictive description therefore requires more than a dynamic tension curve or a fitted adsorption constant: interfacial thermodynamics, diffusion, and adsorption kinetics must be identified separately. Here, we combine equilibrium and diffusion measurements with a microfluidic EDGE tensiometer that provides a nearly stationary interface and controlled micrometer-scale transport. Equilibrium properties and diffusion are determined independently, leaving adsorption kinetics as the key unknown. Dynamic tension is then calculated using a nonequilibrium thermodynamic description, without assuming instantaneous equilibrium between the adsorbed layer and the subsurface solution. For the nonionic surfactant C$_{10}$E$_{8}$, equilibrium thermodynamics and transport are independently constrained, and a single intrinsic adsorption rate constant describes several concentrations. We extend the framework to SDS by including electrostatic interactions and subsurface-concentration dynamics, capturing transient depletion and replenishment. Once thermodynamic, transport, and kinetic parameters are identified, the model predicts dynamic interfacial tension beyond the geometry and conditions used to determine them. The microfluidic EDGE tensiometer thus provides both a reliable short-time tensiometry method and a quantitative framework for identifying the physical mechanisms governing surfactant mass transfer at interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论建模）。判断依据：结合微流控EDGE张力计实验测量与“非平衡热力学描述”的理论计算。；研究对象：表面活性剂（非离子型C₁₀E₈和离子型SDS）在界面上的吸附动力学，以及动态界面张力与传质过程的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将平衡热力学、扩散和吸附动力学分别独立确定，仅用一个本征吸附速率常数即可描述非离子表面活性剂C₁₀E₈在不同浓度下的动态界面张力；该框架还能扩展至离子型SDS，并预测超出测量几何和条件下的动态界面张力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将平衡热力学、扩散和吸附动力学分别独立确定，仅用一个本征吸附速率常数即可描述非离子表面活性剂C₁₀E₈在不同浓度下的动态界面张力；该框架还能扩展至离子型SDS，并预测超出测量几何和条件下的动态界面张力。；创新点：将界面热力学、扩散和吸附动力学三者分离并独立约束，避免了传统动态张力曲线拟合中参数耦合的模糊性；建立了可跨几何和条件预测的定量框架，而非仅拟合单一曲线。
papers.method_zh: 微流控EDGE张力计（提供近静止界面和受控微米尺度传质）；独立测量平衡界面性质与扩散系数；采用非平衡热力学理论计算动态张力，不假设吸附层与次表面溶液瞬时平衡；对SDS引入静电相互作用和次表面浓度动力学。

papers.title: Charge transfer and competing symmetry breaking drive orbital reconstruction and emergent ferromagnetism in insulating oxide superlattices
papers.abstract: Electron correlation, hopping, and ligand-to-metal charge transfer collectively lead to diverse electronic and magnetic phenomena in 3$d$ transition-metal oxides, where directional d orbitals make hopping highly sensitive to symmetry-dependent orbital overlap. Heterostructure engineering with atomically flat interfaces adds symmetry-breaking charge transfer as a further route to emergent behavior, yet whether interfacial mismatch between constituent oxides of a superlattice shapes ground states independent of epitaxial strain remains unresolved. Here we examine superlattices combining NdNiO$_3$ with Mott-insulating NdMnO$_3$. Varying layer thickness and combining transport with X-ray spectroscopy, we show that electron transfer from NdMnO$_3$ to NdNiO$_3$ drives a room-temperature insulating state with a distinct electronic structure, accompanied by a reversal in orbital symmetry beyond simple strain considerations, underscoring the interface's central role. These reconstructions stabilize an emergent ferromagnetic insulating state arising from interfacial Ni$^{2+}$-O-Mn$^{4+}$ superexchange. Our results establish a pathway to interface-engineered ferromagnetic insulating phases via competing interactions, with potential for spin-insulatronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要提及“combining transport with X-ray spectroscopy”（输运测量与X射线谱学结合），以及“Varying layer thickness”（改变层厚）等实验操作。；研究对象：NdNiO₃/NdMnO₃ 氧化物超晶格，具体研究界面电荷转移、轨道重构以及由此诱导的室温绝缘态和铁磁绝缘态。
