papers.title: Coupled anisotropic weak topological states and Floquet mixed-parity altermagnetism in two-dimensional Su-Schrieffer-Heeger models
papers.abstract: Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) topological systems and altermagnetic (AM) states are two important research areas in condensed matter physics. Realizing the coupled states between the SSH lattices and AM phanse in a single syetem remains challenging. However, the Floquet engineering change it. Our work constructs five two-dimensional-(2D-) SSH models to describe the coupled phases of SSH weak topological state and AM order by tight-binding (TB) method. The evolution of band structures, spin-splitting, and topological phase transitions under the circularly polarized light (CPL) and relative atomic displacement (RAD) in 2D SSH lattices were systematically investigated. The results reveal that the inequality of hopping parameters (t1 and t2) serves as the fundamental origin of SSH topological states and AM order. For the 2D nonmagnetic state, anisotropic weak topological states with Zak phase governed edge states are realized by unit cell selection, similar to the conventional 1D SSH model. The collinear antiferromagnetic state preserves the spin-degenerate band structure and intrinsic weak topological properties. Furthermore, the Floquet engineering introduces the AM phase of odd-parity p-wave while the RAD introduces the AM phase of even-parity d-wave. By combining the two effects, the mixed-parity (non-odd/non-even parity) AM phase could be realized, achieving the simultaneous control of the light field of spin-splitting and topological edge states. The physical mechanisms of Floquet engineering and RAD for the 2D rectangular SSH lattice are also from the inequality of t1 and t2, which can be not only fully understand by the TB methods, but also in good agreement with the first-principle calculations of 2D carbon-based materials. This work establishes an effective theoretical platform for coupling anisotropic SSH weak topological states and AM orders with multi-parities in 2D systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“tight-binding (TB) method”、“systematically investigated”以及“in good agreement with the first-principle calculations”，属于紧束缚模型与第一性原理计算相结合的理论计算工作。；研究对象：二维Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) 模型中的耦合各向异性弱拓扑态与Floquet混合宇称交错磁（altermagnetism, AM）序。具体为二维矩形SSH晶格体系，并涉及二维碳基材料的第一性原理验证。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二维SSH模型中，跳跃参数的不相等（t1≠t2）是SSH拓扑态与交错磁序的共同物理根源；通过Floquet工程（圆偏振光）与相对原子位移（RAD）的协同作用，可在同一体系中实现混合宇称（非奇/非偶）的交错磁相，并同时调控自旋劈裂与拓扑边缘态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二维SSH模型中，跳跃参数的不相等（t1≠t2）是SSH拓扑态与交错磁序的共同物理根源；通过Floquet工程（圆偏振光）与相对原子位移（RAD）的协同作用，可在同一体系中实现混合宇称（非奇/非偶）的交错磁相，并同时调控自旋劈裂与拓扑边缘态。；创新点：首次在单一二维SSH体系中实现了SSH弱拓扑态与交错磁序的耦合，并通过Floquet工程与RAD的组合实现了混合宇称（p波与d波混合）的交错磁相，建立了可同时调控自旋劈裂与拓扑边缘态的理论平台。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 紧束缚（TB）方法构建五个二维SSH模型；系统计算能带结构、自旋劈裂及拓扑相变随圆偏振光（CPL）和相对原子位移（RAD）的演化；结合Zak相位分析边缘态；并与二维碳基材料的第一性原理计算结果进行对比验证。

papers.title: The heavy Fermi polaron I: the Lithium-Cesium experiment
papers.abstract: We present details of an experimental platform for studying Fermi polarons in a quantum-gas mixture. The system consists of about a thousand bosonic $^{133}$Cs impurities immersed in a deeply degenerate Fermi gas ($T/T_F \sim 0.2$) of approximately $2\times 10^5$ $^6$Li atoms in a single hyperfine state, with interspecies interactions tunable via a Feshbach resonance. Using optical Raman spectroscopy without relative momentum transfer, we perform injection spectroscopy and thereby create the Fermi polaron. Owing to the large mass imbalance between the two species, the setup provides access to previously unexplored regimes of Fermi polarons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述“experimental platform”“injection spectroscopy”等实验手段。；研究对象：费米极化子（Fermi polaron），具体体系为约1000个玻色性¹³³Cs杂质原子浸入约2×10⁵个深简并⁶Li费米气体（T/T_F ~ 0.2，单一超精细态）中的量子气体混合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该实验平台利用大质量失配的Li-Cs混合物，通过光学拉曼注入谱学成功制备费米极化子，从而进入此前未探索的费米极化子参数区间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该实验平台利用大质量失配的Li-Cs混合物，通过光学拉曼注入谱学成功制备费米极化子，从而进入此前未探索的费米极化子参数区间。；创新点：利用¹³³Cs与⁶Li之间极大的质量失配，使该平台能够进入此前无法触及的费米极化子新参数区域。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：Feshbach共振调节种间相互作用；光学拉曼光谱（无相对动量转移）进行注入谱学（injection spectroscopy）以产生费米极化子。

papers.title: Grain Boundary Phase Transitions Enable Diffusionless Climb of Disconnections
papers.abstract: Dislocation-grain boundary (GB) interactions govern the mechanical response of polycrystalline materials by controlling dislocation absorption, transmission, and interfacial plasticity. While disconnection climb is conventionally understood to require the absorption or emission of point defects supplied through long range bulk diffusion, GBs possess intrinsic configurational degrees of freedom associated with their atomic structure, or microstate, that may provide an alternative mechanism. Here, using bicrystallography and molecular dynamics simulations, we investigate the interaction of shear dislocation loops with the [1 1 0](-5 5 14) symmetric tilt grain boundary in Al. We show that dislocation absorption generates a mobile extrinsic disconnection with a nonzero climb component that propagates conservatively along the interface without long-range bulk point-defect transport. Its motion is accompanied by a localized GB phase transformation mediated by cooperative atomic rearrangements within the GB core, producing successive metastable GB microstates. These findings establish a direct coupling between lattice dislocations and GB phase evolution and reveal a conservative mechanism for disconnection climb fundamentally distinct from conventional vacancy-mediated climb.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/模拟文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“bicrystallography and molecular dynamics simulations”（双晶学与分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：铝（Al）中的[1 1 0](-5 5 14)对称倾斜晶界，以及位错环与晶界相互作用导致的界面塑性行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 位错吸收产生的可移动外禀位错（disconnection）具有非零攀移分量，但无需长程体扩散输运点缺陷即可沿界面保守传播；其运动伴随晶界局域相变，通过原子协同重排产生一系列亚稳态晶界微态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：位错吸收产生的可移动外禀位错（disconnection）具有非零攀移分量，但无需长程体扩散输运点缺陷即可沿界面保守传播；其运动伴随晶界局域相变，通过原子协同重排产生一系列亚稳态晶界微态。；创新点：揭示了晶格位错与晶界相演化之间的直接耦合，提出了一种与传统的空位介导攀移根本不同的保守型位错攀移机制——即通过晶界微态转变实现无扩散攀移。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 双晶学（bicrystallography）几何分析 + 分子动力学（MD）模拟，具体研究剪切位错环与Al中[1 1 0](-5 5 14)对称倾斜晶界的相互作用。

papers.title: 3D Cloud Component Analysis of Atomic Structures
papers.abstract: We present a method for decomposing atomic structures into physically meaningful components by converting discrete atomic coordinates into continuous three-dimensional density fields. Each element is represented by a Gaussian-smeared density map with values ranging from 0 to 1, computed efficiently through a bin-then-blur approach with periodic boundary conditions. The sum of all element densities, truncated at unity, defines the material region; its complement defines the vacuum. Every voxel is first assigned a chemical formula from the set of elements present above a threshold; the resulting formula map is then cleaned so that only regions with a genuine bulk interior-measured by the Euclidean distance to their own boundary-survive as components. Thin surface terminations (e.g., a Ga monolayer on GaAs) and one-to-two-voxel boundary layers between two crystals are absorbed by the neighboring stable region, so the decomposition contains exactly the bulk-like chemical-formula components and the vacuum, with no surface or interface components. For each component we determine the crystal phase with a neural prototype classifier: one phase if the trusted interior atoms vote unanimously, two phases (e.g., crystalline and amorphous Si) if they split into two confident groups, in which case the component is divided into two. Interfaces and surfaces are then derived as boundaries-material-material and material-vacuum-and every atom is labeled bulk, surface, interface, or vertex, with vertex reserved for geometric corners of a component. Inside crystalline components, inner defects are detected from coordination-number and local-density deviations. We demonstrate the approach on Si/GaAs and Si/SiO2 heterojunctions, crystalline/amorphous silicon junctions, vacancy-containing crystals, and bulk crystals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/方法类文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“将离散原子坐标转换为连续三维密度场”“通过bin-then-blur方法高效计算”“神经网络原型分类器”等计算分析方法，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：原子结构的三维组分分解方法，应用于多种材料体系：Si/GaAs异质结、Si/SiO2异质结、晶体/非晶硅界面、含空位晶体以及块体晶体。核心物理对象是原子结构的化学组分、晶体相、界面/表面/体相/顶点分类以及内部缺陷。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种将原子结构分解为“体相化学式组分+真空”的方法，能够自动消除表面薄层和晶界边界层，使分解结果不含表面或界面组分；并通过神经网络分类器识别晶体相（如晶体/非晶硅可被分为两相），进而从组分边界导出界面和表面，标记每个原子为体相、表面、界面或顶点，并在晶体组分内检测内部缺陷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种将原子结构分解为“体相化学式组分+真空”的方法，能够自动消除表面薄层和晶界边界层，使分解结果不含表面或界面组分；并通过神经网络分类器识别晶体相（如晶体/非晶硅可被分为两相），进而从组分边界导出界面和表面，标记每个原子为体相、表面、界面或顶点，并在晶体组分内检测内部缺陷。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与传统结构分解方法（如基于原子坐标的团簇分析或Wigner-Seitz划分）相比的具体优势，但核心新意在于：将原子结构转化为连续密度场后，以“体相内部”的几何判据（欧氏距离）自动吸收表面单层和晶界薄层，使分解结果天然不含表面/界面组分，并利用神经网络对组分进行晶体相分类，实现原子级别的体相/表面/界面/顶点标注及内部缺陷检测。
papers.method_zh: 具体方法包括：(1) 将每种元素表示为高斯涂抹的密度图（值域0–1），采用“先分箱后模糊”（bin-then-blur）算法配合周期性边界条件高效计算；(2) 所有元素密度之和截断至1定义材料区域，其余为真空；(3) 每个体素根据阈值分配化学式，形成化学式图，再通过到自身边界的欧氏距离判断“真实体相内部”区域，仅保留这些区域作为组分；(4) 用神经网络原型分类器判定每个组分的晶体相，若原子投票一致则为一相，若分裂为两个置信组则将该组分一分为二；(5) 通过配位数和局域密度偏差检测晶体组分内的内部缺陷。

papers.title: Benchmarking of Fast and Interpretable UF Machine Learning Potentials
papers.abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have emerged as a powerful alternative to density functional theory (DFT) for molecular dynamics simulations, offering near-DFT accuracy at a fraction of the computational cost. However, many state-of-the-art MLIPs remain computationally demanding and act as black boxes, limiting physical interpretability. In this work, we evaluate the ultra-fast force field (UF$^3$) potential, which employs linear regression with cubic B-spline basis to represent effective two- and three-body interactions. We show that UF$^3$ displays accuracy comparable to established models such as GAP, MTP, NNP (Behler Parrinello), and qSNAP MLIPs. We further investigate the transferability of UF$^3$ by computing melting points for six elemental systems with potentials fitted without any solid-liquid interface configurations or explicit thermodynamic information about melting. The model reproduces experimental melting points within $\sim$6% for simple metals (Ni, Cu, Li), but substantially underestimates them for Mo and Si and fails to yield a stable potential for Ge, reflecting the limitations of a fixed expansion truncated at the three-body term for systems with strong angular or covalent bonding. We further illustrate how UF$^3$'s spline-based formulation allows direct visualization of the learned interactions, enabling identification of unphysical behavior that black-box approaches often obscure.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。依据：摘要中涉及机器学习势函数的构建、评估与拟合，属于计算模拟与势函数开发范畴。；研究对象：超快力场（UF³）机器学习原子间势函数，及其在六种元素体系（Ni、Cu、Li、Mo、Si、Ge）上的精度与迁移性测试，重点关注熔点预测和相互作用可视化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: UF³势函数在精度上可与GAP、MTP、NNP（Behler-Parrinello）和qSNAP等成熟MLIPs相当；对简单金属（Ni、Cu、Li）的熔点预测误差约6%，但对Mo和Si明显低估，且对Ge无法获得稳定势函数，表明固定截断至三体项的展开对强角度/共价键合体系存在局限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：UF³势函数在精度上可与GAP、MTP、NNP（Behler-Parrinello）和qSNAP等成熟MLIPs相当；对简单金属（Ni、Cu、Li）的熔点预测误差约6%，但对Mo和Si明显低估，且对Ge无法获得稳定势函数，表明固定截断至三体项的展开对强角度/共价键合体系存在局限。；创新点：UF³势函数兼具超快计算速度和物理可解释性（样条基函数可直接可视化），克服了黑箱式MLIPs缺乏可解释性的问题；同时系统展示了其在熔点预测上的迁移性边界。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用线性回归结合三次B样条基函数表示有效二体和三体相互作用；通过拟合六种元素体系的势函数并计算熔点来评估迁移性；利用样条公式直接可视化学习到的相互作用以识别非物理行为。摘要未明确说明具体DFT参考数据或训练集细节。

papers.title: Grain-Boundary Premelting in High-Entropy Transition Metal Carbides
papers.abstract: Grain-boundary segregation and thermally induced interfacial disordering were investigated in four high-entropy transition metal carbides using Monte Carlo (MC) sampling and molecular dynamics (MD) with the universal MACE-OMAT-0 machine-learning interatomic potential. MC sampling segregated the group-VI element (Cr, Mo, or W) and Zr to grain boundaries, where the group-VI content reached approximately 45 at.%, consistent with STEM-EDS observations. During MD heating, the grain-boundary Lindemann index, a normalized measure of interatomic distance fluctuations, reached the liquid-like threshold of $δ=0.15$ near $1390^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ for the Cr-containing carbides, $1660^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ for Mo, and $1890^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ for W, while the grain interiors remained below the threshold. A chemically random (Cr,Hf,Ta,Ti,Zr)C reference crossed about $60^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$ later and showed less boundary-localized disorder, highlighting the role of interfacial chemistry in premelting. Species-resolved displacements showed enhanced grain-boundary mobility, particularly for carbon. Overall, Cr-rich interfaces showed the earliest and most extensive premelting-like response, followed by Mo- and W-containing boundaries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用Monte Carlo (MC)采样和分子动力学(MD)模拟，并采用机器学习原子间势（MACE-OMAT-0）。；研究对象：四种高熵过渡金属碳化物（含Cr、Mo、W的碳化物体系）中的晶界偏析和热致界面无序化（晶界预熔化）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Cr含量高的碳化物晶界在约1390°C即达到液态化阈值（Lindemann指数δ=0.15），表现出最早且最显著的预熔化响应；Mo和W体系分别在1660°C和1890°C达到该阈值，且晶界化学组成对预熔化行为有显著调控作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Cr含量高的碳化物晶界在约1390°C即达到液态化阈值（Lindemann指数δ=0.15），表现出最早且最显著的预熔化响应；Mo和W体系分别在1660°C和1890°C达到该阈值，且晶界化学组成对预熔化行为有显著调控作用。；创新点：首次将机器学习原子间势（MACE-OMAT-0）应用于高熵过渡金属碳化物晶界预熔化研究，并通过化学随机参考体系（(Cr,Hf,Ta,Ti,Zr)C）的对比，定量揭示了界面化学（尤其是VI族元素种类）对预熔化温度及局域化程度的调控作用。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 蒙特卡洛（MC）采样用于模拟晶界偏析；分子动力学（MD）用于加热过程中的界面无序化模拟；采用通用MACE-OMAT-0机器学习原子间势；使用Lindemann指数（原子间距涨落的归一化度量）表征晶界熔化程度；与STEM-EDS实验观测进行对比验证。

papers.title: Crystal Structure Prototype Identification via Element-Mapped Rotation-Invariant Descriptors
papers.abstract: We present a method for identifying crystal structure prototypes from local atomic environments. A center atom and its neighbors within a distance-normalized cutoff are mapped to anonymous element types (A/B/C/D) by proximity, and a NEP-style descriptor-radial Chebyshev moments plus contracted spherical-harmonic (S-vector) invariants-is computed per type block. The descriptor is rotation-invariant by construction (MLFF-style contraction with analytic normalization constants), so no rotation augmentation is needed. A trainable block-diagonal projection compresses the 316-dimensional raw basis into a 168-dimensional learned descriptor fed to a three-layer MLP. The model classifies each atom into one of 271 AFLOW crystal structure prototypes or the amorphous class (272 classes), reaching 99.38% accuracy on 538,190 per-atom samples. The full pipeline (descriptor extraction + inference) runs on a single CPU core at 3.9 s per 10,000 atoms, making it suitable for website deployment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/机器学习方法文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“descriptor”“model”“classifies”“accuracy”等机器学习与计算建模关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：晶体结构原型识别问题，具体针对局部原子环境（local atomic environments），涵盖271种AFLOW晶体结构原型及非晶态（共272类），研究对象为538,190个逐原子样本。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于元素映射与旋转不变描述符的机器学习方法，可在单CPU核上以每10,000原子3.9秒的速度实现99.38%的晶体结构原型分类准确率，适合网站部署。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于元素映射与旋转不变描述符的机器学习方法，可在单CPU核上以每10,000原子3.9秒的速度实现99.38%的晶体结构原型分类准确率，适合网站部署。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比，但可看出创新点在于：①通过元素映射（A/B/C/D匿名化）处理化学无序；②利用解析归一化常数构造旋转不变描述符，避免数据增强；③分块投影降维策略在保持精度的同时显著提升推理速度。
papers.method_zh: 采用NEP风格描述符——径向切比雪夫矩与收缩球谐函数（S-vector）不变量，按元素类型分块计算；通过MLFF风格的解析归一化常数实现旋转不变性（无需旋转增强）；使用可训练的分块对角投影将316维原始基压缩为168维学习描述符，输入三层MLP进行分类。

papers.title: Asymmetric Ions in Solution are Similar to Active Brownian Particles
papers.abstract: Molecular dynamics simulations of electrolyte ions with charge shifted by the distance $d$ from the ion geometrical center have shown that mechanical equilibrium in the ion's body frame is not established beyond a critical shift distance $d^*$. A sharp crossover to a non-zero body-frame force occurs due to frustration of water molecules failing to compensate the electrostatic pull with a local density augmentation. A solution ion with asymmetric charge experiences a net body-frame force similar to self-propelled motion of active-matter Brownian particles. Thermal equilibrium and zero laboratory-frame force are still maintained, but the diffusion constant drops significantly ($\sim 400$ times) when the charge displacement crosses the threshold value $d^*$. Alternative routes to the diffusion constant become inequivalent and the diffusion constant from the mean-squared displacement is much higher than those from velocity and force correlation functions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Molecular dynamics simulations”（分子动力学模拟）。；研究对象：溶液中的非对称电解质离子，具体为电荷中心偏离离子几何中心一定距离 d 的离子体系，以及由此引发的离子扩散行为变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当电荷偏移距离 d 超过临界值 d* 时，离子体坐标系中无法建立力学平衡，出现非零的体坐标系力，使离子表现出类似活性布朗粒子的自推进行为；同时扩散常数显著下降约 400 倍，且不同途径计算的扩散常数不再等价。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当电荷偏移距离 d 超过临界值 d* 时，离子体坐标系中无法建立力学平衡，出现非零的体坐标系力，使离子表现出类似活性布朗粒子的自推进行为；同时扩散常数显著下降约 400 倍，且不同途径计算的扩散常数不再等价。；创新点：首次将电解质溶液中非对称电荷离子的行为与活性物质中的自驱动布朗粒子建立类比，并揭示了电荷偏移导致的力学平衡破坏与扩散常数急剧下降之间的关联。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学（MD）模拟，用于研究水溶液中电荷偏移离子的力学平衡、受力情况、扩散常数（通过均方位移、速度自相关和力自相关三种途径计算）以及水分子局域密度响应。

papers.title: Long-time Dynamics of Many-body Open Quantum Systems using Quantum Generating Functions
papers.abstract: The interplay between coherent unitary evolution and environment-induced dissipation can give rise to a wide range of non-equilibrium dynamics in open quantum systems, ranging from interesting transport phenomena to dynamical phase transitions. However, accessing such long-time dynamics remains challenging for the existing methods developed for the simulation of many-body open quantum systems. We address this problem by developing a quantum generating function (QGF) formalism for open many-body systems for both ensemble-averaged dynamics governed by a Markovian quantum master equation and trajectory-resolved dynamics described by the quantum trajectory formalism, including quantum jumps, and quantum state diffusion. Our approach computes the dynamics of higher-order moments and fluctuation statistics without explicitly evolving the quantum state, thereby providing an efficient and scalable approach for investigating many-body open quantum systems. We demonstrate the versatility of the formalism by applying it to both the integrable open XXZ chain and the nonintegrable open next-nearest-neighbor XXZ spin chain, where it uncovers distinct initial state dependent long-time transport regimes. Our work establishes quantum generating functions as an efficient and scalable framework for investigating long-time dynamics in open quantum many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算方法文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“developing a quantum generating function (QGF) formalism”，属于理论框架构建与数值模拟结合的研究。；研究对象：多体开放量子系统，具体包括可积的开放XXZ链和不可积的开放次近邻XXZ自旋链，关注其长时非平衡动力学、输运行为及动力学相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作建立了量子生成函数（QGF）形式，能够在不显式演化量子态的情况下计算高阶矩和涨落统计，并揭示了开放XXZ链中依赖于初始态的不同长时输运区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作建立了量子生成函数（QGF）形式，能够在不显式演化量子态的情况下计算高阶矩和涨落统计，并揭示了开放XXZ链中依赖于初始态的不同长时输运区域。；创新点：首次将量子生成函数形式系统性地应用于多体开放量子系统的长时动力学模拟，避免了直接演化量子态的计算瓶颈，为研究开放多体系统的高阶矩和涨落统计提供了可扩展的高效框架。摘要未突出说明与其他具体方法的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为量子生成函数形式，涵盖两种动力学描述：马尔可夫量子主方程（系综平均动力学）和量子轨迹形式（含量子跳跃与量子态扩散的轨迹分辨动力学）。数值上应用于可积与不可积自旋链模型。

papers.title: Occupation-Driven Josephson Diode in a Symmetric Junction
papers.abstract: We propose a Josephson diode mechanism in which nonreciprocity arises not from a conventional asymmetric Andreev spectrum but from nonequilibrium occupation of the current-carrying states engineered by attached reservoirs. We realize this mechanism in a double-quantum-dot junction, where a phase-textured nonlocal reservoir acts as a quantum Zeno selector: rapid dissipation freezes out the bright state directly coupled to the jump operator $L$, while preserving an orthogonal dark Andreev channel whose supercurrent remains comparable to that of the lossless junction. In the infinite-gap limit, the steady-state current factorizes as $I_{\rm ss}=I_A P_γ$, so that even when the Andreev current $I_A$ is strictly reciprocal, the phase asymmetry of $P_γ$ alone can produce a Josephson diode effect through reservoir engineering. We further show that local Coulomb repulsion can drive the system toward a nearly ideal diode regime via a dark-pair resonance. Using Keldysh-Lindblad calculations, we demonstrate that our results remain robust for realistic junctions with a finite superconducting gap and dissipation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We propose”“Keldysh-Lindblad calculations”“steady-state current”等理论建模与数值计算关键词。；研究对象：双量子点约瑟夫森结（double-quantum-dot junction）中的约瑟夫森二极管效应，具体关注非平衡占据驱动的非互易超流输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种全新的约瑟夫森二极管机制：非互易性并非来自传统的非对称安德烈夫谱，而是由外部储库工程调控载流态的非平衡占据产生。在无限能隙极限下，稳态电流可分解为 I_ss = I_A P_γ，即使安德烈夫电流 I_A 严格互易，仅凭 P_γ 的相位不对称即可实现二极管效应；局域库仑排斥可通过“暗对共振”将系统驱动至近乎理想的二极管工作区。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种全新的约瑟夫森二极管机制：非互易性并非来自传统的非对称安德烈夫谱，而是由外部储库工程调控载流态的非平衡占据产生。在无限能隙极限下，稳态电流可分解为 I_ss = I_A P_γ，即使安德烈夫电流 I_A 严格互易，仅凭 P_γ 的相位不对称即可实现二极管效应；局域库仑排斥可通过“暗对共振”将系统驱动至近乎理想的二极管工作区。；创新点：首次提出“占据驱动”的约瑟夫森二极管机制——利用非局域储库的相位纹理作为量子芝诺选择器，通过耗散工程而非谱对称性破缺来实现超流非互易性，为无磁场的约瑟夫森二极管提供了全新设计思路。
papers.method_zh: Keldysh-Lindblad 量子主方程方法，结合量子芝诺选择机制分析（快速耗散冻结亮态、保留正交暗安德烈夫通道），并考虑了有限超导能隙和耗散的真实结情形。

papers.title: Multi-orbital physics in inverse Lieb lattice altermagnets
papers.abstract: The inverse Lieb lattice has recently emerged as a promising platform for altermagnetism, with several materials with this structure proposed as $d$-wave altermagnetic candidates. Here, we develop a symmetry-based microscopic Hamiltonian for these materials that includes both sublattice and orbital degrees of freedom, going beyond the sublattice-only minimal models that have been extensively used to study such altermagnets. We apply these models to examine multi-orbital electron correlation physics in the vanadium oxychalcogenide family altermagnets, which contain dominant $xy$ and $xz/yz$ orbitals character at the Fermi level in the altermagnetic state. We demonstrate that $xy$ orbitals are crucial to stabilize the altermagnetic state observed within a single V$_2$O layer, and altermagnetic order in the $xz/yz$ orbitals is induced through Hund's coupling. Additionally, we show that these multi-orbital models reveal topological regimes in which topological edge states are naturally orbital selective.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a symmetry-based microscopic Hamiltonian”（构建基于对称性的微观模型）、“apply these models to examine”（应用模型研究），属于理论建模与计算分析。；研究对象：逆Lieb晶格交变磁体（inverse Lieb lattice altermagnets），具体为钒氧硫族化合物家族（vanadium oxychalcogenide family）中的单层V₂O体系，涉及xy与xz/yz轨道在费米能级附近的电子关联物理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: xy轨道对稳定单层V₂O中观测到的交变磁序至关重要，而xz/yz轨道中的交变磁序是通过Hund耦合诱导产生的；此外，多轨道模型揭示了轨道选择性的拓扑边缘态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：xy轨道对稳定单层V₂O中观测到的交变磁序至关重要，而xz/yz轨道中的交变磁序是通过Hund耦合诱导产生的；此外，多轨道模型揭示了轨道选择性的拓扑边缘态。；创新点：将逆Lieb晶格交变磁体的研究从仅含子格自由度的最小模型推广到包含轨道自由度的多轨道模型，揭示了xy轨道在稳定磁序中的关键作用以及轨道选择性拓扑态这一新物理。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称性构建包含子格与轨道自由度的微观哈密顿量，超越仅含子格自由度的最小模型；结合多轨道电子关联分析，研究交变磁态稳定性及拓扑性质。摘要未明确提及具体数值方法（如DFT+U、Hartree-Fock等）。

papers.title: Terahertz anomalous Hall effect in magnetic Weyl semimetal Co$_3$Sn$_2$S$_2$
papers.abstract: Time-reversal-symmetry-broken Weyl semimetals are known to have at least two nodes in their electronic band structure, separated in momentum space and acting as sources and sinks of Berry curvature. This gives rise to a transverse Hall conductivity, known as the anomalous Hall effect (AHE), which, in the simplest two-node picture, is proportional to the momentum-space separation between the nodes in the zero frequency limit. In the recently discovered Weyl semimetal $\mathrm{Co_3Sn_2S_2}$, a giant AHE has been observed. However, experimental investigations in the low-energy regime, which directly probe quasiparticle excitations near the Weyl nodes, remain limited. Here, we present a systematic study of the intrinsic low-energy gyrotropic optical response of $\mathrm{Co_3Sn_2S_2}$ using terahertz spectroscopy combined with semianalytical calculations based on a physically intuitive effective model. Our results provide a robust and transparent explanation of the observed magnetooptical phenomena in terms of intrinsic gyrotropy arising from momentum-space separation of the Weyl nodes. Furthermore, quantitative comparison between experiment and theory places stringent constraints on the material parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论计算）。关键词：terahertz spectroscopy（太赫兹光谱实验）、semianalytical calculations（半解析计算）、effective model（有效模型）。；研究对象：磁性外尔半金属 Co₃Sn₂S₂ 的低能旋光（gyrotropic）光学响应，特别是太赫兹频段下的反常霍尔效应（AHE）及其与外尔节点动量空间分离的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Co₃Sn₂S₂ 在太赫兹频段的磁光现象可由外尔节点动量空间分离产生的本征旋光性（intrinsic gyrotropy）稳健且透明地解释；实验与理论的定量对比对材料参数给出了严格约束。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Co₃Sn₂S₂ 在太赫兹频段的磁光现象可由外尔节点动量空间分离产生的本征旋光性（intrinsic gyrotropy）稳健且透明地解释；实验与理论的定量对比对材料参数给出了严格约束。；创新点：首次系统研究了 Co₃Sn₂S₂ 低能（太赫兹）频段的本征旋光响应，直接探测外尔节点附近的准粒子激发，并通过有效模型定量约束材料参数；摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 太赫兹光谱实验（terahertz spectroscopy）测量低能旋光响应；结合基于物理直觉的有效模型进行半解析计算（semianalytical calculations），并与实验定量比较。

papers.title: Data-efficient crack quantification in lithium-ion cathodes using foundation model transfer
papers.abstract: Battery lifetime is central to sustainable electrification, yet the particle cracking that drives lithium-ion cathode aging is hard to measure: quantitative microscopy of this degradation is bottlenecked by annotation, because each destructive electron-microscopy cross-section spans hundreds of megapixels and pixel-level expert labelling requires hours per image. We show that a frozen self-supervised vision-transformer encoder, combined with a lightweight trainable decoder and iterative model-assisted annotation, turns this sparse labelling budget into population-scale degradation measurements. Applied to three 120-megapixel NMC cathode cross-sections representing initial, cycled-aged and calendar-aged states, the framework distinguishes intragranular cracks from early- and late-stage intergranular cracks and yields per-particle distributions of crack width, tortuosity and area fraction. Late intergranular crack coverage reaches 4.6% in the cycled sample versus 0.5% in the initial and calendar-aged samples, forming more tortuous, higher-coverage networks, consistent with degradation from repeated electrochemical cycling rather than elevated-temperature storage alone. A single destructive image yields the population-level statistics needed for lifetime-extending design, aging assessment and second-life decisions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：涉及破坏性电子显微镜截面成像、定量显微分析等实验手段。；研究对象：锂离子电池NMC（镍锰钴氧化物）正极材料中的颗粒开裂现象，具体包括晶内裂纹和不同阶段（早期/晚期）的晶间裂纹，以及裂纹宽度、曲折度和面积分数等微观结构特征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用冻结的自监督视觉Transformer编码器结合轻量级可训练解码器，可将稀疏标注转化为群体尺度的退化统计测量；循环老化样品中晚期晶间裂纹覆盖率（4.6%）显著高于初始态和日历老化态（0.5%），且形成更曲折、覆盖率更高的裂纹网络，表明反复电化学循环而非高温存储是主要退化机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用冻结的自监督视觉Transformer编码器结合轻量级可训练解码器，可将稀疏标注转化为群体尺度的退化统计测量；循环老化样品中晚期晶间裂纹覆盖率（4.6%）显著高于初始态和日历老化态（0.5%），且形成更曲折、覆盖率更高的裂纹网络，表明反复电化学循环而非高温存储是主要退化机制。；创新点：将基础模型迁移学习应用于电池材料退化分析，以极低的标注成本实现大规模（群体级）降解统计测量，避免了传统逐像素人工标注的瓶颈；单张破坏性截面图像即可获得用于寿命设计、老化评估和二次利用决策的群体统计信息。
papers.method_zh: 自监督视觉Transformer（冻结编码器）+ 轻量级可训练解码器 + 迭代模型辅助标注；应用于三张120兆像素NMC正极截面图像（分别代表初始态、循环老化态和日历老化态），进行像素级裂纹分割与定量统计。

papers.title: 3D- (H-theta-phi) magnetic phase diagram of antiferromagnetic metal GdB6 with electron and lattice instability
papers.abstract: The origin of charge transport and magnetization anisotropy was studied in GdB6, an antiferromagnetic (AF) metal (Néel temperature TN ~ 15.5 K) with cubic lattice and Gd S-type magnetic ions. Both small static Jahn-Teller distortions and nanoscale electronic instabilities (dynamic charge stripes) were found in precise low temperature X-ray diffraction measurements. The detailed magnetic field (H) vs temperature (T) phase diagrams were constructed with two main magnetic phases AF(I) and AF(II). Using the angular phi-dependences of magnetoresistance and magnetization, impeller-type patterns of the H-phi magnetic phase diagrams in the (110) and (111) planes were found at helium temperatures, which included the AF phases I and II separated from each other by radial and circular boundaries. The results argue in favor of the important role of the spin density wave 5d- component in the magnetic structure of AF(II) state. Charge fluctuations in stripes are proposed to be responsible for the suppression of the Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yoshida (RKKY) indirect exchange between the first and second neighboring Gd3+ ions located along the <100> and <110> directions. These dynamic charge stripes and vibrationally coupled Gd-Gd pairs produce unusual anisotropy of charge scattering and the impeller-type diagrams in GdB6 with S-type magnetic ion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“精确低温X射线衍射测量”、“磁电阻和磁化强度的角phi依赖关系”等实验手段。；研究对象：反铁磁金属六硼化钆（GdB6），一种具有立方晶格和Gd S型磁性离子的材料。研究聚焦于其电荷输运和磁化各向异性的起源，以及磁场-温度-角度三维磁相图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在GdB6中发现了动态电荷条纹和静态Jahn-Teller畸变，并构建了包含AF(I)和AF(II)两个主磁相的详细磁场-温度相图。在氦温度下，(110)和(111)面内的磁场-角度（H-phi）磁相图呈现“叶轮型”图案，表明自旋密度波5d分量在AF(II)态磁结构中起重要作用，且动态电荷条纹抑制了特定方向上的RKKY间接交换作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在GdB6中发现了动态电荷条纹和静态Jahn-Teller畸变，并构建了包含AF(I)和AF(II)两个主磁相的详细磁场-温度相图。在氦温度下，(110)和(111)面内的磁场-角度（H-phi）磁相图呈现“叶轮型”图案，表明自旋密度波5d分量在AF(II)态磁结构中起重要作用，且动态电荷条纹抑制了特定方向上的RKKY间接交换作用。；创新点：首次在GdB6中揭示了动态电荷条纹与振动耦合的Gd-Gd对共同作用，导致电荷散射的各向异性，并产生了独特的“叶轮型”角度依赖磁相图。这一发现将电荷涨落与磁交换作用的抑制直接联系起来，为理解具有S型磁性离子的立方体系中的复杂各向异性提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用了高精度的低温X射线衍射测量（用于探测结构畸变和电荷条纹），以及系统的磁电阻和磁化强度随角度变化的测量（用于构建H-phi磁相图）。通过测量磁场(H)和温度(T)依赖关系构建了H-T相图。

papers.title: Emergent Skyrmion Hall Effect in $d$-wave Altermagnets at Finite Temperature
papers.abstract: Altermagnets combine compensated magnetic order with unconventional symmetry-dependent responses, offering a promising platform for spintronic applications. Here, we show that a voltage-controlled magnetic-anisotropy gradient drives altermagnetic (ATM) skyrmions in a nearly rectilinear, Hall-free manner in the absence of thermal fluctuations, owing to their strongly compensated gyrotropic response. Thermal magnons qualitatively modify this behavior by increasing the longitudinal drag through magnon--skyrmion scattering and generating a transverse reaction force through handedness-dependent skew scattering. Owing to the anisotropic altermagnetic magnon band structure, the relative transport weights of the two magnon handednesses are interchanged between propagation along the $x$ and $y$ directions, resulting in transverse skyrmion drifts of opposite sign. By contrast, along the high-symmetry direction, the two magnon handednesses remain degenerate and their transverse contributions cancel, preserving Hall-free motion even at finite temperature. We thus uncover a thermally emergent anisotropic skyrmion Hall effect whose direction-dependent magnitude and sign originate from the intrinsic symmetry-dependent magnon spectrum, making it a generic finite-temperature dynamical feature of ATM skyrmions. Our results establish a low-power route toward electrically controlled and thermally tunable ATM skyrmion transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用“we show”“owing to”“result in”等理论推导性表述，且未提及实验手段或计算模拟方法。；研究对象：d波交错磁体（altermagnet）中的skyrmion（斯格明子），具体研究其在有限温度下、由电压控制的磁各向异性梯度驱动下的输运行为，以及热磁振子散射对其运动的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无热涨落时，交错磁skyrmion因强补偿的回旋响应而近似直线、无霍尔效应地运动；但在有限温度下，由于磁振子-斯格明子散射及手性依赖的斜散射，产生方向依赖的、符号可变的各向异性skyrmion霍尔效应，其大小和符号由交错磁体各向异性的磁振子能带结构决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无热涨落时，交错磁skyrmion因强补偿的回旋响应而近似直线、无霍尔效应地运动；但在有限温度下，由于磁振子-斯格明子散射及手性依赖的斜散射，产生方向依赖的、符号可变的各向异性skyrmion霍尔效应，其大小和符号由交错磁体各向异性的磁振子能带结构决定。；创新点：首次揭示有限温度下交错磁skyrmion的热致各向异性霍尔效应，其方向依赖的符号和大小源于交错磁体固有的对称性依赖磁振子谱，并指出沿高对称方向该效应消失，从而提出一种低功耗、电控且热可调的skyrmion输运方案。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，具体包括：电压控制的磁各向异性梯度驱动skyrmion运动模型、磁振子-斯格明子散射与手性依赖斜散射的输运理论、基于交错磁体各向异性磁振子能带结构的输运权重分析。摘要未明确说明是否采用数值模拟（如微磁学模拟或蒙特卡洛）。

papers.title: Localization Delocalization Transition in Diffusion with Adaptive Resetting
papers.abstract: Stochastic resetting can localize diffusion and generate nonequilibrium steady states, but the conditions under which spatially dependent resetting produces localization remain unclear. Here, we establish a general classification for diffusion under adaptive resetting, where the resetting rate $r(x)$ depends on position. For rates with the asymptotic scaling $r(x)\sim |x|^λ$, we identify a sharp threshold at $λ=-2$. For $λ>-2$, the steady state is localized and exhibits stretched-exponential tails, whereas for $λ<-2$, resetting is asymptotically too weak to localize the particle. Precisely at the marginal scaling $r(x)\sim |x|^{-2}$, a qualitatively new regime emerges: the steady state develops power-law tails with a temperature-dependent exponent and exhibits a finite-temperature delocalization transition. Thus, inverse-square resetting plays the role of the logarithmic potential in equilibrium, establishing a nonequilibrium counterpart of the temperature-driven delocalization seen there.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“general classification”“scaling”“steady state”等理论分析术语，未提及实验或数值模拟手段。；研究对象：随机重置（stochastic resetting）作用下的扩散过程，具体研究空间依赖的重置率 r(x) 对粒子局域化-退局域化转变的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于自适应重置率 r(x) ~ |x|^λ，存在一个尖锐的临界指数 λ = -2：当 λ > -2 时稳态局域化且呈拉伸指数尾；当 λ < -2 时重置太弱无法局域化；当 λ = -2（反平方重置）时，稳态出现温度依赖的幂律尾，并发生有限温度下的退局域化转变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于自适应重置率 r(x) ~ |x|^λ，存在一个尖锐的临界指数 λ = -2：当 λ > -2 时稳态局域化且呈拉伸指数尾；当 λ < -2 时重置太弱无法局域化；当 λ = -2（反平方重置）时，稳态出现温度依赖的幂律尾，并发生有限温度下的退局域化转变。；创新点：首次系统建立了自适应重置下局域化-退局域化转变的完整分类，揭示了反平方重置率与平衡态对数势的深刻对应关系，从而为非平衡统计物理中的温度驱动退局域化提供了新的对应机制。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，基于对空间依赖重置率下扩散方程稳态解的渐近分析，通过指数 λ 的标度分类建立局域化判据，并与平衡态对数势问题进行类比。

papers.title: Laser induced ultrafast Co 3d and Ho 4f spin dynamics in CoHo ferrimagnetic alloys
papers.abstract: The transition metal (TM) / rare-earth (RE) alloys have received renewed interest lately as model systems to decipher the origin of all-optical helicity-independent switching (AO-HIS) by femtosecond laser pulses. Recently, a distinct single-pulse magnetization reversal mechanism, based on domain-wall motion and coalescence, has been reported in CoDy and CoHo alloys, as well as in Co/Gd ultrathin bilayers. It has been claimed that this specific toggle switching is achieved when the Co sublattice is fully demagnetized and the characteristic demagnetization times τRE of the RE (Gd, Dy or Ho) sublattices is longer than that of the Co and the angular momentum transferred to Co is reduced. Element- and time-resolved X-ray spectroscopy studies of CoDy alloys have reported characteristic demagnetization times of τCo = 0.2 ps and τDy = 0.6 ps at room temperature. Similarly, Ho is expected to exhibit a slower response, but its ultrafast 4f spin dynamics remain experimentally unexplored. Here, we report on element- and time-resolved investigations of femtosecond laser induced ultrafast dynamics of the Co 3d and Ho 4f spins in ferrimagnetic Co_{80}Ho_{20} alloys to verify this prediction. We observed characteristic demagnetization times τCo = 0.22 +/- 0.01 ps and τHo = 0.87 +/- 0.15 ps at room temperature. These results show that Ho demagnetizes substantially more slowly than Co in Co_{80}Ho_{20}, supporting the proposed condition for domain-wall-mediated all-optical toggle switching
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“element- and time-resolved X-ray spectroscopy studies”“element- and time-resolved investigations”，属于时间分辨X射线光谱实验。；研究对象：铁磁性 Co₈₀Ho₂₀ 合金中 Co 3d 与 Ho 4f 自旋的超快激光诱导动力学，具体关注飞秒激光脉冲下两种亚晶格的退磁过程及其与全光无螺旋度开关（AO-HIS）机制的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在室温下测得 Co₈₀Ho₂₀ 中 Co 亚晶格的特征退磁时间 τCo = 0.22 ± 0.01 ps，Ho 亚晶格的特征退磁时间 τHo = 0.87 ± 0.15 ps，证实 Ho 的退磁速度显著慢于 Co，从而支持了基于畴壁运动的全光开关机制所要求的条件（RE 退磁时间大于 Co 且 Co 角动量转移减少）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在室温下测得 Co₈₀Ho₂₀ 中 Co 亚晶格的特征退磁时间 τCo = 0.22 ± 0.01 ps，Ho 亚晶格的特征退磁时间 τHo = 0.87 ± 0.15 ps，证实 Ho 的退磁速度显著慢于 Co，从而支持了基于畴壁运动的全光开关机制所要求的条件（RE 退磁时间大于 Co 且 Co 角动量转移减少）。；创新点：首次实验测量了 Ho 4f 自旋的超快退磁动力学（此前 Ho 的慢响应仅为理论预期，实验上尚未被探索），填补了 CoHo 合金中稀土亚晶格超快动力学研究的空白，并为畴壁介导的全光开关条件提供了直接实验证据。
papers.method_zh: 元素分辨和时间分辨的 X 射线光谱技术（element- and time-resolved X-ray spectroscopy），结合飞秒激光泵浦-探测方案，分别追踪 Co 3d 和 Ho 4f 自旋的瞬态动力学。

papers.title: Giant bulk photovoltaic effect driven by interfacial symmetry breaking in MoS2/Ta2NiSe5 heterostructures
papers.abstract: Van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures offer a versatile platform for engineering unconventional bulk photovoltaic (BPV) effect through interfacial symmetry breaking. However, the coexistence of multiple photophysical mechanisms, driven by structural complexity, spontaneous charge transfer, and strong interlayer coupling, often obscures the microscopic origin of the BPV response and hinders its rational optimization. Here, we demonstrate a pronounced BPV effect localized at the overlap region of a cross-bar MoS2/Ta2NiSe5 vdW heterostructure, where symmetry breaking induced by vertical stacking lifts the inversion center of MoS2. The orthogonal device geometry enables the independent probing of intralayer and interfacial photoresponse pathways, facilitating clear separation of competing mechanisms. Spontaneous interfacial charge transfer between MoS2 and Ta2NiSe5 further establishes a strong interlayer electronic coupling. By modulating the interlayer potential landscape through gate voltage and vertical electric fields, we achieve an optimized zero-bias photocurrent density of 247 A/cm2 and a BPV coefficient of 0.99 V-1. Supported by theoretical modelling, our results illustrate how minimalist device geometry can transform complex heterostructures into experimentally tractable platforms. This strategy paves the way for analyzing and optimizing interface-driven BPV effect, with implications for self-powered optoelectronics, broadband photodetection, and energy-harvesting nanodevices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含理论建模支持）。判断依据：摘要中出现“demonstrate”“device geometry”“photocurrent density”等实验表征词汇，同时提及“Supported by theoretical modelling”，属于实验为主、理论辅助的混合类型。；研究对象：MoS₂/Ta₂NiSe₅ 范德华异质结中的体光伏效应（BPV effect），具体关注垂直堆叠导致的界面对称性破缺及其对零偏置光电流的调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在交叉条形 MoS₂/Ta₂NiSe₅ 异质结的重叠区域，垂直堆叠引起的对称性破缺（消除 MoS₂ 反演中心）产生了显著的体光伏效应，通过栅压和垂直电场调控层间电势景观，实现了 247 A/cm² 的零偏置光电流密度和 0.99 V⁻¹ 的 BPV 系数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在交叉条形 MoS₂/Ta₂NiSe₅ 异质结的重叠区域，垂直堆叠引起的对称性破缺（消除 MoS₂ 反演中心）产生了显著的体光伏效应，通过栅压和垂直电场调控层间电势景观，实现了 247 A/cm² 的零偏置光电流密度和 0.99 V⁻¹ 的 BPV 系数。；创新点：利用极简的交叉条形器件几何，将结构复杂的异质结转化为实验上可独立解析的平台，实现了对界面驱动 BPV 效应中多种竞争光物理机制（结构复杂性、自发电荷转移、强层间耦合）的清晰分离与优化。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用正交器件几何结构（cross-bar geometry）分别探测层内与界面光响应路径，以分离竞争机制；通过栅压和垂直电场调制层间电势；测量零偏置光电流密度和 BPV 系数。理论上辅以建模（摘要未明确说明具体计算方法，如 DFT 或模型哈密顿量）。

papers.title: THz-induced phonomagnetism in diamagnetic quantum paraelectric KTaO$_3$
authors: T. V. A. G. de Oliveira
papers.abstract: The current efforts striving to develop new ways of data manipulation are aimed at ultrafast control of magnetization in magnetic materials, as well as at inducing magnetic moments in diamagnetics. We demonstrate that in the diamagnetic quantum paraelectric KTaO$_3$, the electric field of circularly polarized THz pulses with an amplitude of $\sim 300\,$kV/cm induces a transient magnetic-like response by resonantly exciting its degenerate soft polar phonon. This phonon-mediated response was measured using the THz pump---optical probe technique via the time-resolved magneto-optic Faraday effect. Our detection scheme was set up to cancel out the major part of the electro-optic Kerr effect which also usually significantly contributes to the transient response. The Kerr-effect-related signal was further suppressed by subtracting the experimental data related to oppositely circularly polarized THz radiation. Thus, we were able to unambiguously identify a temperature-dependent magnetic-like behavior of the KTaO$_3$ crystal manifested by the extracted Faraday rotation. We developed a theoretical model describing well quantitatively the measured curves of the transient Faraday effect signal. However, their amplitudes exhibit an unexpected temperature dependence, which might be a key to a deeper understanding of the observed phonomagnetic effect.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“measured”“THz pump—optical probe technique”“time-resolved magneto-optic Faraday effect”等实验手段，并辅以理论模型（“developed a theoretical model”）进行定量描述，属于实验为主、理论辅助的混合类型。；研究对象：抗磁性量子顺电体 KTaO₃（钛酸钾）晶体，具体研究其软极性声子在圆偏振太赫兹脉冲激发下产生的瞬态类磁性响应（phonomagnetic effect）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 KTaO₃ 中，振幅约 300 kV/cm 的圆偏振太赫兹脉冲通过共振激发简并软极性声子，诱导出瞬态的类磁性响应（表现为可提取的 Faraday 旋转），且该响应具有温度依赖性；其振幅的温度依赖行为与现有理论预期不符，可能为理解该声子磁效应提供关键线索。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 KTaO₃ 中，振幅约 300 kV/cm 的圆偏振太赫兹脉冲通过共振激发简并软极性声子，诱导出瞬态的类磁性响应（表现为可提取的 Faraday 旋转），且该响应具有温度依赖性；其振幅的温度依赖行为与现有理论预期不符，可能为理解该声子磁效应提供关键线索。；创新点：首次在抗磁性量子顺电体 KTaO₃ 中利用太赫兹圆偏振光共振激发软声子实现瞬态磁化响应，并通过巧妙的测量方案（Kerr 效应消除）明确区分出磁光信号；发现 Faraday 信号振幅的温度依赖异常，可能揭示新的物理机制。摘要未突出说明与已有声子磁效应研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用 THz 泵浦—光学探测技术，结合时间分辨磁光 Faraday 效应测量；通过实验设计抵消主要的电光 Kerr 效应贡献，并进一步通过减去相反圆偏振 THz 辐射的数据来抑制 Kerr 相关信号。理论上构建了定量描述瞬态 Faraday 信号曲线的模型。

papers.title: Crossing the Rotational Sound Barrier in a Quantum Solvent
papers.abstract: Molecules embedded in superfluids provide an experimentally controllable platform for investigating impurity physics. Here, we investigate a driven molecule rotating in a superfluid environment, including helium and Bose--Einstein condensates, at rotation frequencies similar to the bath dynamics. Within the experimentally relevant platform of an optical centrifuge, we show that the rotor remains localized up to a characteristic harmonic frequency that can realistically exceed the excitation energies of the bath, enabling access to ultrafast rotating impurities. In the co-rotating frame, the bath excitations experience a rotational Doppler shift, generating angular-momentum-resolved resonances absent in equilibrium angulon theory. We identify a dissipative rotational sound barrier at which the molecule resonantly emits bath excitations and undergoes strong angular momentum exchange with the surrounding medium. Overall, we establish the dynamical phase diagram of the driven rotor in a quantum solvent and introduce a generic platform for investigating fast driven rotating impurities in quantum many-body systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及理论框架（angulon theory）、动力学相图建立，以及“我们表明”“我们识别”等理论推导性表述，未提及实验数据或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：超流体环境（包括液氦和玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体）中受驱动旋转的分子杂质，即“量子溶剂中的旋转杂质”体系，具体关注其旋转频率接近或超过浴（bath）动力学频率时的超快旋转行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 旋转分子在光学离心机驱动下可保持局域化直至一个特征谐波频率，该频率可实际超过浴的激发能量，从而进入超快旋转杂质区域；同时存在一个“耗散性旋转声屏障”，在此处分子共振发射浴激发并与周围介质发生强角动量交换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：旋转分子在光学离心机驱动下可保持局域化直至一个特征谐波频率，该频率可实际超过浴的激发能量，从而进入超快旋转杂质区域；同时存在一个“耗散性旋转声屏障”，在此处分子共振发射浴激发并与周围介质发生强角动量交换。；创新点：将angulon理论推广至非平衡驱动情形（旋转频率与浴动力学可比），揭示了平衡态angulon理论中不存在的角动量分辨共振，并首次建立了驱动转子在量子溶剂中的动力学相图。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为angulon理论（角动量分辨的杂质-浴耦合理论），并结合光学离心机（optical centrifuge）这一实验相关平台进行建模；在共转坐标系中分析浴激发的旋转多普勒频移，从而获得角动量分辨的共振结构。

papers.title: Intrinsic anomalous Hall response in the bilayer kagome ferromagnet Co$_3$Sn
papers.abstract: Transition-metal kagome magnets provide a rich platform for investigating the interplay between layer stacking, magnetic order, and band topology. Here, we report the molecular beam epitaxy and experimental investigation of high-quality thin films of the kagome metal Co$_3$Sn, which has not been synthesized in bulk form yet. Structural and chemical analyses confirm a hexagonal lattice structure ($P6_3/mmc$) composed of direct A-B stacked Co$_3$Sn kagome bilayers. Magnetometry reveals robust easy-plane ferromagnetism with a Curie temperature exceeding $300\,\text{K}$. Magneto-transport measurements demonstrate metallic behavior (carrier density $n\approx5.01\times10^{22}\,\text{cm}^{-3}$) alongside a temperature-independent anomalous Hall conductivity of $σ_{\rm AHE}\approx90\,Ω^{-1}\cdot{\rm cm}^{-1}$, extending from $2\,\text{K}$ up to room temperature. Results from first-principles density functional theory calculations attribute this anomalous Hall response to intrinsic Berry curvature hotspots near the Fermi level in the spin-split band structure. Our results establish Co$_3$Sn as a room-temperature kagome ferromagnet and highlight the impact of the layer stacking sequence on the material properties of kagome metals from the CoSn family.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“分子束外延与实验研究”“磁输运测量”等实验手段，同时包含“第一性原理密度泛函理论计算”。；研究对象：双层kagome金属Co₃Sn薄膜。该材料尚未以块体形式合成，本研究通过分子束外延制备了高质量薄膜，并研究了其层堆叠方式、磁有序与能带拓扑之间的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Co₃Sn薄膜具有易面铁磁性（居里温度超过300 K），并表现出与温度无关的异常霍尔电导率σ_AHE≈90 Ω⁻¹·cm⁻¹（2 K至室温）。第一性原理计算表明该异常霍尔响应源于自旋劈裂能带中费米能级附近的Berry曲率热点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Co₃Sn薄膜具有易面铁磁性（居里温度超过300 K），并表现出与温度无关的异常霍尔电导率σ_AHE≈90 Ω⁻¹·cm⁻¹（2 K至室温）。第一性原理计算表明该异常霍尔响应源于自旋劈裂能带中费米能级附近的Berry曲率热点。；创新点：首次合成了尚未有块体形式的Co₃Sn薄膜，并证明其为室温kagome铁磁体；同时揭示了层堆叠顺序（A-B直接堆叠）对CoSn家族kagome金属物性的重要影响。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验方面：分子束外延（MBE）生长薄膜，结构/化学分析（确认P6₃/mmc六方结构及A-B直接堆叠），磁强计（磁化测量），磁输运测量（载流子密度n≈5.01×10²² cm⁻³）。计算方面：第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，用于分析Berry曲率分布。

papers.title: Atomic-scale composition of the ternary III-V semiconductor (Al,Ga)Sb visualized by cross-sectional scanning tunneling microscopy
papers.abstract: Cross-sectional scanning tunneling microscopy at 5 K is used to investigate cation mixing in (Al,Ga)Sb layers grown by molecular beam epitaxy, via direct atom counting at the (1-10) and (110) cleavage planes. Electronic contrast between Al and Ga surface cations enables statistical analysis of the metal sublattice along the non-equivalent <110> directions within the zincblende (001) surface and along the [001] growth direction. The cation distribution is found to be random both along the growth direction and within the growth plane, with no evidence of long-range order or anisotropic growth kinetics; notably, the mean numbers of consecutive cations of the same type along the two in-plane directions are equal, possibly due to statistical averaging over randomly distributed subsurface cations. The results are compatible with either strain-mediated interactions during cation incorporation at the growth front or ideal, uncorrelated cation mixing. Overall, the examined (Al,Ga)Sb alloy shows an exceptionally high degree of atomic-level homogeneity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用cross-sectional scanning tunneling microscopy（横截面扫描隧道显微镜）进行直接原子计数测量。；研究对象：三元III-V族半导体合金(Al,Ga)Sb，具体研究其分子束外延生长薄膜中阳离子（Al/Ga）在金属亚晶格上的混合分布情况。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: (Al,Ga)Sb合金中阳离子分布沿生长方向和生长面内均为随机分布，不存在长程有序或各向异性生长动力学；合金表现出极高的原子级均匀性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：(Al,Ga)Sb合金中阳离子分布沿生长方向和生长面内均为随机分布，不存在长程有序或各向异性生长动力学；合金表现出极高的原子级均匀性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 低温（5 K）横截面扫描隧道显微镜（X-STM），在(1-10)和(110)解理面上进行直接原子计数，利用Al与Ga表面阳离子的电子衬度差异，对闪锌矿(001)表面非等价<110>方向及[001]生长方向的金属亚晶格进行统计分析。

papers.title: Magnon-induced phononic Chern insulator
papers.abstract: High-frequency artificial phononic crystals offer a low-loss platform compatible with on-chip integration, yet realizing Chern phononic phases at GHz frequencies remains challenging. Here, we propose a magnon-induced phononic Chern insulator in a honeycomb phononic crystal hybridized with ferromagnetic islands at the hexagon centers. A circularly polarized Kittel mode couples to the surrounding phonons with a phase winding, which breaks time-reversal symmetry and opens a full Chern gap. In the large-detuning regime, this mechanism leads to an effective Haldane-type phononic model with magnon-induced complex hopping. By tuning the magnon-phonon interaction, the full hybrid system accesses Chern phases with tunable Chern numbers |C|=1 and |C|=2. The predicted gaps can exceed realistic phonon and magnon linewidths, enabling their observation in GHz acoustic devices. Our work establishes chiral magnon--phonon hybridization as a route to magnetically reconfigurable topological phononics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“propose”（提出理论方案）、“leads to an effective model”（构建有效模型）、“tuning the interaction”（参数调控）等理论建模与数值分析关键词，未提及实验测量手段。；研究对象：一种由六角蜂窝声子晶体与位于六边形中心的铁磁岛杂化构成的“磁振子诱导声子陈绝缘体”体系，具体物理现象为GHz频段声子陈相（拓扑声子态）的实现与调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过圆极化Kittel模与周围声子的相位缠绕耦合，可打破时间反演对称性并打开完整的陈能隙；在失谐较大时，该机制等效于具有磁振子诱导复跃迁的Haldane型声子模型，系统可获得陈数|C|=1和|C|=2的可调拓扑相，且能隙宽度超过实际声子与磁振子线宽，可在GHz声学器件中观测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过圆极化Kittel模与周围声子的相位缠绕耦合，可打破时间反演对称性并打开完整的陈能隙；在失谐较大时，该机制等效于具有磁振子诱导复跃迁的Haldane型声子模型，系统可获得陈数|C|=1和|C|=2的可调拓扑相，且能隙宽度超过实际声子与磁振子线宽，可在GHz声学器件中观测。；创新点：首次提出利用手性磁振子-声子杂化机制在GHz频段人工声子晶体中实现磁可重构的拓扑声子陈绝缘体，将磁振子诱导的复跃迁引入声子体系，并实现陈数|C|=1和|C|=2的可调拓扑相。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与有效哈密顿量推导：利用磁振子（Kittel模）与声子的杂化耦合，构建大失谐条件下的有效Haldane型声子模型；通过调节磁振子-声子相互作用强度，计算陈数（Chern number）以表征拓扑相变，并对比能隙与实验线宽。

papers.title: Topology-Controlled Phonon Dielectric Response Beyond Density Scaling in Metal-Organic Frameworks
papers.abstract: Effective-medium theory treats material porosity as passive dilution. Using ab initio density functional theory and high-resolution synchrotron terahertz (THz) spectroscopy on isochemical zeolitic-imidazolate frameworks, we show that while the electronic permittivity obeys Clausius-Mossotti density scaling, the phonon contribution violates the conventional density scaling rules. Identical Born charges rule out the role of local chemistry. Instead, the framework connectivity localizes the THz response, where the coherency of phonon eigenvectors determines the mode-effective charges. Long-range architecture of framework topology ubiquitous in metal-organic frameworks is therefore a dielectric degree of freedom beyond the density scaling of conventional solids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时使用了“ab initio density functional theory”（第一性原理计算）和“high-resolution synchrotron terahertz (THz) spectroscopy”（高分辨同步辐射太赫兹光谱实验）。；研究对象：等化学组成的沸石咪唑酯骨架材料（isochemical zeolitic-imidazolate frameworks, ZIFs），属于金属-有机框架（MOFs）家族。具体物理现象为太赫兹频段的声子介电响应及其与框架拓扑结构的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子介电常数遵循Clausius-Mossotti密度标度，但声子对介电响应的贡献违反传统密度标度规则。框架的拓扑连接性（而非局部化学环境）决定了声子本征矢的相干性，从而控制模式有效电荷，使长程拓扑架构成为超越密度标度的介电自由度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子介电常数遵循Clausius-Mossotti密度标度，但声子对介电响应的贡献违反传统密度标度规则。框架的拓扑连接性（而非局部化学环境）决定了声子本征矢的相干性，从而控制模式有效电荷，使长程拓扑架构成为超越密度标度的介电自由度。；创新点：首次揭示MOF中声子介电响应不遵循传统密度标度，并将框架拓扑连接性确立为独立的介电调控自由度。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算；高分辨同步辐射太赫兹光谱实验；通过比较Born有效电荷排除局部化学作用。

papers.title: Spin preservation in screw-symmetric molecules
papers.abstract: In electronic transport through long molecules, spin is expected to be preserved only when the dwell time is much shorter than the characteristic spin-mixing timescale $\hbar/Δ$, where $Δ$ is the magnitude of a spin-dependent potential, such as spin-orbit coupling. We show that, in molecules featuring discrete screw symmetry, spin preservation can be enhanced far beyond this timescale owing to strong spin separation in quasi-momentum. This spin fidelity in long molecules is consistent with chirality-induced spin selectivity (CISS), suggesting spin-dependent transport in long, chiral molecules with amplified spin-splitting mechanisms. We provide analytical derivation of the enhanced spin preservation and test it on tight-binding models, which confirm that the effect gradually weakens when the screw symmetry is broken or changes from discrete to continuous. Furthermore, we perform transport simulations to show that a strong magnetoresistance trace of symmetry-protected spin fidelity emerges in a spin-valve setup with two magnetic leads, which we propose as an experimentally accessible signature.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要提及“analytical derivation”（解析推导）、“tight-binding models”（紧束缚模型）、“transport simulations”（输运模拟）。；研究对象：具有离散螺旋对称性的长链分子中的自旋输运行为，具体涉及自旋保持（spin preservation）与手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有离散螺旋对称性的分子中，由于准动量空间中的强自旋分离，自旋保持时间可远超由自旋-轨道耦合强度决定的特征时间尺度 ħ/Δ，从而在长分子中实现增强的自旋保真度，与CISS效应一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有离散螺旋对称性的分子中，由于准动量空间中的强自旋分离，自旋保持时间可远超由自旋-轨道耦合强度决定的特征时间尺度 ħ/Δ，从而在长分子中实现增强的自旋保真度，与CISS效应一致。；创新点：首次提出离散螺旋对称性（而非连续螺旋对称性）可作为增强长分子自旋保持的机制，并给出对称性破坏（离散→连续或完全破坏）时效应逐渐减弱的定量证据；同时提出自旋阀磁电阻测量作为实验可观测的判据。
papers.method_zh: 解析推导增强自旋保持的表达式；基于紧束缚模型进行数值验证；通过输运模拟计算自旋阀结构（两个磁性电极）中的磁电阻信号。

papers.title: Hall effect in viscous flows of two-dimensional electrons in samples with edges of arbitrary roughness
papers.abstract: In ultra-clean conductors, fast inter-particle collisions can lead to the formation of a viscous electron fluid and realization of the hydrodynamic transport regime. Here we develop a theory of hydrodynamic magnetotransport of two-dimensional (2D) electrons in samples with low densities of defects and edges of arbitrary roughness. Within our model the roughness is described by a single parameter with the dimension of speed in the boundary conditions on sample edges. The electron-fluid flow profiles in long samples, as well as the corresponding longitudinal and Hall resistances, are calculated. The contribution to the Hall resistance associated with the relaxation processes exhibits a saturation in the limit of high magnetic field and a minimum as a function of the magnetic field for sufficiently rough edges. The minimum disappears as the edge roughness decreases or the sample width and bulk scattering by defects increase. These properties of the Hall resistance can serve as the signs to identify the hydrodynamic regime of electron transport in experiments and can be used to determine its parameters, in particular, the degree of edge roughness.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“develop a theory”“within our model”“calculated”等关键词，属于理论建模与解析计算研究。；研究对象：二维电子系统中的粘性流体（hydrodynamic electron fluid）输运，具体研究具有任意粗糙度边缘的长条形样品中的磁输运行为，包括纵向电阻和霍尔电阻。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在边缘粗糙度足够大的情况下，与弛豫过程相关的霍尔电阻贡献在高磁场下趋于饱和，并随磁场变化出现一个极小值；该极小值随边缘粗糙度减小、样品宽度增大或体缺陷散射增强而消失。这些特征可作为实验上识别电子流体动力学输运 regime 的标志。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在边缘粗糙度足够大的情况下，与弛豫过程相关的霍尔电阻贡献在高磁场下趋于饱和，并随磁场变化出现一个极小值；该极小值随边缘粗糙度减小、样品宽度增大或体缺陷散射增强而消失。这些特征可作为实验上识别电子流体动力学输运 regime 的标志。；创新点：首次在理论上系统地考虑了任意粗糙度边缘对二维粘性电子流体霍尔效应的影响，给出了霍尔电阻随磁场变化的非单调行为（饱和与极小值），并提出了利用霍尔电阻特征来判定流体动力学输运 regime 及提取边缘粗糙度参数的实验判据。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与解析计算。采用单参数描述边缘粗糙度（该参数具有速度量纲），将其引入样品边缘的边界条件中，求解二维粘性电子流体的流动剖面，并计算长条形样品的纵向电阻和霍尔电阻。

papers.title: Electronic Structure and Band-Edge Character of Ga-Substituted $α$-Al$_2$O$_3$: A First-Principles Study
papers.abstract: We present a first-principles density functional theory study of substitutional Ga incorporation in an $α$-Al$_2$O$_3$-derived host, isolating chemical embedding effects without explicit geometric quantum confinement. Using a 30-atom $α$-Al$_2$O$_3$ supercell with two substituted Ga atoms, we examine three nonequivalent Ga-pair configurations and combine configuration-dependent energetics, local structural analysis, Ga-centered distortion metrics, and electronic-structure calculations.% to establish the relationship between local coordination distortion and band-edge modification. The energetically preferred configuration is governed not solely by Ga--O bond expansion but by the ability of the host lattice to accommodate bond-length and angular distortions around substituted Ga centers. Ga incorporation narrows the band gap relative to pristine $α$-Al$_2$O$_3$ without generating mid-gap states, primarily modifying the conduction-band manifold while preserving the oxygen-dominated valence edge. Band-edge charge densities and charge-density-difference maps show that the electronic response remains localized around the Ga-centered coordination environment. These results establish a chemically resolved baseline for understanding Ga incorporation in ultrawide-band-gap oxides and for future studies of confinement and interface effects in Ga-containing oxide nanostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first-principles density functional theory study”（第一性原理密度泛函理论研究）。；研究对象：Ga取代的α-Al₂O₃（蓝宝石）体系，具体为在30原子超胞中引入两个取代Ga原子，研究三种不等价Ga对构型下的电子结构与带边特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ga掺入使α-Al₂O₃带隙变窄但不产生带隙中间态，主要修饰导带能带结构而价带边仍由氧主导；能量上最稳定的Ga构型并非由Ga–O键膨胀单独决定，而是由宿主晶格对Ga中心周围键长和键角畸变的整体容纳能力决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ga掺入使α-Al₂O₃带隙变窄但不产生带隙中间态，主要修饰导带能带结构而价带边仍由氧主导；能量上最稳定的Ga构型并非由Ga–O键膨胀单独决定，而是由宿主晶格对Ga中心周围键长和键角畸变的整体容纳能力决定。；创新点：在无几何量子限域的条件下，将Ga化学嵌入效应从限域效应中分离出来，建立了Ga在超宽禁带氧化物中嵌入的化学分辨基线，为后续研究含Ga氧化物纳米结构中的限域和界面效应提供参考。摘要未突出说明与以往计算研究的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，使用30原子α-Al₂O₃超胞，包含两种取代Ga原子，结合构型依赖的能量学分析、局域结构分析、Ga中心畸变度量以及电子结构计算（能带、带边电荷密度、电荷密度差图）。

papers.title: Scalable conformal electronics based on roll-to-roll exfoliated van der Waals semiconductors
papers.abstract: Integrating electronic devices onto surfaces with complex topography such as skin, textiles, and biological tissues requires fabrication strategies that combine mechanical conformability with high electronic performance and scalable manufacturing. While two-dimensional (2D) semiconductors are promising materials for such applications, their integration into conformal electronic systems remains challenging because scalable liquid-phase processing typically yields films with limited electronic performance, whereas high-quality CVD materials require complex synthesis and transfer processes. Here we establish a scalable route toward conformal electronics based on semiconducting van der Waals materials by combining high-throughput roll-to-roll mechanical exfoliation with commercially available temporary tattoo and waterslide decal transfer substrates. This approach enables the fabrication of ultrathin MoS2-based electronic devices that can be transferred onto rough and curved surfaces such as skin, synthetic leather, and plant leaves. The resulting devices operate reliably after transfer and exhibit strong electronic and optoelectronic performance, including photodetectors with responsivities up to approximately 3.5 A W$^{-1}$, thermistors with temperature coefficients of resistance from -2 to -3.5% per degree Celsius, and ionic-gel-gated field-effect transistors with mobilities reaching approximately 18 cm$^2$ V$^{-1}$ s$^{-1}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：roll-to-roll mechanical exfoliation、fabrication、devices、photodetectors、field-effect transistors。；研究对象：基于二硫化钼（MoS₂）的范德华半导体超薄电子器件，及其在粗糙、弯曲表面（皮肤、合成皮革、植物叶片）上的共形集成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过卷对卷机械剥离结合商用临时纹身/水转印基底，实现了高性能MoS₂共形电子器件的可规模化制造，器件在转移到复杂表面后仍能可靠工作，并展现出优异的光电性能（光响应度约3.5 A/W）、热敏性能（电阻温度系数-2至-3.5%/°C）和场效应迁移率（约18 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过卷对卷机械剥离结合商用临时纹身/水转印基底，实现了高性能MoS₂共形电子器件的可规模化制造，器件在转移到复杂表面后仍能可靠工作，并展现出优异的光电性能（光响应度约3.5 A/W）、热敏性能（电阻温度系数-2至-3.5%/°C）和场效应迁移率（约18 cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹）。；创新点：将卷对卷机械剥离与商用转印基底结合，绕过了液相剥离性能差和CVD合成转移复杂的瓶颈，首次实现了兼具高性能与可规模化制造能力的共形范德华半导体电子器件。
papers.method_zh: 高通量卷对卷机械剥离法制备MoS₂薄膜；采用商用临时纹身纸和水转印贴纸作为转移基底；制备了光电探测器、热敏电阻和离子凝胶栅控场效应晶体管，并测试其电学与光电性能。

papers.title: Vortex lattices in coupled one-dimensional Bose-Einstein condensates with a synthetic magnetic field
papers.abstract: We investigate the mean-field ground states of coupled one-dimensional Bose-Einstein condensates subject to a synthetic magnetic field. The resulting interacting coupled-wire model has one continuous and one discrete spatial direction, providing a controlled way to interpolate between the physics of few-leg ladders and extended vortex lattices. For two wires, we study the vortex-like, biased-density, and Meissner-like states, exploring how the finite longitudinal size of the system modifies the transitions between them. Increasing the number of wires, the ground state evolves towards an extended vortex lattice. We find numerically that periodic boundary conditions in the discrete direction can favour staggered arrays of like-signed vortices resembling an Abrikosov lattice, while open boundaries in small finite-size systems confine the vortices into rows near the centre of the synthetic direction. Our results explore how finite size effects and boundary conditions govern the emergence and spatial organisation of vortices in continuous-discrete quantum fluids, with relevance to future experiments in tunnel-coupled atomic wires or with synthetic dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“We investigate the mean-field ground states”（平均场基态研究）、“We find numerically”（数值发现），属于理论建模与数值计算结合的工作。；研究对象：耦合一维玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体（Bose-Einstein condensates）在合成磁场（synthetic magnetic field）作用下的涡旋晶格（vortex lattices）基态。具体体系为耦合导线模型（coupled-wire model），具有一个连续空间方向和一个离散空间方向，可连接少腿梯子（few-leg ladders）与扩展涡旋晶格两种物理图像。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 随着导线数目增加，基态从少腿梯子中的涡旋态、偏置密度态和类迈斯纳态演化为扩展涡旋晶格；离散方向上的周期性边界条件可促进类似阿布里科索夫晶格（Abrikosov lattice）的交错同号涡旋阵列，而开放边界在小尺寸体系中会将涡旋限制在合成方向中心附近的涡旋行中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：随着导线数目增加，基态从少腿梯子中的涡旋态、偏置密度态和类迈斯纳态演化为扩展涡旋晶格；离散方向上的周期性边界条件可促进类似阿布里科索夫晶格（Abrikosov lattice）的交错同号涡旋阵列，而开放边界在小尺寸体系中会将涡旋限制在合成方向中心附近的涡旋行中。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其新意在于：通过连续-离散混合维度的耦合导线模型，系统研究有限尺寸效应和边界条件如何调控涡旋的空间组织与涌现，为隧道耦合原子导线或合成维度实验提供理论预言。
papers.method_zh: 平均场理论（mean-field theory）框架下的数值求解，具体为对耦合导线模型求解基态，系统尺寸（纵向长度、导线数目）和边界条件（周期/开放）作为可控参数进行扫描。

papers.title: Decoupled domain-texture switching from magnetic easy axis in kagome ferromagnet EuTi3Bi4
papers.abstract: Magnetic anisotropy defines the easy axis of a magnetic material and governs the spatial arrangement of its domains. To date, anisotropy engineering has focused on reorienting the easy axis or tuning the anisotropy energy, both of which demand substantial energy input. Here, we demonstrate that magnetic domain textures can be switched without reorienting the easy axis, as observed in a kagome ferromagnet EuTi3Bi4 crystal. Using low-temperature magnetic force microscopy, we observe that the preferred orientation of magnetic domains switches from the a-axis to the b-axis upon temperature variation, and that this switching can also be triggered by an out-of-plane magnetic-field reset. Magnetization measurements and density functional theory calculations confirm a robust c-axis easy magnetization, ruling out a conventional spin-reorientation transition. Instead, the texture switching is governed by the temperature dependence of the in-plane variation of the Magnetic anisotropy energy landscape, which arises from two competing interactions with different decay rates: single-ion anisotropy favors a-oriented spin components, while nearest-neighbor anisotropic exchange favors b-oriented ones. Furthermore, the critical switching temperature is substantially elevated in a mechanically exfoliated EuTi3Bi4 flake. Our findings establish that macroscopic magnetic textures can be effectively manipulated by tuning the competition between in-plane anisotropic interactions, without the energy cost of reorienting the easy axis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“低溫磁力显微镜”实验观测、“磁化测量”实验，以及“密度泛函理论计算”。；研究对象：kagome晶格铁磁材料EuTi₃Bi₄单晶及其机械剥离薄片中的磁畴织构与磁各向异性能景观。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在EuTi₃Bi₄中，磁畴的择优取向可在不改变c轴易磁化轴的前提下，随温度变化或面外磁场重置而在a轴与b轴之间切换；该切换源于面内各向异性能景观的温度依赖，由单离子各向异性与最近邻各向异性交换相互作用之间的竞争所驱动。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在EuTi₃Bi₄中，磁畴的择优取向可在不改变c轴易磁化轴的前提下，随温度变化或面外磁场重置而在a轴与b轴之间切换；该切换源于面内各向异性能景观的温度依赖，由单离子各向异性与最近邻各向异性交换相互作用之间的竞争所驱动。；创新点：首次在实验上证明，无需重新取向易磁化轴（即无需克服传统自旋重取向所需的能量），仅通过调控面内各向异性相互作用之间的竞争即可实现宏观磁畴织构的切换，为磁各向异性工程提供了新的低能耗自由度。此外，机械剥离薄片显著提升了临界切换温度，这一维度效应在摘要中被明确提及。
papers.method_zh: - 实验手段：低温磁力显微镜（MFM）直接观测磁畴取向随温度及磁场的变化；宏观磁化测量确认易磁化轴方向。

papers.title: Low-temperature magnetism and spin dynamics in the disordered triangular-lattice Yb$^{3+}$ compound LiCaYb$_5$(BO$_3$)$_6$
papers.abstract: The interplay between geometric frustration, spin--orbit coupling, and structural disorder can give rise to unconventional magnetic ground states in rare-earth triangular-lattice magnets. We report low-temperature magnetic and $^7$Li NMR investigations of the disordered triangular-lattice compound LiCaYb$_5$(BO$_3$)$_6$ (LCYBO). Rietveld refinement confirms a hexagonal $P6_522$ structure with partial Ca/Yb antisite disorder and fractional Li occupancy. Magnetic susceptibility and magnetization measurements indicate a well-isolated effective $J_{\mathrm{eff}}=1/2$ Kramers doublet with weak antiferromagnetic interactions ($θ_{\mathrm{CW}} \approx -0.54$~K). The specific heat reveals a weak anomaly near 0.43 K, suggesting the development of short-range correlated magnetism rather than conventional long-range order. $^7$Li NMR spectra broaden strongly upon cooling, consistent with increasingly inhomogeneous internal magnetic fields. The spin-lattice relaxation exhibits two relaxation components consistent with disorder-induced distributions of local magnetic environments arising from antisite disorder and competing exchange pathways. Our results establish LCYBO as a structurally disordered frustrated triangular-lattice magnet with correlated low-energy spin dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Rietveld refinement”“磁化率与磁化强度测量”“比热”“⁷Li NMR”等实验手段。；研究对象：具有无序三角晶格结构的稀土化合物 LiCaYb₅(BO₃)₆（LCYBO），重点关注其低温磁性、自旋动力学以及几何阻挫、自旋-轨道耦合与结构无序的相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: LCYBO 是一种结构无序的阻挫三角晶格磁体，其有效 J_eff = 1/2 的 Kramers 双重态具有弱反铁磁相互作用（θ_CW ≈ −0.54 K），在 0.43 K 附近出现比热弱异常，表明形成短程关联磁性而非常规长程有序，且自旋动力学受无序诱导的局域磁环境分布影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：LCYBO 是一种结构无序的阻挫三角晶格磁体，其有效 J_eff = 1/2 的 Kramers 双重态具有弱反铁磁相互作用（θ_CW ≈ −0.54 K），在 0.43 K 附近出现比热弱异常，表明形成短程关联磁性而非常规长程有序，且自旋动力学受无序诱导的局域磁环境分布影响。；创新点：首次系统研究了 LCYBO 这一具有 Ca/Yb 反位无序和 Li 部分占据的无序三角晶格 Yb³⁺ 化合物的低温磁性与自旋动力学，揭示了无序与阻挫共同作用下形成短程关联而非长程有序的磁性基态。摘要未突出说明与其他无序三角晶格体系的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 粉末 X 射线衍射的 Rietveld 精修确定晶体结构；磁化率与磁化强度测量表征磁性基态与相互作用；比热测量探测低温相变或短程有序；⁷Li 核磁共振（NMR）谱与自旋-晶格弛豫测量研究局域内场分布与自旋动力学。

papers.title: Four-phonon scattering and coherent heat transport in ultrawide-bandgap SrSnO3
papers.abstract: SrSnO3 is a promising ultrawide-bandgap perovskite oxide whose thermal transport is governed by structural distortions and anharmonic lattice dynamics. Here, we investigate the lattice thermal conductivity (kL) of orthorhombic and cubic SrSnO3 within a unified first-principles framework combining self-consistent phonon renormalization, three- and four-phonon scattering, and coherent heat transport. Bonding analysis reveals a rigid Sn-O octahedral framework embedded in a weakly bonded Sr sublattice, giving rise to low-frequency vibrational modes susceptible to strong anharmonic effects. Four-phonon scattering is identified as a key mechanism limiting particle-like heat conduction, reducing the Peierls thermal conductivity by 19.4% at 300 K in the orthorhombic phase and by 52.1% at 1300 K in the cubic phase, while the coherent contribution provides a finite channel that partially compensates this reduction. We further show that the apparent agreement between three-phonon calculations and experimental thermal conductivity at room temperature is not indicative of a complete physical description. Instead, it arises from a near cancellation between four-phonon suppression of the particle-like channel and the neglected coherent contribution. This cancellation breaks down when the full temperature dependence is considered, where only the combined treatment improves agreement with the experimentally observed scaling behavior. A physically consistent description of kL therefore requires phonon renormalization, four-phonon scattering, and coherent transport to be treated on equal footing rather than inferred from three-phonon agreement at a single temperature. These results provide microscopic insight into thermal transport in ultrawide-bandgap stannate perovskites and establish a benchmark for anharmonic transport in strongly distorted oxides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“first-principles framework”“self-consistent phonon renormalization”“calculations”等关键词，属于第一性原理计算研究。；研究对象：超宽禁带钙钛矿氧化物 SrSnO₃ 的晶格热导率（kL），具体涵盖正交相与立方相两种结构，以及其声子非谐输运行为（三声子/四声子散射与相干热输运）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 四声子散射是限制 SrSnO₃ 粒子型热传导的关键机制（300 K 正交相降低 19.4%，1300 K 立方相降低 52.1%），而相干热输运通道可部分补偿该抑制；室温下三声子计算与实验的“表观吻合”实为四声子抑制与相干贡献的近似抵消，并非物理描述的完备性体现，只有同时考虑声子重正化、四声子散射与相干输运才能在全温区与实验标度行为一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：四声子散射是限制 SrSnO₃ 粒子型热传导的关键机制（300 K 正交相降低 19.4%，1300 K 立方相降低 52.1%），而相干热输运通道可部分补偿该抑制；室温下三声子计算与实验的“表观吻合”实为四声子抑制与相干贡献的近似抵消，并非物理描述的完备性体现，只有同时考虑声子重正化、四声子散射与相干输运才能在全温区与实验标度行为一致。；创新点：首次在统一第一性原理框架内同时纳入声子重正化、四声子散射与相干输运，系统揭示了三声子计算在单一温度下与实验“假吻合”的物理根源（近抵消效应），并指出该抵消在全温区失效，从而确立了强畸变氧化物非谐输运描述的新基准。
papers.method_zh: 统一的第一性原理框架，具体包括：自洽声子重正化（self-consistent phonon renormalization）、三声子与四声子散射计算、相干热输运（coherent heat transport）建模，并结合成键分析（bonding analysis）揭示晶格动力学特征。

papers.title: Quenched activity induces nonuniversal scaling in nonreciprocal XY Models and surfaces
papers.abstract: Active XY models and active surfaces are two paradigmatic nonequilibrium systems with distinct microscopic origins. We show that the hydrodynamic theories for a quenched-disordered nonreciprocal random bond two-dimensional XY model and an inversion-symmetric active surface tangentially advected by quenched velocities are identical. This theory predicts sub-logarithmic phase order in the XY model and sub- or super-logarithmic positional order in the surface for short-range disorder with nonuniversal exponents, which vary continuously with the degree of transversality of the disorder variance. We argue that the nonreciprocal random bond XY model can disorder through vortex proliferation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：hydrodynamic theories、predicts、argue，属于理论分析与模型推导。；研究对象：非互易XY模型（nonreciprocal XY model）与活性表面（active surfaces）这两类非平衡系统，具体涉及淬火无序（quenched disorder）下的二维随机键XY模型，以及由淬火速度切向平流（tangentially advected by quenched velocities）的反演对称活性表面。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 淬火无序的非互易随机键XY模型与反演对称活性表面的流体动力学理论完全相同；该理论预言在短程无序下，XY模型呈现亚对数（sub-logarithmic）的相位序，而表面呈现亚对数或超对数（sub- or super-logarithmic）的位置序，且指数随无序方差横向度（transversality）连续变化，具有非普适性。此外，非互易随机键XY模型可能通过涡旋增殖（vortex proliferation）发生失序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：淬火无序的非互易随机键XY模型与反演对称活性表面的流体动力学理论完全相同；该理论预言在短程无序下，XY模型呈现亚对数（sub-logarithmic）的相位序，而表面呈现亚对数或超对数（sub- or super-logarithmic）的位置序，且指数随无序方差横向度（transversality）连续变化，具有非普适性。此外，非互易随机键XY模型可能通过涡旋增殖（vortex proliferation）发生失序。；创新点：揭示了淬火无序的非互易XY模型与活性表面在流体动力学层面具有完全相同的理论描述，并预言了非普适的亚对数/超对数标度行为，以及涡旋增殖失序机制。摘要未突出说明与既有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用流体动力学理论（hydrodynamic theory）框架，对两类系统的有效场论进行对比分析，并基于无序方差的结构参数（横向度）推导序参量的标度指数。摘要未提及数值模拟或具体解析技术细节。

papers.title: Band offsets and electronic structure at $α$/$β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ and $κ$/$β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ phase heterojunctions
papers.abstract: Ga$_2$O$_3$ phase heterojunction materials are emerging as promising candidates for deep-ultraviolet optoelectronics. Here, the band offsets at the $α$/$β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ and $κ$/$β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ phase heterojunctions are investigated through hybrid functional calculations. Explicit, realistic slab models that satisfy electron counting rules are constructed for the heterojunctions. Our calculations demonstrate that a type-II staggered band alignment forms at the $α$/$β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ and $κ$/$β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ phase heterojunctions, where both the valence and conduction band edges of $α$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ and $κ$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ are higher than those of $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$. Strain effects on the band alignment are also discussed. Spatially resolved local density of states maps are presented, clearly revealing the interfacial electronic structures. These results provide valuable insights into the physical properties of Ga$_2$O$_3$ phase heterojunctions, offering guidance for future device design efforts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“hybrid functional calculations”（杂化泛函计算），属于第一性原理计算研究。；研究对象：Ga₂O₃ 相异质结，具体为 α/β-Ga₂O₃ 和 κ/β-Ga₂O₃ 两种相界面的能带偏移与电子结构，面向深紫外光电器件应用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: α/β-Ga₂O₃ 和 κ/β-Ga₂O₃ 相异质结均形成 type-II 交错能带排列，其中 α-Ga₂O₃ 和 κ-Ga₂O₃ 的价带顶与导带底均高于 β-Ga₂O₃ 的对应能带边。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：α/β-Ga₂O₃ 和 κ/β-Ga₂O₃ 相异质结均形成 type-II 交错能带排列，其中 α-Ga₂O₃ 和 κ-Ga₂O₃ 的价带顶与导带底均高于 β-Ga₂O₃ 的对应能带边。；创新点：首次对 α/β-Ga₂O₃ 和 κ/β-Ga₂O₃ 相异质结采用满足电子计数规则的显式 slab 模型进行杂化泛函计算，并系统给出应变效应与空间分辨的界面态密度信息。摘要未突出说明与以往计算在方法或结论上的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用杂化泛函（hybrid functional）第一性原理计算；构建满足电子计数规则的显式、真实 slab 模型来模拟异质结界面；计算了应变对能带排列的影响；通过空间分辨的局域态密度（LDOS）图揭示界面电子结构。

papers.title: A novel Grand-Potential Phase-Field Lattice-Boltzmann model for multi-phase solidification with convection
papers.abstract: Melt convection plays a critical role in microstructure evolution during alloy solidification, yet accurately capturing its interaction with moving solid-liquid interfaces remains a significant computational challenge, particularly in multi-phase, multi-component systems. In this work, we develop a computational framework that couples a Grand-Potential phase-field model with the Lattice Boltzmann method (LBM) to simulate convection-driven solidification within a unified and thermodynamically consistent formulation. The proposed approach rigorously enforces no-slip conditions at evolving solid-liquid interfaces, while fluid transport is solved using the standard single-relaxation-time Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook collision operator. The framework provides an efficient and robust methodology for resolving the coupled evolution of interfaces, solute transport, and fluid flow. The versatility of the proposed framework is demonstrated through simulations of dendritic and eutectic solidification under natural convection. The results show that convection significantly modifies solute segregation, destabilizes growth fronts, and induces oscillatory growth modes in both systems. These examples illustrate the capability of the proposed method to capture complex flow-induced morphological instabilities and provide new insights into the mechanisms governing convection-driven microstructure evolution in alloy solidification.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/模拟文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a computational framework”“simulations of dendritic and eutectic solidification”，属于数值模拟研究。；研究对象：合金凝固过程中的多相、多组分体系，具体涉及枝晶（dendritic）和共晶（eutectic）凝固，以及自然对流（natural convection）对固液界面形貌演化和溶质输运的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型成功模拟了自然对流下的枝晶和共晶凝固，发现对流显著改变溶质偏析、使生长前沿失稳，并在两类体系中均诱导出振荡生长模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型成功模拟了自然对流下的枝晶和共晶凝固，发现对流显著改变溶质偏析、使生长前沿失稳，并在两类体系中均诱导出振荡生长模式。；创新点：在统一的热力学自洽框架内，将巨势相场与LBM耦合，实现对多相、多组分凝固中界面演化、溶质输运和流体流动的联合求解，并严格处理移动界面上的无滑移条件。摘要未突出说明与已有相场-LBM耦合方法相比的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 将巨势相场模型（Grand-Potential phase-field model）与格子玻尔兹曼方法（LBM）耦合，采用标准单松弛时间 Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook（BGK）碰撞算子求解流体输运，并在演化的固液界面处严格施加无滑移边界条件。

papers.title: Exceptional point induced by hyperbolicity in an electrostatic spherical shell
papers.abstract: Exceptional points (EPs) are non--Hermitian degeneracies at which both eigenvalues and eigenvectors coalesce, usually engineered through balanced gain and loss or non--reciprocity. In this work, we show that the radial electrostatic problem of an anisotropic core--shell nanoparticle realizes an EP without any of the alluded conditons. Written in the logarithmic radial coordinate, the problem is a Cauchy--Euler equation that maps onto a damped oscillator and, equivalently, onto a two-site Hatano--Nelson Hamiltonian, so that the non-Hermiticity is emulated in space rather than in time and the sole control parameter is the degree of dielectric anisotropy, $\varepsilon_t/\varepsilon_r$. The shell is passive, reciprocal, and lossless, yet it hosts an EP and a non--Hermitian phase transition governed by hyperbolicity alone. Beyond a hyperbolicity threshold the electric field inside the shell turns from monotonic decay into spatial oscillation, producing hotspots at intermediate radii which can be exploited to tailor fluorescence, strong coupling, sensing, or cloaking. More broadly, this establishes hyperbolic media as a platform to simulate non--Hermitian physics without gain, loss, or non--reciprocity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：realizes、maps onto、emulated in space、theoretical framework（Cauchy–Euler方程、Hatano–Nelson哈密顿量映射）。；研究对象：各向异性核壳纳米颗粒的径向静电问题，具体为介电各向异性（ε_t/ε_r）调控下的静电势分布，以及由双曲性（hyperbolicity）诱导的奇异点（Exceptional Point, EP）和非厄米相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无增益、无损耗、无非互易性的无源无耗散壳层中，仅通过介电各向异性（双曲性）即可实现奇异点（EP）和非厄米相变；超过双曲性阈值后，壳内电场从单调衰减转变为空间振荡，并在中间半径处产生热点。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无增益、无损耗、无非互易性的无源无耗散壳层中，仅通过介电各向异性（双曲性）即可实现奇异点（EP）和非厄米相变；超过双曲性阈值后，壳内电场从单调衰减转变为空间振荡，并在中间半径处产生热点。；创新点：首次证明无需增益/损耗或非互易性，仅凭介电各向异性（双曲性）即可在无源无耗散体系中实现奇异点，将双曲介质确立为模拟非厄米物理的新平台。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析方法：将径向静电问题在对数径向坐标下转化为Cauchy–Euler方程，进一步映射为阻尼谐振子及两格点Hatano–Nelson哈密顿量，以介电各向异性比ε_t/ε_r作为唯一控制参数进行分析。

papers.title: The Effect of Geometry on Thermodynamic Response
papers.abstract: At the nano- and microscale, various patterns influence and shape thermal and optical response, making them essential for the survival of various biological species. In addition, controlling thermal radiation is vital for a broad range of applications, such as thermal management, spectroscopy, optoelectronics, and energy conversion technologies. For this reason, there is strong pressure to elucidate the physics of thermal radiation at the nanoscale. In this article, we provide evidence that complex nanoscale geometries affect thermal management, leading to an unusual thermal response in heat-capacity measurements as a function of temperature. Beyond identifying the structural constraints associated with this unusual thermodynamic response, the current study introduces the possibility of shaping the apparent heat-capacity response through geometry without necessarily altering the system's chemistry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中未提及具体实验手段，主要围绕“提供证据”“引入可能性”等理论分析表述，且讨论热容响应与几何结构的关系，属于理论建模或数值模拟范畴。；研究对象：纳米和微米尺度下复杂几何结构对热辐射及热力学响应（特别是热容随温度变化的响应）的影响。具体体系为具有特定纳米级图案/几何构型的材料，但摘要未明确指定具体化合物或材料类别。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 复杂纳米几何结构能够改变热管理行为，导致热容测量随温度出现异常响应；通过改变几何形状而非改变材料化学组成，即可调控表观热容响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：复杂纳米几何结构能够改变热管理行为，导致热容测量随温度出现异常响应；通过改变几何形状而非改变材料化学组成，即可调控表观热容响应。；创新点：首次提出“几何工程”可作为独立于化学组分的手段来塑造材料的热容响应，为纳米尺度热辐射调控提供了新的自由度。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体计算方法或理论框架（如DFT、分子动力学、有限元等），仅提及对结构约束条件的识别与分析。摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: Repeated Growth and Hot Delamination of Single-Crystal Graphene: A Two-Kilometer Process-Design Assessment with hBN as a Separate Case
papers.abstract: Large single crystals of graphene and hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) remain difficult to manufacture because batch growth and transfer limit area, throughput, and quality. This Perspective asks whether an atomically thin film could instead be grown, hot-delaminated, and regrown repeatedly on a long, reusable single-crystal metal surface. No integrated process is demonstrated. Once rapid full-area growth is available, hot film removal is likely to become the rate-limiting step, whereas usable single-crystal growth area sets the material produced per cycle. Two experiments determine whether the concept merits further development: rapid, damage-free delamination at or near the growth temperature, and acceptable film growth through repeated complete growth-dwell-peel-regrowth cycles. The analysis then examines the crystalline growth surface, layer control, interface and gas chemistries, product capture, quality criteria, energy, and scale. These provisional analyses expose known requirements, define early stop criteria, and guide experiments; they cannot anticipate every coupled constraint or failure mode. Graphene is the quantitative baseline. hBN requires its own M(111), product thickness, apparatus, and scaling strategy. Pilot-scale development is justified only if the two central experiments succeed and the remaining gates can then be refined experimentally.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：Perspective（观点/展望类文章），非实验、计算或理论原始研究。判断依据：摘要明确说明“This Perspective asks whether...”“No integrated process is demonstrated”，属于工艺概念评估与可行性分析。；研究对象：单晶石墨烯（graphene）和六方氮化硼（hBN）的大面积单晶薄膜制备工艺，具体为在长尺寸可重复使用的单晶金属表面上进行“重复生长—热剥离—再生长”的循环工艺概念。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未给出明确物理结论，因为这是概念评估而非实验验证。核心观点是：一旦实现快速全覆盖生长，热剥离将成为速率限制步骤；两个关键实验（近生长温度下的快速无损伤剥离、以及重复完整生长-停留-剥离-再生长循环后的可接受薄膜质量）决定该概念是否值得继续发展。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未给出明确物理结论，因为这是概念评估而非实验验证。核心观点是：一旦实现快速全覆盖生长，热剥离将成为速率限制步骤；两个关键实验（近生长温度下的快速无损伤剥离、以及重复完整生长-停留-剥离-再生长循环后的可接受薄膜质量）决定该概念是否值得继续发展。；创新点：提出“在长尺寸可重复使用的单晶金属表面上反复进行生长—热剥离—再生长”的连续化单晶薄膜制造概念，区别于传统批量生长与转移路线；并明确将石墨烯作为定量基线，指出hBN需要独立的M(111)衬底、产物厚度、设备和放大策略。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未涉及具体实验手段或计算方法。本文为工艺设计评估，采用分项分析框架，涵盖：晶体生长表面、层数控制、界面与气体化学、产物收集、质量判据、能量消耗和规模放大。提出了早期终止判据（early stop criteria）和实验指导原则。

papers.title: Switchable giant room-temperature nonlinear Hall effect in Bilayer Graphene
papers.abstract: Utilizing quantum second-order nonlinear transport for practical junction-free devices require materials with large and tunable nonlinearites at room temperature -- a current materials platform challenge.
