Here, we report the nonlinear Hall effect (NLHE) in double-ionic gated bilayer graphene devices that enable unusually strong inversion breaking. We observe NLHE that are readily switchable (on, off, and sign reversed) with second order nonlinear susceptibilities $χ^{(2)}_{yxx}$ that reaches giant room-temperature values of $3\,10^{-3}\,μ\mathrm{m}\,\mathrm{S/V}$, comparable to values commonly observed at low temperature in WTe$_2$ or in graphene-based moiré superlattices, and three-to-four orders of magnitude larger than values reported in material systems recently employed in search of a room-temperature NLHE. Our devices produce corresponding THz voltage responsivities $\simeq 4\,10^{4}\,\mathrm{V/W}$, comparable to commercially available Schottky diodes. These are orders of magnitude better than for previously reported room-temperature NLHE devices rendering double-ionic gated bilayer graphene a choice platform for junction-free nonlinear technology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述“我们报道”“我们观察到”“我们的器件产生”，属于实验测量结果。；研究对象：双离子栅控的双层石墨烯器件中的非线性霍尔效应（NLHE），重点研究其在室温下的可开关非线性响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双层石墨烯中实现了室温下巨大的、可开关（开、关、符号反转）的非线性霍尔效应，其二阶非线性磁化率 χ⁽²⁾_{yxx} 达到 3×10⁻³ μm·S/V，与低温下 WTe₂ 或石墨烯莫尔超晶格中的典型值相当，比此前室温 NLHE 材料体系高 3–4 个数量级；对应的太赫兹电压响应度约 4×10⁴ V/W，可与商用肖特基二极管媲美。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双层石墨烯中实现了室温下巨大的、可开关（开、关、符号反转）的非线性霍尔效应，其二阶非线性磁化率 χ⁽²⁾_{yxx} 达到 3×10⁻³ μm·S/V，与低温下 WTe₂ 或石墨烯莫尔超晶格中的典型值相当，比此前室温 NLHE 材料体系高 3–4 个数量级；对应的太赫兹电压响应度约 4×10⁴ V/W，可与商用肖特基二极管媲美。；创新点：首次在双层石墨烯中实现室温下可开关（开、关、符号反转）的巨非线性霍尔效应，其性能远超此前所有室温 NLHE 器件，且无需结型结构即可实现非线性功能，为无结非线性技术提供了实用平台。摘要未突出说明与理论机制的对比或具体栅控电压范围。
papers.method_zh: 采用双离子栅控（double-ionic gated）技术对双层石墨烯施加异常强的反演对称性破缺，通过非线性霍尔输运测量提取二阶非线性磁化率，并测量太赫兹电压响应度。

papers.title: Observation of dodecagonal replica bands in 30$^{\circ}$-twisted bilayer WSe$_2$
papers.abstract: Twisted bilayers of two-dimensional (2D) transition metal dichalcogenides are promising systems for achieving tunable quasicrystalline orders with emergent properties. The underpinning electronic structure and scattering processes in 2D quasicrystals with multiorbital dodecagonal replica bands have so far not been determined. Here, we utilize angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) with micrometer spatial resolution to directly observe replica bands in 30$^{\circ}$-twisted bilayer WSe$_2$. The symmetry and intensity distribution of the observed replicas are explained by interlayer Umklapp scattering from bottom to top WSe$_2$ layers. Our spectral function measurements are consistent with the presence of a van Hove singularity adjacent to the $\mathrm{K}$-valleys, which underlines the possibility of inducing electronic reconstructions in bilayers with a large interlayer twist angle.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“我们利用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）……直接观察”，属于实验测量手段。；研究对象：30°扭转的双层WSe₂（过渡金属硫属化物），具体关注其十二重准晶有序中的电子结构，特别是多轨道十二重复制带及层间Umklapp散射过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在30°扭转双层WSe₂中直接观察到复制带，其对称性和强度分布可由底层到顶层WSe₂的层间Umklapp散射解释；谱函数测量表明K谷附近存在范霍夫奇点，暗示大扭转角双层中可能诱导电子重构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在30°扭转双层WSe₂中直接观察到复制带，其对称性和强度分布可由底层到顶层WSe₂的层间Umklapp散射解释；谱函数测量表明K谷附近存在范霍夫奇点，暗示大扭转角双层中可能诱导电子重构。；创新点：首次直接确定了二维准晶中多轨道十二重复制带的电子结构和散射过程（此前尚未被实验测定）。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 具有微米空间分辨率的角分辨光电子能谱（micro-ARPES），用于测量电子谱函数并分析复制带的对称性与强度分布。

papers.title: Self-selective growth of GaAs1-xBix on GaAs zinc blende/wurtzite nanowire heterostructures
papers.abstract: Site-selective nanostructure growth and material incorporation at the atomic scale offer a promising pathway for engineering quantum materials and nanodevices. Here, GaAs nanowires (NWs) with an axial heterostructure of alternating zinc blende (Zb) and wurtzite (Wz) crystal phases are employed as templates for site-selective Ga and Bi overgrowth. Using X-ray photoemission electron microscopy (XPEEM) with nanoscale spatial resolution, we map elemental distribution and local chemical bonding to reveal the incorporation behavior of Bi atoms in {110} Zb and {11-20} Wz facets. Bi incorporation proceeds through an anion-exchange process, where Bi atoms replace As, forming local Ga-Bi bonds and producing a thin GaAs1-xBix shell. We observe crystal-phase-dependent Bi incorporation, with higher Bi concentration in the Zb segments than in the neighboring Wz segments within the same NW. Furthermore, the Zb segment with higher Bi content exhibits reduced susceptibility to oxidation compared with the Wz segment, resulting in increased Ga-oxide in the Wz surfaces. This study highlights GaAs NW Zb/Wz heterostructures as a template for controlled growth of GaBi and GaAs1-xBix nanostructures with tailored functionalities for quantum applications
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用X射线光电子发射显微镜（XPEEM）进行实验表征，并描述元素分布和化学键合的观测结果。；研究对象：GaAs纳米线中闪锌矿（Zb）/纤锌矿（Wz）轴向异质结构，以及在其{110} Zb和{11-20} Wz晶面上进行Ga和Bi的选择性过生长，形成GaAs₁₋ₓBiₓ薄壳层。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Bi原子通过阴离子交换过程取代As，形成局部Ga-Bi键，且Bi掺入具有晶相依赖性：同一纳米线中Zb段的Bi浓度高于相邻Wz段；同时，Bi含量较高的Zb段比Wz段更不易氧化，Wz表面则形成更多Ga氧化物。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Bi原子通过阴离子交换过程取代As，形成局部Ga-Bi键，且Bi掺入具有晶相依赖性：同一纳米线中Zb段的Bi浓度高于相邻Wz段；同时，Bi含量较高的Zb段比Wz段更不易氧化，Wz表面则形成更多Ga氧化物。；创新点：首次利用GaAs纳米线Zb/Wz轴向异质结构作为模板，实现晶相依赖的Bi选择性掺入和GaAs₁₋ₓBiₓ壳层自选择性生长，并揭示Bi掺入与抗氧化性之间的关联，为可控生长GaBi及GaAs₁₋ₓBiₓ纳米结构提供新途径。
papers.method_zh: 以具有交替Zb/Wz晶相的GaAs纳米线为模板，进行Ga和Bi的位点选择性过生长；使用具有纳米级空间分辨率的X射线光电子发射显微镜（XPEEM）绘制元素分布和局部化学键合信息。

papers.title: A review of simulation, measurement techniques, and development in chip thermal design
papers.abstract: As integrated circuits advance toward higher power densities, three-dimensional integration, and heterogeneous packaging, chip thermal management has become a key bottleneck limiting device performance, reliability, and lifetime. This article systematically reviews numerical simulation methods and experimental measurement techniques for chip thermal design, with particular emphasis on the technical challenges associated with multiscale and multiphysics coupling, thermal boundary resistance measurement, and high-heat-flux cooling. We first introduce macro- and device-scale thermal simulation methods, including equivalent thermal-circuit models, the finite element method, and computational fluid dynamics, and discuss the application of phonon transport theory and molecular dynamics at microscopic scales. We then examine the advantages and limitations of infrared thermography, thermoreflectance, Raman thermometry, and embedded sensors. Current limitations include the enormous computational cost, inaccurate multiscale coupling, expensive experimental facilities, and the physical limits of conventional cooling technologies. Finally, we discuss emerging directions, including AI-accelerated thermal simulation, embedded microchannel liquid cooling, two-phase cooling, advanced high-thermal-conductivity materials, and multiphysics co-design, with the aim of advancing chip thermal management toward greater efficiency and intelligence.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（综述文章）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“systematically reviews numerical simulation methods and experimental measurement techniques”，涵盖计算模拟与实验测量两方面。；研究对象：芯片热设计中的热管理问题，具体涉及集成电路（高功率密度、三维集成、异构封装）中的多尺度热输运现象、热边界电阻、以及高热流密度冷却技术。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 芯片热管理已成为限制器件性能、可靠性与寿命的关键瓶颈；当前主要挑战包括多尺度/多物理场耦合计算成本巨大、热边界电阻测量困难、传统冷却技术存在物理极限，而AI加速模拟、嵌入式微通道液冷、两相冷却及高导热材料等新兴方向有望推动热管理走向高效与智能化。

papers.title: Stabilization of Interband Phase Solitons in Two-Band Noncentrosymmetric Superconducting Rings
papers.abstract: Two-band superconductors maintain a relative interband phase which can carry winding soliton excitations in a superconducting ring, supported by independent winding numbers in the two bands. In rings of superconductors obeying the inversion symmetry the interband phase solitons are metastable states, separated from the uniform ground state by the energy of screening currents. In this work we find that, breaking the inversion symmetry strongly enough, one can make the soliton a true ground state. In that case, a magneto-electric coupling, absent in centrosymmetric materials, contributes critically above a certain threshold, a relevant, free-energy term, odd with respect to the winding number, which biases the energy balance in favor of a particular winding sign. Once the bias outweighs the energy cost that originally made the soliton metastable, a phase soliton with a finite winding number becomes the ground state, with chirality set by the applied field. In current--flux measurements performed in equilibrium states, the effect is demonstrated by field-odd soliton branches, that replace the metastable ones existing in mesoscopic rings, built by two-component superconductors, realizing a magneto-electric analog of the Little--Parks fluxoid-branch physics in the interband relative-phase sector.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“we find that”“contributes critically”“free-energy term”等理论分析表述，未提及实验手段或数值模拟方法。；研究对象：两带非中心对称超导环中的带间相位孤子（interband phase soliton），以及磁电耦合效应对其稳定性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当反转对称性被足够强地破坏时，带间相位孤子可以从亚稳态转变为真正的基态；磁电耦合项（对绕数呈奇函数）在超过某一阈值后主导自由能平衡，使具有有限绕数的相位孤子成为基态，其手性由外加磁场决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当反转对称性被足够强地破坏时，带间相位孤子可以从亚稳态转变为真正的基态；磁电耦合项（对绕数呈奇函数）在超过某一阈值后主导自由能平衡，使具有有限绕数的相位孤子成为基态，其手性由外加磁场决定。；创新点：首次提出在非中心对称两带超导环中，通过磁电耦合将带间相位孤子从亚稳态提升为基态，并预言了平衡态电流-磁通测量中可观测的场奇孤子分支，实现了Little–Parks通量分支物理在带间相对相位通道的磁电类比。摘要未突出说明与具体材料体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体理论框架，但涉及自由能分析、绕数（winding number）拓扑论证、电流-磁通平衡态测量方案的理论推导，以及Little–Parks物理的类比分析。摘要未提及具体计算方法（如第一性原理或数值模拟）。

papers.title: Brownian yet non-Gaussian diffusion through equilibrium nonlinear friction
papers.abstract: In Brownian yet non-Gaussian diffusion (BnGD) the mean squared displacement grows linearly in time. However, the displacement statistics do not follow a normal distribution throughout. Typically, they are non-Gaussian at intermediate times, before they cross over to Gaussian in the long-time regime. We demonstrate that nonlinear friction under correctly applied stochastic equilibrium conditions provides an explanation of this phenomenon also for homogeneous environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中“demonstrate that nonlinear friction under correctly applied stochastic equilibrium conditions provides an explanation”表明该工作通过理论论证提出解释机制，而非实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：布朗但非高斯扩散（BnGD）现象，具体关注在均匀环境中，非线性摩擦如何导致位移统计在中间时间尺度呈现非高斯分布、长时间尺度恢复高斯分布的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在正确施加随机平衡条件的前提下，非线性摩擦本身即可解释均匀环境中的布朗但非高斯扩散现象，无需依赖空间异质性或活性介质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在正确施加随机平衡条件的前提下，非线性摩擦本身即可解释均匀环境中的布朗但非高斯扩散现象，无需依赖空间异质性或活性介质。；创新点：已有BnGD解释通常依赖非均匀环境或活性噪声，本工作表明在均匀环境中仅通过平衡条件下的非线性摩擦即可复现该现象，摘要未突出说明更具体的理论工具或推导细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于随机热力学框架，重点在于“correctly applied stochastic equilibrium conditions”（正确施加的随机平衡条件）下对非线性摩擦模型的统计性质进行推导。

papers.title: Neural Renormalization Group Flow for Percolation
papers.abstract: Machine learning offers a possible route to data-driven real-space renormalization when the relevant observables are nonlocal and difficult to prescribe explicitly. We explore this idea for two-dimensional site percolation developping a supervised, scale-shared neural architecture. The model recursively applies the same learned coarse-graining rule across scales, producing a latent field from which the crossing probability is predicted, while a corresponding fine-graining decoder reconstructs the largest-cluster mask. Trained only on small lattices, the model extrapolates to substantially larger systems, recovers the spanning cluster with high fidelity, and produces observables obeying the expected finite-size scaling near the critical point. We observe that to get such performance it is key that the learned latent representation exhibits critical fluctuations and scale-dependent flows consistent with the renormalization-group structure of percolation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“machine learning”“neural architecture”“supervised”“scale-shared”等关键词，属于数据驱动的计算方法，并结合了重整化群理论框架。；研究对象：二维格点逾渗（two-dimensional site percolation）体系，具体关注跨越概率（crossing probability）、最大团簇（largest cluster）以及临界点附近的标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该神经网络模型仅在小尺寸晶格上训练，即可外推到更大系统，高保真地重建跨越团簇，并在临界点附近产生符合预期有限尺寸标度的可观测量。关键在于学习到的隐表示必须呈现临界涨落和与逾渗重整化群结构一致的尺度依赖流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该神经网络模型仅在小尺寸晶格上训练，即可外推到更大系统，高保真地重建跨越团簇，并在临界点附近产生符合预期有限尺寸标度的可观测量。关键在于学习到的隐表示必须呈现临界涨落和与逾渗重整化群结构一致的尺度依赖流。；创新点：提出了一种数据驱动的实空间重整化方案，无需显式预设非局域可观测量，而是通过神经网络自动学习粗粒化规则，并展示了该规则在跨尺度外推和临界标度行为上的有效性。摘要未突出说明与已有神经网络重整化方法的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用有监督的、尺度共享（scale-shared）的神经网络架构，递归地在不同尺度上应用同一套学习到的粗粒化规则（即重整化群流），生成隐场用于预测跨越概率；同时配备一个细粒化解码器（fine-graining decoder）用于重建最大团簇掩码。训练数据来自小尺寸晶格，测试时外推到更大系统。

papers.title: Interlayer-engineering of Charge Order Wave Vector in Kagome Metals
papers.abstract: Charge orders in the kagome metals AV$_3$Sb$_5$ sit at the center of a rich phase diagram that also includes superconductivity, nematicity, and signatures of time-reversal-symmetry breaking. Yet even the basic question of which charge ordering wave vectors are intrinsic, and which are selected by dimensionality and lattice coupling, remains unsettled. Importantly, the microscopic origin of different charge orders and, in particular, the relationship between the robust bulk $2 \times 2$ charge order and the controversial $4 \times 1$ modulation, which is primarily resolved by surface probes, remains unresolved. Here, we use first-principles calculations to study the role of interlayer coupling in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$ by tuning the interlayer separation from the monolayer limit to the bulk limit. In the monolayer AV$_3$Sb$_5$ (A = Rb, Cs), the phonon spectrum exhibits no instability at the M point; instead, the dominant lattice instability occurs at q = (1/4, 0, 0), consistent with a $4 \times 1$ modulation. As interlayer coupling increases in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$, an M-point phonon progressively softens and becomes unstable already near c = 12.24 Å, evolving into the strong $2 \times 2$ instability characteristic of the bulk. These results identify interlayer coupling as a control parameter at a fixed stoichiometry that links competing $4 \times 1$ and $2 \times 2$ tendencies, providing a unified framework for understanding why multiple charge-order wave vectors coexist and compete in kagome metals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“first-principles calculations”（第一性原理计算），并系统调节层间距进行模拟。；研究对象：笼目金属 AV₃Sb₅（A = Rb, Cs），具体为 CsV₃Sb₅ 中的电荷序波矢竞争问题，涉及单层到体相的层间耦合调控，以及 2×2 与 4×1 电荷序的微观起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 层间耦合是决定电荷序波矢选择的关键控制参数：单层 AV₃Sb₅ 中不存在 M 点声子不稳定性，主导晶格失稳发生在 q = (1/4, 0, 0)（对应 4×1 调制）；随着层间耦合增强，M 点声子逐渐软化并在 c ≈ 12.24 Å 附近失稳，最终演化为体相中强烈的 2×2 不稳定性。这为 4×1 与 2×2 电荷序共存与竞争提供了统一框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：层间耦合是决定电荷序波矢选择的关键控制参数：单层 AV₃Sb₅ 中不存在 M 点声子不稳定性，主导晶格失稳发生在 q = (1/4, 0, 0)（对应 4×1 调制）；随着层间耦合增强，M 点声子逐渐软化并在 c ≈ 12.24 Å 附近失稳，最终演化为体相中强烈的 2×2 不稳定性。这为 4×1 与 2×2 电荷序共存与竞争提供了统一框架。；创新点：在固定化学计量比下，将层间耦合识别为连接竞争性 4×1 与 2×2 电荷序倾向的控制参数，为理解笼目金属中多种电荷序波矢共存与竞争的微观机制提供了统一解释。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（DFT 框架下的声子谱计算），通过调节 CsV₃Sb₅ 的层间距（从单层极限到体相极限）系统研究层间耦合对晶格不稳定性的影响。

papers.title: Instability of two-dimensional nonrelativistic altermagnets
papers.abstract: Altermagnets (AMs) are collinear compensated magnets that exhibit momentum-dependent spin splitting without requiring a net magnetization. Since local magnetic moments and exchange-driven order do not rely on relativistic effects, altermagnetism can be naturally formulated in a nonrelativistic spin-group framework. This raises a basic question: can two-dimensional altermagnetic order be stabilized by purely exchange interactions in the absence of spin-orbit-induced anisotropy? We address this question by applying Bogoliubov's inequality to a minimal $d$-wave altermagnetic spin model. We show that the anisotropic exchange pattern responsible for altermagnetism still contributes only a quadratic long-wavelength term to the Bogoliubov denominator. Consequently, short-ranged exchange interactions alone cannot stabilize long-range altermagnetic order in two dimensions when continuous spin-rotation symmetry is preserved. In contrast, the corresponding three-dimensional system has a finite small-momentum contribution and is not ruled out by the Mermin-Wagner argument.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Bogoliubov's inequality、spin model、理论论证。；研究对象：二维非相对论性交错磁体（altermagnet）的磁有序稳定性问题，具体为纯交换相互作用下二维d波交错磁自旋模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在保持连续自旋旋转对称性且无自旋轨道耦合各向异性的情况下，短程交换相互作用单独无法在二维中稳定长程交错磁有序；而对应的三维系统则不受此限制，可存在有限小动量贡献，不被Mermin-Wagner论证排除。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在保持连续自旋旋转对称性且无自旋轨道耦合各向异性的情况下，短程交换相互作用单独无法在二维中稳定长程交错磁有序；而对应的三维系统则不受此限制，可存在有限小动量贡献，不被Mermin-Wagner论证排除。；创新点：首次从理论上证明二维交错磁有序在纯交换相互作用下无法稳定存在，揭示了维度效应对交错磁有序稳定性的关键影响。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：对最小d波交错磁自旋模型应用Bogoliubov不等式，分析长波极限下各向异性交换作用对不等式分母的贡献。

papers.title: Non-Hermitian Skin Effect from Radiative Coupling in a Reciprocal Chiral Medium
papers.abstract: We find that long-range radiative coupling through a passive reciprocal chiral medium produces an unusual non-Hermitian skin effect in a chain of electric dipoles. Although the system is reciprocal, the chirality generates polarization-dependent phase accumulation and attenuation, leading to degenerate pairs of skin modes localized at opposite boundaries. We find that the skin mode profile consists of an exponential contribution from an isolated complex-$β$ pole and a longer-range tail proportional to $1/[n(\ln n)^2]$, where $n$ is the distance from the occupied boundary measured in lattice sites. Finite-chain calculations show that part of the OBC spectrum contracts toward the Bloch spectrum, whereas the number of boundary-localized modes remains extensive.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We find that”“Finite-chain calculations show”等理论推导与计算表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：通过无源互易手性介质中的长程辐射耦合实现的一维电偶极子链，重点研究其中的非厄米趋肤效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在互易手性介质中，长程辐射耦合可产生非厄米趋肤效应：手性导致偏振相关的相位累积与衰减，使趋肤模成对地局域在相反边界；趋肤模轮廓由孤立复β极点的指数贡献与正比于1/[n(ln n)²]的长程尾部组成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在互易手性介质中，长程辐射耦合可产生非厄米趋肤效应：手性导致偏振相关的相位累积与衰减，使趋肤模成对地局域在相反边界；趋肤模轮廓由孤立复β极点的指数贡献与正比于1/[n(ln n)²]的长程尾部组成。；创新点：首次在互易（非磁）手性介质中通过纯辐射耦合实现非厄米趋肤效应，且趋肤模具有非指数长程尾部（1/[n(ln n)²]），并发现开边界谱部分收缩至布洛赫谱而边界模数目仍保持广延性——这一组合行为在以往非厄米趋肤效应研究中未见报道。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与有限链计算。具体包括：对电偶极子链的辐射耦合进行解析建模（提取复β极点），以及有限链本征谱计算（用于检验开边界谱与布洛赫谱的关系及边界局域模数目）。

papers.title: Topologically protected perfect crossed Andreev reflection in flux-engineered quantum wire junctions
papers.abstract: Generating non-locally entangled electron pairs via Cooper-pair splitting is vital for solid-state quantum information processing. However, isolating the underlying crossed Andreev reflection (CAR) is challenging due to competing transport processes like electron tunneling (ET) and local Andreev reflection (AR). Here, we propose a flux-tunable four-terminal normal metal-superconductor junction that achieves deterministic, 100\% efficient CAR. We demonstrate that at exactly half a magnetic flux quantum ($φ=π$), exact destructive Aharonov-Bohm and Peierls interferences structurally forbid ET and AR respectively. By tuning the central junction hopping, electron reflection is also suppressed to zero. Using the Cauchy argument principle, we prove that this suppression manifests as a quantized topological winding number, guaranteeing a topologically protected unit CAR probability. We establish that this regime is characterized by a strictly positive cross-correlation shot noise, providing an unambiguous experimental signature of Cooper-pair splitting. Furthermore, this perfect CAR is nearly broadband within the superconducting gap and remarkably robust against structural disorder, offering a highly resilient architecture for deterministic nonlocal entanglement generation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“we propose”“we prove”“Cauchy argument principle”“topological winding number”等理论推导与模型构建关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：由正常金属-超导体构成的四端量子线结，具体研究其中由磁通调控的交叉Andreev反射（CAR）过程，即库珀对劈裂产生的非局域纠缠电子对输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在磁通量取半量子（φ=π）时，通过Aharonov-Bohm和Peierls干涉可结构性地完全抑制电子隧穿（ET）和局域Andreev反射（AR），再调节中心结跳跃参数可消除电子反射，从而实现确定性的100%效率CAR，且该完美CAR受拓扑量子化绕数保护，对结构无序具有鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在磁通量取半量子（φ=π）时，通过Aharonov-Bohm和Peierls干涉可结构性地完全抑制电子隧穿（ET）和局域Andreev反射（AR），再调节中心结跳跃参数可消除电子反射，从而实现确定性的100%效率CAR，且该完美CAR受拓扑量子化绕数保护，对结构无序具有鲁棒性。；创新点：首次提出通过磁通调控在四端结中同时结构性禁止ET和AR，实现100%效率的拓扑保护CAR，并以正交叉关联散粒噪声作为库珀对劈裂的明确实验判据；摘要未突出说明与以往CAR方案的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论模型与解析证明：构建四端正常金属-超导结的量子线模型，利用Aharonov-Bohm干涉和Peierls相位实现干涉相消，采用Cauchy辐角原理（Cauchy argument principle）证明输运抑制对应量子化拓扑绕数，并计算散粒噪声（shot noise）作为实验可测信号。

papers.title: A solid-solution approach for room-temperature bulk plasticity in KTa1-xNbxO3
papers.abstract: Dislocations are being engineered into perovskite oxides to harvest versatile functional properties. One major bottleneck, however, persists: perovskite oxides that can be engineered with dislocations, particularly via mechanical deformation at room temperature in bulk scale, have so far been limited to only three materials: SrTiO3 (2001, Brunner et al.), KNbO3 (2016, Mark et al.), and KTaO3 (2024, Fang & Zhang et al.). Here, we propose a simple and effective approach by using solid solution to significantly extend the range of materials. We showcase KTa1-xNbxO3 (0<x<1) perovskite oxides for their bulk plasticity at room temperature by constructing a closed-loop validation workflow that includes crystal growth, Brinell indentation, bulk compression, and transmission electron microscopy characterization. Our findings are expected to unlock the materials toolbox for dislocation-tuned functionality of perovskite oxides.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到晶体生长、布氏压痕、块体压缩、透射电子显微镜表征等实验手段。；研究对象：KTa1-xNbxO3（0<x<1）钙钛矿氧化物固溶体，具体研究其在室温下的块体塑性变形能力。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过固溶体策略，KTa1-xNbxO3在室温下表现出块体塑性，显著扩展了可通过位错工程调控功能的钙钛矿氧化物材料范围（此前仅有SrTiO3、KNbO3、KTaO3三种材料）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过固溶体策略，KTa1-xNbxO3在室温下表现出块体塑性，显著扩展了可通过位错工程调控功能的钙钛矿氧化物材料范围（此前仅有SrTiO3、KNbO3、KTaO3三种材料）。；创新点：提出利用固溶体（KTa1-xNbxO3）这一简单有效的方法，将室温块体塑性钙钛矿氧化物的材料种类从三种单一氧化物扩展到连续可调的固溶体体系，为位错调控功能提供了更广阔的材料选择空间。
papers.method_zh: 闭环验证流程，包括：晶体生长、布氏压痕测试、块体压缩实验、透射电子显微镜（TEM）表征。

papers.title: Strain-driven orbital-selective reconstruction and bicollinear-to-stripe evolution in FeTe
papers.abstract: FeTe, as a representative parent material among iron-based superconductors, provides an ideal platform for exploring the interplay among orbital-selective correlations, magnetism, and unconventional superconductivity. However, a unified picture of the correlated electronic structure and magnetism of FeTe under strain remains to be fully clarified. Here, combining density functional theory plus dynamical mean-field theory and Heisenberg model analysis, we uncover an orbital-selective reconstruction of the correlated electronic structure and reveal a strain-driven trajectory from bicollinear to stripe antiferromagnetism (AFM) via an intermediate competing staggered $n$-mer AFM regime in FeTe. Moderate strain gives rise to a regime where more coherent quasiparticles coexist with suppressed local moments. Further strain drives FeTe into an incoherent correlated regime with robust local moments and Fe-$3d_{z^2}$-dominated low-energy states. These results establish a strain-driven trajectory across distinct magnetic and correlated electronic states in FeTe.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“density functional theory plus dynamical mean-field theory”（DFT+DMFT）和“Heisenberg model analysis”。；研究对象：铁基超导母体材料FeTe，重点研究其在应变作用下的轨道选择性关联电子结构、磁性（双斜列反铁磁到条纹反铁磁的转变）以及中间竞争态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了FeTe在应变驱动下经历从双斜列反铁磁到条纹反铁磁的演化路径，中间经过一个竞争的交错n-mer反铁磁态；同时伴随轨道选择性电子结构重构，从相干准粒子与抑制局域磁矩共存的态过渡到非相干关联态（Fe-3d_z²主导低能激发）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了FeTe在应变驱动下经历从双斜列反铁磁到条纹反铁磁的演化路径，中间经过一个竞争的交错n-mer反铁磁态；同时伴随轨道选择性电子结构重构，从相干准粒子与抑制局域磁矩共存的态过渡到非相干关联态（Fe-3d_z²主导低能激发）。；创新点：首次在FeTe中建立了应变驱动的从双斜列到条纹反铁磁的完整演化轨迹，并识别出中间的交错n-mer反铁磁竞争态，同时将磁性转变与轨道选择性电子重构（特别是Fe-3d_z²轨道的主导作用）联系起来。摘要未突出说明与具体实验对比的细节。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论+动力学平均场理论（DFT+DMFT）结合海森堡模型分析。

papers.title: Emptiness formation in the Lieb-Liniger gas: hydrodynamic instantons and a conjectured rate function
papers.abstract: We study the emptiness formation probability (EFP) in the ground state of the repulsive one-dimensional Lieb-Liniger Bose gas. For a macroscopic empty interval of length $2R$, its leading asymptotic behavior is described by a rate function $f(γ_0)$, defined by $-\log P(R)\sim(ρ_0R)^2f(γ_0)$, where $ρ_0$ is the mean density and $γ_0$ is the dimensionless interaction strength. We propose a parameter-free integral equation for $f(γ_0)$. Starting from the exact dual-field Fredholm-determinant representation of the EFP, we show how the conjectured kernel arises formally and identify the uniform asymptotic statement that remains to be proven for a rigorous derivation. The conjecture reproduces the Tonks-Girardeau and weak-coupling limits, as well as the first correction obtained independently in both limits. It also agrees at the few-percent level with numerical minimization of the Lieb-Liniger hydrodynamic action over more than four orders of magnitude in coupling. The numerical calculation yields the corresponding emptiness instantons and their astroid-like vacuum regions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“提出积分方程”“形式推导”“猜想”“数值最小化”等理论推导与数值计算关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：一维排斥性Lieb-Liniger玻色气体的基态，具体研究其空区间形成概率（EFP），即长度为2R的宏观空区间在基态中出现的概率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一个无参数的积分方程，用于描述空区间形成概率的速率函数f(γ₀)，该猜想在Tonks-Girardeau极限和弱耦合极限下均正确，并与数值结果在四个数量级耦合强度范围内吻合（误差在百分之几以内）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一个无参数的积分方程，用于描述空区间形成概率的速率函数f(γ₀)，该猜想在Tonks-Girardeau极限和弱耦合极限下均正确，并与数值结果在四个数量级耦合强度范围内吻合（误差在百分之几以内）。；创新点：首次提出一个无参数积分方程作为EFP速率函数的统一表达式，并给出其形式推导路径；同时通过数值计算揭示了空穴瞬子的星形（astroid-like）真空区域结构。摘要未明确说明与已有理论工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 从EFP的精确对偶场Fredholm行列式表示出发，形式推导出猜想核；利用Lieb-Liniger流体动力学作用量的数值最小化计算速率函数及对应的空穴瞬子（instanton）构型。

papers.title: When dissipative steady states admit thermodynamic occupation laws
papers.abstract: Non-equilibrium steady states (NESSs) generally lack thermodynamic occupation laws because finite stationary circulation and a globally exact rate-ratio field cannot coexist for the same Markov generator. Here we construct a sector-separated geometry that overcomes this incompatibility without arresting dissipation. Entropy-production exposure-and-separation excludes the entropy-producing state~$0$ from the conditional occupation manifold while retaining it in the dissipative full graph; physical returns $i\to0\to0^\ast$ become effectively Markovian in the strong-bias/rapid-reset (SR) limit. For a thermodynamically complete conditional manifold, autonomous redistribution (AR) eliminates residual futile circulation, making the rate-ratio one-form exact. Thermodynamic calibration gives $X_i=β(Δμ- \mathcal F_i^{\mathrm{cost}})$ and $p_i=e^{X_i}/Z_\mathcal{C}$, with $Z_\mathcal{C}=1+\sum_i e^{X_i}$. Full-graph probabilities factorize exactly as $P_α=(1-P_0)p_α$. In the SR limit, the kinetic factor tends to unity while $p_α\to e^{X_α}/Z_\mathcal C$, yielding $P_α\to p_α$ while finite dissipation persists. Near AR, integrability is lost linearly in residual cycle current whereas dissipation begins quadratically. In the binary zero-cycle-rank limit, occupation redistributes autonomously under maintained $Δμ$ bias, yielding the inverted Fermi--Dirac law, which is applied to thermal smearing in quantum-dot lasers. The framework provides constructive acquisition conditions and failure diagnostics for thermodynamic occupation laws in dissipative NESSs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：construct（构造）、Markov generator、thermodynamic calibration、framework。；研究对象：非平衡稳态（NESS）中的热力学占据律（thermodynamic occupation laws）问题，具体涉及马尔可夫生成器描述的耗散系统、扇区分离几何、量子点激光器中的热展宽。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过构造扇区分离几何，在保持有限耗散的同时，使非平衡稳态的占据概率满足热力学形式的玻尔兹曼-吉布斯分布（p_i = e^{X_i}/Z），并推导出二元零循环秩极限下的反费米-狄拉克分布。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过构造扇区分离几何，在保持有限耗散的同时，使非平衡稳态的占据概率满足热力学形式的玻尔兹曼-吉布斯分布（p_i = e^{X_i}/Z），并推导出二元零循环秩极限下的反费米-狄拉克分布。；创新点：摘要未突出说明（但可看出其新意在于：首次在保持有限耗散的前提下，通过扇区分离几何使速率比一形式精确闭合，从而在非平衡稳态中重建热力学占据律，并给出可构造性条件与失效诊断）。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造与解析推导：基于马尔可夫生成器框架，引入熵产生暴露-分离（exposure-and-separation）机制、强偏置/快速重置（SR）极限、自主再分布（AR）消除残余无效循环，以及热力学标定（thermodynamic calibration）方法。

papers.title: Influence of twist direction and large deformation on soft material torsional contact
papers.abstract: Shear-induced contact area reduction is widely observed in soft contacts, yet recent torsional experiments have revealed a more complex non-monotonic evolution in which the contact area first increases and then decreases with twist angle. The mechanism responsible for this initial area increase and the role of large deformation in the overall area evolution remain unclear. In this study, we experimentally investigate the torsional contact response of soft Polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) spheres by combining forward-backward twist tests with a systematic variation of the curing-agent-to-base ratio to tune material softness and deformation level. The loading-unloading tests show that the torsional interface is strongly irreversible: during unloading, the contact area follows a decrease-increase-decrease path rather than retracing the loading branch, and repeatable petal-like edges appear, indicating a wrinkle-induced surface instability. By decreasing the mixing ratio, we find that larger deformation strengthens the area-reduction contribution and eventually suppresses the initial area increase, leading to a monotonic area decrease during loading for sufficiently soft PDMS. Softer PDMS also exhibits lower shear strength, weaker torque oscillations, and improved repeatability. The results provide experimental evidence that large deformation can drive shear-induced contact area reduction, while the origin of the initial area increase remains unresolved. These findings narrow the possible mechanisms (e.g., triboelectrification) responsible for the initial area increase and provide a stringent benchmark for frictional contact models of soft interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“experimentally investigate”“loading-unloading tests”，属于实验研究。；研究对象：软材料（聚二甲基硅氧烷，PDMS）球体在扭转接触中的接触面积演化行为，具体涉及扭转方向、大变形效应以及接触界面的不可逆性与表面失稳现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 大变形会增强剪切诱导的接触面积缩减效应，并最终抑制初始面积增加，使足够软的PDMS在加载过程中呈现单调面积减小；而初始面积增加的机制仍未解决，但实验结果缩小了可能机制（如摩擦起电）的范围。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：大变形会增强剪切诱导的接触面积缩减效应，并最终抑制初始面积增加，使足够软的PDMS在加载过程中呈现单调面积减小；而初始面积增加的机制仍未解决，但实验结果缩小了可能机制（如摩擦起电）的范围。；创新点：首次系统结合扭转方向变化与材料软硬度调节，揭示大变形对扭转接触面积非单调演化的调控作用，并明确排除了部分可能的初始面积增加机制，为软界面摩擦接触模型提供了严格的实验基准。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：正向-反向扭转测试（forward-backward twist tests），通过系统改变固化剂与基体比例（curing-agent-to-base ratio）来调节材料软硬度和变形程度；加载-卸载循环测试用于表征界面不可逆性；观察接触边缘的“花瓣状”形貌以判断褶皱诱导的表面失稳。

papers.title: Thermally quenched metastability in metal-insulator transitions via elemental substitution
papers.abstract: Thermal quenching inhibits equilibration toward the thermodynamic ground state during phase transitions, revealing metastable phases such as structural glasses and quenched alloys. Whether such thermally quenched metastability can be realized in metal-insulator transitions has remained an open question because these transformations are governed by collective electronic reorganization rather than atomic diffusion. We demonstrate that rapid cooling exceeding 10$^9$ K s$^{-1}$ kinetically avoids the metal-insulator transition, stabilizing a long-lived metastable metallic phase in tungsten-substituted VO$_2$. Temperature-dependent relaxation reveals nucleation-dominated kinetics with a thermal activation barrier introduced by tungsten substitution. Our results establish elemental substitution as a route to thermally quenched metastability in metal-insulator transitions, expanding metastable phase control to electronic phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate”“rapid cooling”“Temperature-dependent relaxation”等实验性描述。；研究对象：钨取代的二氧化钒（W-substituted VO₂）中的金属-绝缘体相变，以及通过热淬火实现亚稳态金属相的可能性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过超过10⁹ K s⁻¹的快速冷却，可以动力学地避开金属-绝缘体相变，稳定一种长寿命的亚稳态金属相；钨取代引入了热激活势垒，使该相变呈现成核主导的动力学特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过超过10⁹ K s⁻¹的快速冷却，可以动力学地避开金属-绝缘体相变，稳定一种长寿命的亚稳态金属相；钨取代引入了热激活势垒，使该相变呈现成核主导的动力学特征。；创新点：首次在金属-绝缘体相变中实现热淬火诱导的亚稳态，将元素取代作为调控电子相亚稳态的通用途径，扩展了亚稳相控制的范围至电子相（而非仅结构相）。
papers.method_zh: 快速热淬火实验（冷却速率>10⁹ K s⁻¹）、温度依赖的弛豫测量，用于表征亚稳态金属相的稳定性与衰变动力学。

papers.title: Atomic investigations on the mechanical properties of CoCrNi medium-entropy alloy nanowires
papers.abstract: This work investigated the mechanical properties of CoCrNi medium-entropy alloy (MEA) nanowires under uniaxial tensile loading along three crystallographic orientations [100], [110] and [111].The CoCrNi single crystal nanowires with face-centered cubic (FCC) structure exhibits a strong anisotropic behavior.Molecular dynamics simulations were employed to give atomic-level insight into the plastic deformation.The surface effect causes dislocations emitted from the free surface and slip into the internal. The temperature effect was also considered. Under identical geometric configurations, crystal orientations and temperature, interatomic interactions dominate key mechanical properties such as Young's modulus and yield strength.Simulation results reveal a promounced linear correlation between the average atomic force and mechanical performance across eight representative FCC metallic nanowires (Al, Au, Ag, Cu, Ni, Al19Mg alloy, FeCoCrCuNi high-entropy alloy and CoCrNi MEA). This study delivers novel insights into the mechanical behavior of metallic nanowires, and offers guidance for the rational design of alloy nanowires.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及“Molecular dynamics simulations”（分子动力学模拟），属于原子级计算模拟研究。；研究对象：CoCrNi中熵合金（MEA）纳米线，具体为面心立方（FCC）单晶结构，研究其在[100]、[110]和[111]三种晶体取向下单轴拉伸的力学行为与塑性变形机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CoCrNi中熵合金纳米线表现出强烈的力学各向异性，塑性变形由表面发射位错并向内部滑移主导；在相同几何构型、晶体取向和温度下，原子间相互作用决定杨氏模量和屈服强度等关键力学性能。此外，在八种代表性FCC金属纳米线中，平均原子力与力学性能之间存在显著的线性关联。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CoCrNi中熵合金纳米线表现出强烈的力学各向异性，塑性变形由表面发射位错并向内部滑移主导；在相同几何构型、晶体取向和温度下，原子间相互作用决定杨氏模量和屈服强度等关键力学性能。此外，在八种代表性FCC金属纳米线中，平均原子力与力学性能之间存在显著的线性关联。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其新意在于：首次系统揭示CoCrNi MEA纳米线在不同晶体取向下力学性能的各向异性及表面位错发射机制，并提出了跨多种FCC金属纳米线的平均原子力与力学性能的普适线性关联，为合金纳米线的理性设计提供指导。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学（MD）模拟，用于原子级解析塑性变形过程；考虑了表面效应和温度效应；对比了八种FCC金属纳米线（Al、Au、Ag、Cu、Ni、Al19Mg合金、FeCoCrCuNi高熵合金和CoCrNi MEA）以建立平均原子力与力学性能的关联。

papers.title: Dynamical phase selection controls compute scaling in looped transformers
papers.abstract: A looped transformer performs inference by iterating a weight-tied map, making its computation a dynamical process whose cost is set by the resulting inference dynamics. Here we show that networks with identical architecture and objective, trained to identical accuracy, nevertheless realize distinct dynamical phases depending strongly on initialization, and that the bifurcation defining each phase determines how test-time compute scales. The phases are distinguished by their bifurcation mechanisms, including a saddle-node fold and a Neimark-Sacker-type transition to bounded nonstationary motion. In the fold phase, a one-dimensional normal-form reduction predicts both the relaxation-time and spectral-gap amplitudes from local derivatives of the trained map, yielding the parameter-free relation $τ(\varepsilon)[1-λ_{\max}(-\varepsilon)]\toπ$. Composed with a regular distribution of problem difficulty, the same critical slowing down produces the workload-level tail $P(τ>N)\sim N^{-2}$. In the Neimark--Sacker phase, the fold scaling law disappears rather than merely changing its prefactor. Thus, test-time compute is not determined by architecture alone. It is governed by the dynamical phase of the solution found by training.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要涉及“dynamical process”“normal-form reduction”“scaling law”等理论分析关键词，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：循环变压器（looped transformer）的推理动力学，具体研究其计算成本（test-time compute）如何由训练后映射的动力学相（dynamical phase）决定，属于神经网络动力学与统计物理交叉体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 具有相同架构、目标和训练精度的网络，因初始化不同可进入截然不同的动力学相（鞍结分岔相 vs. Neimark-Sacker 相），而每个相的分岔机制决定了测试时计算量的标度行为；鞍结相中临界慢化产生普适的松弛时间-谱隙关系 τ(ε)[1−λ_max(−ε)]→π，并导致工作量尾部分布 P(τ>N)∼N^{−2}，而 Neimark-Sacker 相中该标度律完全消失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：具有相同架构、目标和训练精度的网络，因初始化不同可进入截然不同的动力学相（鞍结分岔相 vs. Neimark-Sacker 相），而每个相的分岔机制决定了测试时计算量的标度行为；鞍结相中临界慢化产生普适的松弛时间-谱隙关系 τ(ε)[1−λ_max(−ε)]→π，并导致工作量尾部分布 P(τ>N)∼N^{−2}，而 Neimark-Sacker 相中该标度律完全消失。；创新点：首次揭示测试时计算量并非由架构单独决定，而是由训练所找到解的动力学相（分岔类型）主导；并给出参数无关的定量关系 τ(ε)[1−λ_max(−ε)]→π，以及不同分岔相下标度律的截然不同行为（消失而非仅改变前因子）。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合数值训练：对权重共享的循环映射进行动力学分岔分析，利用一维正规形约化（normal-form reduction）从训练后映射的局部导数推导松弛时间和谱隙振幅，并组合问题难度的正则分布得到工作量尾部标度。

papers.title: Field-amplified readouts of weak altermagnetic exchange in MnF$_2$
papers.abstract: MnF$_2$, the textbook two-sublattice antiferromagnet, has reemerged as a prototypical altermagnet, yet the sublattice-odd exchange that defines this identity remains under active debate: it enters the magnon splitting only in quadrature with the dipole--dipole interaction, its magnitude suppressed and its sign erased. An overdetermined first-principles total-energy mapping resolves this scale as a seventh-neighbor imbalance $δ{J_7}\simeq+8~μ$eV. The resulting Hamiltonian, with the dipole--dipole interaction included explicitly, reproduces the low-energy gap and the visible finite-momentum splitting. A longitudinal field $B\parallel c$ then acts as a linear amplifier of the hidden scale, opening two signed, field-linear readouts. The first is the compensation field $B^\ast(\mathbf Q)$, the position of minimum splitting, which is equal and opposite at the rotation-related partner momenta: a shift from zero field is itself evidence of a finite imbalance, its side gives the sign, and its magnitude, $|B^\ast|\simeq0.34$~T here, gives the scale. The second is the fixed-field contrast of the partner splittings, $\simeq0.14$~meV at $1$~T, six times the zero-field excess: a sign check from just two spectra. Both readouts survive a $0.12$~meV energy resolution, and the construction carries over to any easy-axis collinear altermagnet, bringing $μ$eV altermagnetic exchange within present instrumental reach.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提及“first-principles total-energy mapping”（第一性原理总能量映射）、“Hamiltonian”（哈密顿量）等理论计算关键词，未提及实验测量手段。；研究对象：MnF₂（氟化锰），一种典型的双子格反铁磁体，近期被重新认定为交错磁体（altermagnet）。研究聚焦于其子格奇次交换相互作用（即交错磁交换）的尺度与符号，以及纵向磁场下的可观测响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: MnF₂ 中决定交错磁身份的子格奇次交换被确定为第七近邻不平衡 δJ₇ ≈ +8 μeV；施加沿 c 轴的纵向磁场 B∥c 可线性放大这一隐藏能标，产生两个带符号的场线性读出信号：补偿场 B*(Q) 和固定场下伙伴劈裂对比度，二者均可直接给出该交换相互作用的符号与大小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：MnF₂ 中决定交错磁身份的子格奇次交换被确定为第七近邻不平衡 δJ₇ ≈ +8 μeV；施加沿 c 轴的纵向磁场 B∥c 可线性放大这一隐藏能标，产生两个带符号的场线性读出信号：补偿场 B*(Q) 和固定场下伙伴劈裂对比度，二者均可直接给出该交换相互作用的符号与大小。；创新点：提出利用纵向磁场作为“线性放大器”，将原本仅以正交（quadrature）方式进入磁振子劈裂、且被偶极相互作用掩盖的微弱交错磁交换（μeV 量级）转化为可直接测量的场线性信号，并给出符号判据；该方法可推广至任意易轴共线交错磁体。
papers.method_zh: 采用超定（overdetermined）第一性原理总能量映射方法提取交换参数；构建包含偶极-偶极相互作用（dipole–dipole interaction）的哈密顿量；通过解析/数值求解磁振子谱，分析纵向磁场下的劈裂行为与读出信号。

papers.title: Competition between Geometrical Frustration and the Kondo Effect in CePdAl Revealed by High-Resolution Magnetization
papers.abstract: CePdAl is a heavy-fermion compound with a quasi-kagome structure, where geometrical frustration competes with the Kondo effect. Using a high-sensitivity magnetometer, we observe clear first-order metamagnetic transitions without magnetization plateaus in CePdAl at 80 mK, indicating a lifting of frustration through the suppression of the Kondo effect and spin flips of ordered moments under fields. An anomaly in the nonlinear magnetic susceptibility at 4.3 T suggests nondipolar correlations in the polarized paramagnetic state. Furthermore, we found no evidence of non-Fermi-liquid behavior in the high-field region, where the antiferromagnetic order is completely suppressed. These findings establish the essential thermodynamic constraints for understanding the field-induced spin-liquid state in CePdAl.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用高灵敏度磁强计”（high-sensitivity magnetometer）进行测量，并报告了实验观测结果（如80 mK下的磁化数据）。；研究对象：重费米子化合物CePdAl，其具有准kagome结构，核心物理现象是几何阻挫与近藤效应之间的竞争，以及磁场诱导的自旋液体态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在80 mK下，CePdAl中观测到清晰的一级亚磁跃迁且无磁化平台，表明磁场通过抑制近藤效应和翻转有序磁矩来解除几何阻挫；同时在高场区未发现非费米液体行为证据。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在80 mK下，CePdAl中观测到清晰的一级亚磁跃迁且无磁化平台，表明磁场通过抑制近藤效应和翻转有序磁矩来解除几何阻挫；同时在高场区未发现非费米液体行为证据。；创新点：首次在CePdAl中观测到无磁化平台的一级亚磁跃迁，并明确排除了高场区非费米液体行为，为理解该材料中场致自旋液体态提供了关键的热力学约束条件。
papers.method_zh: 高灵敏度磁强计（high-sensitivity magnetometer）进行高分辨率磁化测量，包括非线性磁化率测量（在4.3 T处观测到异常）。

papers.title: Optical spectroscopy of composite fermion edge states in the fractional quantum Hall effect
papers.abstract: We show that edge states in fractional quantum Hall effect samples can be selectively probed and excited with sub-terahertz optical spectroscopy. Using the composite fermion (CF) mean-field framework, which maps the strongly correlated fractional quantum Hall problem onto an effective integer quantum Hall problem, we calculate the absorbance spectrum for the Jain sequence of filling fractions including both bulk and edge states. The CF edge-state absorption peaks appear in the millimeter-wave to sub-terahertz range, e.g., 60-500 GHz at B = 10 T in GaAs, i.e. they are blueshifted with respect to the bulk CF cyclotron frequency but are well below the integer quantum Hall cyclotron frequency scale at the same magnetic fields. The number of resolved peaks in each series of the absorption spectrum counts the filled Lambda-levels and fingerprints the fraction. Inversion symmetry breaking near the edge activates optical transitions forbidden in the bulk and enables second-order nonlinear processes in electric-dipole approximation. The absolute frequency scale of the spectrum is set by the CF effective mass, which is generated entirely by electron-electron interactions, so the absorption spectrum provides a direct optical probe of this interaction-induced mass.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“composite fermion (CF) mean-field framework”进行计算，并“calculate the absorbance spectrum”，未提及实验测量。；研究对象：分数量子霍尔效应（FQHE）中的边缘态，具体为Jain序列填充因子下的复合费米子边缘态，材料体系为GaAs二维电子气。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 复合费米子边缘态在毫米波至亚太赫兹波段（如B=10 T时60–500 GHz）产生可分辨的吸收峰，其频率相对体态CF回旋频率蓝移，但远低于同磁场下整数量子霍尔回旋频率；吸收峰数目直接对应填充的Lambda能级数，可作为填充分数的“指纹”。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：复合费米子边缘态在毫米波至亚太赫兹波段（如B=10 T时60–500 GHz）产生可分辨的吸收峰，其频率相对体态CF回旋频率蓝移，但远低于同磁场下整数量子霍尔回旋频率；吸收峰数目直接对应填充的Lambda能级数，可作为填充分数的“指纹”。；创新点：首次提出用亚太赫兹光学光谱选择性探测和激发FQHE边缘态，并揭示吸收谱可直接测量由电子-电子相互作用产生的复合费米子有效质量——这是对相互作用诱导质量的直接光学探针。摘要未突出说明与以往边缘态输运或光学研究的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用复合费米子平均场理论框架，将强关联FQHE问题映射为有效整数量子霍尔问题，计算包含体态和边缘态的吸收光谱（absorbance spectrum）。同时分析了电偶极近似下由边缘反演对称性破缺激活的非线性光学过程。

papers.title: Phase transitions and microphases in elastomers. II. Anisotropy-driven morphologies
papers.abstract: In swollen elastomers, elasticity can arrest macroscopic demixing between the polymer network and the solvent, producing stable domains of finite size. While previous theories have focused on isotropically swollen elastomers, anisotropy strongly influences the phase behavior of many related systems, such as gels and crosslinked polymer blends. Building on the approach developed in Part I of this two-part paper, we investigate the effects of two experimentally induced sources of anisotropy: uniaxial swelling and stiffness gradients. We show that uniaxial swelling can lead to the formation of stable lamellar microphases and modify phase behavior, while stiffness gradients can cause spatial variations in the characteristic microphase size.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“previous theories”“Building on the approach developed in Part I”，以及讨论“elasticity can arrest”“we investigate the effects”，属于理论建模与分析。；研究对象：弹性体（elastomers）中的相分离与微相（microphases）行为，具体关注各向异性（单轴溶胀和刚度梯度）对聚合物网络与溶剂体系相行为的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单轴溶胀可诱导稳定的层状微相形成并改变相行为；刚度梯度会导致特征微相尺寸在空间上发生变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单轴溶胀可诱导稳定的层状微相形成并改变相行为；刚度梯度会导致特征微相尺寸在空间上发生变化。；创新点：将各向异性效应引入弹性体微相形成的理论描述，系统研究了单轴溶胀和刚度梯度这两种实验可控的各向异性来源对相图和微相形貌的影响。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于该两篇论文第一部分（Part I）所发展的理论框架，对各向异性来源（单轴溶胀、刚度梯度）进行理论分析与建模。摘要未明确说明具体数学方法（如自由能泛函、自洽场理论等）。

papers.title: Beyond Allen-Heine-Cardona: non-perturbative electron-phonon interactions in the linewidths and lineshifts of diamond
papers.abstract: The temperature-dependent band gap of solids is usually computed from the perturbative Allen-Heine-Cardona (AHC) electron-phonon self-energy evaluated on-shell. Extending AHC to arbitrary frequency $ω$ to determine the full spectral function via the Dyson equation is known to fail, misplacing satellites and yielding no broadening at band extrema, while non-perturbative supercell (SC) methods have focused on eigenvalue averages rather than lineshapes, and approaches based on special displacements cannot describe the full lineshape, or the lineshift at degenerate bands. Here we use a non-perturbative Green's function method (NPG), stochastically sampling distorted SC configurations, from which the spectral function, including lineshift, linewidth, and asymmetry, follows directly, and we recover finite spectral weight at the renormalized band extrema. We prove that the perturbative self-energy, computed to any order with the bare propagator and introduced into the Dyson equation, has an imaginary part that vanishes within the bare gap, giving incorrect spectral functions: self-consistency of the propagator is essential to broaden the band edges. NPG satisfies this property by construction, and contains all non-bubble diagrams. We also give a simple explanation of why SC methods converge with much smaller SCs than the corresponding $\mathbf{q}$-grids required by perturbation theory. For the band gap shift itself, the NPG and on-shell AHC results are found to be comparable, demonstrating that higher-order terms do not significantly alter the resulting renormalization in diamond. When it comes to the spectral function though, our results show that going beyond bare perturbation theory is not merely more accurate, but necessary, and NPG provides a robust framework to capture spectral broadening and higher-order effects from first principles.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“非微扰格林函数方法（NPG）”“随机采样”“超胞（SC）方法”“微扰自能”等理论计算关键词，未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：金刚石（diamond）的电子-声子相互作用，具体关注其温度依赖的能带隙重整化、谱函数中的谱线位移（lineshift）、谱线宽度（linewidth）及不对称性（asymmetry），尤其是能带极值处的谱权重行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非微扰格林函数方法（NPG）能够正确给出金刚石在重整化能带极值处的有限谱权重，而任意阶的裸微扰自能代入戴森方程后，其虚部在裸带隙内恒为零，导致谱函数错误；NPG与on-shell AHC方法给出的带隙位移相当，表明高阶项对金刚石的重整化影响不大，但谱函数必须超越裸微扰理论才能正确描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非微扰格林函数方法（NPG）能够正确给出金刚石在重整化能带极值处的有限谱权重，而任意阶的裸微扰自能代入戴森方程后，其虚部在裸带隙内恒为零，导致谱函数错误；NPG与on-shell AHC方法给出的带隙位移相当，表明高阶项对金刚石的重整化影响不大，但谱函数必须超越裸微扰理论才能正确描述。；创新点：首次将非微扰格林函数方法系统应用于谱线形状（而非仅特征值平均）的计算，证明自洽传播子对展宽能带边缘是本质必需的，且NPG天然包含所有非气泡图；同时给出了超胞方法比微扰论q网格收敛更快的简单解释。
papers.method_zh: 非微扰格林函数方法（NPG）：随机采样畸变超胞构型，直接计算谱函数（含谱线位移、宽度和不对称性）；与on-shell AHC（Allen-Heine-Cardona）微扰自能方法进行对比；并分析了超胞方法与微扰论所需q网格收敛性的差异。

papers.title: Fluctuation--response relations from an emergent $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry in the rotating stochastic Landau model
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate the extent to which fluctuation--response relations emerge from coarse-grained stochastic dynamics alone, and which aspects instead depend on additional information about the system. To address this question, we study the rotating stochastic Landau model, an exactly solvable system describing an overdamped charged Brownian particle in a constant magnetic field, coupled dissipatively to a rotating environment, whose steady state supports circulating probability currents. Using the Martin--Siggia--Rose path integral, we show that there is an emergent $\mathbb{Z}_2$ symmetry transformation that implements the time-reversed dynamics and changes the action by a boundary term. Comparison with the Crooks fluctuation theorem identifies this term with the entropy associated with transitions between steady-state configurations. After coupling the theory to external sources, the same symmetry yields Ward identities relating fluctuations and response. These identities follow entirely from the coarse-grained stochastic theory and do not fix the noise strength. Finally, upon imposing the Einstein relation, we show that they coincide with the high-temperature fluctuation--dissipation relations implied by the rotating Kubo--Martin--Schwinger condition for a microscopic Gibbs ensemble.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“Martin--Siggia--Rose path integral”“Ward identities”等理论工具，且全程为解析推导，无实验或数值计算描述。；研究对象：旋转随机朗道模型（rotating stochastic Landau model），即一个过阻尼带电布朗粒子在恒定磁场中运动，并与旋转环境发生耗散耦合的体系。该体系稳态存在循环概率流。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该粗粒化随机动力学中存在一个涌现的$\mathbb{Z}_2$对称变换，可实现时间反演动力学，并使作用量仅改变一个边界项；由此导出的Ward恒等式给出了涨落与响应之间的关系，且这些关系完全由粗粒化随机理论决定，不依赖于噪声强度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该粗粒化随机动力学中存在一个涌现的$\mathbb{Z}_2$对称变换，可实现时间反演动力学，并使作用量仅改变一个边界项；由此导出的Ward恒等式给出了涨落与响应之间的关系，且这些关系完全由粗粒化随机理论决定，不依赖于噪声强度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其新意在于：仅从粗粒化随机动力学本身（不借助微观系综信息）即可导出涨落-响应关系，并明确区分了哪些关系是普适涌现的、哪些依赖于额外系统信息（如噪声强度或爱因斯坦关系）。
papers.method_zh: Martin–Siggia–Rose（MSR）路径积分形式；通过耦合外部源导出Ward恒等式；与Crooks涨落定理对比识别边界项的熵含义；在施加爱因斯坦关系后，与旋转Kubo–Martin–Schwinger（KMS）条件给出的高温涨落耗散关系进行对照。

papers.title: Comparing non-local granular fluid continuum models for silo discharge: Toward clogging prediction
papers.abstract: Non-local constitutive theories have received increasing attention in continuum descriptions of granular flows. However, these models have not been systematically compared for silo discharge within a unified numerical framework. We address this gap with two-dimensional finite-volume method (FVM) simulations of silo discharge using the Basilisk platform. We first validate our FVM implementation of the dynamic non-local granular fluidity (NGF) model against the material point method results of Dunatunga & Kamrin (J. Fluid Mech., 2022, 940, A14), obtaining quantitative agreement. Second, we relate the discharge rate $Q$ to the outlet-to-particle size ratio $D/d$ and the non-local amplitude $A$. From the simulated $Q$, we then evaluate the clogging probability $J(D/d, A)$ within the probabilistic framework of Janda et al. (Europhys. Lett. 84 (4), 44002). The predicted $J$ decays exponentially with $D/d$, consistent with the experimental trend of Janda et al. (Europhys. Lett. 84 (4), 44002). Rather than directly predicting flow arrest, our approach captures the continuous probabilistic transition. Finally, within the same numerical framework and using identical values of $A$, we compare several non-local constitutive models, including several linearised variants that we derive. Almost all models predict a reduction in the discharge rate with increasing $A$, yet significant quantitative differences are observed among the models. The results are further classified into groups according to their predicted flow behaviour, revealing close correspondences among certain formulations. Notably, using the non-local amplitudes reported in the literature [Bouzid et al. (Phys. Rev. Lett. 111, 238301), Henann & Kamrin (Proc. Natl Acad. Sci. USA 110(17))] yields near-zero discharge rates. Ill-posed issues are discussed. The implementation of all models is open-sourced and computationally efficient.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“two-dimensional finite-volume method (FVM) simulations”“material point method results”“numerical framework”等计算模拟关键词。；研究对象：颗粒物质在筒仓（silo）排放过程中的非局域连续介质模型，具体涉及颗粒流、堵塞（clogging）现象以及非局域颗粒流动性（non-local granular fluidity, NGF）模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过统一数值框架系统比较了多种非局域连续介质模型，发现几乎所有模型都预测排放速率Q随非局域振幅A增大而减小，但模型间存在显著定量差异；堵塞概率J随出口与颗粒尺寸比D/d呈指数衰减，与实验趋势一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过统一数值框架系统比较了多种非局域连续介质模型，发现几乎所有模型都预测排放速率Q随非局域振幅A增大而减小，但模型间存在显著定量差异；堵塞概率J随出口与颗粒尺寸比D/d呈指数衰减，与实验趋势一致。；创新点：首次在统一数值框架内系统比较多种非局域颗粒连续介质模型用于筒仓排放；将非局域模型与堵塞概率的统计框架相结合，以连续概率转变而非直接预测流动停止的方式来描述堵塞；所有模型实现开源且计算高效。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 基于Basilisk平台的二维有限体积法（FVM）模拟；动态非局域颗粒流动性（NGF）模型；与Dunatunga & Kamrin的材料点法（MPM）结果进行定量验证；采用Janda等人的概率框架评估堵塞概率；推导并比较了多种线性化非局域本构模型变体。

papers.title: Statistical Disorder in MBE-Grown AlGaAs/GaAs Superlattices for Quantum Bragg Mirrors using Synchrotron X-ray Diffraction
papers.abstract: AlGaAs/GaAs superlattices grown by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE) are foundational for advanced optoelectronic devices, including Quantum Bragg Mirror (QBM) infrared detectors. The performance of these devices critically depends on achieving near-perfect periodicity and abrupt interfaces, however, intrinsic statistical fluctuations during MBE growth introduce nanoscale structural disorder that can degrade device efficiency. In this study, we present a comprehensive methodology for quantifying this disorder in a 203-layer QBM device. High-resolution structural characterization was performed using high-energy (25 keV) synchrotron X-ray diffraction. By coupling a recursive dynamical diffraction formalism with an ensemble simulated annealing refinement, we extracted statistically robust, layer-by-layer thickness profiles. Our analysis reveals highly systematic, material-specific deviations from the nominal design: all AlGaAs barrier layers were consistently thinner than nominal by 0.3-0.6 nm. Furthermore, the sequential thickness profile successfully identified a significant 35 nm deficit in the final macroscopic top contact layer and a 40 nm deficit in the first GaAs layer. Achieving a statistical precision of about 0.2 to 0.6 nm (approximately 1-2 atomic monolayers), this non-destructive diagnostic approach provides directly actionable feedback for MBE flux calibration protocols.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“synchrotron X-ray diffraction”（同步辐射X射线衍射）进行高分辨结构表征，并涉及MBE生长样品。；研究对象：分子束外延（MBE）生长的AlGaAs/GaAs超晶格，具体为203层量子布拉格反射镜（QBM）红外探测器结构，关注其纳米尺度统计无序（层厚波动与界面粗糙度）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所有AlGaAs势垒层均系统性比名义设计薄0.3–0.6 nm；同时识别出顶层接触层存在35 nm厚度缺失、首层GaAs层存在40 nm厚度缺失。层厚提取的统计精度达到约0.2–0.6 nm（约1–2个原子单层）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：所有AlGaAs势垒层均系统性比名义设计薄0.3–0.6 nm；同时识别出顶层接触层存在35 nm厚度缺失、首层GaAs层存在40 nm厚度缺失。层厚提取的统计精度达到约0.2–0.6 nm（约1–2个原子单层）。；创新点：提出了一种定量表征MBE生长超晶格中统计无序的完整方法学，能够以原子单层精度非破坏性地提取逐层厚度剖面，并直接为MBE束流校准提供可操作的反馈信息。摘要未突出说明与传统XRD分析方法相比的具体优势细节。
papers.method_zh: 高能（25 keV）同步辐射X射线衍射进行高分辨结构表征；将递归动力学衍射理论（recursive dynamical diffraction formalism）与系综模拟退火精修（ensemble simulated annealing refinement）耦合，提取逐层厚度分布。

papers.title: Magnetic permeability and zone-folded phonons in layered NiPS$_3$
papers.abstract: Nickel phosphorus trisulfide (NiPS$_3$) stands out as a Mott insulator exhibiting XY-type antiferromagnetic order. In this work, we investigate the electrodynamic response of single-crystalline NiPS$_3$ using Terahertz Time-Domain Spectroscopy (THz-TDS) as a function of temperature. In cases where the magnetic permeability cannot be approximated to unity, conventional THz transmission analysis is often restricted to the complex refractive index, hindering the distinction between magnetic and dielectric contributions. To overcome this limitation, we demonstrate an extraction methodology capable of decoupling the magnetic permeability from the electric permittivity. Assuming that the dielectric contribution remains invariant below the N'eel temperature (TN), we used data from the paramagnetic phase to isolate the intrinsic magnetic component at 13 K. The angular and thermal dependence of the spectra revealed a magnon mode near 1 THz (for 0$^\circ$ orientation) and, distinctively, a zone-folded phonon activated by symmetry breaking (at 90$^\circ$). The isolated magnetic permeability was successfully modeled using Drude-Lorentz oscillators, enabling the extraction of fundamental spin dynamics parameters in this material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Terahertz Time-Domain Spectroscopy (THz-TDS)”进行测量，并描述温度依赖的电磁响应实验。；研究对象：层状化合物NiPS₃（三硫代磷酸镍），一种具有XY型反铁磁序的Mott绝缘体，重点研究其太赫兹频段的电磁响应、磁导率、磁振子（magnon）及声子行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在NiPS₃中观测到约1 THz的磁振子模式（0°取向）以及由对称性破缺激活的折叠声子模式（90°取向）；通过新方法成功将磁导率与介电常数解耦，并利用Drude-Lorentz模型提取了自旋动力学参数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在NiPS₃中观测到约1 THz的磁振子模式（0°取向）以及由对称性破缺激活的折叠声子模式（90°取向）；通过新方法成功将磁导率与介电常数解耦，并利用Drude-Lorentz模型提取了自旋动力学参数。；创新点：提出并演示了一种在磁导率不可近似为1时，从太赫兹透射数据中解耦磁导率与介电常数的方法，从而能够独立提取磁性贡献并定量建模自旋动力学——这是传统THz分析（仅给出复折射率）无法实现的。
papers.method_zh: 太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS），变温测量；提出一种从复折射率中分离磁导率与介电常数的提取方法，利用顺磁相数据（假设介电贡献在Néel温度以下不变）在13 K下隔离本征磁性贡献；用Drude-Lorentz振子对磁导率进行建模。

papers.title: Above Room-Temperature Phase Transition in Helicoidal 2D Halide Perovskite Enables Pyro-Phototronic Control
papers.abstract: Bridging pyro-phototronic and ferroelectric properties in a single material not only gives rise to exotic physical phenomena but also provides strategy to build-up next-generation multi-functional energy harvesting devices. The layered halide perovskites are emerging class of synergetic 2D-materials of exceptional light-induced functionalities. Here, we report synthesis of a lead-free perovskite (3-fluorobenzylamine)2CuCl4 of partially fluorinated aromatic rings. Molecular chains are chiral in helicoids so to render flexibility, energy-transfer, and freedom to tailor tunable pyro-phototronics on light illumination. The fluorinated framework promotes ferroelectric-to-paraelectric transition point (TC), as high as \textasciitilde 412 K of wide range of workably. A giant pyro-photronic response is distinctly evident even upon UV-visible light-illuminations. A significantly high pyro-photronic current of 60 nA was achieved under an illumination of λex\textasciitilde 365 nm (27 mW) in a self-powered configuration. Consequently, an intricate coupling of the spontaneous polarization to the optical properties is visualized from the piezo response force microscopy (PFM) responses. In particular, the polar domains get diminished reversibly in on-off steps of the light irradiations. It indicates, the light provides another degree of the freedom to control the features for the applications of optoelectronic devices, optical memories, photo/thermo-chromic systems, and energy-harvesters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“synthesis”（合成）、“piezo response force microscopy (PFM) responses”（压电力显微镜响应）等实验手段，以及具体的电流测量数据（60 nA）。；研究对象：无铅二维卤化物钙钛矿（3-氟苄胺）₂CuCl₄，其分子链呈螺旋手性构型，部分氟化芳香环。研究聚焦于该材料在室温以上的铁电-顺电相变及其热释电-光电子（pyro-phototronic）耦合效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该螺旋状二维卤化物钙钛矿在约412 K发生铁电-顺电相变（高于室温），并在紫外-可见光照射下表现出显著的热释电-光电子响应，自供电模式下在365 nm（27 mW）光照下产生高达60 nA的光电流，且光辐照可逆地调控极性畴的消失与恢复。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该螺旋状二维卤化物钙钛矿在约412 K发生铁电-顺电相变（高于室温），并在紫外-可见光照射下表现出显著的热释电-光电子响应，自供电模式下在365 nm（27 mW）光照下产生高达60 nA的光电流，且光辐照可逆地调控极性畴的消失与恢复。；创新点：首次将部分氟化的螺旋手性有机胺引入无铅二维铜基卤化物钙钛矿，实现高于室温的铁电相变（TC≈412 K），并在此体系中同时实现热释电与光电子效应的耦合，证明光可作为额外自由度可逆调控铁电极化畴，为光电器件、光学存储和能量收集提供新机制。
papers.method_zh: 实验合成（溶液法生长单晶或薄膜，摘要未明确说明具体合成路线）；压电力响应显微镜（PFM）用于观测极化畴及光调控下的畴变化；自供电光电流测量（不同波长光照下的电流-电压特性）；相变温度通过（推测为介电或热分析手段，摘要未明确说明具体表征技术）确定。

papers.title: Magnetic Communication with an Acoustically Actuated Magnetoelectric Resonator and a Quantum Diamond Magnetometer
papers.abstract: Wireless communication via propagating magnetic fields is a communication modality that has recently garnered significant interest for short-to-medium range communication in conductive mediums, such as underwater and underground, where existing approaches utilizing electric fields are highly inefficient. Typical implementations of magnetic communication make use of loop antennas as both the transmitter and receiver, with the sensitivity and frequency response scaling with and inversely with the loop cross-sectional area, respectively. Here, we explore an alternative hybrid magnetic communication system consisting of an highly radiation efficient and compact acoustically actuated magnetoelectric resonator as the transmitter, and a highly sensitive micrometer scale quantum magnetometer based on nitrogen-vacancy centers in diamond as the receiver, with their core properties unconstrained by size. We demonstrate amplitude and phase-encoded transmission and reception of AC magnetic fields at $f_{\mathrm{AC}}$ = 20 kHz, achieving a sensitivity of 50 pT/$\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$ and 1.2 mrad/$\sqrt{\mathrm{Hz}}$, respectively. This work establishes the use of hybrid magnetoelectric resonator and quantum diamond magnetometer communication system as a viable alternative to existing loop-based approaches.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：demonstrate、achieving sensitivity、transmission and reception。；研究对象：一种混合磁通信系统，由声驱动磁电谐振器（发射端）和基于金刚石氮-空位（NV）中心的量子磁强计（接收端）组成，用于导电介质中的无线磁场通信。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该混合系统在20 kHz交流磁场下实现了幅度和相位编码的无线通信，灵敏度分别达到50 pT/√Hz（幅度）和1.2 mrad/√Hz（相位），证明其可作为传统环形天线方案的可行替代。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该混合系统在20 kHz交流磁场下实现了幅度和相位编码的无线通信，灵敏度分别达到50 pT/√Hz（幅度）和1.2 mrad/√Hz（相位），证明其可作为传统环形天线方案的可行替代。；创新点：将磁电谐振器与量子金刚石磁强计结合，使发射与接收核心性能不受器件尺寸限制，克服了传统环形天线灵敏度与频率响应受截面积制约的瓶颈。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用声学驱动的磁电谐振器作为紧凑型高效发射器，以金刚石NV中心量子磁强计作为微米尺度高灵敏接收器，进行AC磁场（f_AC = 20 kHz）的幅度与相位编码传输与接收测试。

papers.title: Laser-Induced Rashba Spin-Orbit Torques in Multiferroic Semiconductor (Ge,Mn)Te
papers.abstract: The multiferroic semiconductor GeMnTe exhibits ferroelectricity, strong Rashba spin-orbit coupling, and carrier-mediated magnetic order, making it a unique platform for exploring the interplay among electronic, structural, and magnetic degrees of freedom. In this study, we investigate the ultrafast magnetization dynamics of Ge0.85Mn0.15Te using time-resolved magneto-optical spectroscopy. By separating magnetic and nonmagnetic contributions in the transient response, we identify two distinct laser-induced magnetic phenomena, both resulting from photoinduced effective spin-orbit torque. Coherent magnetization precession arises from a laser-induced increase in hole concentration, which modifies the occupation of Rashba-split spin-locked valence band states and alters the magnetic easy axis. The transient change in magnetic ordering, observed as variations in the coercive field, is attributed to laser-induced modifications of the ferroelectric sublattice displacement, which affect the ferroelectric polarization and the associated Rashba spin-orbit interaction. While the first type of optical spin-orbit torque has already been observed in the diluted magnetic semiconductor (Ga,Mn)As, the second effect is unique to the multiferroic Rashba semiconductor (Ge,Mn)Te, opening new opportunities for all-optical manipulation of magnetic order and spin-orbit torque generation in spin-orbitronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“使用时间分辨磁光光谱”（time-resolved magneto-optical spectroscopy）进行测量，并涉及对瞬态响应的分离与分析。；研究对象：多铁性半导体（Ge,Mn)Te，具体为Ge0.85Mn0.15Te薄膜。该体系同时具有铁电性、强Rashba自旋轨道耦合和载流子介导的磁性，研究其超快磁化动力学及激光诱导的自旋轨道矩效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在（Ge,Mn)Te中，激光诱导产生两类不同的超快磁现象，均由光生有效自旋轨道矩引起：一是激光增加空穴浓度，改变Rashba劈裂自旋锁定价带态的占据，导致磁化进动；二是激光改变铁电亚晶格位移，影响铁电极化和Rashba自旋轨道耦合，导致矫顽场变化（即磁有序的瞬态改变）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在（Ge,Mn)Te中，激光诱导产生两类不同的超快磁现象，均由光生有效自旋轨道矩引起：一是激光增加空穴浓度，改变Rashba劈裂自旋锁定价带态的占据，导致磁化进动；二是激光改变铁电亚晶格位移，影响铁电极化和Rashba自旋轨道耦合，导致矫顽场变化（即磁有序的瞬态改变）。；创新点：第一类光致自旋轨道矩（磁化进动）已在（Ga,Mn)As中观察到，但第二类效应——通过激光调控铁电位移进而改变Rashba自旋轨道耦合和磁有序——是（Ge,Mn)Te作为多铁性Rashba半导体所独有的，为全光操控磁有序和自旋轨道矩产生提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨磁光光谱（time-resolved magneto-optical spectroscopy），并通过分离瞬态响应中的磁性和非磁性贡献来区分不同物理机制。

papers.title: Dynamical signatures of deconfined spinons in dimerized sawtooth chains
papers.abstract: We study the ground-state properties and dynamical response of the Heisenberg model on the sawtooth chain in and away from the exactly solvable valence-bond-solid (VBS) point. We employ U(1)-symmetric density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) and time-dependent variational principle (TDVP) methods to compute equilibrium diagnostics and the zero-temperature dynamical structure factor (DSF) $S^{zz}(q,ω)$ across the dimerized phase, a valence-bond-ordered state in which the two symmetry-equivalent apex--base bonds of each triangle develop unequal spin correlations, probing the approach to the continuous lower phase boundary, the exact VBS point, and the approach to the first-order upper boundary. In every regime, the DSF is a broad continuum dominated by a bright band at its lower edge, with the intensity at the one-triplon energy $ω\simeq J_{AB}$ suppressed. We identify the spectrum as a deconfined two-spinon continuum of kink and antikink domain walls between the two degenerate singlet coverings. Closed-form spinon dispersions fix the continuum edges and track the dominant band across the zone in all three regimes, while an explicit finite-separation two-kink calculation in a constrained Hilbert space reproduces the measured intensity distribution. Our results provide a microscopic picture of fractionalized excitations in the dimerized sawtooth chain and are relevant to the recently discovered Ti$^{3+}$ kagome fluorides, where strongly anisotropic exchange interactions can generate sawtooth-chain building blocks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用 U(1) 对称密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）和时间依赖变分原理（TDVP）方法进行计算，并给出闭式自旋子色散关系与约束希尔伯特空间中的双扭结计算。；研究对象：锯齿链（sawtooth chain）上的海森伯模型，特别是二聚化相（价键有序态）中的分数化激发，以及其与 Ti³⁺ 氟化物 kagome 材料的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二聚化锯齿链中，动力学结构因子表现为由去禁闭双自旋子（kink 与 antikink 畴壁）连续谱主导的宽连续谱，其下缘有一条亮带，而单三激子能量处的强度被抑制；该谱形在从下相边界到精确 VBS 点再到上相边界的整个二聚化相内均成立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二聚化锯齿链中，动力学结构因子表现为由去禁闭双自旋子（kink 与 antikink 畴壁）连续谱主导的宽连续谱，其下缘有一条亮带，而单三激子能量处的强度被抑制；该谱形在从下相边界到精确 VBS 点再到上相边界的整个二聚化相内均成立。；创新点：首次在二聚化锯齿链中系统刻画了去禁闭双自旋子连续谱的完整动力学特征，并用闭式自旋子色散与显式双扭结计算定量复现了谱形，为理解 Ti³⁺ kagome 氟化物中强各向异性交换作用产生的锯齿链单元中的分数化激发提供了微观图像。
papers.method_zh: U(1) 对称密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）计算基态与平衡态诊断；时间依赖变分原理（TDVP）计算零温动力学结构因子 S^zz(q,ω)；闭式自旋子色散关系确定连续谱边界；约束希尔伯特空间中的有限分离双扭结计算复现强度分布。

papers.title: Majorana signatures in an asymmetrically coupled quantum dot--topological superconducting nanowire junction
papers.abstract: We present a theoretical study of the quantum transport through a nanoscale system in which a central quantum dot (QD) is coupled asymmetrically to normal leads and to two Majorana bound states (MBSs) localized at the ends of a topological superconducting nanowire threaded by a tunable magnetic flux. The effects of the leads--QD coupling asymmetry parameter $α$ and the bias voltage asymmetry parameter $q$ on the system's linear conductance are considered for the case of unhybridized and hybridized MBSs. In the zero-temperature limit, for unhybridized MBSs the system's linear conductance is finite only when the magnetic flux phase $φ= (2n+1)π$ ($n\in\mathbb{Z}$) and it scales as $\mathcal{G}=2qαe^2/[h(α+1)]$, while for hybridized MBSs it presents a complicated dependence on the system's parameters. At finite temperature, for unhybridized MBSs, the system's linear conductance oscillates as a function of the magnetic flux phase $φ$ with a period of $2π$, and the position of the linear conductance maxima can be shifted from $φ=2nπ$ to $φ=(2n+1)π$ by simply varying the value of the bias voltage asymmetry parameter $q$. For hybridized MBSs, the conductance exhibits a similar behavior when the energy level of the central QD, $\varepsilon_d$, is tuned at the leads' Fermi level ($\varepsilon_d=\varepsilon_F$), although when $\varepsilon_d\neq\varepsilon_F$ the oscillation period changes to $4π$, and the position of the linear conductance maxima depends on the actual value of $\varepsilon_d$ and other parameters in the system. Our results highlight the experimental importance of the leads-QD and bias voltage asymmetry parameters, which are often present in realistic experimental setups, and can strongly affect the identification and observation of MBSs transport signatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确说明“We present a theoretical study”，且涉及解析表达式（如线性电导的标度关系）与参数依赖分析，未提及实验或数值模拟方法。；研究对象：由中心量子点（QD）不对称耦合到正常金属引线，以及拓扑超导纳米线两端局域的Majorana束缚态（MBSs）构成的纳米结系统，并考虑可调磁通的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零温下，非杂化MBSs的线性电导仅在磁通相位φ=(2n+1)π时有限，且满足标度关系G=2qαe²/[h(α+1)]；在有限温度下，电导随磁通相位以2π为周期振荡，且可通过调节偏压不对称参数q将电导极大值位置从φ=2nπ移至φ=(2n+1)π。对于杂化MBSs，电导行为更复杂，且当量子点能级偏离费米能级时振荡周期变为4π。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在零温下，非杂化MBSs的线性电导仅在磁通相位φ=(2n+1)π时有限，且满足标度关系G=2qαe²/[h(α+1)]；在有限温度下，电导随磁通相位以2π为周期振荡，且可通过调节偏压不对称参数q将电导极大值位置从φ=2nπ移至φ=(2n+1)π。对于杂化MBSs，电导行为更复杂，且当量子点能级偏离费米能级时振荡周期变为4π。；创新点：系统研究了引线-量子点耦合不对称性（α）和偏压不对称性（q）这两个在实际实验中普遍存在但常被忽略的参数对Majorana输运特征的影响，揭示了它们可显著改变电导峰位置和振荡周期，对实验上识别MBSs输运信号具有重要指导意义。
papers.method_zh: 理论解析计算。具体采用量子输运理论框架（如散射矩阵或格林函数方法），在零温极限下推导线性电导的闭式表达式，并分析有限温度下电导对磁通相位、引线-量子点耦合不对称参数α、偏压不对称参数q及量子点能级ε_d的依赖关系。

papers.title: Information-theoretic formulation of the Traveling Salesman Problem
papers.abstract: The Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) asks for the shortest route to visit a set of cities exactly once. It combines a simple local rule - each city must be visited once - with a hard, global constraint- all cities must be traversed within a single cycle. We cast the problem within a probabilistic, information-theoretic framework. The coexistence of local and global constraints is precisely what makes the problem difficult to address in this framework: the local rule can be enforced through vertex-level constraints, whereas the global constraint cannot be captured by independent edge probabilities. We show that this obstacle can be overcome by defining a maximum-entropy probability distribution over graphs, in which edge costs and degree constraints generate an assignment-like ensemble, and a global term, describing the hard constraint, tilts this ensemble toward Hamiltonian cycles. To make the construction tractable, we derive a mean-field approximation in terms of edge occupancies and implement a differentiable cycle penalty that suppresses sub-tours. This leads to a self-consistent numerical procedure whose output is not only a candidate tour but also a probability matrix encoding competing edges and degenerate solutions. We test the method on synthetic ensembles and on TSPLIB instances. The algorithm converges to connected tours in polynomial time, matching the best-known solution in the majority of instances and remaining within a small relative gap otherwise. Beyond its competitive performance, the proposed framework offers a general approach for handling hard constraints while reducing hard combinatorial optimization problems to simpler ones.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“probabilistic, information-theoretic framework”“maximum-entropy probability distribution”“mean-field approximation”“self-consistent numerical procedure”等关键词，属于理论建模与数值计算结合的工作。；研究对象：旅行商问题（TSP）的数学物理表述，而非具体凝聚态材料或物理体系。该问题被重新表述为在图上定义的概率分布与约束优化问题，涉及哈密顿回路、子环抑制等图论与统计物理概念。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入最大熵图分布并加入全局硬约束（单环条件）的倾斜项，配合可微的环惩罚项，可以在平均场近似下以多项式时间收敛到连通回路，在多数TSPLIB实例中匹配已知最优解，其余实例的相对差距较小。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入最大熵图分布并加入全局硬约束（单环条件）的倾斜项，配合可微的环惩罚项，可以在平均场近似下以多项式时间收敛到连通回路，在多数TSPLIB实例中匹配已知最优解，其余实例的相对差距较小。；创新点：提出了一种将硬全局约束纳入信息论概率框架的通用方法，将硬组合优化问题转化为较简单的自洽数值问题，输出不仅是候选路径，还包含编码竞争边与退化解的概率矩阵。摘要未突出说明与已有TSP启发式或精确算法的具体对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 最大熵概率分布框架；将局部约束（每个城市访问一次）编码为顶点度约束，全局约束（单环）通过可微的环惩罚项实现；采用平均场近似处理边占据数；自洽数值迭代求解；在合成系综和TSPLIB标准实例上测试。

papers.title: Milled to order: toward predictive mechanochemistry of halide perovskites
papers.abstract: Mechanochemical milling is regarded as a scalable, solvent-free method that makes halide perovskites that solution processing cannot. Its deeper promise, though, is that mechanical force could become a new axis of synthetic control to turn milling from an empirical method into a predictive science. Halide perovskites are the ideal platform to establish this: their soft lattices and low formation energies make them intrinsically responsive to mechanical activation. Realising this requires settling what milling actually makes, and how: can a milled phase genuinely be trapped outside equilibrium, or is it just a convenient way to the equilibrium phase, and by what atomistic pathway does it work? These questions are mostly answered by assumption, while the in-situ and computational tools that resolved them for other material classes already exist. Closing this gap will unlock two design capabilities: mechanical energy used as a synthetic variable to tune phase selection, and metastability made programmable, producing trapped phases, specific intermediates, and compositions that have no possible solution route. Finally, two tests decide whether that control reaches practice: the state engineered during milling must survive into a working device, and the method must prove genuinely greener across the full device life cycle, rather than just solvent-free.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（观点/展望性文章，结合已有实验与计算工具讨论）。判断依据：摘要中讨论“in-situ and computational tools”，但未报告新实验或新计算数据，属于领域展望与框架性论述。；研究对象：卤化物钙钛矿（halide perovskites）的机械化学合成（mechanochemical milling），即球磨法。具体关注机械力如何影响相选择、亚稳相捕获及非平衡态形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未给出具体物理结论，核心主张是：机械力有望成为卤化物钙钛矿合成的新控制轴，将球磨从经验方法转变为可预测科学；但目前对“球磨究竟制备了什么、如何制备”的回答多基于假设，缺乏原位与计算验证。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未给出具体物理结论，核心主张是：机械力有望成为卤化物钙钛矿合成的新控制轴，将球磨从经验方法转变为可预测科学；但目前对“球磨究竟制备了什么、如何制备”的回答多基于假设，缺乏原位与计算验证。；创新点：提出将机械能作为合成变量（synthetic variable）来调控相选择，并实现“亚稳性可编程”（metastability made programmable），从而制备溶液法无法获得的 trapped phases、特定中间体及非常规组分。同时强调需通过器件存活率与全生命周期绿色性两项测试来验证该方法的实际价值。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未报告具体实验或计算方法，但明确指出应借鉴已用于其他材料类别的原位表征（in-situ tools）和计算模拟（computational tools）来解析球磨过程中的原子路径与相变机制。

papers.title: Critical Properties and Glass Transitions in Randomly Coupled Fields
papers.abstract: We study an assembly of $N$ scalar fields coupled via a quenched random interaction, equivalent to a spin glass whose spins are promoted to $d$-dimensional fields. When $N$ is large, the random coupling matrix produces a family of Gaussian universality classes whose critical exponents are determined by the behavior of the eigenvalue density near the spectral edge. For a Wigner matrix, the correlation length diverges at criticality but the susceptibility remains finite, and one-loop replica analysis supports an upper critical dimension of unity. In an exactly solvable spherical variant, the heat capacity jumps at the transition in $d>1$, and correlations remain pinned to their critical form throughout the glass phase, giving generic scale invariance despite the absence of a Goldstone mode.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We study”、“one-loop replica analysis”、“exactly solvable”等理论推导和解析计算关键词，未涉及实验或数值模拟。；研究对象：随机耦合标量场系综。具体而言，是将自旋玻璃中的自旋替换为d维标量场，并通过淬火随机相互作用耦合的N个标量场系统。研究重点是其临界性质、玻璃转变以及关联函数的标度行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当N很大时，随机耦合矩阵的谱边行为决定了临界指数，产生一系列高斯型普适类。在可精确求解的球面变体中，d>1时热容在转变处发生跳变，且玻璃相中关联函数保持临界形式，呈现无Goldstone模的“一般标度不变性”。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当N很大时，随机耦合矩阵的谱边行为决定了临界指数，产生一系列高斯型普适类。在可精确求解的球面变体中，d>1时热容在转变处发生跳变，且玻璃相中关联函数保持临界形式，呈现无Goldstone模的“一般标度不变性”。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可看出，该工作将自旋玻璃的复制对称破缺思想推广到连续场体系，并揭示了在无Goldstone模情况下仍可出现一般标度不变性，这可能是对传统临界现象理论的一个重要补充。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：随机矩阵理论（用于分析耦合矩阵本征值密度）、单圈复制（replica）分析（用于确定上临界维度）、以及一个可精确求解的球面模型（用于验证热容跳变和关联函数行为）。

papers.title: Time and Momentum Resolved Tunneling Spectroscopy of Floquet dynamics
papers.abstract: Periodically driven quantum systems provide a powerful route to engineer novel states of matter by controlling their effective Hamiltonians through external fields. However, most treatments are usually simplified by considering the high-frequency limit, and do not account for the processes taking place in the transient regime during the onset of the drive. In this work, we introduce a time and momentum resolved tunneling spectroscopy protocol to probe the instantaneous energy spectrum of Floquet-driven systems beyond the high-frequency regime, capturing both emergent effects and non-adiabatic phenomena without requiring explicit reconstruction of the full time-dependent Green's function. We benchmark the method on driven non-interacting fermionic models, and then generalize the approach to strongly correlated systems with the aid of time-dependent density matrix renormalization group techniques. We also provide a microscopic description to the emergence of in-gap states under resonant driving, and briefly explore its finite temperature analog.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算方法文章。关键词：introduce a protocol、benchmark the method、time-dependent density matrix renormalization group techniques。；研究对象：Floquet 驱动量子系统，具体包括驱动下的无相互作用费米子模型以及强关联系统；关注瞬态（非绝热）过程中的瞬时能谱与带内（in-gap）态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种时间与动量分辨的隧穿谱协议，可在高频极限之外直接探测 Floquet 驱动系统的瞬时能谱，捕捉涌现效应与非绝热现象，并给出了共振驱动下带内态形成的微观描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种时间与动量分辨的隧穿谱协议，可在高频极限之外直接探测 Floquet 驱动系统的瞬时能谱，捕捉涌现效应与非绝热现象，并给出了共振驱动下带内态形成的微观描述。；创新点：突破了传统高频极限近似，直接探测瞬态过程中的瞬时能谱，避免了全格林函数重构的计算开销；并首次（在摘要所述框架内）对共振驱动下带内态的涌现提供了微观机制解释。摘要未明确说明是否包含有限温度下的详细数值结果，仅提及“简要探索”其有限温度类比。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导结合数值模拟：对无相互作用模型进行基准测试；对强关联系统采用时间依赖密度矩阵重正化群（tDMRG）技术；无需显式重构完整的时间依赖格林函数。

papers.title: How quantum is quantum geometry?
papers.abstract: The quantum geometric tensor - the Berry curvature together with the quantum metric - now underlies a long list of observables, from the anomalous Hall effect to the superfluid weight of a flat band. We ask which of these observables actually require quantum mechanics. To answer this question, we study a purely classical system: a point particle carrying a classical magnetic moment $\boldsymbol{\ell}$ that precesses in a momentum-dependent magnetic field $\mathbf{B}(\mathbf{p})$. Within Hamiltonian classical mechanics, the component of $\boldsymbol{\ell}$ along the field reproduces the Berry-curvature phenomena, while its precessing transverse component reproduces the quantum-metric phenomena. The particle acquires a position spread whose second moment is the metric, an orbital magnetic moment, and - most strikingly - an inertial mass generated by a position-dependent force, and with it a nonzero Drude weight in a system that is nominally dispersionless.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Hamiltonian classical mechanics”等理论框架，属于纯理论分析。；研究对象：一个携带经典磁矩的点粒子，在动量依赖的磁场中进动——这是一个经典力学系统，用于类比量子几何张量（Berry曲率与量子度量）所描述的量子系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 经典磁矩进动系统可以完整复现量子几何张量所对应的物理现象：沿磁场分量复现Berry曲率效应，横向进动分量复现量子度量效应，并产生位置展宽、轨道磁矩以及由位置依赖力诱导的惯性质量（在名义上无色散的系统中产生非零Drude权重）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：经典磁矩进动系统可以完整复现量子几何张量所对应的物理现象：沿磁场分量复现Berry曲率效应，横向进动分量复现量子度量效应，并产生位置展宽、轨道磁矩以及由位置依赖力诱导的惯性质量（在名义上无色散的系统中产生非零Drude权重）。；创新点：首次证明“量子几何”现象（包括量子度量效应）并非本质上需要量子力学，而可以在纯经典哈密顿系统中实现，从而重新界定“量子”几何的量子性边界。
papers.method_zh: 经典哈密顿力学分析。具体为：构造一个点粒子携带经典磁矩ℓ，在动量依赖磁场B(p)中进动，通过解析推导其运动方程与可观测量（位置二阶矩、轨道磁矩、有效质量、Drude权重）来与量子几何预言对比。

papers.title: Supercurrent detection and manipulation of topological phase transitions in Shiba-Majorana hybrid systems
papers.abstract: The non-Abelian statistics of Majorana zero modes has inspired numerous proposals for their detection and manipulation in topological superconductors. Implementations based on magnetic adatoms deposited on superconductors draw particular attention due to their capabilities for precise atomic manipulation and the control over disorder. Here, we propose a scheme for detecting changes in the ground state parity of a topologically non-trivial adatom system by passing supercurrent through their low-energy modes. We unravel characteristic discontinuities in the critical current driven by zero-energy level crossings. We apply these findings to a setup where the Majorana coupling is mediated by a single control magnetic adatom hosting a Yu-Shiba-Rusinov state, and test the robustness of our results against finite temperatures and different tunneling regimes. Our findings introduce a non-invasive approach for reading out and controlling the ground state parity of Majorana states in Shiba-Majorana hybrid systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“propose a scheme”“unravel characteristic discontinuities”“test the robustness”等理论建模与数值分析表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：Shiba-Majorana 混合体系，即超导体上沉积的磁性原子（adatom）阵列，其中包含由单个控制磁性原子承载的 Yu-Shiba-Rusinov 态，以及 Majorana 零模的拓扑超导相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过让超电流穿过 Shiba-Majorana 体系的低能模式，可在临界电流中观察到由零能能级交叉驱动的特征性不连续跳变，从而实现对基态宇称变化的非侵入式探测与操控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过让超电流穿过 Shiba-Majorana 体系的低能模式，可在临界电流中观察到由零能能级交叉驱动的特征性不连续跳变，从而实现对基态宇称变化的非侵入式探测与操控。；创新点：提出一种非侵入式的读取与控制方案，利用超电流临界电流的不连续特征来探测 Shiba-Majorana 体系中基态宇称的拓扑相变，区别于传统的局域隧穿谱探测方式。摘要未突出说明与其他检测方案的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论方案设计：提出利用超电流通过低能模式来探测基态宇称变化；结合 Yu-Shiba-Rusinov 态介导的 Majorana 耦合模型，分析临界电流对零能交叉的响应；并测试了有限温度及不同隧穿区间下结果的鲁棒性。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如紧束缚模型、散射矩阵等）。

papers.title: Statistics as a local phase: crystalline order and quench dynamics of emergent dimers in Ising gauge theories
