papers.abstract: How does the Bose or Fermi statistics of microscopic particles survive when confinement binds them into emergent bosonic composites? We address this question in the strong-coupling limit of a $2+1$D $\mathbb{Z}_2$ lattice gauge theory, where charges are confined into tightly bound pairs that can be described by an effective dimer model. We find that the statistics of the underlying matter is encoded entirely in a single local hopping phase $\varphi$ -$0$ for bosons, $π$ for fermions- while interactions remain statistics-independent. Treating $\varphi$ as a continuous parameter that interpolates between the two, we map the ground-state phase diagram with the help of tensor-network methods. The angle $\varphi$ itself drives a transition between a dimer-superfluid and dimer charge density wave state, while the magnetic coupling binds neighboring dimers into resonating pairs, in competition with the inter-dimer repulsion. We identify a novel gapped phase in which dimer pairs crystallize into an ordered pattern of resonating plaquettes. Finally, we propose a quench protocol under which identical dimer configurations evolve in markedly different ways depending on the statistics of their constituents. This provides a dynamical probe of the internal structure of dimers, and detects ordered phases through real time signatures, within reach of simulators that natively realize bosonic degrees of freedom.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：tensor-network methods、quench protocol、strong-coupling limit、lattice gauge theory。；研究对象：2+1维 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 格点规范理论中，费米子或玻色子被禁闭成紧束缚对（涌现二聚体）后的统计性质与量子相变，以及二聚体在淬灭动力学中的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 微观粒子的玻色/费米统计完全编码在一个局域跳跃相位 $\varphi$（玻色子为0，费米子为$\pi$）中，而相互作用与统计无关；该相位本身可驱动二聚体超流到二聚体电荷密度波态的相变，并存在一种新的有能隙相——二聚体对结晶为共振plaquette的有序图案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：微观粒子的玻色/费米统计完全编码在一个局域跳跃相位 $\varphi$（玻色子为0，费米子为$\pi$）中，而相互作用与统计无关；该相位本身可驱动二聚体超流到二聚体电荷密度波态的相变，并存在一种新的有能隙相——二聚体对结晶为共振plaquette的有序图案。；创新点：首次指出在禁闭复合体中，底层粒子的统计仅表现为单个局域跳跃相位，而非相互作用形式；并利用该相位作为连续调控参数绘制相图，同时提出通过淬灭动力学直接探测二聚体内部统计性质的实验方案。
papers.method_zh: 在强耦合极限下将 $\mathbb{Z}_2$ 格点规范理论映射为有效二聚体模型；将 $\varphi$ 作为连续参数插值玻色子与费米子情形，利用张量网络方法（tensor-network methods）计算基态相图；提出淬灭（quench）协议，通过实时动力学演化区分不同统计的二聚体内部结构。

papers.title: Hidden Frustration in Collinear Altermagnets: Pairing Vortices and Equilibrium Spin Current Loops
papers.abstract: We show that a magnet can remain perfectly collinear while its quantum vacuum circulates. In a centrosymmetric altermagnet, a symmetry-allowed locally staggered Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya coupling imprints a gauge-irremovable vortex-antivortex pair into the anomalous magnon pair correlations at high-symmetry points in momentum space. In real space, these hidden vortices produce an antiferrochiral array of equilibrium spin currents circulating oppositely around neighboring plaquettes. Gauge-irremovable frustration therefore survives despite classical collinearity: it exists entirely in the quantum correlations. Our results show that complex pairing, gauge-invariant fluxes, and equilibrium loop currents - structures encountered across electronic flux phases, spin liquids, and frustrated quantum magnets - can be encoded in the squeezed vacuum of a collinear magnet.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复使用“we show”“symmetry-allowed”“gauge-irremovable”等理论推导与对称性分析术语，未提及任何实验手段。；研究对象：共线交错磁体（collinear altermagnet）中的量子真空态，具体关注其磁振子（magnon）对关联、平衡自旋流以及隐藏阻挫（hidden frustration）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中心对称的交错磁体中，对称性允许的局域交错Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya耦合会在动量空间高对称点处产生规范不可去除的涡旋-反涡旋对，进而在实空间形成相邻原胞周围反向循环的平衡自旋流阵列（反手性排列）。尽管磁序保持经典共线，阻挫完全存在于量子关联中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中心对称的交错磁体中，对称性允许的局域交错Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya耦合会在动量空间高对称点处产生规范不可去除的涡旋-反涡旋对，进而在实空间形成相邻原胞周围反向循环的平衡自旋流阵列（反手性排列）。尽管磁序保持经典共线，阻挫完全存在于量子关联中。；创新点：首次揭示共线磁体可以在经典自旋构型完全共线的同时，其量子真空（压缩真空）中携带规范不可去除的配对涡旋与平衡环流，将电子通量相、自旋液体和阻挫量子磁体中常见的复杂配对与环流结构映射到共线磁体的磁振子压缩真空中。摘要未突出说明与具体材料体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 对称性分析与量子多体理论框架。具体包括：基于晶体对称性分析Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya耦合的允许形式，研究磁振子对关联函数中的配对涡旋结构，并通过规范不变通量（gauge-invariant flux）与实空间自旋流算符计算来表征平衡环流。

papers.title: Quantized Transport through a Supermoiré Chern Mosaic
papers.abstract: Magic-angle helical trilayer graphene---three graphene layers sequentially twisted in the same direction by $\sim1.8^\circ$---relaxes into a mosaic of domains that, at zero field, carry opposite valley-resolved Chern numbers, with boundaries hosting a network of gapless conducting modes. Charge transport through this network depends sensitively on how the modes connect and scatter, making well-quantized transport unlikely. Contrary to this expectation, we observe a field-induced Chern gap with Chern number $C=-6$ emanating from charge neutrality; in this gap, the Hall resistance is quantized to within $2\%$ of the expected value, $-h/6e^2$, at 4.6 K. We explain this behavior using both Hofstadter and orbital Zeeman calculations, which show that a moderate magnetic field drives a valley-selective topological transition. Above the transition, the total Chern number of the occupied states in each spin-valley flavor becomes identical across neighboring domains, and the domain-wall modes can become gapped. Though the central valence-band Chern numbers still differ between the two domain types, the observed quantized transport attests to a global gap.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论计算结合的混合类型。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“we observe”（实验观测）以及“We explain this behavior using both Hofstadter and orbital Zeeman calculations”（理论计算）。；研究对象：魔角螺旋三层石墨烯（magic-angle helical trilayer graphene），即三层石墨烯以约1.8°同向依次扭转形成的体系，具体研究其超莫尔（supermoiré）畴结构中的拓扑输运性质，特别是零磁场下形成的Chern mosaic（陈数马赛克）及其在磁场下的量子化输运行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在魔角螺旋三层石墨烯中，外加中等磁场可诱导一个陈数为C=-6的能隙，该能隙内霍尔电阻在4.6 K下量子化至预期值-h/6e²的2%以内，表明尽管零场下不同畴的谷分辨陈数相反，磁场驱动的谷选择性拓扑转变可使畴壁模式打开能隙，从而实现全局量子化输运。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在魔角螺旋三层石墨烯中，外加中等磁场可诱导一个陈数为C=-6的能隙，该能隙内霍尔电阻在4.6 K下量子化至预期值-h/6e²的2%以内，表明尽管零场下不同畴的谷分辨陈数相反，磁场驱动的谷选择性拓扑转变可使畴壁模式打开能隙，从而实现全局量子化输运。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用输运测量（霍尔电阻测量）；理论上采用Hofstadter模型计算和轨道Zeeman效应计算，用于分析磁场下的拓扑相变和能带陈数。

papers.title: Exact pair density wave in topological moire flat bands and universal superfluid stiffness
papers.abstract: Pair-density waves (PDWs) are unconventional superconducting states beyond the BCS paradigm, but identifying them unambiguously in microscopic lattice models is generally challenging due to various competing orders. In particular, an exact realization of PDW in interacting models with topological bands remains elusive. Here we construct an interacting model on a twisted bilayer checkerboard lattice (TBCB) featuring topological flat bands, and rigorously show that an exact PDW ground state can be induced by quantum geometric nesting (QGN), owing to its momentum-space nonsymmorphic symmetry. We further prove that the superfluid stiffness of any nondegenerate QGN superconductor (including the PDW studied here and uniform superconductor) obeys the universal relation $D_s=2N_{\rm flat}ν(1-ν)m_{\rm pair}^{-1}$, where $N_{\rm flat}$, $ν$, and $m_{\rm pair}$ are the number of flat bands, flat band filling, and the two-particle effective mass, respectively. Our results reveal a rich interplay among PDW order, quantum geometry, and band topology.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“construct an interacting model”“rigorously show”“prove”等理论推导关键词，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：扭曲双层棋盘格（TBCB）晶格中的拓扑平带体系，以及其中的配对密度波（PDW）超导态和超流刚度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有拓扑平带的扭曲双层棋盘格模型中，通过量子几何嵌套（QGN）可严格实现配对密度波基态；并证明任何非简并QGN超导体的超流刚度满足普适关系 D_s = 2N_flat ν(1−ν) m_pair⁻¹。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有拓扑平带的扭曲双层棋盘格模型中，通过量子几何嵌套（QGN）可严格实现配对密度波基态；并证明任何非简并QGN超导体的超流刚度满足普适关系 D_s = 2N_flat ν(1−ν) m_pair⁻¹。；创新点：首次在具有拓扑带的相互作用模型中严格实现配对密度波基态（此前PDW的精确实现仅在无拓扑带模型中存在）；揭示了PDW序、量子几何与能带拓扑之间的深层联系，并给出超流刚度的普适解析关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论构造与严格证明：构建了具有拓扑平带的相互作用模型（扭曲双层棋盘格），利用动量空间非辛对称性（nonsymmorphic symmetry）实现量子几何嵌套，并通过解析推导证明PDW基态的存在性及超流刚度的普适公式。

papers.title: When chemical potential continuity fails: kinetic interface models for hydrogen isotope transport
papers.abstract: Macroscopic hydrogen transport codes model material interfaces with local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE), imposing continuity of chemical potential as a per-species constraint. Three assumptions hide in that condition: fast interfacial equilibration, a single exchange pathway between the two sides, and a carrier species known in advance on each side. The literature scrutinises the first, but the other two are the more consequential failures, and neither survives at a metal/molten-salt interface. We replace the constraint with reversible reaction channels at the interface that obey mass action, with detailed balance fixing each ratio of rate constants from the thermodynamic data that already parameterise LTE, and we implement the framework in festim. LTE is recovered as the fast-kinetics limit of a single channel, in both its Sieverts/Sieverts and its Sieverts/Henry form, so the framework generalises LTE and does not compete with it. A Damköhler number delimits validity within a channel, a branching ratio between channels. In a representative nickel/FLiBe system, hydrogen partitions kinetically between molecular and fluoride carriers. The apparent interfacial law then drifts between Sieverts and Henry with loading and salt redox state, and an LTE condition underestimates the steady permeating flux. The measured pressure exponent is set by the branching ratio, not by any fixed property of the salt; a redox sweep at fixed temperature should continuously shift it between 0.5 and 1. With two isotopes, two metal-side species feed five salt-side carriers, and a per-species LTE condition is ill-posed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：kinetic interface models（动力学界面模型）、framework（理论框架）、implement the framework in festim（数值实现）。；研究对象：氢同位素在金属/熔盐界面（具体为镍/FLiBe体系）的宏观输运行为，以及界面处化学势连续性假设的失效问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在金属/熔盐界面，化学势连续性（局部热力学平衡）假设因存在多个反应通道和未知载流子种类而失效；改用可逆反应通道（质量作用定律+细致平衡）后，氢的界面分配律会在Sieverts与Henry定律之间漂移，且稳态渗透通量被LTE条件低估。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在金属/熔盐界面，化学势连续性（局部热力学平衡）假设因存在多个反应通道和未知载流子种类而失效；改用可逆反应通道（质量作用定律+细致平衡）后，氢的界面分配律会在Sieverts与Henry定律之间漂移，且稳态渗透通量被LTE条件低估。；创新点：首次系统指出化学势连续性假设中除“界面平衡快”之外的两个隐含失效条件（单一交换路径、预先已知载流子种类），并给出一个可推广LTE的动力学框架，在快动力学极限下自然恢复Sieverts/Sieverts和Sieverts/Henry形式的LTE，而非与之竞争。摘要未突出说明与实验对比的细节。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模：用界面可逆反应通道替代化学势连续性约束，以质量作用定律描述反应速率，用细致平衡从已有热力学数据固定速率常数比；数值实现于开源有限元程序festim中。引入Damköhler数界定单通道有效性，用分支比描述通道间竞争。

papers.title: Spectral Fingerprints of Gauge Theories on a Quantum Computer
papers.abstract: Maximally mixed state spectral sampling is an unbiased quantum algorithm that allows for extraction of a finite-resolution spectral distribution from a Hamiltonian over potentially the entire allowed range of energies. We show how it may be focused on any desired area of the spectrum in order to learn about the full \textit{fingerprint} of the model of interest: from its ground state phenomena such as quantum criticality, obtained from the lowest lying energies, to its thermalization behavior, obtained from the mid-spectrum. We demonstrate this technique specifically on a $(1+1)d$ non-Abelian $SO(3)$ gauge theory, providing a comprehensive analysis of the steps necessary for performing this algorithm, as well as what is possible in the near-term with superconducting quantum hardware, performing simulations with circuits that are $78$ two-qubit gates deep. We show how this algorithm is able to take advantage of emerging dynamical circuit capabilities in near-term hardware to roughly halve the number required qubits, as well as how quantum readout error mitigation is trivial for this method. Along the way, we propose a novel strategy for compiling the controlled-time evolutions needed for spectral sampling by means of Pauli-frame optimizations. We illustrate two physical applications of quantum spectral sampling -- disordered many-body transitions, and mid-spectrum densities of states -- and what postprocessing steps they require beyond the Fourier outputs of the algorithm.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：quantum algorithm、simulations、quantum computer、compiling。；研究对象：量子计算机上模拟的(1+1)维非阿贝尔SO(3)规范场论，以及该体系的谱分布（从基态量子临界到中谱热化行为）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 展示了最大混合态谱采样算法可聚焦于哈密顿量谱的任意区域，从而获取规范场论模型的完整“谱指纹”；在含78个两比特门深度的超导量子电路上实现了该算法，并利用动态电路能力将所需量子比特数大致减半。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：展示了最大混合态谱采样算法可聚焦于哈密顿量谱的任意区域，从而获取规范场论模型的完整“谱指纹”；在含78个两比特门深度的超导量子电路上实现了该算法，并利用动态电路能力将所需量子比特数大致减半。；创新点：首次将最大混合态谱采样技术系统应用于非阿贝尔规范场论，展示其可覆盖从基态到中谱的完整谱指纹；提出利用动态电路能力减少约一半量子比特数的新方案；提出Pauli-frame优化编译受控时间演化的新策略。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 最大混合态谱采样（无偏量子算法）；在超导量子硬件上进行电路深度为78个两比特门的模拟；提出基于Pauli-frame优化的受控时间演化编译新策略；采用量子读出误差缓解（该方法中该误差缓解是平凡的）。

papers.title: Dynamics of local quantum information in random unitary circuits
papers.abstract: The physics of information scrambling in quantum many-body systems is intimately related to thermalisation and emergence of chaos. However, its standard characterisation through bipartite entanglement or operator growth remains inherently coarse-grained, obscuring the spatiotemporal anatomy of how quantum information flows between different regions of the system and across various length scales. In this work, we develop a theory for the dynamics of local information in local random unitary circuits which resolves the fine-grained microscopic structures of local information flow in such systems. Using the framework of information lattice which systematises the information content at each length scale within each subsystem, we identify a distribution of length scales at which information resides and obtain the dynamics of the distribution. For Haar-random circuits with infinite local Hilbert-space dimensions, we map this dynamics onto an exact classical stochastic process which reveals that this distribution is described by a Tracy-Widom form which moves ballistically in time ($ \propto t$) toward larger scales, accompanied by a $\sim t^{1/3}$ broadening. We also find the same qualitative behaviour for random Clifford circuits acting on qubits. The similar scaling behaviour in two rather different settings hints strongly towards the universality of our results. In the case of Clifford circuits, we develop a phenomenological Markov process for the dynamics of the stabiliser generators in a specific gauge which confirms the Tracy-Widom distribution and the $t^{1/3}$ scaling of the fluctuations. Ultimately, our results establish the universal properties of the dynamics of local quantum information in a length scale-resolved fashion and provide a possible route towards bridging exact microscopic theories for information dynamics with emergent hydrodynamic descriptions of information flow.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a theory”“map this dynamics onto an exact classical stochastic process”“phenomenological Markov process”，属于理论建模与分析。；研究对象：随机幺正电路（random unitary circuits）中局部量子信息的动力学，具体关注信息在不同长度尺度与不同子系统之间的流动与分布演化，涉及Haar随机电路和随机Clifford电路。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 局部量子信息在随机幺正电路中的长度尺度分布随时间呈弹道式（∝ t）向更大尺度移动，并伴随约 t^{1/3} 的展宽，该分布由Tracy-Widom形式描述；这一标度行为在Haar随机电路与Clifford电路中均出现，提示其具有普适性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：局部量子信息在随机幺正电路中的长度尺度分布随时间呈弹道式（∝ t）向更大尺度移动，并伴随约 t^{1/3} 的展宽，该分布由Tracy-Widom形式描述；这一标度行为在Haar随机电路与Clifford电路中均出现，提示其具有普适性。；创新点：首次在长度尺度分辨的层面上解析了局部量子信息流动的细粒度微观结构，建立了信息分布动力学的精确随机过程描述，并揭示了Tracy-Widom分布与 t^{1/3} 涨落标度在两类不同电路中的普适性，为连接微观信息动力学理论与信息流动的涌现流体力学描述提供了可能途径。
papers.method_zh: 基于“信息格”（information lattice）框架，系统化刻画每个子系统内各长度尺度上的信息含量；对无限局域希尔伯特空间维度的Haar随机电路，将信息分布动力学精确映射为经典随机过程；对qubit上的随机Clifford电路，发展了一个规范依赖的稳定子生成元动力学唯象马尔可夫过程。

papers.title: Detuning- and Stark-robust Rydberg gates
papers.abstract: Rydberg entangling gates driven by a two-photon transition in alkali atoms suffer from an adverse scaling of light-shift-induced errors. Robustness to such detuning errors is known to be impossible to achieve in the design of conventional Rydberg gate protocols, where only one of the qubit states is coupled to the Rydberg state. Here, we show that in a more general framework, in which both qubit states take part in the gate, full or partial robustness to these errors can be realized. We present two gate constructions, which either cancel the errors outright or convert them into single-qubit errors that can be corrected locally. We map the regimes -- in terms of light-shift strength, intensity inhomogeneity, and Rydberg decay rate -- in which these protocols outperform the widely used time-optimal Rydberg gate, and find that they already include the conditions of state-of-the-art experiments. Finally, we show the existence of a Rydberg `fly-by' entangling gate, an important primitive for an emerging class of neutral-atom quantum computing architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show、present、map regimes、existence（理论分析与协议设计）。；研究对象：中性碱金属原子中的里德伯（Rydberg）双光子激发纠缠门，具体关注光移（light-shift）导致的退失谐误差及其鲁棒性，以及一种新型“飞越”（fly-by）纠缠门。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双光子激发框架下，若两个量子比特态均参与里德伯激发，则可实现对该类退失谐误差的完全或部分鲁棒性；并证明存在一种里德伯“飞越”纠缠门，适用于新兴的中性原子量子计算架构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双光子激发框架下，若两个量子比特态均参与里德伯激发，则可实现对该类退失谐误差的完全或部分鲁棒性；并证明存在一种里德伯“飞越”纠缠门，适用于新兴的中性原子量子计算架构。；创新点：突破了传统里德伯门协议中“仅一个量子比特态耦合到里德伯态”的限制，首次在双光子激发的一般框架下实现退失谐误差的鲁棒性，并提出了“飞越”纠缠门这一新原语。摘要未突出说明具体数学方法或数值技术。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为广义的里德伯门协议设计，对比了两种门构造（完全消除误差或转化为可局域纠正的单比特误差），并系统映射了光移强度、强度不均匀性和里德伯衰减率参数空间，与时间最优里德伯门进行性能比较。

papers.title: Krylov Break Times from an Inhomogeneous Lieb--Robinson Light Cone
papers.abstract: Krylov and Lanczos approximations are used in quantum dynamics, quantum subspace methods, and Hamiltonian learning. A practical question is how long an $m$-dimensional Krylov truncation can be trusted. We argue that this time is fixed by causal propagation on the associated Jacobi chain. The relevant distance is not the Krylov index itself, but the inhomogeneous transport metric $ρ(m,n) = \sum_{j=\min(m,n)}^{\max(m,n)-1} 1/b_j$, where $b_j$ is the Lanczos hopping across the bond $j \leftrightarrow j+1$. We prove a Lieb--Robinson bound in this metric. Its small-weight limit gives the velocity $v_{\rm LR} = 2$, meaning that propagation is exponentially suppressed outside the cone $ρ(m,n) \simeq 2|t|$. The error of a finite Krylov approximation to the return amplitude is a round-trip effect: information has to travel from the probe to the truncation boundary and back. Combining the Lieb--Robinson bound with Duhamel's formula yields a lower bound on the error of the truncated dynamics. For a fixed tolerance $ε$, let the break time $t_\ast(m;ε)$ denote the longest time for which the $m$-dimensional truncation is guaranteed to reproduce the exact return amplitude within error $ε$. We show that $t_\ast(m;ε) \ge τ_m[1-o(1)]$, where $τ_m = ρ(0,m) = \sum_{j<m} 1/b_j$. When the probe spreads along the chain, this lower bound is also tight, so $t_\ast(m) \simeq τ_m$. The situation is different when the probe excites only a localized part of the spectrum, or a part already resolved by the truncation. In this case, essentially no signal reaches the boundary. Beyond a state-dependent Krylov dimension $m_\ast$, the approximation can therefore remain accurate at all times, and the break time is effectively infinite. Numerical tests on spin chains and random Jacobi matrices support $t_\ast(m) \simeq τ_m$ in the transport-limited regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We prove a Lieb--Robinson bound”“Duhamel's formula”“lower bound”等数学证明与理论推导关键词，并辅以数值测试（“Numerical tests”），但核心贡献为理论证明。；研究对象：量子动力学中Krylov截断（Krylov truncation）的可靠性问题，具体涉及Lanczos链上的因果传播、Lieb–Robinson光锥以及有限维Krylov近似对返回振幅（return amplitude）的误差控制。体系包括自旋链和随机Jacobi矩阵。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Krylov截断的可信时间（break time）由非均匀Lieb–Robinson光锥决定，其下界为τ_m = ρ(0,m) = ∑_{j<m} 1/b_j；在输运受限区域，该下界是紧的，即t_*(m) ≃ τ_m。但当探针只激发谱的局域部分或已被截断解析的部分时，信号无法到达边界，截断可在所有时间内保持精确，break time趋于无穷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Krylov截断的可信时间（break time）由非均匀Lieb–Robinson光锥决定，其下界为τ_m = ρ(0,m) = ∑_{j<m} 1/b_j；在输运受限区域，该下界是紧的，即t_*(m) ≃ τ_m。但当探针只激发谱的局域部分或已被截断解析的部分时，信号无法到达边界，截断可在所有时间内保持精确，break time趋于无穷。；创新点：首次将Krylov截断的失效时间与Jacobi链上的非均匀因果光锥联系起来，证明break time由非均匀传输度量而非Krylov指数本身决定；并区分了输运受限与谱局域两种截然不同的截断行为，后者可导致无限break time。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：Lieb–Robinson界（在非均匀传输度量ρ(m,n)下证明）、Duhamel公式用于误差下界推导、小权重极限提取速度v_LR = 2。数值方法：自旋链和随机Jacobi矩阵的数值测试（具体算法如精确对角化或Lanczos迭代，摘要未明确说明）。

papers.title: Stochastic transport of a Goldstone mode in a self-organized atomic crystal
papers.abstract: Spontaneous breaking of a continuous symmetry produces a massless Goldstone mode that can evolve across a degenerate manifold at zero energy cost. Goldstone modes have been identified primarily through excitation spectra, mode softening or collective oscillations. However, their time-domain transport under intrinsic fluctuations and dissipation has remained largely unexplored. Here we directly track the stochastic transport of a Goldstone mode in a self-organized atomic crystal inside an optical ring cavity. The ring cavity maps the order-parameter phase onto the real-space position of the emergent crystal. Without any external perturbation, fundamental photon-scattering recoil drives the collective transport, while cavity dissipation generates friction. We monitor individual trajectories of the atoms and their self-generated optical lattice by measuring the cavity output phase. We find that the diffusion constant decreases as $1/N$, indicating that all atoms move collectively as a rigid object rather than independently. By tuning the Langevin driving force and cavity-mediated damping, we show that the normalized diffusion constant collapses onto a single universal curve. This work extends the study of continuous symmetry breaking from excitation-frequency measurements to real-time tracking of transport, and opens routes for studying non-equilibrium collective transport, phonon dynamics, and defect formation in driven-dissipative quantum matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Here we directly track...”、“We monitor individual trajectories...”、“By tuning... we show...”，使用了直接观测和调控的实验手段。；研究对象：光环形腔内的自组织原子晶体，具体研究其连续对称性自发破缺产生的Goldstone模（声学模）在时间域上的随机输运（扩散）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验直接追踪了Goldstone模在无外扰下的随机输运，发现其扩散常数随原子数N按1/N标度，表明所有原子作为刚性整体集体运动；通过调节朗之万驱动力和腔耗散，归一化扩散常数塌缩到一条普适曲线上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验直接追踪了Goldstone模在无外扰下的随机输运，发现其扩散常数随原子数N按1/N标度，表明所有原子作为刚性整体集体运动；通过调节朗之万驱动力和腔耗散，归一化扩散常数塌缩到一条普适曲线上。；创新点：将连续对称性破缺的研究从传统的激发谱/频率测量扩展到实时追踪Goldstone模在时域中的输运行为，并揭示了集体刚性输运的1/N标度律和普适扩散行为，为驱动-耗散量子物质中的非平衡集体输运、声子动力学和缺陷形成研究开辟了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上利用光学环形腔将序参量相位映射为晶体在实空间的位置，通过测量腔输出相位实时追踪原子及其自生光晶格的单轨迹；通过调节腔耗散和朗之万驱动力（光子散射反冲）来调控输运，并测量扩散常数。

papers.title: Universality and sharp thresholds for ellipsoid fitting
papers.abstract: We establish a sharp phase transition for fitting random vectors by an ellipsoid. The random vectors have independent subgaussian coordinates with mean zero, variance one, and a common fourth moment, and the number of vectors is proportional to the square of the dimension. We identify an explicit satisfiability threshold such that, with high probability, a positive definite ellipsoid passes through every data point below the threshold, whereas no positive semidefinite fit exists above it. We also determine the optimal squared fitting error throughout the unsatisfiable regime. In particular, the threshold depends on the coordinate distributions only through their common fourth moment, revealing a fourth moment universality phenomenon. For standard Gaussian data the threshold is $1/4$, resolving the ellipsoid fitting conjecture.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要涉及数学证明、概率论中的相变与阈值分析，属于数学物理/统计理论范畴。；研究对象：高维随机向量（具有独立亚高斯坐标、均值为零、方差为一、共同四阶矩）的椭球拟合问题，即随机数据点能否被一个正定椭球完全穿过，以及不可行区域内的最优拟合误差。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了椭球拟合的尖锐相变：当数据点数量与维度平方成正比时，存在一个显式的可满足性阈值——低于阈值时，高概率存在正定椭球穿过所有数据点；高于阈值时，不存在正半定拟合。该阈值仅依赖于坐标分布的四阶矩，呈现四阶矩普适性；对标准高斯数据，阈值为1/4，解决了椭球拟合猜想。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了椭球拟合的尖锐相变：当数据点数量与维度平方成正比时，存在一个显式的可满足性阈值——低于阈值时，高概率存在正定椭球穿过所有数据点；高于阈值时，不存在正半定拟合。该阈值仅依赖于坐标分布的四阶矩，呈现四阶矩普适性；对标准高斯数据，阈值为1/4，解决了椭球拟合猜想。；创新点：首次给出椭球拟合问题的精确相变阈值，并揭示其仅依赖四阶矩的普适性；同时解决了此前悬而未决的椭球拟合猜想（针对高斯数据）。摘要未突出说明其他方面的创新。
papers.method_zh: 概率论与高维几何的数学分析，具体涉及亚高斯随机向量、四阶矩条件、正定/半定矩阵可行性判定，以及相变阈值的显式推导与最优误差的刻画。

papers.title: Dynamical slowdown, bottlenecks, and multiscaling in Voigt-regularised turbulence
papers.abstract: We investigate bottleneck formation in turbulence using the Voigt-regularised SABRA model and DNS of the corresponding Voigt-Navier-Stokes (NSV) equations. The Voigt regularisation introduces a scale-dependent slowdown of nonlinear interactions without enhancing dissipation, providing a natural setting to study the interplay between nonlinear transfer and thermalised behaviour. We find three distinct spectral regimes: an inertial range at $k<k_I$, an intermediate equilibrium-like range associated with partial thermalisation for $k_I<k<k_{II}$, and a high-$k$ thermal regime for $k>k_{II}$, where the Voigt contribution dominates the conserved invariant. The crossover to the high-$k$ regime occurs at $k_{II}\sim 1/α$, while $k_I$ marks the onset of thermalised behaviour. Equal and multi-time statistics reveal a progressive suppression of intermittency and a tendency towards Gaussianity at small scales, together with a transition from dynamic multiscaling in the turbulent regime to simple scaling in the equilibrium ranges. The shell model resolves these three regimes over a broad range of scales, while DNS of the corresponding NSV equations reproduces the same qualitative trends, including bottleneck formation, delayed cascade completion, reduced intermittency, and a tendency towards Gaussianity at small scales. We find that bottleneck formation might be associated with scale-dependent dynamical slowdown and incipient thermalisation, rather than being purely dissipative in origin. We provide strong evidence that, in the regime where the regularization parameter $α$ is much smaller than the dissipation length scale, the Voigt model reproduces the same inertial-range turbulent regime and turbulence statistics as the Navier-Stokes (NS) equations. This provides evidence that the Voigt model constitutes an excellent practical approximation to the NS equations for small $α$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数值模拟文章。依据：摘要明确提到使用“Voigt-regularised SABRA model”（壳模型）和“DNS of the corresponding Voigt-Navier-Stokes (NSV) equations”（直接数值模拟）。；研究对象：湍流中的瓶颈效应（bottleneck formation），具体研究Voigt正则化（Voigt regularisation）对湍流非线性相互作用、能量级串和热化行为的影响。体系为Voigt正则化的SABRA壳模型和Voigt-Navier-Stokes方程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Voigt正则化湍流存在三个不同的谱区：惯性区（k<k_I）、部分热化的中间平衡区（k_I<k<k_{II}）和高k热化区（k>k_{II}）。瓶颈形成可能与尺度依赖的动力学减速和初期热化有关，而非纯粹由耗散引起；当正则化参数α远小于耗散长度尺度时，Voigt模型能复现Navier-Stokes方程的惯性区湍流统计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Voigt正则化湍流存在三个不同的谱区：惯性区（k<k_I）、部分热化的中间平衡区（k_I<k<k_{II}）和高k热化区（k>k_{II}）。瓶颈形成可能与尺度依赖的动力学减速和初期热化有关，而非纯粹由耗散引起；当正则化参数α远小于耗散长度尺度时，Voigt模型能复现Navier-Stokes方程的惯性区湍流统计。；创新点：首次系统揭示Voigt正则化导致的尺度依赖动力学减速与瓶颈效应之间的关联，提出瓶颈可能源于“初期热化”而非纯耗散机制；并证明Voigt模型在小α下可作为NS方程的实用近似。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟方法：1）Voigt正则化的SABRA壳模型（shell model）；2）Voigt-Navier-Stokes方程的DNS（直接数值模拟）。分析了等时和多时统计量，研究间歇性、高斯化趋势以及动态多尺度标度行为。

papers.title: 2-Morita Theory of $E_2$-Algebras and Module Categories
papers.abstract: Building on our previous work on 2-Morita equivalence for $E_2$-algebras using topological pictures, we develop a systematic framework for Morita equivalence of topological orders in different dimensions in terms of $n$-Morita categories $\mathrm{Mrt}_{E_n}(\mathcal{C})$. In this framework, various notions of $n$-Morita equivalence are unified as equivalences of objects in $\mathrm{Mrt}_{E_n}(\mathcal{C})$. We also compare the constructions of higher Morita categories due to Haugseng and to Gwilliam--Scheimbauer. For $n=1,2$, we prove that the functor $\mathrm{Mod}_n:\mathrm{Mrt}_{E_n}(\mathcal{C})\to \mathrm{Mrt}_{E_{n-1}}(\mathrm{LMod}^{\mathrm{rep}}(\mathcal{C}))$ is an equivalence, relating the algebraic description of higher Morita theory to its realization in terms of module categories. In this formulation, the notion of a bi-bimodule arises naturally and provides a common framework for local and confined modules. Its explicit orientation data, together with the corresponding fusion rules, clarifies the relations among defects arising from condensation in topological orders.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要涉及“2-Morita等价”“n-Morita范畴”“函子等价”等纯数学物理框架构建，无实验或数值计算关键词。；研究对象：拓扑序（topological orders）及其缺陷（defects）的代数分类，具体为不同维度下拓扑序的Morita等价关系，以及凝聚（condensation）过程中产生的局域模与受限模（local and confined modules）之间的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了以n-Morita范畴 \(\mathrm{Mrt}_{E_n}(\mathcal{C})\) 为框架的统一Morita等价理论，并证明对 \(n=1,2\)，函子 \(\mathrm{Mod}_n:\mathrm{Mrt}_{E_n}(\mathcal{C})\to \mathrm{Mrt}_{E_{n-1}}(\mathrm{LMod}^{\mathrm{rep}}(\mathcal{C}))\) 是等价，从而将高维Morita理论的代数描述与其模范畴实现联系起来。该框架中自然涌现出双双模（bi-bimodule）概念，为局域模与受限模提供了统一描述，并澄清了凝聚缺陷间的融合规则。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了以n-Morita范畴 \(\mathrm{Mrt}_{E_n}(\mathcal{C})\) 为框架的统一Morita等价理论，并证明对 \(n=1,2\)，函子 \(\mathrm{Mod}_n:\mathrm{Mrt}_{E_n}(\mathcal{C})\to \mathrm{Mrt}_{E_{n-1}}(\mathrm{LMod}^{\mathrm{rep}}(\mathcal{C}))\) 是等价，从而将高维Morita理论的代数描述与其模范畴实现联系起来。该框架中自然涌现出双双模（bi-bimodule）概念，为局域模与受限模提供了统一描述，并澄清了凝聚缺陷间的融合规则。；创新点：将不同维度的拓扑序Morita等价统一到同一范畴框架中，并首次在 \(n=1,2\) 情形下严格证明代数描述与模范畴实现之间的等价性；引入双双模概念作为局域模与受限模的共同框架，并给出其显式定向数据与融合规则。摘要未突出说明与更早工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于拓扑图（topological pictures）的2-Morita等价方法，构建n-Morita范畴 \(\mathrm{Mrt}_{E_n}(\mathcal{C})\)；比较了Haugseng与Gwilliam–Scheimbauer两种高维Morita范畴构造；利用函子等价性证明（\(\mathrm{Mod}_n\) 为等价）连接代数描述与模范畴实现。摘要未提及具体数值或实验手段。

papers.title: ElemCo.jl: A Julia package for electron-correlation methods
papers.abstract: We present ElemCo.jl, an open-source Julia package for molecular electronic structure and properties calculations with a particular emphasis on Coupled Cluster and Distinguishable Cluster methods. The package provides a high-level, macro-based user interface which makes routine calculations accessible to users with no prior Julia experience. A newly developed visualizer, JLmol, assists in the graphical preparation of ElemCo.jl input files and displays results such as molecular orbitals. ElemCo.jl offers restricted closed-shell and unrestricted variants of state-of-the-art electron-correlation methods such as FCI, MP2, CCSD(T) as well as EOM-CCSD and the DC methods DCSD and DC-CCSDT. In addition to traditional approaches, ElemCo.jl provides recently developed methods that are currently unique to the package. These include tensor-decomposed implementations of DCSD and DC-CCSDT (SVD-DCSD and SVD-DC-CCSDT) as well as two-determinant and fixed-reference CC and DC methods. For excited-state calculations, ElemCo.jl also offers EOM-DCSD, which is benchmarked in this work against CC3 on the QUEST3 benchmark set, alongside EOM-CCSD. Furthermore, both ground and excited states, including those of multireference character, can be treated using CIPHI - an efficient selected Configuration Interaction (CI) approach employing a CIPSI/Heat-Bath-CI-based algorithm. Users can directly invoke internal functions from the input file, enabling them to test and compose new methods without the need to modify ElemCo.jl's source code. Also, ElemCo.jl can be readily interfaced with external quantum chemistry codes through the Fcidump format, for example as the high-level solver for transcorrelated Hamiltonians, periodic embedded fragments, etc. We provide a detailed overview of ElemCo.jl's methodological repertoire and discuss its technical details and implementation, performance, interfaces, and usage.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要描述的是一个开源软件包（Julia包），用于分子电子结构计算，属于计算方法开发与基准测试。；研究对象：分子电子结构计算中的电子关联方法，具体涵盖Coupled Cluster（耦合簇）、Distinguishable Cluster（可区分簇）、FCI、MP2、CCSD(T)、EOM-CCSD、DCSD、DC-CCSDT等方法的实现，以及激发态（含多参考特征）的计算。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确给出单一物理结论，核心贡献在于发布了ElemCo.jl软件包，提供了多种电子关联方法的实现，并首次对EOM-DCSD方法在QUEST3基准集上相对于CC3进行了基准测试。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确给出单一物理结论，核心贡献在于发布了ElemCo.jl软件包，提供了多种电子关联方法的实现，并首次对EOM-DCSD方法在QUEST3基准集上相对于CC3进行了基准测试。；创新点：提供若干目前该包独有的新方法，包括张量分解实现的SVD-DCSD和SVD-DC-CCSDT，以及双行列式和固定参考的CC/DC方法；用户可直接在输入文件中调用内部函数以测试和组合新方法，无需修改源代码；EOM-DCSD在QUEST3基准集上首次与CC3对比基准测试。
papers.method_zh: 计算方法：Julia语言实现的量子化学软件包，包含FCI、MP2、CCSD(T)、EOM-CCSD、DCSD、DC-CCSDT、SVD-DCSD、SVD-DC-CCSDT、EOM-DCSD、CIPHI（基于CIPSI/Heat-Bath-CI算法的选择性组态相互作用）等方法；提供宏命令式用户界面、JLmol可视化工具，支持Fcidump格式与外部量子化学程序接口。

papers.title: Diamond quantum-sensing platform with integrated boron-doped diamond microwave antenna and thermometer
papers.abstract: Wide-field nitrogen-vacancy (NV) magnetic imaging at cryogenic temperatures requires microwave excitation and reliable knowledge of the temperature near the sensing region. Here, we report an integrated diamond quantum-sensing platform combining an ensemble of NV centers with a boron-doped diamond (BDD) microwave antenna and thermometer formed on the same diamond substrate. The BDD antenna provides microwave excitation for optically detected magnetic resonance measurements, and the BDD thermometer monitors the thermal environment near the NV sensing region. The BDD thermometer detected laser-induced local heating that was not clearly resolved by a stage-mounted thermometer. Using this platform, we imaged the temperature-dependent Meissner response of multiple cuprate superconductors while recording the temperature. These results demonstrate that the integrated BDD--NV platform provides a practical approach for cryogenic wide-field magnetic imaging with integrated microwave delivery and local thermometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了对集成平台的构建、测量（ODMR、温度成像）以及对超导样品的实际成像应用，属于实验工作。；研究对象：集成氮-空位（NV）色心与硼掺杂金刚石（BDD）微波天线及温度计的金刚石量子传感平台；研究对象包括该平台本身，以及利用该平台在低温下成像的铜氧化物超导体的Meissner响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该集成BDD–NV平台可在低温宽场磁成像中同时实现微波激励与局部测温；BDD温度计探测到了激光诱导的局部加热，而这一加热未被安装在冷台上的温度计清晰分辨。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该集成BDD–NV平台可在低温宽场磁成像中同时实现微波激励与局部测温；BDD温度计探测到了激光诱导的局部加热，而这一加热未被安装在冷台上的温度计清晰分辨。；创新点：将微波天线（BDD）与温度计（BDD）集成在同一金刚石衬底上，并与NV传感区域结合，实现了低温宽场磁成像中微波传输与局部测温的一体化，解决了低温下微波激励与局部温度监测的集成难题。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：NV色心系综的光探测磁共振（ODMR）测量（利用BDD作为微波天线）、BDD电阻式温度计进行局部测温、宽场磁成像技术，以及对铜氧化物超导体进行温度依赖的Meissner响应成像。

papers.title: Quantifying the effects of nickel on Earth's inner-core nucleation
papers.abstract: The formation of Earth's solid inner core marks a major transition in the thermal and chemical evolution of the deep Earth, yet its origin remains paradoxical, as initial nucleation appears to require unrealistically large undercooling in the outer core. Here, we use atomistic simulations to quantify how Ni affects this process under inner-core conditions. While Fe-Ni alloys preserve strong thermodynamic competition between the hcp and bcc phases, the bcc phase consistently forms smaller critical nuclei and has lower nucleation barriers than hcp. Increasing Ni content in the melts further lowers the nucleation barrier and shortens the nucleation waiting time. Local chemical fluctuations also strongly affect the macroscopic nucleation rate. Combining these effects, bcc nucleation in Fe80Ni20 reaches about 250 K of undercooling, approaching geophysical constraints. We demonstrate that Ni enrichment, bcc nucleation, and chemical heterogeneity substantially narrow the inner-core nucleation paradox.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“atomistic simulations”（原子尺度模拟）。；研究对象：地球固态内核的成核过程，具体为Fe-Ni合金在内核条件下（高温高压）的成核行为，涉及hcp与bcc两相的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ni的富集、bcc相成核以及局部化学涨落共同显著缩小了地球内核成核悖论：Fe80Ni20合金中bcc相成核所需过冷度约为250 K，接近地球物理观测约束。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ni的富集、bcc相成核以及局部化学涨落共同显著缩小了地球内核成核悖论：Fe80Ni20合金中bcc相成核所需过冷度约为250 K，接近地球物理观测约束。；创新点：首次定量评估了Ni对地球内核成核过程的影响，并系统展示了bcc相成核优势与化学异质性如何协同缓解内核成核所需的极端过冷度问题。
papers.method_zh: 原子尺度模拟（atomistic simulations），具体用于计算临界核尺寸、成核势垒、成核等待时间及宏观成核速率，并考察了熔体中Ni含量和局部化学涨落的影响。

papers.title: Programmable Cavity Squeezing for Distributed Sensing in a Tweezer Array
papers.abstract: Field sensing with state-of-the-art atom interferometers is restricted to the use of uncorrelated devices op- erating in parallel. We can overcome this limitation by using distributed sensing protocols where quantum correlations among spatially-separated devices are engineered in the spatial mode carrying the signal. We show that a tweezer array in a cavity offers an ideal testbed to engineer quantum states for distributed sensing, with the possibility to generate entanglement both within and between the clouds. The competition between local and intercloud cavity-mediated exchange allows the sign and spatial pattern of the intercloud couplings to select the squeezed mode. For two ensembles, positive coupling produces uniform collective squeezing, whereas negative coupling generates strong staggered, nonlocal squeezing. A semiclassical analysis reveals a counter-twisting- like phase-space flow, qualitatively distinct from standard one-axis twisting. The analysis and results can be further generalized to a larger number of ensembles. We apply the scheme to differential Ramsey interferometry with common phase noise spanning the full 2 πrange, the resulting staggered states reduce the phase uncertainty below the standard quantum limit, with an ellipse estimator approaching the Cramèr-Rao bound. These results establish programmable cavity interactions as a scalable route to entanglement tailored to distributed signals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“We show”“A semiclassical analysis reveals”“The analysis and results can be further generalized”等理论推导与方案设计表述，未提及实验数据或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：光镊阵列（tweezer array）与光学腔耦合的量子气体系统，具体研究分布式量子传感中空间分离原子云之间的纠缠生成与压缩态工程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过腔中介的局域与云间交换相互作用竞争，可编程地选择耦合符号与空间模式，从而在两组原子云中分别产生均匀集体压缩或交错的非局域强压缩态；该交错压缩态在差分拉姆齐干涉测量中可将相位不确定度降至标准量子极限以下，并接近Cramèr-Rao界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过腔中介的局域与云间交换相互作用竞争，可编程地选择耦合符号与空间模式，从而在两组原子云中分别产生均匀集体压缩或交错的非局域强压缩态；该交错压缩态在差分拉姆齐干涉测量中可将相位不确定度降至标准量子极限以下，并接近Cramèr-Rao界。；创新点：提出利用可编程腔相互作用在光镊阵列中按需生成针对分布式信号的纠缠态，特别是通过负耦合实现交错非局域压缩，其相空间动力学与标准单轴扭曲定性不同，且方案可扩展至多个原子云——这为分布式传感提供了可扩展的纠缠工程路径。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架包括：腔QED中原子系综的集体自旋模型、局域与云间腔中介交换相互作用的竞争分析、半经典相空间流分析（揭示与标准单轴扭曲不同的反扭曲类动力学）、以及针对差分拉姆齐干涉的相位估计（椭圆估计器）与Cramèr-Rao界对比。

papers.title: Fast On-Chip Thermometry with TiN Kinetic Inductance Resonators in 22 nm Process Technology
papers.abstract: Understanding the temporal and spatial dependence of temperature is critical in high-performance cryogenic devices. Typical thermometry techniques struggle to simultaneously combine high bandwidth, sensitivity and on-chip integration, limiting their ability to measure fast intra-device thermal fluctuations. Here, we demonstrate a time-resolved thermometry platform based on TiN kinetic inductance resonators integrated in a 22 nm FDSOI chip. By tracking temperature-dependent shifts in the resonant frequency, we achieve sub-millikelvin temperature sensitivity down to temperatures of 100 mK. Time-resolved on-chip pulsed heating experiments as a function of distance reveal an onset delay, consistent with a quasi-ballistic heat propagation velocity of 3.9 ${\pm}$ 0.1 mm $μ$s${}^{-1}$. We also show that elevated temperatures increase net thermal conductance, shortening thermal relaxation times across all spatial separations. This behaviour manifests in two distinct regimes: a substrate-limited regime at 100 mK, where cooling rates vary with heater distance, and a Kapitza boundary-limited regime at 400 mK, where thermal relaxation becomes more spatially uniform. These measurements demonstrate kinetic inductance thermometry's ability to rapidly probe non-equilibrium temperature dynamics in cryogenic devices such as quantum processors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了对TiN谐振器的实际测量（“demonstrate”“measurements”），包括时间分辨脉冲加热实验和温度响应追踪。；研究对象：集成在22 nm FDSOI芯片上的TiN（氮化钛）动力学电感谐振器，用于低温器件中的快速温度测量，具体物理现象为芯片内非平衡热传播与热弛豫动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该TiN动力学电感测温平台在100 mK下达到亚毫开尔文温度灵敏度，并测得准弹道热传播速度约为3.9 ± 0.1 mm/μs；同时发现升温会增大净热导，缩短热弛豫时间，且在100 mK（衬底限制）与400 mK（Kapitza边界限制）下表现出两种不同的热弛豫空间行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该TiN动力学电感测温平台在100 mK下达到亚毫开尔文温度灵敏度，并测得准弹道热传播速度约为3.9 ± 0.1 mm/μs；同时发现升温会增大净热导，缩短热弛豫时间，且在100 mK（衬底限制）与400 mK（Kapitza边界限制）下表现出两种不同的热弛豫空间行为。；创新点：将动力学电感测温技术集成于商用22 nm FDSOI工艺芯片中，实现了兼具高带宽、高灵敏度和片上集成能力的时间分辨测温，并首次在该平台上观测到准弹道热传播速度及两种不同温度限制下的热弛豫机制。（摘要未突出说明与已有测温技术的直接对比数据。）
papers.method_zh: 利用TiN动力学电感谐振器的谐振频率随温度漂移进行测温；在芯片上进行时间分辨的脉冲加热实验，并改变加热器与探测器的距离以研究热传播的空间依赖性和时间延迟。

papers.title: A Superconducting Phase Transition Single-Electron Transistor
papers.abstract: Quantum computers require fast and accurate methods for qubit state detection. Phase-transition sensors exploit the abrupt change between two physical states of a material to achieve enhanced sensitivity and have enabled advanced detectors for quantum technologies, such as superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors. However, this sensing principle has not yet been applied to semiconductor spin qubits. Here, we demonstrate a superconducting phase-transition radio-frequency single-electron transistor (PTSET), a charge sensor for semiconductor spin qubits whose response is enhanced by a superconducting-to-normal phase transition. The transition is engineered by linking the sensor current to a low-critical-current, high-kinetic-inductance inductor integrated into the radio-frequency matching network. We demonstrate improvements in sensitivity of one and two orders of magnitude over conventional rfSETs in the large- and small-signal regimes, respectively. Our results establish phase-transition sensing as a route towards ultrasensitive, integrated charge sensors for semiconductor quantum computing and point to broader applications, including cryogenic photon detection for radio astronomy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“we demonstrate”（我们演示了）、“measurements”相关的实验性表述，以及“sensitivity improvements”（灵敏度提升）等实验量化结果。；研究对象：半导体自旋量子比特的电荷传感器——一种基于超导-正常态相变的射频单电子晶体管（PTSET），其核心物理现象是超导相变增强的电荷传感响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过将传感器电流与集成在射频匹配网络中的低临界电流、高动态电感元件耦合，实现了由超导到正常态的相变增强传感。与传统射频单电子晶体管（rfSET）相比，在大信号和小信号模式下灵敏度分别提升了一个和两个数量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过将传感器电流与集成在射频匹配网络中的低临界电流、高动态电感元件耦合，实现了由超导到正常态的相变增强传感。与传统射频单电子晶体管（rfSET）相比，在大信号和小信号模式下灵敏度分别提升了一个和两个数量级。；创新点：首次将相变传感原理应用于半导体自旋量子比特的电荷检测——此前相变传感仅用于超导纳米线单光子探测器等量子技术，尚未用于半导体自旋量子比特。摘要未突出说明其他创新细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验上构建了超导相变射频单电子晶体管（PTSET），将低临界电流、高动态电感的超导元件集成到射频匹配网络中，使传感器电流触发超导-正常态相变，从而增强电荷响应。摘要未明确说明具体材料体系或制备工艺。

papers.title: High-resolution in situ analysis of biomass pyrolysis by combining quantitative synchrotron $μ$CT and 3D particle-resolved simulations
papers.abstract: Understanding the coupling between transport, chemical kinetics, and structural response within solid fuel combustion requires in situ measurements at high spatial resolution. To examine the dynamics of biomass pyrolysis, we optimize synchrotron X-ray micro-computed tomography ($μ$CT), and conduct 3D particle-resolved simulations. A micro-focused heating cell with controlled heating and flow rate is employed, achieving temperatures of up to 1240 K and 3D imaging at 3.24 $μ$m spatial and sub-minute temporal resolutions. The pyrolysis of three biomass materials at sample heating rates of 10-14 K/min are examined. The $μ$CT measurements capture pore deformation, cracking, anisotropic shrinkage, and provide simultaneous thermogravimetric and thermovolumetric analyses to examine specific secondary pyrolysis pathways. Complementary 3D simulations considering detailed kinetics and structural response reproduce the key trends observed, and identify deficiencies in capturing simultaneous mass and volume losses during pyrolysis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：结合了同步辐射X射线微计算机断层扫描（$μ$CT）实验与3D粒子分辨模拟。；研究对象：生物质热解过程中的固体燃料燃烧动力学，具体关注三种生物质材料在高温加热下的传输、化学动力学与结构响应（孔隙变形、开裂、各向异性收缩）之间的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高分辨率原位$μ$CT测量成功捕获了生物质热解过程中的孔隙变形、开裂和各向异性收缩，并同时提供了热重与热体积分析以研究二次热解路径；3D模拟能再现主要实验趋势，但无法同时准确捕捉热解过程中的质量损失与体积损失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高分辨率原位$μ$CT测量成功捕获了生物质热解过程中的孔隙变形、开裂和各向异性收缩，并同时提供了热重与热体积分析以研究二次热解路径；3D模拟能再现主要实验趋势，但无法同时准确捕捉热解过程中的质量损失与体积损失。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用优化后的同步辐射X射线微计算机断层扫描（$μ$CT），配合微聚焦加热池（可控加热与流速，最高温度1240 K），实现3.24 $μ$m空间分辨率和亚分钟时间分辨率的原位3D成像；计算上采用考虑详细化学动力学和结构响应的3D粒子分辨模拟。

papers.title: Packora: Systematic Design for Generative Molecular Crystal Structure Prediction
papers.abstract: Molecular crystal structure prediction (CSP) is important in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, and organic electronics, where subtle differences in molecular conformation and packing can strongly affect material properties. We present Packora, a flow-based generative model for molecular CSP that jointly predicts atomic coordinates and the lattice from molecular graphs. Packora supports multi-component and organometallic crystals and can condition on any subset of molecular conformers, stereochemical labels, and space-group information within a single model. Inspired by the CCDC CSP blind test, we evaluate generation and ranking separately, using generation to isolate generator quality and ranking to measure end-to-end performance under a common relaxation and ranking pipeline. We also systematically study architecture, training, conditioning, inference, and scaling, identifying an effective design based on cacheable pairwise reasoning, training objective and numerical solver choices, conditioning dropout, and balanced scaling of pairwise and single representations. Packora outperforms the baselines on both structure generation and ranking benchmarks, achieving the best matched-budget coverage across all six generation benchmarks, as well as higher experimental-form recovery, lower experimental-form ranks, and faster convergence in ranking.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“flow-based generative model”“generation and ranking benchmarks”“architecture, training, conditioning, inference, and scaling”等，属于机器学习与计算方法驱动的材料模拟研究。；研究对象：分子晶体，涵盖多组分晶体和有机金属晶体，重点关注分子构象与堆积方式对材料性质的影响，属于分子晶体结构预测（CSP）问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Packora模型在分子晶体结构生成和排序基准上均优于基线方法，在全部六个生成基准上取得最佳匹配预算覆盖率，并在实验形态恢复率、实验形态排序和收敛速度方面表现更优。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Packora模型在分子晶体结构生成和排序基准上均优于基线方法，在全部六个生成基准上取得最佳匹配预算覆盖率，并在实验形态恢复率、实验形态排序和收敛速度方面表现更优。；创新点：摘要未突出说明单一创新点，但可归纳为：提出了一种统一的生成式CSP框架，支持多组分与有机金属晶体，并可在单一模型内灵活条件化任意子集的构象、立体化学和空间群信息；同时系统性地研究了多个设计维度对生成性能的影响。
papers.method_zh: 基于流的生成模型（flow-based generative model），联合预测原子坐标和晶格参数；支持以分子图作为输入，可对分子构象子集、立体化学标签和空间群信息进行条件生成；采用生成与排序分离的评估策略，并使用统一的弛豫与排序管线；系统研究了架构、训练目标、数值求解器、条件丢弃（conditioning dropout）以及表征的平衡缩放等设计选择。

papers.title: Isotropic Nanoscale Quantum Sensor at Room-Temperature
papers.abstract: Color-center based quantum sensors provide nanoscale resolution under ambient conditions, yet their applicability remains limited. Because the quantization axes are locked to the host lattice, conventional color centers suffer severe signal loss in off-axis magnetic fields. To address this, we report an isotropic magnetometer enabled by the neutrally charged nitrogen-vacancy center (NV0) in diamond. Here, spin-to-charge dynamics yield an NV0-dark spin pair whose quantization axis dynamically aligns with the external field. Read out through NV charge-state-selective fluorescence, this system exhibits microsecond room-temperature coherence and nanotesla sensitivity for arbitrary field directions. We demonstrate alignment-free mapping of steep field gradients and single paramagnetic micro-targets, alongside isotropic readout from randomly oriented nanodiamonds. Resolving longstanding orientation constraints, this platform unlocks unrestricted nanoscale magnetometry across life sciences and quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了“我们报告”“我们展示”等实验性表述，涉及实际测量（如相干时间、灵敏度、磁场梯度成像）。；研究对象：金刚石中中性荷电氮-空位色心（NV0）及其自旋-电荷动力学，用于室温下的各向同性纳米级磁传感。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: NV0色心通过自旋-电荷动力学形成暗自旋对，其量子化轴可动态沿外磁场方向排列，从而实现对任意方向磁场的纳米级、各向同性、室温高灵敏探测（微秒相干时间、纳特斯拉灵敏度）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：NV0色心通过自旋-电荷动力学形成暗自旋对，其量子化轴可动态沿外磁场方向排列，从而实现对任意方向磁场的纳米级、各向同性、室温高灵敏探测（微秒相干时间、纳特斯拉灵敏度）。；创新点：首次利用NV0（而非常用的NV⁻）实现量子化轴随外场动态重排，彻底消除传统色心因晶格锁定量子化轴导致的离轴磁场信号损失，实现无需对准的任意方向磁传感，并拓展至随机取向纳米金刚石体系。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：NV0色心的自旋-电荷动力学操控、电荷态选择性荧光读出、磁场梯度成像、单顺磁微目标检测，以及对随机取向纳米金刚石的各向同性读出测试。摘要未明确说明具体光学或微波操控细节。

papers.title: Geometric optimality of entanglement-induced fast qubit reset
papers.abstract: Fast and reliable qubit reset is essential for the efficient operation of quantum processors. Among the proposed strategies, Mpemba-effect-based protocols offer a simple route to accelerated relaxation, but provide limited insight into the optimality of the full reset dynamics. Geometric approaches, by contrast, quantify optimality but do not generally suggest practical acceleration protocols. Here, we bridge these perspectives through a geometric analysis of entanglement-assisted qubit reset. We show that entangling operations can redistribute local coherences across a multi-qubit register, allowing the reduced state of each qubit to follow a geodesic path towards the ground state. Remarkably, this locally optimal behaviour can emerge even when the collective evolution becomes suboptimal in the full state space. We illustrate this interplay for different families of initial multi-qubit states. Our results provide a geometric perspective on Mpemba-inspired reset acceleration and clarify when extending two-qubit protocols to larger registers provides a further advantage in the reset process.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“geometric analysis”“geodesic path”“collective evolution”等理论分析术语，未涉及实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：量子处理器中的量子比特重置过程，具体为基于纠缠辅助的多量子比特重置协议，以及Mpemba效应启发的加速弛豫机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 纠缠操作可以重新分配多量子比特寄存器中的局域相干性，使每个量子比特的约化态沿测地线路径趋向基态，从而实现局部最优的快速重置；即使集体演化在全状态空间中并非最优，这种局部最优行为仍可出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：纠缠操作可以重新分配多量子比特寄存器中的局域相干性，使每个量子比特的约化态沿测地线路径趋向基态，从而实现局部最优的快速重置；即使集体演化在全状态空间中并非最优，这种局部最优行为仍可出现。；创新点：将几何最优性框架与Mpemba效应启发的加速重置协议相结合，揭示了局部（单比特约化态）最优性与全局（集体态）次优性可以共存，并阐明了从两比特协议扩展到更大寄存器时是否带来额外优势的条件。
papers.method_zh: 几何分析方法，具体为在量子态空间中分析纠缠辅助重置过程的测地线路径与最优性条件，并针对不同初始多量子比特态族进行对比研究。

papers.title: Measuring the Sr$^+$ 5s$_{1/2}$ Landé $g$-factor Using Singlet-Triplet Oscillations in a Circular Rydberg State of Strontium
papers.abstract: Circular states of strontium are promising platforms for quantum technologies. They exhibit much longer lifetimes than laser-accessible Rydberg states and possess an optically active ionic core that can be manipulated with laser light. Here we trap circular states in optical tweezers by exploiting the dynamical polarizability of the ionic core. We measure the decay of the orbital component of a n=51 circular state and observe singlet-triplet spin oscillations arising from the interplay of vector light shifts induced by the optical tweezers, spin-orbit coupling associated with the Rydberg electron, and the difference in Landé $g$-factor between the ionic core and the Rydberg electrons. By observing the two electron spin dynamics, we measure the spin-orbit interaction and the correction $δg \sim$ 10^(-5) of the Landé $g$-factor of the Sr$^+$ 5s$_{1/2}$ ionic core electron with respect to that of a free electron. This provides a first high-precision measurement of $g_{\textrm{Sr}^+, 5s_{1/2}}$ = 2.002290(1).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了对圆形里德伯态锶原子的囚禁、测量轨道衰变、观测自旋振荡等实验操作，并给出了高精度测量结果。；研究对象：锶原子（Sr）的n=51圆形里德伯态，特别是其离子芯Sr⁺ 5s₁/₂电子的朗德g因子，以及单重态-三重态自旋振荡现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过观测圆形里德伯态中电子自旋的单重态-三重态振荡，首次实现了对Sr⁺ 5s₁/₂离子芯电子朗德g因子的高精度测量，得到g_Sr⁺,5s₁/₂ = 2.002290(1)，其相对自由电子的修正δg约为10⁻⁵量级。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过观测圆形里德伯态中电子自旋的单重态-三重态振荡，首次实现了对Sr⁺ 5s₁/₂离子芯电子朗德g因子的高精度测量，得到g_Sr⁺,5s₁/₂ = 2.002290(1)，其相对自由电子的修正δg约为10⁻⁵量级。；创新点：首次利用圆形里德伯态中的单重态-三重态振荡作为精密测量手段，实现了对Sr⁺离子芯电子g因子的高精度测量（精度达10⁻⁵量级），该方法将里德伯态的长寿命与离子芯的光学可操控性相结合，为量子技术平台提供了新的表征途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验上利用光镊囚禁锶圆形里德伯态（利用离子芯的动态极化率），通过测量n=51圆形态的轨道分量衰变，并观测由光镊矢量光移、自旋-轨道耦合以及离子芯与里德伯电子朗德g因子差异共同导致的单重态-三重态自旋振荡，从中提取自旋-轨道相互作用和g因子修正。

papers.title: Circular Dichroism Spectroscopy of Single Objects: Problems, Artifacts, and Corrections
papers.abstract: Molecular aggregates are at the basis of a broad range of functional systems, including photosynthetic light-harvesting complexes, organic photovoltaics, optoelectronic devices, and molecular sensors. Their structural organization, however, is often difficult to resolve because intrinsic heterogeneity. In this context, circular dichroism (CD) spectroscopy is particularly powerful because of its sensitivity to the three-dimensional organization of molecular building blocks. Extending CD measurements from ensembles to individual objects therefore offers a unique approach to probing supramolecular architecture in heterogeneous, non-crystallizable systems. However, without spatial and orientational averaging, measurements are highly sensitive to imbalances between left- and right-circularly polarized excitation, deviations from ideal circular polarization, and polarization imperfections coupled to linear dichroism, which creates spurious CD signals. Here, we present a systematic theoretical and experimental framework for understanding, quantifying, and controlling artifacts in single-object CD spectroscopy. We develop a mathematical description of the principal artifact mechanisms, identify their origins in practical implementations, including Pockels-cell-based polarization modulation, and establish strategies for their minimization. We validate this framework using an experimental implementation capable of acquiring CD spectra from individual molecular aggregates over 690-785 nm. Our results demonstrate that reliable single-object CD measurements are achievable when polarization-related artifacts are rigorously characterized and controlled. This Tutorial Review provides a unified theoretical framework and practical guide for single-object CD spectroscopy and its application to single-particle chirality, supramolecular photonics, and biophotonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论+实验）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“systematic theoretical and experimental framework”“validate this framework using an experimental implementation”。；研究对象：单个分子聚集体（molecular aggregates）的圆二色（CD）光谱，具体涉及光合作用光捕获复合物、有机光伏、光电器件等体系中的手性超分子结构，以及单物体CD光谱测量中的偏振伪影问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单物体CD光谱测量中，若对偏振相关伪影进行严格表征和控制，可以获得可靠的单物体CD数据；该工作建立了一个统一的理论框架来理解、量化和抑制这些伪影。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单物体CD光谱测量中，若对偏振相关伪影进行严格表征和控制，可以获得可靠的单物体CD数据；该工作建立了一个统一的理论框架来理解、量化和抑制这些伪影。；创新点：首次系统性地为单物体CD光谱提供统一的理论框架和实用指南，明确区分并量化了多种伪影来源（包括Pockels盒调制引入的偏振缺陷），并给出了可操作的抑制策略；将CD光谱从系综平均拓展到单个异质、不可结晶体系。
papers.method_zh: 理论方面：建立了描述主要伪影机制的数学模型，涵盖左右圆偏振激发不平衡、非理想圆偏振、与线二色性耦合的偏振缺陷等。实验方面：基于Pockels盒偏振调制的实验装置，在690–785 nm波段对单个分子聚集体采集CD光谱，用于验证理论框架。

papers.title: Adiabatic Otto-like quantum thermodynamical cycle in the non-quasi-static regime
papers.abstract: We show a finite-time Otto-like quantum thermodynamic cycle that preserves the adiabatic population structure of a time-dependent harmonic oscillator in the non-quasi-static regime. In the conventional energy representation, finite-rate driving induces non-adiabatic population redistribution and leaves residual excitations after the Hamiltonian has returned to its initial value. We show that this difficulty can be avoided by formulating the dynamics in the Lewis-Riesenfeld invariant representation, without modifying the physical Hamiltonian through auxiliary counterdiabatic driving. For a parametric Mathieu protocol, quantum inertia produces a mismatch between the spatial width of the working mode and its transient dressed energy scale. We propose an experimental implementation of this scheme in a trapped-ion Paul trap using stimulated Raman interactions, with independent control of the laser detuning and beam intersection angle. This provides a finite-time implementation in which the invariant population structure is preserved while the physical trap frequency evolves non-quasi-statically. Our results establish a clear distinction between adiabatic operation and quasi-static driving, providing a route toward finite-time quantum thermal cycles that retain the adiabatic energy structure without requiring the quasi-static limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We show”“formulating the dynamics in the Lewis-Riesenfeld invariant representation”等理论推导表述，并涉及量子热力学循环的动力学分析。；研究对象：非准静态（有限时间）驱动下的含时谐振子量子热力学循环，具体为Otto-like量子热力学循环中的绝热布居结构保持问题；同时提出在离子阱（Paul trap）中的实验实现方案。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非准静态（有限速率）驱动下，通过在Lewis-Riesenfeld不变量表象中描述动力学，可以在不引入辅助反绝热驱动（counterdiabatic driving）修改物理哈密顿量的情况下，保持含时谐振子的绝热布居结构，从而避免传统能量表象中有限速率驱动导致的非绝热布居重分布和残余激发。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非准静态（有限速率）驱动下，通过在Lewis-Riesenfeld不变量表象中描述动力学，可以在不引入辅助反绝热驱动（counterdiabatic driving）修改物理哈密顿量的情况下，保持含时谐振子的绝热布居结构，从而避免传统能量表象中有限速率驱动导致的非绝热布居重分布和残余激发。；创新点：建立了绝热操作与准静态驱动之间的明确区分，提出了一种在有限时间内实现量子热循环的路径，使循环在物理阱频非准静态演化时仍能保持绝热能量结构，且无需借助辅助反绝热驱动来修改物理哈密顿量。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为Lewis-Riesenfeld不变量表象下的量子动力学分析；具体驱动协议采用参数Mathieu协议；实验实现方案为囚禁离子Paul阱中的受激拉曼相互作用，通过独立控制激光失谐和光束交角来实现。

papers.title: Approximating the peculiar velocity distribution of dark matter halos with Tsallis statistics
papers.abstract: Dark matter halos, which host galaxies and galaxy clusters, have peculiar velocities far from thermal equilibrium. Characterizing the nonlinear and non-Gaussian features of this velocity distribution improves our understanding of the gravitational evolution of the cosmic web and supports related cosmological applications. We endeavor to establish a connection between the peculiar velocity distribution of halos and nonequilibrium statistical mechanics, with the objective of obtaining a model that is both concise and accurate for practical applications. We extracted halo samples from large N-body simulations and performed maximum-likelihood fits to the peculiar velocity distributions using a two-parameter Tsallis model, derived from non-extensive statistical mechanics. On the theoretical side, we reformulated the halo distribution in the superstatistics framework by means of a generalized Gram-Charlier expansion based on the gamma distribution. For halo peculiar velocities below 1000 km/s, the Tsallis model achieves 5 percent accuracy over z=0-2, with performance improving toward lower redshifts. Our results show that the halo velocity distribution becomes increasingly non-Gaussian and departs further from equilibrium over time. The best-fit parameters depend only weakly on mass, though low-mass halos exhibit slightly stronger non-Gaussianity. The two parameters, especially the velocity dispersion, offer promising probes of cosmological parameters. Theoretically, we find that in general the halo peculiar velocity distribution function is expressible as a superposition of a series of Tsallis distribution functions, while simulation results demonstrate that the zeroth-order approximation, namely a single Tsallis function, already achieves sufficient accuracy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论混合型文章。判断依据：使用N体模拟（N-body simulations）提取样本，结合非广延统计力学的理论模型（Tsallis模型、超统计框架）进行最大似然拟合与解析推导。；研究对象：暗物质晕的 peculiar velocity（本动速度）分布，具体关注其非线性、非高斯特征以及宇宙学演化（红移z=0–2）中的统计性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Tsallis双参数模型在z=0–2范围内、对速度低于1000 km/s的暗物质晕本动速度分布可实现5%精度拟合；暗物质晕速度分布随时间演化越来越偏离高斯分布和热平衡态，且理论上该分布可展开为一系列Tsallis分布函数的叠加，零阶近似（单一Tsallis函数）已足够精确。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Tsallis双参数模型在z=0–2范围内、对速度低于1000 km/s的暗物质晕本动速度分布可实现5%精度拟合；暗物质晕速度分布随时间演化越来越偏离高斯分布和热平衡态，且理论上该分布可展开为一系列Tsallis分布函数的叠加，零阶近似（单一Tsallis函数）已足够精确。；创新点：首次将暗物质晕的本动速度分布与非广延统计力学（Tsallis统计）建立直接联系，并证明其可解析地表示为Tsallis分布的级数叠加；同时发现拟合参数（尤其是速度弥散）对宇宙学参数具有潜在探测能力。
papers.method_zh: 从大规模N体模拟中提取暗物质晕样本，采用最大似然估计对速度分布进行双参数Tsallis模型拟合；理论上利用基于伽马分布的广义Gram-Charlier展开，在超统计（superstatistics）框架下重新表述晕分布函数。

papers.title: Beyond geometric symmetry: Broadband linear relations in wave scattering
papers.abstract: The design and control of wave scattering, that is, of the reflection and transmission parameters of a device, is of ubiquitous importance. These parameters generally change with varying frequency, though certain \emph{frequency-independent} linear relations may exist between them. Reciprocity and geometric symmetry (reflections, rotations, etc.) are classic and well-known examples that are present in many devices and significantly ease their design. In this work, we go beyond these and introduce a new class of relations that cannot be induced by reciprocity or geometric symmetry. Choosing networks of waveguides as our workhorse, we discuss the conditions and consequences of such novel behaviour and showcase suitable example setups. We further experimentally test our predictions using coaxial cables and find excellent agreement in the broad frequency range between 0 and 1 GHz. Our work not only deepens the theoretical understanding of waveguide network dynamics, but also opens new avenues for applications in broadband signal processing, quantum information, and integrated photonics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（理论分析 + 实验验证）。判断依据：摘要中既有“introduce a new class of relations”“discuss the conditions and consequences”等理论推导表述，又有“experimentally test our predictions using coaxial cables”的实验验证。；研究对象：波导网络（waveguide networks）中的波散射现象，具体关注反射与透射参数之间存在的**与频率无关的线性关系**，并超越传统的互易性与几何对称性所给出的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一类新的、无法由互易性或几何对称性诱导的**频率无关线性关系**，并在同轴电缆波导网络中于0–1 GHz宽频范围内实验验证了该关系的存在，理论与实验高度一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一类新的、无法由互易性或几何对称性诱导的**频率无关线性关系**，并在同轴电缆波导网络中于0–1 GHz宽频范围内实验验证了该关系的存在，理论与实验高度一致。；创新点：突破了传统仅依赖互易性和几何对称性（反射、旋转等）来构造频率无关散射关系的局限，首次提出并实验证实了一类**非对称性起源的宽带线性散射关系**，为宽带信号处理、量子信息与集成光子学提供了新的设计自由度。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为波导网络的散射矩阵分析（基于线性散射理论）；实验手段为同轴电缆搭建的波导网络，在0–1 GHz频段进行散射参数测量。

papers.title: Random Recursive Simplicial Complexes
papers.abstract: We investigate random recursive simplicial complexes growing by adding, at each step, a vertex together with a simplex formed by joining the new vertex with a randomly chosen existing simplex. We also add all faces of the new simplex to ensure that the resulting object remains a simplicial complex. If the choice of an existing simplex is uniform among simplices of dimension $<m$, the number $S_d$ of simplices of any admissible dimension $d\leq m$ is an asymptotically self-averaging random variable. This feature allows us to determine the asymptotic growth law of the average of $S_d$ when the number of vertices diverges. We also probe the degree distribution, examine the probabilities of various extreme outcomes, and analyze the characteristics of the first vertex.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要涉及随机递归单纯复形的数学定义、渐近增长规律、概率分析，属于统计物理与随机图论交叉的理论研究。；研究对象：随机递归单纯复形（Random Recursive Simplicial Complexes），即一种在每一步添加新顶点并与随机选择的已有单纯形相连、同时补齐所有面以保持单纯复形结构的随机增长网络/几何对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当已有单纯形的选择在维度小于 m 的单纯形中均匀进行时，任意允许维度 d ≤ m 的单纯形数目 S_d 是渐近自平均的随机变量；据此可确定顶点数发散时 S_d 平均值的渐近增长律。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当已有单纯形的选择在维度小于 m 的单纯形中均匀进行时，任意允许维度 d ≤ m 的单纯形数目 S_d 是渐近自平均的随机变量；据此可确定顶点数发散时 S_d 平均值的渐近增长律。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其新意在于将递归随机图模型推广到单纯复形，并利用自平均性严格求解各维度单纯形数目的渐近增长律，同时首次系统考察该模型的度分布与极端行为。
papers.method_zh: 概率论与随机图/复形分析：利用自平均性质（self-averaging）推导平均单纯形数目的渐近标度；还分析了度分布、极端事件概率以及第一个顶点的统计特征。摘要未提及具体数值模拟或实验手段。

papers.title: Quantum cellular automata and invertible phases of matter
papers.abstract: We introduce and study (fermionic and bosonic) invertible quasi-local algebras over uniformly locally finite metric spaces $X$ with infinite-dimensional local von Neumann algebras. We show that the group of Brauer equivalence classes of such algebras is isomorphic to both the group of phases of invertible states and the group of stable equivalence classes of quantum cellular automata over $X\times \mathbb{Z}$. Using K-theory of the symmetric monoidal category of invertible quasi-local algebras and bounded spread isomorphisms, we propose a definition of an $Ω$-spectrum of invertible phases as conjectured by Kitaev. We then show that the $c=\frac{1}{2}$ chiral Majorana fermion net and the $(E_{8})_{1}$ conformal net provide Brauer non-trivial invertible quasi-local algebras, thus providing explicit constructions of non-trivial invertible states and quantum cellular automata on $\mathbb{Z}^{2}$. In addition, we show that the time-slice nets of rational diagonal conformal field theories admit lattice degrees of freedom, which implies the discretization of any holomorphic conformal net is invertible.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“引入并研究”“提出定义”“证明同构”等理论性表述，无实验或计算手段关键词。；研究对象：量子格点系统与拓扑物态，具体包括：费米子和玻色子的可逆准局域代数、可逆物相（invertible phases）、量子元胞自动机（QCA），以及手性马约拉纳费米子网和 (E₈)₁ 共形网等一维/二维量子场论体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了可逆准局域代数的 Brauer 等价类群与可逆态相群、以及 X×ℤ 上量子元胞自动机的稳定等价类群三者同构；并构造了 ℤ² 上非平凡的 Brauer 可逆准局域代数，从而给出非平凡可逆态和量子元胞自动机的显式例子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了可逆准局域代数的 Brauer 等价类群与可逆态相群、以及 X×ℤ 上量子元胞自动机的稳定等价类群三者同构；并构造了 ℤ² 上非平凡的 Brauer 可逆准局域代数，从而给出非平凡可逆态和量子元胞自动机的显式例子。；创新点：首次将可逆准局域代数、可逆物相与量子元胞自动机三者统一到同一代数框架下，并通过 K-理论提出 Kitaev 猜想中 Ω-谱的定义；同时给出 c=1/2 手性马约拉纳网和 (E₈)₁ 共形网作为 Brauer 非平凡可逆准局域代数的显式构造，并证明有理对角共形场论的时间片网具有格点自由度，从而推出全纯共形网的离散化是可逆的。
papers.method_zh: 采用算子代数与张量范畴方法，具体包括：可逆准局域 von Neumann 代数、Brauer 等价类、对称幺半范畴的 K-理论、Ω-谱构造（Kitaev 猜想）、共形网（conformal net）与时间片网（time-slice net）分析。

papers.title: Optically Induced Thermal Runaway in Phase-Change VO2 Nanostructures
papers.abstract: While thermal runaway occurs across diverse physical disciplines, its presence in subwavelength phase-change photonics remains unexplored because existing thermo-optical models break down near sharp optical transitions. Here, we introduce an iterative multiphysics framework coupling full-wave electrodynamics with heat transfer, and we discover optically induced thermal runaway in vanadium dioxide (VO2) nanostructures. The runaway switching threshold depends on the illumination wavelength, ambient temperature, and underlying substrate, with external thermal biasing significantly reducing the optical intensity required for runaway ignition. Our results push forward the modeling of sharp photothermal transitions and provide essential design principles for active metasurfaces, neuromorphic photonic devices, and nanoscale thermal management.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要提到“引入迭代多物理场框架”“耦合全波电动力学与热传递”，属于建模与数值模拟研究。；研究对象：二氧化钒（VO2）纳米结构中的光致热失控现象，属于亚波长相变光子学领域，涉及可调光学相变与热输运的耦合。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在VO2纳米结构中发现了光致热失控现象，其开关阈值依赖于光照波长、环境温度和衬底类型，且外部热偏置可显著降低触发热失控所需的光强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在VO2纳米结构中发现了光致热失控现象，其开关阈值依赖于光照波长、环境温度和衬底类型，且外部热偏置可显著降低触发热失控所需的光强。；创新点：首次在亚波长相变光子学体系中揭示光致热失控的存在，并建立了能够处理尖锐光热相变过程的迭代多物理场建模方法，为有源超表面和神经形态光子器件的设计提供了原理性指导。
papers.method_zh: 迭代多物理场仿真框架，将全波电动力学（麦克斯韦方程求解）与热传导方程耦合求解，用于处理尖锐光学跃迁附近传统热-光模型失效的问题。

papers.title: Large Deviations for the Bose--Einstein Condensate of the Ideal Gas in the Canonical Ensemble
papers.abstract: We consider a non-interacting Bose gas governed by a general one-particle Hamiltonian in the canonical ensemble. Our main results are large-deviation estimates for the number of particles in the Bose--Einstein condensate. We show that the left- and right-tail probabilities decay at different exponential rates as the number of particles tends to infinity.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“large-deviation estimates”（大偏差估计）等数学物理理论术语，并讨论统计系综（canonical ensemble）下的严格结果。；研究对象：理想玻色气体的玻色–爱因斯坦凝聚（BEC）现象，具体为在正则系综下、由一般单粒子哈密顿量描述的非相互作用玻色气体中凝聚体粒子数的统计涨落行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 凝聚体粒子数的左尾与右尾概率在粒子数趋于无穷时以不同的指数速率衰减，即大偏差函数在左右两侧不对称。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：凝聚体粒子数的左尾与右尾概率在粒子数趋于无穷时以不同的指数速率衰减，即大偏差函数在左右两侧不对称。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其新意在于给出了正则系综下BEC粒子数大偏差的严格结果，并揭示了左右尾指数衰减速率的不对称性（摘要未明确说明与已有工作的具体差异）。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，具体为统计力学中的大偏差理论（large deviation theory），针对正则系综下的非相互作用玻色气体进行严格的渐近估计。

papers.title: Lieb-Schultz-Mattis Constraints for Quantum Channels: A Spacetime-Duality View
papers.abstract: Quantum anomalies strongly constrain the possible behavior of many-body systems. A prime example is the Lieb-Schultz-Mattis (LSM) theorem, which relates UV symmetry and filling constraints to IR features of the energy spectrum and ground-state structure. Here, we ask how LSM constraints shape dynamical signatures and temporal correlations in open quantum systems. Using a spacetime duality, we show that the Liouvillian of a $d$-dimensional repeated quantum channel with a mixed anomaly between strong $S$ and weak $G$ symmetry can be mapped to a $(d{+}1)$-dimensional mixed-state symmetry-protected topological (mSPT) phase. Under this correspondence, the initial and steady states of the channel are identified with boundary states of the higher-dimensional mSPT in the presence of bulk projection. We further introduce the twisted Renyi-$N$ correlator (TRNC) as a probe of temporal correlations in the channel and demonstrate that it is dual to the mSPT strange correlator, providing a direct bulk-boundary route to diagnose long-range temporal order implied by the LSM anomaly. Finally, we identify the \textit{Liouvillian singular spectrum}, rather than the Liouvillian spectrum itself, as a more fundamental diagnostic of quantum anomalies, and show that it is dual to the operator entanglement spectrum of the mSPT.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：spacetime duality、mapped to、theoretical framework。；研究对象：开放量子系统中重复量子通道（repeated quantum channel）的动力学，特别是具有混合量子反常（mixed anomaly）的对称性约束下的时间关联与李雅普诺夫谱。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过时空对偶，将d维重复量子通道的刘维尔算符映射为(d+1)维混合态对称性保护拓扑（mSPT）相，并证明LSM反常会通过mSPT的体-边对应在通道中产生长程时间序；同时提出刘维尔奇异谱（Liouvillian singular spectrum）作为比刘维尔谱更基本的反常诊断量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过时空对偶，将d维重复量子通道的刘维尔算符映射为(d+1)维混合态对称性保护拓扑（mSPT）相，并证明LSM反常会通过mSPT的体-边对应在通道中产生长程时间序；同时提出刘维尔奇异谱（Liouvillian singular spectrum）作为比刘维尔谱更基本的反常诊断量。；创新点：首次将LSM定理的约束从平衡态能谱推广到开放量子通道的时间关联与李雅普诺夫谱，引入TRNC作为时间序探针并建立其与mSPT奇异关联子的对偶，提出刘维尔奇异谱作为更基本的反常诊断量。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：时空对偶（spacetime duality）、混合态对称性保护拓扑（mSPT）相、体-边界对应（bulk-boundary correspondence）、扭曲Rényi-N关联函数（TRNC）与奇异关联子（strange correlator）的对偶关系、算子纠缠谱（operator entanglement spectrum）分析。

papers.title: Why Cooper pairs live in AdS2: a spectral analysis of the Yukawa-SYK model
papers.abstract: We establish the spectral foundation of the geometric formulation of Cooper pairing in the Yukawa--Sachdev--Ye--Kitaev model. Starting from the large-$N$ bilocal effective action, we derive the Gaussian fluctuation kernel in the even-frequency spin-singlet Cooper channel. Following the construction of Maldacena and Stanford, we determine the kernel eigenvalue $k\left(h\right)$ analytically for arbitrary conformal weight $h$ and resolve the pairing fluctuations into the continuous and discrete sectors of the associated de-Sitter space Laplacian. We show that the superconducting instability and the universal low-energy fluctuations near it reside entirely in the continuous scattering sector, while the discrete modes remain non-critical. Expanding the kernel about the lowest continuum mode yields a Klein--Gordon action on ${\rm dS}_2$, restricted to the continuous spectral subspace. This is precisely the subspace on which the inverse Radon transform to ${\rm AdS}_2$ is well defined. The projected bilocal Cooper-pair field can therefore be mapped onto a scalar matter field propagating in ${\rm AdS}_2$, without requiring any further spectral restriction on the bulk theory. Our results provide the missing microscopic justification for the projection implicit in earlier holographic formulations and clarify how a local bulk field emerges from the bilocal pairing theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“large-$N$ bilocal effective action”、“Gaussian fluctuation kernel”、“解析推导（analytically）”等强理论物理与数学物理方法关键词，未涉及任何实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：Yukawa-SYK（Yukawa–Sachdev–Ye–Kitaev）模型中的Cooper配对问题，具体聚焦于该模型中超导不稳定性及其低能涨落的几何（全息）描述，即Cooper对为何“生活”在AdS₂时空中的谱学基础。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作证明，Yukawa-SYK模型中Cooper配对通道的超导不稳定性及其附近的普适低能涨落完全由de-Sitter空间（dS₂）拉普拉斯算子的连续散射谱主导，而离散模不具临界性。将核展开到最低连续模附近后，双局域Cooper对场可无额外谱限制地映射为AdS₂中的标量物质场，从而为先前全息公式中隐含的投影提供了微观证明。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作证明，Yukawa-SYK模型中Cooper配对通道的超导不稳定性及其附近的普适低能涨落完全由de-Sitter空间（dS₂）拉普拉斯算子的连续散射谱主导，而离散模不具临界性。将核展开到最低连续模附近后，双局域Cooper对场可无额外谱限制地映射为AdS₂中的标量物质场，从而为先前全息公式中隐含的投影提供了微观证明。；创新点：首次从微观谱分析角度严格证明了Cooper配对几何化（AdS₂描述）的合法性：明确了只有连续散射谱子空间上的投影才使得逆Radon变换良定义，且该投影无需对体理论做额外谱截断。这填补了早期全息公式中隐含投影步骤的微观理论空白。
papers.method_zh: 采用大-N双局域有效作用量框架，推导出偶频自旋单态Cooper通道的高斯涨落核；遵循Maldacena和Stanford的构造方法，解析求解了该核的本征值k(h)（对任意共形权重h）；利用dS₂拉普拉斯算子的谱分解将涨落分为连续与离散部分；通过逆Radon变换将连续谱子空间上的双局域场映射到AdS₂，并得到受限的Klein-Gordon作用量。

papers.title: Least Variable Quantum Counting Processes
papers.abstract: Counting processes provide a fundamental description of stochastic events ranging from photon detection to clock ticks. A central question is how accurately such events can be timed when only finite memory resources are available. Here, we investigate this problem within a general framework of finite-dimensional classical and quantum counting processes. We derive a rigorous finite-memory variance bound obeyed by every classical $d$-state counting process, which is tight and saturated by a discrete Erlang-type ladder process. Through numerical optimization, we identify quantum counting processes that violate this classical bound, achieving smaller first-tick fluctuations than any classical process with the same memory size and mean tick time. For the qubit case, we further derive an analytical large-mean bound within a single-Kraus no-tick family, showing that the quantum advantage persists asymptotically within this class. The optimized quantum processes exhibit coherent conditioned dynamics and approach a continuous-time quantum-jump description as the mean increases. Our results establish a finite-memory quantum advantage in temporal precision and connect discrete-time counting processes with continuous-time quantum timekeeping.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：general framework、derive a rigorous bound、numerical optimization、analytical derivation。；研究对象：有限维经典与量子计数过程（counting processes），即描述随机事件（如光子探测、时钟滴答）发生时间序列的随机过程，重点研究在有限记忆资源下的计时精度极限。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 经典d态计数过程存在一个紧致的有限记忆方差下界（由离散Erlang型阶梯过程饱和），而量子计数过程可以打破该经典下界，在相同记忆大小和平均滴答时间下实现更小的首次滴答时间涨落，即有限记忆下的量子计时精度优势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：经典d态计数过程存在一个紧致的有限记忆方差下界（由离散Erlang型阶梯过程饱和），而量子计数过程可以打破该经典下界，在相同记忆大小和平均滴答时间下实现更小的首次滴答时间涨落，即有限记忆下的量子计时精度优势。；创新点：首次在有限记忆资源框架下严格证明了量子计数过程相对于经典计数过程在时间精度上的优势，并建立了离散时间计数过程与连续时间量子守时（quantum timekeeping）之间的联系。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导（严格证明经典d态计数过程的方差下界）、数值优化（搜索量子计数过程以最小化首次滴答方差）、解析分析（在单Kraus无滴答族内推导大平均值的解析界）。

papers.title: Intrinsic temporal and spectral mixing in time-resolved terahertz spectroscopy
papers.abstract: In an ultrafast optical-pump terahertz-probe measurement, the photoinduced material response can be modulated on a timescale shorter than the extent of the THz pulse. In this situation, the measured time-frequency response deviates from a simple time-dependent linear response. When full two-dimensional time-frequency maps are measured, this yields complex features that can be incorrectly assigned to a photoexcited coherent response. We investigate this experimentally via the measured response of photoexcited SnSe, whereby photoinduced phase change dynamics lead to ultrafast changes of the charge carrier and lattice optical conductivity response. Two-dimensional time-frequency THz transmission maps subsequently show unexpected time-frequency features at early pump-probe delay times. These features are reproduced in both finite-difference time-domain simulations of the THz experiment and in an extension of non-equilibrium response function theory, demonstrating their systematic origin. This work improves the understanding of systematic effects in high time resolution optical-pump THz-probe spectroscopy, and explores the conditions in which they are likely to appear.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验 + 模拟 + 理论）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experimentally via the measured response”、“finite-difference time-domain simulations”以及“extension of non-equilibrium response function theory”。；研究对象：光激发SnSe（硒化锡）材料在超快光泵浦-太赫兹探测实验中的光致相变动力学，以及由此引起的电荷载流子与晶格光导率响应的超快变化。核心物理现象是时间分辨太赫兹光谱中出现的“时间-频率混合”伪影。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在超快光泵浦-太赫兹探测中，当光致材料响应在比太赫兹脉冲持续时间更短的时间尺度上被调制时，测得的时频响应会偏离简单的含时线性响应，产生可被错误归因于光激发相干响应的复杂时频特征。这些特征在SnSe中被实验观测到，并通过FDTD模拟和非平衡响应函数理论扩展得到复现，证明其具有系统性起源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在超快光泵浦-太赫兹探测中，当光致材料响应在比太赫兹脉冲持续时间更短的时间尺度上被调制时，测得的时频响应会偏离简单的含时线性响应，产生可被错误归因于光激发相干响应的复杂时频特征。这些特征在SnSe中被实验观测到，并通过FDTD模拟和非平衡响应函数理论扩展得到复现，证明其具有系统性起源。；创新点：系统揭示了高时间分辨光泵浦-太赫兹探测光谱中由“时间-频率混合”导致的系统性伪影的物理起源，并给出了其出现的条件，有助于避免将此类伪影误判为光激发相干响应。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用超快光泵浦-太赫兹探测光谱，测量光激发SnSe的二维时频太赫兹透射图；数值上使用有限差分时域（FDTD）模拟太赫兹实验；理论上扩展了非平衡响应函数理论框架来复现实验特征。

papers.title: Front-induced transitions control THz waves
papers.abstract: Relativistically moving dielectric perturbations can be used to manipulate light in new and exciting ways beyond the capabilities of traditional nonlinear optics. Adiabatic interaction with the moving front modulates the wave simultaneously in both space and time, and manifests a front-induced transition in both wave vector and frequency yielding exotic effects including non-reciprocity and time-reversal. Here, we introduce a technique called SLIPSTREAM, Spacetime Light-Induced Photonic STRucturEs for Advanced Manipulation. The technique is based on the creation of relativistic fronts in a semiconductor-filled planar waveguide by photoexcitation of mobile charge carriers. Here we demonstrate the capabilities of SLIPSTREAM for novel manipulation of THz light pulses through relativistic front-induced transitions. In the sub-luminal front velocity regime, we generate temporally stretched THz waveforms, with a quasi-static field lasting for several picoseconds tunable with the front interaction distance. In the super-luminal regime, the carrier front outpaces the THz pulse and a time-reversal operation is performed via a front-induced intra-band transition. We anticipate our platform will be a versatile tool for future applications in the THz spectral band requiring direct and advanced control of light at the sub-cycle level.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：“we demonstrate”、“we introduce a technique”、“photoexcitation”。；研究对象：半导体填充的平面波导中，由移动光生载流子产生的相对论运动介电扰动（即“前端”）对太赫兹（THz）光脉冲的操控，具体涉及亚光速与超光速前端诱导的频带内跃迁现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过SLIPSTREAM技术，在亚光速前端速度下可产生准静态场持续数皮秒的时间拉伸THz波形；在超光速前端速度下，载流子前端超过THz脉冲，实现基于前端诱导带内跃迁的时间反演操作。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过SLIPSTREAM技术，在亚光速前端速度下可产生准静态场持续数皮秒的时间拉伸THz波形；在超光速前端速度下，载流子前端超过THz脉冲，实现基于前端诱导带内跃迁的时间反演操作。；创新点：首次将相对论运动介电前端的概念引入THz波段，实现亚周期级别的直接光场操控，包括非互易性、时间反演以及可调谐的准静态场产生，超越了传统非线性光学的调控能力。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用光激发半导体平面波导中的移动载流子来构建相对论运动介电前端（SLIPSTREAM技术），通过控制前端速度（亚光速/超光速）与相互作用距离，测量THz脉冲的时域波形变化。

papers.title: Multicomponent Magnetic Domain Walls in Rhombohedral Graphene
papers.abstract: Spatial textures of magnetic order, such as domain walls and skyrmions, are fundamental objects in magnetism. In rhombohedral multilayer graphene, magnetic order involves spin and valley degrees of freedom, opening the possibility of qualitatively new spatial textures. Here, we explore this possibility through a microscopic study of a one-dimensional domain wall in the valley-imbalanced quarter-metal phase of rhombohedral graphene. We uncover two different classes of domain walls. One resembles a conventional magnetic domain wall, locally rotating between the two bulk states, whereas the other is intrinsically multicomponent and explores states that are not occupied in either bulk domain. Which texture is realized is controlled by the competition between intervalley Hund's coupling and spin-orbit coupling, and we identify experimental signatures to distinguish them. We further show that, in a superconducting junction formed across the wall, the superconducting phase difference couples directly to the intervalley-coherent phase of the texture. Precession of this internal phase can therefore generate a voltage across the junction. Our theory shows that rhombohedral graphene indeed has magnetic textures beyond conventional magnet and that their dynamics can couple to superconducting transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“microscopic study”“our theory shows”等理论计算表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：菱方多层石墨烯（rhombohedral multilayer graphene）中谷极化四分之一金属相（valley-imbalanced quarter-metal phase）内的一维磁畴壁，以及畴壁上的超导结。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 菱方石墨烯中存在两类本质不同的磁畴壁：一类类似传统磁畴壁，在两种体态间局域旋转；另一类为多组分畴壁，会探索两个体畴均未占据的中间态。两类畴壁的实现由谷间Hund耦合与自旋轨道耦合的竞争决定，且畴壁内部谷相干相位可直接耦合超导相位差，其进动可在超导结上产生电压。
