papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：菱方石墨烯中存在两类本质不同的磁畴壁：一类类似传统磁畴壁，在两种体态间局域旋转；另一类为多组分畴壁，会探索两个体畴均未占据的中间态。两类畴壁的实现由谷间Hund耦合与自旋轨道耦合的竞争决定，且畴壁内部谷相干相位可直接耦合超导相位差，其进动可在超导结上产生电压。；创新点：首次在菱方石墨烯中揭示超越传统磁体的多组分磁畴壁纹理，并发现其内部相位动力学可与超导输运直接耦合，为磁纹理与超导的相互作用提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 基于微观模型对一维畴壁进行理论计算，分析自旋与谷自由度的空间纹理，并研究畴壁与超导结的耦合动力学。摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如平均场、紧束缚模型等）。

papers.title: Viscochiral Transport: Chiral Selection of Hydrodynamic Vortices by Berry Curvature
papers.abstract: We predict a new viscochiral regime of electronic transport in which spatially varying Hall viscosity selects vortical flow patterns. Although uniform Hall viscosity cannot alter incompressible bulk flow, its spatial gradient redistributes vorticity, amplifying vortices in one chamber while suppressing the vortex in the other. We further determine the underlying mechanism to be generic to recirculating flows and insensitive to the details of the device geometry. The paper maps the resulting phase diagram and shows that the regime is experimentally accessible in valley-polarized bilayer graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：predict（预言）、maps the phase diagram（绘制相图）、theoretical framework（理论框架）。；研究对象：电子输运中的“粘手性”（viscochiral）效应，具体体系为谷极化的双层石墨烯（valley-polarized bilayer graphene）中的流体动力学涡旋（hydrodynamic vortices）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 空间变化的霍尔粘度（Hall viscosity）可以重新分布涡量，从而在双腔结构中实现涡旋的手性选择——一个腔中涡旋被放大，另一个腔中涡旋被抑制。该机制对再循环流动具有普适性，不依赖具体器件几何细节。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：空间变化的霍尔粘度（Hall viscosity）可以重新分布涡量，从而在双腔结构中实现涡旋的手性选择——一个腔中涡旋被放大，另一个腔中涡旋被抑制。该机制对再循环流动具有普适性，不依赖具体器件几何细节。；创新点：首次预言了“粘手性输运”这一新 regime：此前已知均匀霍尔粘度不能改变不可压缩体流，本工作发现其空间梯度可以产生涡旋手性选择效应，且该效应具有几何普适性，并在实验可行的谷极化双层石墨烯体系中实现。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与解析建模，结合相图分析。摘要未明确说明具体数值方法（如玻尔兹曼方程、流体动力学方程求解等），仅提及“maps the resulting phase diagram”。

papers.title: Exact analytical spectrum, eigenstates, and quantum geometry of the quarter-flux Harper-Hofstadter model
papers.abstract: Quantum geometry has emerged as a guiding principle across atomic and condensed-matter physics, shaping the topological responses of Bloch bands and the stability of the correlated phases they host. Beyond two-band models, however, closed-form expressions for both the spectrum and the quantum geometry are rare. Here we provide such expressions for a paradigmatic four-band model that has recently been realized experimentally with ultracold atoms, photons and in superconducting circuits: the Harper-Hofstadter model at quarter flux, describing charged particles on a two-dimensional square lattice subjected to a uniform magnetic field. We achieve this by first showing that the model possesses a sublattice symmetry, which renders its Bloch Hamiltonian anti-block-diagonal allowing us to derive the spectrum and the eigenstates analytically. From that we also obtain closed-form expressions for the full quantum geometric tensor (QGT), including both the Berry curvature and the quantum metric, for all the bands of the model. For this purpose we first derive a general expression for the QGT for sublattice-symmetric systems in terms of contributions from the individual sublattice sectors. Finally, we evaluate fractional-Chern-insulator stability criteria analytically and quantify the lowest band of the quarter-flux Harper-Hofstadter model to be a nearly ideal Chern band.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中反复出现“analytically”“closed-form expressions”“derive”“general expression”等关键词，属于解析理论推导工作。；研究对象：四分之一磁通Harper-Hofstadter模型，即二维正方晶格中带电粒子在均匀磁场下、每四个晶格原胞含一个磁通量子的体系。该模型已在超冷原子、光子及超导电路中被实验实现。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型具有子晶格对称性，使Bloch哈密顿量呈反对角块结构，从而可解析推导出全部能带的本征谱与本征态；进一步得到所有能带的完整量子几何张量（含Berry曲率与量子度规）的闭式表达式，并定量评估了分数陈绝缘体稳定性判据，表明最低能带是近乎理想的Chern带。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型具有子晶格对称性，使Bloch哈密顿量呈反对角块结构，从而可解析推导出全部能带的本征谱与本征态；进一步得到所有能带的完整量子几何张量（含Berry曲率与量子度规）的闭式表达式，并定量评估了分数陈绝缘体稳定性判据，表明最低能带是近乎理想的Chern带。；创新点：为四带模型提供了谱与量子几何张量的闭式解析表达式，突破了以往仅限两带模型的局限；首次给出子晶格对称系统量子几何张量的一般分解公式，并据此解析量化了该模型最低带的Chern带理想程度。
papers.method_zh: 解析理论推导：利用子晶格对称性将Bloch哈密顿量化为反对角块形式，先推导子晶格对称系统量子几何张量的一般表达式（按各子晶格扇区贡献分解），再将其应用于四分之一磁通Harper-Hofstadter模型，得到谱、本征态及量子几何张量的闭式解，并据此解析计算分数陈绝缘体稳定性判据。

papers.title: Parity Anomaly as Modular Commutator with Massless Dirac Fermion
papers.abstract: The modular commutator $J(A,B,C) = i\langle[K_{AB},K_{BC}]\rangle$ extracts the chiral central charge $c_-$ from a single bulk wavefunction of a \emph{gapped} 2d state, where $3J/π=c_-$. Inspired by the recent developments in the field of gapless symmetry-protected topological phases, we ask: what does the modular commutator measure, if it is well-defined at all, when the 2d bulk becomes \textit{gapless}? Several interesting new insights can already be obtained using the simple Haldane honeycomb model. For the critical point hosting an isolated Dirac node we find that $J$ remains sharp: it converges to a \textit{half-quantized} value, with corrections that decay as a power law in the subsystem size rather than exponentially, mirroring the power-law correlations in gapless systems. We prove the half-quantization using an emergent reflection symmetry of the massless Dirac cone, and show that the half-quantized contribution comes from the other gapped cone (the massive partner of the massless one). This massive partner can be interpreted as the physical incarnation of the Pauli-Villars regulator, which is the origin of the parity-breaking level-$\frac{1}{2}$ Chern-Simons term (with half-quantized Hall conductance) and the parity anomaly. When protected chiral edge modes coexist with a bulk Dirac node we obtain $3J/π= c_-+\frac{1}{2}$. The half-quantization is also shown to be robust against tripartition deformation, tuning Dirac velocity and Dirac cone anisotropy. We further investigate other types of gaplessness---quadratic nodes (in contrast to linear Dirac) and the case with Fermi surface---and show that the robust half-quantization of $J$ is lost in such non-Dirac cases. These results generalize the modular commutator beyond gapped phases, and at the same time provide an information-theoretic measurement of the parity anomaly.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及理论推导（“we prove”）、模型分析（Haldane honeycomb model）以及概念性论证（modular commutator、parity anomaly），未提及实验手段。；研究对象：二维无带隙（gapless）量子态中的模交换子（modular commutator）行为，具体以Haldane蜂巢模型中的狄拉克锥（Dirac node）为研究对象，并延伸至二次节点（quadratic node）和费米面情形。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当二维体态变为无带隙且存在孤立狄拉克节点时，模交换子J仍保持尖锐（sharp），并收敛到半量子化值（half-quantized value），即3J/π = c_- + 1/2（当手性边缘模与体狄拉克节点共存时）；该半量子化来源于质量狄拉克锥（massive partner），可视为Pauli-Villars正则化子的物理体现，从而为宇称反常提供了信息论度量。对于非狄拉克型无带隙（二次节点、费米面），半量子化鲁棒性丧失。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当二维体态变为无带隙且存在孤立狄拉克节点时，模交换子J仍保持尖锐（sharp），并收敛到半量子化值（half-quantized value），即3J/π = c_- + 1/2（当手性边缘模与体狄拉克节点共存时）；该半量子化来源于质量狄拉克锥（massive partner），可视为Pauli-Villars正则化子的物理体现，从而为宇称反常提供了信息论度量。对于非狄拉克型无带隙（二次节点、费米面），半量子化鲁棒性丧失。；创新点：将模交换子从有能隙（gapped）相推广到无带隙（gapless）体系，首次揭示其在狄拉克临界点处的半量子化行为，并将其与宇称反常（parity anomaly）和Pauli-Villars正则化建立直接联系，提供了从量子信息角度测量宇称反常的新途径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与解析证明：利用Haldane蜂巢模型（紧束缚模型）计算模交换子J(A,B,C) = i⟨[K_AB,K_BC]⟩，通过子系统尺寸标度分析（幂律衰减 vs 指数衰减），并利用无质量狄拉克锥的涌现反射对称性（emergent reflection symmetry）证明半量子化；同时考察三部分变形（tripartition deformation）、狄拉克速度调节和各向异性对鲁棒性的影响。

papers.title: Incommensurate spin fluctuations in one-dimensional Kondo metal CeCo2Ga8
papers.abstract: We present an experimental and numerical study of the spin fluctuations in 1D Kondo metal CeCo$_2$Ga$_8$. Using inelastic neutron spectroscopy, we measure highly one-dimensional magnetism with low-energy incommensurate short-ranged magnetic fluctuations. ARPES similarly shows a highly one-dimensional electronic band structure, confirming the one-dimensional nature of the system. We use density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) simulations of the 1D Kondo lattice model to interpret the measured spectrum, which successfully reproduce the neutron scattering features. We are thus able to place CeCo$_2$Ga$_8$ within the emergent incommensurate phase of the 1D Kondo lattice phase diagram, and demonstrate that the Kondo lattice simulated non-perturbatively is an accurate microscopic model for heavy fermion physics. This shows CeCo$_2$Ga$_8$ to be one-dimensional despite its complexities, and reveals a coexistence of low-energy Kondo and magnetic features in its inelastic spectrum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+数值模拟）。关键词：inelastic neutron spectroscopy、ARPES、DMRG simulations。；研究对象：一维近藤金属材料 CeCo₂Ga₈，具体研究其低能非公度短程磁涨落及一维电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CeCo₂Ga₈ 尽管结构复杂，但本质上是一维近藤金属；其非弹性谱中同时存在低能近藤（Kondo）与磁性特征，且该系统处于一维近藤晶格相图的非公度（incommensurate）相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CeCo₂Ga₈ 尽管结构复杂，但本质上是一维近藤金属；其非弹性谱中同时存在低能近藤（Kondo）与磁性特征，且该系统处于一维近藤晶格相图的非公度（incommensurate）相。；创新点：首次将 CeCo₂Ga₈ 明确置于一维近藤晶格模型的非公度相中，并通过非微扰 DMRG 模拟成功复现中子散射特征，证明一维近藤晶格模型是重费米子物理的准确微观模型。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用非弹性中子散射（INS）测量磁激发谱，使用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）测量电子能带结构；数值上采用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）对一维近藤晶格模型进行非微扰模拟，并与中子散射谱进行对比。

papers.title: Depth Control of Room-Temperature Quantum Emitters in Gallium Nitride
papers.abstract: Bright quantum emitters are key components for quantum communication systems. Radiative point defects in gallium nitride (GaN) are promising candidates for room-temperature single-photon emission, operating from the visible to the telecom O-band. Despite their potential, their integration into photonic structures has remained limited in the literature, with experimental photon extraction efficiencies far below simulated predictions. To identify the origin of this limitation, we investigate visible and near-infrared quantum emitters in GaN epilayers grown on $c$-plane sapphire substrates exhibiting narrow linewidths ($\sim$4 nm), high photon count rates ($ > $2 MHz), and strong antibunching, reaching $g^{(2)}(0)$ values as low as 0.06 at room temperature. We find that these emitters are located near the GaN/substrate interface, explaining their limited coupling to optical modes. Building on this observation, we show that the insertion of a thin low-temperature GaN interlayer enables the formation of quantum emitters at arbitrary depths with sub-60 nm accuracy, independent of the substrate. The intentionally introduced emitters retain optical properties comparable to naturally occurring ones, including narrow linewidths ($\sim$6 nm), saturation count rates exceeding 1.5 MHz, high Debye-Waller factors (0.69-0.98), and strong antibunching. The resulting epilayer fully coalesces within less than 250 nm ensuring compatibility with GaN-based cavity fabrication and enabling emitter placement within intrinsic regions of p-i-n diode architectures. These results mark a decisive step toward efficient emitter-cavity coupling, enabling the realization of cavity-enhanced quantum emission in GaN.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了量子发射体的制备（GaN外延层生长、插入低温GaN中间层）、光学表征（线宽、计数率、反聚束g^(2)(0)测量）等实验内容。；研究对象：氮化镓（GaN）外延层中的室温量子发射体（辐射性点缺陷），覆盖可见光到电信O波段，以及其与光子结构耦合的深度控制问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: GaN中自然形成的量子发射体位于GaN/蓝宝石衬底界面附近，这解释了其与光学模式耦合效率低的原因；通过插入薄低温GaN中间层，可在任意深度（精度优于60 nm）可控地形成量子发射体，且光学性质与自然发射体相当。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：GaN中自然形成的量子发射体位于GaN/蓝宝石衬底界面附近，这解释了其与光学模式耦合效率低的原因；通过插入薄低温GaN中间层，可在任意深度（精度优于60 nm）可控地形成量子发射体，且光学性质与自然发射体相当。；创新点：首次实现GaN中量子发射体在任意深度（亚60 nm精度）的可控定位，且不依赖衬底类型；发射体可置于p-i-n二极管本征区及与GaN腔体兼容的位置，为高效发射体-腔耦合和腔增强量子发射铺平道路。摘要未突出说明与已有深度控制方法的直接对比。
papers.method_zh: 光致发光光谱（测量线宽~4-6 nm）、单光子计数（计数率>2 MHz）、二阶关联函数g^(2)(0)测量（反聚束表征，最低0.06）、饱和计数率测量、Debye-Waller因子测量；材料生长采用GaN外延（c面蓝宝石衬底）及低温GaN中间层插入技术。

papers.title: Topology of Fluctuation Bands in Chiral Active Matter
papers.abstract: While band topology is usually associated with the deterministic dynamics of a system, we show that it can instead reside in its fluctuations. Using a reciprocal lattice driven by nonequilibrium chiral active noise, we find that the displacement spectrum---which quantifies displacement fluctuations---admits bands with nonzero Chern numbers despite a Chern-trivial deterministic mechanics. A Haldane-like effective coupling in the correlation spectrum explains this topology and produces topological transitions controlled by both the stochastic driving and the observation frequency. Through the bulk--boundary correspondence, we find boundary-localized fluctuation modes that are distinct from the usual propagating mechanical edge states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据关键词：band topology、deterministic dynamics、Chern numbers、bulk–boundary correspondence（均为理论/拓扑物理分析术语）。；研究对象：手性活性物质（chiral active matter）中的涨落带（fluctuation bands）拓扑性质，具体为受非平衡手性活性噪声驱动的倒格子（reciprocal lattice）体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在确定性力学为Chern平庸的体系中，位移涨落谱（displacement spectrum）可以具有非零Chern数的能带；该拓扑由关联谱中的Haldane类有效耦合产生，并可通过随机驱动强度和观测频率调控拓扑相变。体–边界对应导致边界局域的涨落模式，与通常的传播型力学边缘态不同。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在确定性力学为Chern平庸的体系中，位移涨落谱（displacement spectrum）可以具有非零Chern数的能带；该拓扑由关联谱中的Haldane类有效耦合产生，并可通过随机驱动强度和观测频率调控拓扑相变。体–边界对应导致边界局域的涨落模式，与通常的传播型力学边缘态不同。；创新点：首次将能带拓扑从确定性动力学推广到涨落谱本身，证明即使确定性力学是Chern平庸的，涨落仍可承载非平庸拓扑，并发现由随机驱动和观测频率控制的拓扑转变以及新型边界局域涨落模式。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于非平衡手性活性噪声驱动的倒格子模型，计算位移涨落谱的能带拓扑（Chern数），引入Haldane类有效耦合解释拓扑起源，并利用体–边界对应原理分析边界涨落模式。

papers.title: Electrical manipulation of oxygen stoichiometry in multiterminal YBa$_2$Cu$_3$O$_{7-δ}$ junctions
papers.abstract: Local manipulation of oxygen stoichiometry offers a route to control the electronic properties of complex oxides, yet the selective modification of individual current-carrying branches through oxygen redistribution remains unexplored in multiterminal high-temperature superconducting junctions. In a YBa$_2$Cu$_3$O$_{7-δ}$ Y-shaped three-terminal device, we demonstrate the possibility to electrically control oxygen vacancy migration on a hand-picked terminal while largely preserving the other two. Oxygen-depleted propagating fronts are directly visualized by the resulting change in optical reflectivity and they are linked to the evolution of the electrical response. The process is highly directional and determined by the polarity of the applied current, allowing for the creation of either a converging or a diverging propagating front from the central node of the Y-shaped device. The associated changes in resistance exhibit relaxation on a timescale of minutes, driven by the vacancy concentration gradient. Effects of oxygen migration are also mapped by Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy and Scanning Laser Microscopy, which probe work-function changes and spatially resolved variations in the superconducting transition, respectively. Notably, the Tc contrast revealed by the latter provides a quantitative handle on the underlying oxygen content, enabling direct visualization of oxygen redistribution. Finite-element modeling and nanoprobe X-ray diffraction qualitatively reproduce the observed vacancy redistribution. These results establish a post-fabrication route to locally tune properties of superconducting multiterminal devices such as nanocryotrons, yTron, and tunable weak links.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：demonstrate、directly visualized、mapped by Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy、Scanning Laser Microscopy、Finite-element modeling、nanoprobe X-ray diffraction（实验为主，辅以建模与衍射验证）。；研究对象：YBa₂Cu₃O₇₋δ（YBCO）Y形三端高温超导结中氧空位迁移的电控调控，以及由此引起的局域电子性质（超导转变温度、功函数、电阻）变化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在YBCO Y形三端器件中，通过施加极性可控的电流，能够选择性地在指定终端诱导氧空位迁移并形成传播前沿，同时基本保持另外两个终端不受影响；该氧再分布过程高度定向，并可通过光学反射率、开尔文探针力显微镜和扫描激光显微镜直接可视化，其引起的电阻变化在分钟量级内弛豫。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在YBCO Y形三端器件中，通过施加极性可控的电流，能够选择性地在指定终端诱导氧空位迁移并形成传播前沿，同时基本保持另外两个终端不受影响；该氧再分布过程高度定向，并可通过光学反射率、开尔文探针力显微镜和扫描激光显微镜直接可视化，其引起的电阻变化在分钟量级内弛豫。；创新点：首次在多端高温超导结中实现通过氧再分布对单个载流支路的选择性电学调控，并建立了Tc对比度作为定量氧含量探针的直接可视化方法，为纳米低温管（nanocryotrons）、yTron和可调弱连接等超导多端器件的后制备局域调控提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：光学反射率成像（可视化氧耗尽传播前沿）、Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy（KPFM，探测功函数变化）、Scanning Laser Microscopy（扫描激光显微镜，空间分辨超导转变Tc变化）、电输运测量（电阻演化与弛豫）；辅助手段为有限元建模和纳米探针X射线衍射（定性复现氧空位再分布）。

papers.title: Electron spin resonance driven photogalvanic effect in graphene-based structures
papers.abstract: We report an electron-spin-resonance-driven linear photogalvanic effect (LPGE) in unbiased monolayer graphene and WSe_2/graphene heterostructures. Under linearly polarized 45--75 GHz radiation, the photovoltage exhibits pronounced resonant features in both Faraday and Voigt geometries. Multiple resonances associated with the electron spin resonance in graphene are observed for both out-of-plane and in-plane magnetic-field orientations. Their magnetic-field positions vary linearly with frequency, their amplitudes reverse sign across the charge-neutrality point, and the resonant contribution has the opposite sign to the nonresonant Drude photogalvanic background. We develop a microscopic theory in which radiation-induced momentum alignment followed by skew scattering generates both contributions. Their opposite signs originate from the orthogonal momentum alignments produced by indirect Drude absorption and direct spin-resonant transitions. The theory describes well the main features of the observed resonant photocurrent and provides a microscopic description of ESR-induced LPGE in two-dimensional systems. These results establish the photogalvanic response as a probe of ESR in unbiased micron-scale graphene-based devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论混合类型。判断依据：摘要中同时报告了实验测量（光电压、共振特征）和“我们发展了一个微观理论”。；研究对象：单层石墨烯及 WSe₂/石墨烯异质结构中的电子自旋共振驱动的线性光生伏打效应（LPGE）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无偏置的石墨烯基器件中，线性偏振微波辐射（45–75 GHz）可诱导出与电子自旋共振相关的光生伏打响应，该共振光电流在电荷中性点两侧符号反转，且与德鲁德非共振背景符号相反；微观理论表明两种贡献源于间接德鲁德吸收与直接自旋共振跃迁产生的正交动量排列。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无偏置的石墨烯基器件中，线性偏振微波辐射（45–75 GHz）可诱导出与电子自旋共振相关的光生伏打响应，该共振光电流在电荷中性点两侧符号反转，且与德鲁德非共振背景符号相反；微观理论表明两种贡献源于间接德鲁德吸收与直接自旋共振跃迁产生的正交动量排列。；创新点：首次将光生伏打效应确立为无偏置微米尺度石墨烯器件中电子自旋共振的探测手段，并给出了ESR诱导LPGE的微观机制（正交动量排列导致符号相反）。摘要未突出说明与其他ESR探测方法的对比优势。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用45–75 GHz线性偏振微波辐射，在法拉第和福格特两种几何构型下测量光电压，并扫描外磁场方向（面外与面内）；理论上构建了辐射诱导动量排列加斜散射的微观模型，用以解释共振与非共振光电流的符号关系。

papers.title: Oxidation-resilient structural modifications in Nickel-functionalized 3D-graphene for hydrogen storage applications
papers.abstract: Porous materials represent a versatile solution for several applications. Indeed, the recent development of a new material, named 3D-Graphene, which combines the exceptional characteristics of graphene with a three-dimensional structure, opens perspectives for applications where a high surface-to-volume ratio is beneficial. In this study, we explore the functionalization of 3D-Graphene with nickel (Ni)-nanoparticles as a strategy to enhance hydrogen storage capabilities, and we assess the influence of the NPs on hydrogen uptake and oxidation resilience. The morphology and structural properties of pristine and Ni-functionalized samples were characterized using Scanning Electron Microscopy. Additionally, X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy was employed to analyze the surface chemical composition of the functionalized samples. Samples have been hydrogenated supplying molecular or atomic hydrogen, and hydrogen storage performance was assessed through Thermal Desorption Spectroscopy. Afterwards, oxidation effects were systematically studied by exposing the samples to atmospheric oxygen, followed by further hydrogenation experiments. Our results indicate that Ni functionalization influences both hydrogen adsorption and oxidation behavior, with potential implications for improving the stability of the material, especially for hydrogen storage applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）、X射线光电子能谱（XPS）、热脱附谱（TDS）等实验表征手段，并进行了氢化与氧化实验。；研究对象：镍（Ni）纳米颗粒功能化的三维石墨烯（3D-Graphene）材料，及其在氢气存储应用中的氢吸附与抗氧化性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ni功能化同时影响3D-Graphene的氢吸附行为和氧化行为，有望改善材料在储氢应用中的稳定性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ni功能化同时影响3D-Graphene的氢吸附行为和氧化行为，有望改善材料在储氢应用中的稳定性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其新意在于将Ni纳米颗粒功能化策略应用于新型3D-Graphene材料，并同时考察了储氢性能与抗氧化稳定性之间的关联。
papers.method_zh: 扫描电子显微镜（SEM）表征形貌与结构；X射线光电子能谱（XPS）分析表面化学组成；分别以分子氢和原子氢对样品进行氢化处理；热脱附谱（TDS）评估储氢性能；将样品暴露于大气氧中系统研究氧化效应，随后再次进行氢化实验。

papers.title: Rare-earth oxysulfides RE$_2$O$_2$S as model mixed-anion frustrated magnets
papers.abstract: The study of low-dimensional and anisotropic magnetism is a promising avenue for the discovery of novel quantum phenomena. Mixed-anion materials, defined by the coordination of metal cations by two or more distinct anionic species, provide an intrinsically anisotropic platform for the tuning of structural, magnetic, and electronic properties. In this work, we report the synthesis and characterization of a family of rare-earth oxysulfide (RE$_2$O$_2$S) antiferromagnets (AFM) possessing a triangular-bilayer slab lattice geometry. Long-range AFM order is observed for the majority of compositions, with several (RE = Ce, Pr, Nd, Sm) having been previously unreported. Although assumed to form stoichiometrically, pair distribution function (PDF) analysis provides evidence for significant, synthesis-dependent interslab structural disorder as RE$_2$O$_{2+x}$S$_{1-x}$, resulting in significant variability in the bulk magnetic response of the Nd member. This work highlights the tunability of frustrated magnetic ground states in rare-earth-based mixed-anion materials, and the importance of thorough structural characterization in the discovery of new mixed-anion magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“synthesis and characterization”（合成与表征），以及使用“pair distribution function (PDF) analysis”（对分布函数分析）等实验手段。；研究对象：稀土氧硫化物 RE₂O₂S（RE = 稀土元素）家族，一种具有三角双层（triangular-bilayer）平板晶格几何结构的混合阴离子反铁磁材料。该体系属于低维、各向异性磁性材料，用于探索受挫磁性与量子现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 多数 RE₂O₂S 组分（包括此前未报道的 Ce、Pr、Nd、Sm 成员）表现出长程反铁磁有序；但 PDF 分析揭示材料实际并非理想化学计量比，而是存在合成依赖的层间结构无序（RE₂O₂₊ₓS₁₋ₓ），该无序显著影响 Nd 成员的宏观磁响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：多数 RE₂O₂S 组分（包括此前未报道的 Ce、Pr、Nd、Sm 成员）表现出长程反铁磁有序；但 PDF 分析揭示材料实际并非理想化学计量比，而是存在合成依赖的层间结构无序（RE₂O₂₊ₓS₁₋ₓ），该无序显著影响 Nd 成员的宏观磁响应。；创新点：首次系统报道多个稀土氧硫化物（Ce、Pr、Nd、Sm）的反铁磁有序行为，并揭示混合阴离子材料中“看似化学计量、实则存在层间无序”这一隐蔽结构问题，强调在发现新型混合阴离子磁体时进行细致结构表征的重要性。
papers.method_zh: 实验合成（具体方法摘要未明确说明）；磁性质测量（用于确定反铁磁有序）；对分布函数（PDF）分析，用于表征局域结构无序与化学计量偏离。

papers.title: Symmetry Origins of the Field-Free Superconducting Diode Effect in the Kagome Superconductor CsV$_3$Sb$_5$
papers.abstract: Field-free superconducting diode effects require both inversion-symmetry breaking and an internal time-reversal-symmetry (TRS) breaking field, making them sensitive probes of hidden order in superconductors. In centrosymmetric kagome AV$_3$Sb$_5$, the inversion symmetry generally should generally preclude the observation of the superconducting diode effect. Furthermore, though TRS breaking has been reported in the superconducting regime of CsV$_3$Sb$_5$, whether it is generated by superconductivity or inherited from charge-density-wave (CDW) order remains unresolved. Here we show that pristine CsV$_3$Sb$_5$ devices exhibit no intrinsic field-free superconducting diode effect, whereas surface oxidation or asymmetric etching activates a large nonreciprocal supercurrent. Moreover, the response is stochastic, with sweep-dependent polarity and magnitude, indicating metastable TRS-breaking domain configurations. Small out-of-plane magnetic fields stabilize the superconducting diode response, consistent with field selection of such domains. Finally, when long-range CDW order is suppressed by Ti doping, the SDE disappears. Our results establish the symmetry requirements for the field-free SDE in CsV$_3$Sb$_5$, reveal its stochastic domain-controlled character, and link superconducting-state TRS breaking to CDW-related order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了器件制备（表面氧化、非对称刻蚀）、输运测量（超导二极管效应、磁场依赖）等实验内容。；研究对象：笼目（Kagome）超导体 CsV₃Sb₅ 中的无外场超导二极管效应（SDE），及其与电荷密度波（CDW）序、时间反演对称性破缺（TRSB）之间的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 原始 CsV₃Sb₅ 器件不存在本征的无外场超导二极管效应，但表面氧化或非对称刻蚀会激活大的非互易超流；该响应具有随机性（极性和大小随扫描变化），表明存在亚稳态 TRSB 畴构型。Ti 掺杂抑制长程 CDW 序后 SDE 消失，说明超导态的 TRSB 与 CDW 相关序有关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：原始 CsV₃Sb₅ 器件不存在本征的无外场超导二极管效应，但表面氧化或非对称刻蚀会激活大的非互易超流；该响应具有随机性（极性和大小随扫描变化），表明存在亚稳态 TRSB 畴构型。Ti 掺杂抑制长程 CDW 序后 SDE 消失，说明超导态的 TRSB 与 CDW 相关序有关。；创新点：首次系统阐明 CsV₃Sb₅ 中无外场 SDE 的对称性要求，揭示其随机畴控制特性，并实验上将超导态 TRSB 与 CDW 相关序直接关联起来。
papers.method_zh: 输运测量（超导二极管效应测量）、器件表面处理（表面氧化、非对称刻蚀）、小面外磁场调控、Ti 掺杂（化学掺杂抑制 CDW 序）。摘要未明确提及具体测量技术细节（如电极构型、低温手段等）。

papers.title: Bayesian Optimization for Self-Driving Materials Laboratories: From Algorithms to Physics-Informed Workflows
papers.abstract: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) are transforming materials research by closing the loop among synthesis, characterization, data analysis and experimental decision making. Bayesian optimization (BO) is a decision engine for these loops because it can select experiments from scarce and noisy data while balancing exploitation and exploration. Yet real materials campaigns often depart from the standard black-box setting, involving failed or missing experiments, noise and drift, mixed variables, constraints, multiple objectives, variable cost and fidelity, transfer from historical data, batch or asynchronous operation, and prior physics knowledge. This review presents BO for materials SDLs through the lens of these practical challenges. We summarize Gaussian-process-based BO and the formulation of materials goals as quantitative objectives, then discuss major choices in surrogate modelling and acquisition. Particular emphasis is placed on physics-informed Bayesian optimization (PIBO), in which domain knowledge enters through representations, priors, kernels, acquisition functions, and constraints. We survey achievements enabled by BO and related active-learning approaches across semiconductors, catalysis, chemical reactions, batteries, alloys, functional materials and quantum materials, highlighting advances beyond parameter optimization, including new materials and synthesis routes, improved functional performance, and reusable scientific knowledge. We conclude by outlining open problems for BO-driven materials SDLs, including nonstationarity, multimodal observations, adaptive problem formulation, and scientific reasoning by humans, large language models and research agents. Addressing these challenges may advance SDLs beyond efficient optimization toward interpretable and knowledge-generating experimentation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（综述/方法类文章）。判断依据：摘要明确为“This review presents...”，属于文献综述，涵盖算法、工作流及实验应用，非单一实验或计算研究。；研究对象：研究对象并非特定材料体系，而是“自驱动实验室”（SDLs）中的**贝叶斯优化（BO）**方法及其在材料科学中的应用，涉及半导体、催化、化学反应、电池、合金、功能材料与量子材料等多个领域。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 贝叶斯优化是自驱动实验室中连接合成、表征与决策的核心引擎，但真实材料实验常偏离标准黑箱设定；将物理知识注入BO（即物理信息贝叶斯优化，PIBO）可显著提升优化效率，并推动新材料、新合成路线及可复用科学知识的产出。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：贝叶斯优化是自驱动实验室中连接合成、表征与决策的核心引擎，但真实材料实验常偏离标准黑箱设定；将物理知识注入BO（即物理信息贝叶斯优化，PIBO）可显著提升优化效率，并推动新材料、新合成路线及可复用科学知识的产出。；创新点：以“实际材料实验中的非理想条件”为组织主线，系统梳理BO在SDLs中的应用，并重点突出**物理信息贝叶斯优化（PIBO）**这一新兴方向，强调其超越参数优化、迈向可解释与知识生成型实验的潜力。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验或计算手段，但系统总结了**高斯过程代理模型**、**采集函数设计**、**多目标/约束/变保真度处理**、**迁移学习**及**物理信息注入方式**（表征、先验、核函数、采集函数、约束）等算法框架。

papers.title: Watching a GaN Transistor Switch: Real-Time Nanoscale Strain and Heat Dynamics
papers.abstract: Digital and energy technologies depend on microelectromechanical and power electronic components whose performance is critically impacted by rapid, cyclic deformations. Real-time information on their operation has remained inaccessible due to the need for nanosecond and nanometer resolution in fully integrated devices. We break this limitation by imaging the complete switching cycle of an industrial GaN high electron mobility transistor through stroboscopic dark field X ray microscopy at a fourth-generation synchrotron, resolving electromechanical and thermal micro strain fields across the entire device and correlating them with time dependent voltage characteristics. Coupled simulations benchmarked against the measurements reproduce electric field evolution and transient thermal hotspots. This combined approach provides direct insight into device physics and informs design strategies for next generation energy and information processing technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验为主，辅以数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“imaging”（成像实验）、“stroboscopic dark field X ray microscopy”（实验手段），以及“Coupled simulations benchmarked against the measurements”（与实验对照的耦合模拟）。；研究对象：工业级GaN高电子迁移率晶体管（HEMT）的完整开关循环过程中的电-机械耦合应变场与瞬态热场演化，属于功率电子器件的实时工作状态物理。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过第四代同步辐射源的频闪暗场X射线显微镜，首次实现了对工业GaN晶体管完整开关周期的实时纳米尺度应变与热动力学成像，揭示了与时间相关电压特性相关联的机电与热微应变场分布，并识别出瞬态热斑。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过第四代同步辐射源的频闪暗场X射线显微镜，首次实现了对工业GaN晶体管完整开关周期的实时纳米尺度应变与热动力学成像，揭示了与时间相关电压特性相关联的机电与热微应变场分布，并识别出瞬态热斑。；创新点：突破了全集成器件中同时需要纳秒时间分辨率和纳米空间分辨率的限制，首次实现对工业级功率晶体管完整开关循环的实时内部应变与热场成像，并将实验测量与耦合模拟直接关联以指导器件设计。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用频闪暗场X射线显微镜（stroboscopic dark field X-ray microscopy）在第四代同步辐射源上对全集成器件进行成像，时间分辨率为纳秒级、空间分辨率为纳米级；理论上采用与实验测量基准对照的耦合模拟（coupled simulations），用于重现电场演化和瞬态热斑。

papers.title: Landau Theory for Commensurate Charge-Density Waves Coupled to Uniform Lattice Deformation
papers.abstract: We formulate a minimal Landau theory for a charge-density wave (CDW) whose commensurability is defined with respect to a deformed lattice. The motivation is provided by recent observations on an isolated single NbS$_3$ chain, which exhibits a commensurate CDW state accompanied by a $6\%$ shrinkage of the lattice constant. A uniform stretch $a_0\to a_0(1+\varepsilon)$ changes the reciprocal lattice wave number to $G(\varepsilon)=G_0/(1+\varepsilon)$, so that an $N$-fold commensurate CDW has the wave number $Q_\mathrm{C}(\varepsilon)=G(\varepsilon)/N$, whereas the wave number $Q_\mathrm{IC}$ favored by the incommensurate instability remains fixed. We propose an amplitude-strain free energy for both $N=3$ and $N=4$, in which the CDW induces a finite uniform strain by relieving the mismatch between $Q_\mathrm{C}(\varepsilon)$ and $Q_\mathrm{IC}$. The mismatch is shared between the CDW and the lattice in a proportion set by their stiffness ratio; since the CDW stiffness grows with the CDW amplitude, the lattice takes up an increasing share of the mismatch as the CDW develops. Our results suggest a reexamination of lock-in theories and of strain-tuning experiments on density-wave systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“We formulate a minimal Landau theory”（构建最小朗道理论）、“We propose an amplitude-strain free energy”（提出振幅-应变自由能）等理论建模表述。；研究对象：一维电荷密度波（CDW）体系，具体以孤立单链NbS₃为动机来源，研究公度CDW与均匀晶格形变之间的耦合，涵盖N=3和N=4两种公度阶数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 公度CDW可通过诱导有限均匀晶格应变来缓解公度波矢Q_C(ε)与非公度不稳定所偏好的波矢Q_IC之间的失配；失配由CDW与晶格按刚度比分担，且随CDW振幅增大，晶格承担更多失配份额。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：公度CDW可通过诱导有限均匀晶格应变来缓解公度波矢Q_C(ε)与非公度不稳定所偏好的波矢Q_IC之间的失配；失配由CDW与晶格按刚度比分担，且随CDW振幅增大，晶格承担更多失配份额。；创新点：将公度性定义在“形变后的晶格”上，而非传统固定晶格，从而在朗道理论框架内自然引入CDW诱导的均匀应变；该视角对传统锁相（lock-in）理论和应变调控实验提出重新审视。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为朗道唯象理论（Landau theory），构建包含CDW振幅与均匀应变耦合的自由能泛函，通过分析应变对倒格矢的修正（G(ε)=G₀/(1+ε)）以及CDW刚度随振幅的依赖关系来求解失配分配。

papers.title: Fluxtube Bouquets and Type-1.5 Clustering in Superfluid Neutron Star Cores
papers.abstract: We study mesoscopic configurations of a neutron superfluid coupled to a proton superconductor in the outer core of a neutron star. The condensates are described by a two-component Ginzburg-Landau free energy with local couplings, neglecting genuine phase-gradient entrainment. In two spatial dimensions, we minimize the free energy using quasi-periodic boundary conditions and constrained phase-imprinting calculations to study vortex-fluxtube and fluxtube-fluxtube interactions. We find that, for locally attractive couplings in the free energy, vortex-fluxtube overlap is energetically favoured and several pre-existing proton fluxtubes can bind around a neutron vortex, forming finite vortex-centred aggregates that we call fluxtube bouquets. These bouquet configurations may become so dense that a vortex can effectively accommodate several quanta of magnetic flux. We also confirm the possible presence of a type-1.5-like regime and find that it survives in the zero-entrainment regime considered here. In this type-1.5 regime, the fluxtube-fluxtube interaction is repulsive at short distances and attractive at intermediate distances, leading to self-assembled clusters while the individual fluxtubes remain topologically distinct. Possible implications for dissipative coupling and transport in neutron stars are discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。依据：摘要明确提到“用Ginzburg-Landau自由能描述”“最小化自由能”“准周期边界条件和约束相位印记计算”，属于凝聚态理论建模与数值模拟。；研究对象：中子星外核中的中子超流体与质子超导体耦合体系，具体研究其中的涡旋-磁通管（vortex-fluxtube）及磁通管-磁通管之间的介观相互作用和聚集构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在局域吸引耦合下，涡旋-磁通管重叠在能量上有利，多个质子磁通管可围绕一个中子涡旋结合形成“磁通管花束”（fluxtube bouquets），且该体系存在type-1.5超导态——磁通管间短程排斥、中程吸引，导致自组装团簇而单个磁通管保持拓扑独立。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在局域吸引耦合下，涡旋-磁通管重叠在能量上有利，多个质子磁通管可围绕一个中子涡旋结合形成“磁通管花束”（fluxtube bouquets），且该体系存在type-1.5超导态——磁通管间短程排斥、中程吸引，导致自组装团簇而单个磁通管保持拓扑独立。；创新点：首次提出“磁通管花束”这一涡旋-磁通管聚集构型，并证明在零纠缠（zero-entrainment）极限下type-1.5类机制仍然存在，扩展了该机制在中子星超流体核心中的适用性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用两分量Ginzburg-Landau自由能（含局域耦合，忽略相位梯度纠缠），在二维空间中结合准周期边界条件和约束相位印记计算，通过自由能最小化研究涡旋-磁通管及磁通管-磁通管相互作用。

papers.title: Size and Impurity Effects on Scattering of Valley Hall Modes in Gate-Defined Bilayer Graphene Superlattices
papers.abstract: In the present paper we perform a tight-binding simulation of gate-defined islands in Bernal bilayer graphene (BLG). The inversion of the gap sign on the boundaries of the islands creates topologically-protected valley Hall modes. We focus on the specific questions of whether the valley Hall modes around such islands could serve as a host for quantum walks or simulate weakly coupled systems, and how their tunneling is affected by in-gap impurities. In addition, we discuss the effect of misalignment of top and bottom gate patterns on the tunneling properties between islands. Our main results show that resonant tunneling via an impurity enhances overlap between superlattice islands, while misalignment does not break topological protection over a wide parameter regime. In addition, we study the two-island geometry and show that it is possible to leverage suppressed scattering to place islands more densely on a single sample.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“tight-binding simulation”（紧束缚模拟）。；研究对象：栅极定义的双层石墨烯（Bernal bilayer graphene, BLG）超晶格中的谷霍尔（valley Hall）模式，具体研究岛状结构边界上的拓扑保护边界态及其散射行为，以及杂质和栅极错位对隧穿的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过杂质引起的共振隧穿可以增强超晶格岛之间的耦合（重叠），而上下栅极图案的错位在宽参数范围内不会破坏拓扑保护。此外，在双岛几何中，利用抑制的散射可以将岛更密集地排布在同一块样品上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过杂质引起的共振隧穿可以增强超晶格岛之间的耦合（重叠），而上下栅极图案的错位在宽参数范围内不会破坏拓扑保护。此外，在双岛几何中，利用抑制的散射可以将岛更密集地排布在同一块样品上。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该工作聚焦于谷霍尔模式作为量子行走或弱耦合系统模拟平台的可行性，并系统研究了杂质和栅极错位对隧穿的影响，以及利用抑制散射实现更密集的岛排布。
papers.method_zh: 紧束缚（tight-binding）模拟方法，对Bernal双层石墨烯中栅极定义的岛状结构进行数值计算，研究谷霍尔模式的隧穿性质。

papers.title: Current fluctuations in a gas of active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particles
papers.abstract: We investigate the statistics of the time-integrated current in an infinite one-dimensional gas of independent active Ornstein--Uhlenbeck particles, as a model system for studying an active generalisation of the corresponding passive (diffusive) phenomenology. Unlike the latter, where current fluctuations exhibit universal sub-diffusive scaling, active systems display diffusive, super-diffusive, and sub-diffusive regimes over different time scales. We fully characterise the distribution of current in terms of large-deviation asymptotics, showing that all of these scaling regimes are described by a single scaled cumulant generating function. Moreover, the statistics retain a dependence on the initial condition even at large times, revealing a persistent memory of the initial state. We further obtain the joint large-deviation statistics of currents measured at two distinct times, characterising temporal correlations. Our analytical predictions are verified using rare-event importance sampling, which resolves probabilities as small as $10^{-1000}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“统计”“大偏差”“解析预测”等理论关键词，且未提及实验或数值模拟方法（除用于验证的稀有事件重要性采样）。；研究对象：一维无限长气体中的独立活性Ornstein-Uhlenbeck粒子体系，具体研究其时间积分电流的涨落统计，作为活性物质中输运现象（对应被动扩散体系）的模型系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性粒子体系中的电流涨落不再像被动扩散体系那样具有普适的亚扩散标度，而是在不同时间尺度上表现出扩散、超扩散和亚扩散三种标度行为；且电流统计在长时间下仍依赖初始条件，表现出对初始态的持续记忆。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性粒子体系中的电流涨落不再像被动扩散体系那样具有普适的亚扩散标度，而是在不同时间尺度上表现出扩散、超扩散和亚扩散三种标度行为；且电流统计在长时间下仍依赖初始条件，表现出对初始态的持续记忆。；创新点：首次完整刻画了活性Ornstein-Uhlenbeck粒子气体中电流涨落的多时间尺度标度行为，并建立了单一标度累积生成函数统一描述所有标度区域；此外，揭示了长时间下电流统计对初始条件的持续依赖，以及两个不同时刻电流的联合大偏差统计（用于表征时间关联）。摘要未明确说明与具体实验体系的对应关系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析采用大偏差渐近方法，推导出统一的标度累积生成函数；同时使用稀有事件重要性采样（importance sampling）进行数值验证，可解析概率低至10^{-1000}的稀有事件。

papers.title: Switchable heavy-hole/light-hole spin qubit
papers.abstract: Compressively strained Ge quantum wells in planar SiGe/Ge heterostructures are the state-of-the-art platform for hole spin qubits. While they exhibit robust coherence times, they possess weak intrinsic spin-orbit interaction (SOI) due to the heavy-hole (HH) character of the wavefunction. Recently, light-hole (LH) qubits were proposed in GeSn/Ge heterostructures, offering strong, intrinsic, linear-in-momentum SOI. In this work, we propose a switchable HH-LH spin qubit in a bilayer Ge heterostructure with SiGeSn barriers, combining the advantages of HH and LH devices. The character of the qubit can be changed by shuttling from an LH well to an HH well, which also enables fast, hopping-based single-qubit rotations. Additionally, we observe an HH-LH resonance introduced by the in-plane confinement, resulting in $g$-factor peaks and first-order charge noise sweet spots. Our calculations reveal a sweet spot with Rabi frequencies on the order of 100 MHz, comparable to the LH regime, but with a more than tenfold increase in coherence time, on the order of 100 $μ$s.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中多次出现“we propose”“Our calculations reveal”等表述，属于理论建模与数值计算研究。；研究对象：双层Ge异质结构中的空穴自旋量子比特，具体为SiGeSn势垒下的重空穴（HH）/轻空穴（LH）可切换自旋量子比特。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种可在重空穴与轻空穴之间切换的自旋量子比特，通过在不同量子阱间穿梭实现快速单比特旋转，并发现面内限制引入的HH-LH共振可产生g因子峰和一阶电荷噪声甜点，在甜点处Rabi频率约100 MHz，相干时间约100 μs，比纯LH方案提高一个数量级以上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种可在重空穴与轻空穴之间切换的自旋量子比特，通过在不同量子阱间穿梭实现快速单比特旋转，并发现面内限制引入的HH-LH共振可产生g因子峰和一阶电荷噪声甜点，在甜点处Rabi频率约100 MHz，相干时间约100 μs，比纯LH方案提高一个数量级以上。；创新点：首次提出在单一器件中通过穿梭实现HH与LH自旋量子比特的可切换操作，同时利用HH-LH共振获得电荷噪声甜点，兼顾了LH的强自旋轨道耦合（快速操控）与HH的长相干时间优势。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值计算：基于Ge/SiGeSn双层异质结构的量子阱能带计算，分析HH/LH波函数特性、自旋轨道耦合、g因子、电荷噪声以及Rabi频率和相干时间。

papers.title: Residual semi-crystalline particles released during enzymatic degradation of plastics
papers.abstract: Enzymatic recycling of plastics is limited by the presence of semi-crystalline spherulites that are recalcitrant to enzymatic depolymerization. Depending on the quality of the waste stream and its treatment history, a large volume fraction of the material actually remains in form of connected clusters of such spherulites. We build on a recently published numeric method to predict the number, the connectivity, and the morphology of these clusters as an outcome of enzymatic degradation. When applied to PET waste, our method predicts that the resulting aggregates are loosely connected, "fluffy" structures with a high surface-to-volume ratio, accompanied by smaller clusters following a continuous size distribution. By providing a quantitative framework for understanding the microparticle production during the depolymerization, these findings should assist choosing a suitable downstream treatment, such as filtering or flocculation. This work could thus help to advance the enzymatic depolymerization technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/模拟文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“build on a recently published numeric method to predict...”，即基于数值方法进行预测。；研究对象：塑料（特别是PET废料）在酶促降解过程中释放的半结晶球晶颗粒及其聚集体的结构特征，属于软物质/高分子物理范畴。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 酶促降解PET废料时，残余的半结晶球晶会形成松散连接、表面体积比高的“蓬松”聚集体，并伴随尺寸连续分布的小团簇。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：酶促降解PET废料时，残余的半结晶球晶会形成松散连接、表面体积比高的“蓬松”聚集体，并伴随尺寸连续分布的小团簇。；创新点：首次为酶促解聚过程中微塑料颗粒的产生提供了定量预测框架，可用于指导下游处理工艺（如过滤或絮凝）的选择。摘要未突出说明与实验对比的细节。
papers.method_zh: 数值模拟方法（基于已发表的数值模型），用于预测酶促降解过程中球晶聚集体的数量、连通性和形貌。

papers.title: Topological phases of a generalised tripartite Haldane model
papers.abstract: We present a generalised tripartite Haldane model with a complex nearest neighbour hopping parameter. The total magnetic flux through the primitive unit cell, which consists of three hexagonal unit cells is zero, and thus the model has the structure of a loop-current model. We calculate topological phase diagrams of the Chern numbers as a function of the phases of the nearest and next-nearest neighbour hopping parameters for a fixed ratio of the magnitude of the hopping parameters. We show that, unlike the Haldane model, the topological phase diagram of this model is very complex, but some aspects can still be dealt with analytically. Furthermore, the Chern numbers of the topological phases are as large as $7$ in absolute value. The analysis is supported by explicit expressions for energy bands crossing at high symmetry points in the Brillouin zone, which show as linear phase boundaries in the phase diagram. We show that such lines explain many features in the topological phase diagrams. Finally, we analyse a few representative examples of the nature of level crossings away from high symmetry and their evolution with model parameters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：topological phase diagrams、Chern numbers、analytically、explicit expressions。；研究对象：广义三方Haldane模型（generalised tripartite Haldane model），即由三个六角原胞组成复合原胞、具有复最近邻跃迁参数的晶格模型，总磁通为零，属于loop-current模型体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型的拓扑相图远比原始Haldane模型复杂，但部分特征可解析处理；拓扑相的Chern数绝对值最大可达7。高对称点处的能带交叉给出线性相边界，可解释相图中许多特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型的拓扑相图远比原始Haldane模型复杂，但部分特征可解析处理；拓扑相的Chern数绝对值最大可达7。高对称点处的能带交叉给出线性相边界，可解释相图中许多特征。；创新点：将Haldane模型推广到三组分复合原胞结构，在总磁通为零的loop-current框架下揭示了远比原始模型复杂的拓扑相图，并发现Chern数可达±7的大拓扑数，同时建立了高对称点能带交叉与线性相边界的解析联系。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值计算相结合：计算Chern数作为最近邻和次近邻跃迁相位函数的拓扑相图（固定跃迁幅度比值）；利用布里渊区高对称点处能带交叉的显式表达式进行解析分析；并对高对称点以外的能级交叉性质及其随参数演化进行了代表性示例分析。

papers.title: Light-Hole Spin Qubits in Strained SiGe Lattice-Matched to Ge
papers.abstract: Strained germanium ($\varepsilon$-Ge) quantum wells on metamorphic SiGe buffers have enabled advanced hole-based spin qubit devices. Alternatively, unstrained Ge with lattice-matched strained silicon-germanium ($\varepsilon$-SiGe) barriers eliminates the need for metamorphic buffers altogether. The ground state character of both these platforms is predominantly heavy-hole (HH) with a largely anisotropic spin response. We propose and study an alternative heterostructure, lattice-matched to Ge, in which both the SiGe quantum well and barriers are tensile strained, with their composition contrast providing the band offset for confinement and the tensile strain stabilizing a light-hole (LH) ground state. We show large spin-orbit coupling (SOC), both linear and cubic, along with a significantly more isotropic spin response compared to strained HH qubits. We also study the decoherence properties of the proposed device, showing an appreciable gain in the quality factor compared to their HH counterparts. Finally, we propose a bilayer heterostructure that allows for electrical switching between HH and LH ground state character.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中多次出现“We propose and study”“We show”“We also study”等表述，属于理论设计与数值计算研究，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：晶格匹配于Ge的应变SiGe异质结构中的**轻空穴（LH）自旋量子比特**。具体为：在Ge衬底上，SiGe量子阱与势垒均处于张应变状态，通过组分差异提供限制势，张应变稳定LH基态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该LH自旋量子比特体系具有**大且各向同性更好的自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）**（同时含线性与立方项），相比传统应变重空穴（HH）量子比特，其**退相干品质因子显著提升**；此外，提出的双层异质结构可实现**HH与LH基态的电学切换**。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该LH自旋量子比特体系具有**大且各向同性更好的自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）**（同时含线性与立方项），相比传统应变重空穴（HH）量子比特，其**退相干品质因子显著提升**；此外，提出的双层异质结构可实现**HH与LH基态的电学切换**。；创新点：首次提出**以张应变SiGe作为量子阱与势垒、晶格匹配于Ge的LH基态自旋量子比特平台**，无需渐变缓冲层（metamorphic buffer），同时实现更各向同性的自旋响应与更高的品质因子，并引入**电学可切换HH/LH基态的双层结构**。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值计算：基于能带工程分析应变SiGe/Ge异质结构的子带能级与基态空穴类型；计算自旋-轨道耦合系数（线性与立方项）；评估自旋响应各向异性；研究退相干性质并提取品质因子。摘要未明确说明具体计算方法（如k·p、紧束缚或DFT）。

papers.title: Mass-anisotropy driven stripe pattern formation and directional modulational instability in polariton condensate
papers.abstract: Motivated by recent experimental advances toward electrical control of the effective mass and the realization of anisotropic mass distributions, we investigate the impact of mass anisotropy on driven-dissipative polariton condensates, focusing on modulational instability, pattern formation, and the collective dynamics of the emergent patterns. We show that unequal effective masses along the two orthogonal directions induce stripe pattern formation in an exciton-polariton condensate pumped by a non-resonant Gaussian laser beam above a critical mass ratio. A Bogoliubov analysis of the homogeneously pumped system reveals that mass anisotropy leaves the modulational-instability criteria unchanged but reshapes the unstable-mode dispersion by reducing the most unstable wave- length along the direction of larger effective mass with increasing mass ratio. This introduces an anisotropy-controlled length scale for pattern selection. When the pump width becomes comparable to the most unstable wavelength, the condensate becomes modulationally unstable and develops stripe patterns along the direction of larger effective mass, accompanied by particle-number fluctua- tions and center-of-mass oscillations along the same direction. As the pump width increases further, the stripes become distorted and develop spatial irregularities during the time evolution, indicative of modulational instability. Nevertheless, the anisotropic mass distribution preserves a pronounced directional preference, in contrast to the fully disordered patterns observed in the isotropic-mass case. Our results identify mass anisotropy as a key control parameter for directional modulational instability and pattern formation in nonequilibrium polariton condensates.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“Bogoliubov analysis”“modulational instability”等理论分析框架，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：非共振高斯激光泵浦下的激子-极化激元凝聚体（exciton-polariton condensate），重点研究有效质量各向异性（mass anisotropy）对调制不稳定性、条纹图案形成及集体动力学的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当两个正交方向的有效质量不等且超过临界质量比时，极化激元凝聚体会自发形成沿较大有效质量方向的条纹图案；质量各向异性不改变调制不稳定性判据，但通过减小较大有效质量方向的最不稳定波长来重塑不稳定模色散，从而引入各向异性控制的图案选择长度尺度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当两个正交方向的有效质量不等且超过临界质量比时，极化激元凝聚体会自发形成沿较大有效质量方向的条纹图案；质量各向异性不改变调制不稳定性判据，但通过减小较大有效质量方向的最不稳定波长来重塑不稳定模色散，从而引入各向异性控制的图案选择长度尺度。；创新点：首次系统揭示质量各向异性可作为非平衡极化激元凝聚体中方向性调制不稳定性和图案形成的控制参数，区别于各向同性质量下完全无序的图案。摘要未突出说明与具体实验方案的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用Bogoliubov线性稳定性分析（对均匀泵浦系统），并结合非均匀泵浦（高斯激光束）下的动力学演化分析，研究调制不稳定性、条纹形成及粒子数涨落和质心振荡。

papers.title: Fate of the non-Abelian Moore-Read manifold under the non-Hermitian skin effect
papers.abstract: We study a non-Abelian Moore-Read fractional Chern insulator under a translation-preserving, nonreciprocal deformation that generates the non-Hermitian skin effect under open boundaries. The model combines the imaginary-gauge Hatano-Nelson deformation with a kagome-lattice three-body interaction designed to stabilize Moore-Read order at $ν=1/2$. Our primary diagnostic is the biorthogonal $(2,4)$-admissible particle-entanglement counting of the sixfold Moore-Read manifold, the standard Moore-Read fingerprint. Across three sizes ($N=16,20,24$), the counting locks to the clean references 1308, 3965, and 9282 over finite nonreciprocity windows through $γ\le0.55$, $0.65$, and $0.74$, respectively, with positive reference-rank entanglement gaps. Within every reported window the count is unchanged by the spectral readings tested; at $N=16$ it is also unchanged across three reduced density operators, with all 15 combinations returning 1308. The sixfold pattern for even $N_f$ and the adiabatically tracked Ising-odd doublet remain separated over the tested range $γ\le0.6$. Beyond a geometry-dependent threshold the instantaneous-lowest-six reference-rank gap drops sharply and its counting destabilizes. At $N=24$ a sector-0 branch pair becomes complex conjugate over a narrow interval inside the delocking bracket; both continuations through the interval are delocked at the tested PES points $γ=0.76$, $0.77$, and $0.80$. A same-lattice Abelian $ν=1/3$ Laughlin realization retains its counting to $γ=1.0$, so its counting is the more robust. On the torus the eigenstates remain extended; under open boundaries the right and left states skin-localize at opposite edges while the biorthogonal particle-entanglement spectrum is invariant under the imaginary-gauge similarity, so the torus and the open cylinder probe the same deformation under periodic and open boundaries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及模型构建、数值计算（粒子纠缠谱计数）、非厄米系统理论分析，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：非厄米趋肤效应下的非阿贝尔Moore-Read分数量子霍尔态（分数陈绝缘体），具体为kagome晶格上ν=1/2的Moore-Read序，以及同晶格上ν=1/3的Laughlin态作为对照。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在有限非互易强度窗口内（γ≤0.55、0.65、0.74，分别对应N=16、20、24），Moore-Read六重简并流形的双正交粒子纠缠计数保持与干净参考值（1308、3965、9282）一致，表明非厄米趋肤效应下Moore-Read拓扑序仍可存活；但超过几何依赖的阈值后计数失稳。相比之下，Abelian Laughlin态的计数稳健性更强（保持至γ=1.0）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在有限非互易强度窗口内（γ≤0.55、0.65、0.74，分别对应N=16、20、24），Moore-Read六重简并流形的双正交粒子纠缠计数保持与干净参考值（1308、3965、9282）一致，表明非厄米趋肤效应下Moore-Read拓扑序仍可存活；但超过几何依赖的阈值后计数失稳。相比之下，Abelian Laughlin态的计数稳健性更强（保持至γ=1.0）。；创新点：首次系统研究非Abelian Moore-Read态在非厄米趋肤效应下的命运，发现其拓扑指纹在有限非互易窗口内保持稳定，且与Abelian态（Laughlin）的稳健性形成对比；揭示了开边界下左右态在相反边缘趋肤局域化而双正交纠缠谱保持不变的特性。摘要未突出说明与以往非厄米拓扑态研究的其他具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用虚规范Hatano-Nelson非互易形变（保持平移对称性）结合kagome晶格三体相互作用；主要诊断工具为双正交(2,4)-可容许粒子纠缠计数（Moore-Read指纹）；计算了三种尺寸（N=16,20,24）的纠缠谱、参考秩纠缠隙、谱读数及约化密度算子依赖性；在环面与开边界圆柱两种几何下对比分析，并利用虚规范相似变换检验纠缠谱不变性。

papers.title: Semi-localized ground state in a 1D system with long-range hopping
papers.abstract: We study the localization of a quantum particle in a one-dimensional disordered system with long-range hopping amplitudes $t(r)\propto r^{-a}$. In contrast to the standard one-dimensional Anderson model ($a\to\infty$), in which all states are localized and the localization length is minimal at the band edge, the long-range model with $1<a<3/2$ exhibits a disorder-driven transition at the band edge, while high-energy states remain localized at arbitrary disorder strength. We investigate this transition for the ground state in momentum space. In the weak-disorder regime, we derive perturbative expressions for the characteristic functions and moments of the momentum-space wave function, as well as for its fractal dimensions. Our results demonstrate that the ground state exhibits $\it semilocalization$ rather than conventional localization, thereby extending the class of models displaying the unusual $\it semifractality$ of wave functions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“We study”“We derive perturbative expressions”等理论推导表述，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：一维无序系统中具有长程跳跃振幅 \(t(r)\propto r^{-a}\) 的量子粒子的局域化行为，特别是基态在动量空间中的性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当 \(1<a<3/2\) 时，该长程跳跃模型在带边出现由无序驱动的相变，而高能态在任意无序强度下仍保持局域化；基态表现出“半局域化”（semilocalization）而非传统局域化，属于“半分形”（semifractality）波函数这一非寻常类别。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当 \(1<a<3/2\) 时，该长程跳跃模型在带边出现由无序驱动的相变，而高能态在任意无序强度下仍保持局域化；基态表现出“半局域化”（semilocalization）而非传统局域化，属于“半分形”（semifractality）波函数这一非寻常类别。；创新点：该工作将“半局域化/半分形”这一非传统波函数行为扩展到具有长程跳跃的一维无序系统，而此前已知的标准一维Anderson模型（\(a\to\infty\)）中所有态均局域化且带边局域长度最小。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：针对弱无序区域，对动量空间波函数的特征函数、矩以及分形维度进行了微扰展开推导。

papers.title: Quasi two dimensional magnetic structure of the triclinic double perovskite Ca$_2$CuWO$_6$
papers.abstract: We present the antiferromagnetic ground state of the triclinic double perovskite Ca$_2$CuWO$_6$solved by neutron powder diffraction, and analyze it in direct comparison with tetragonal Sr$_2$CuWO$_6$. Below $T_\mathrm{N} \simeq 32$ K, the magnetic Bragg reflections of Ca$_2$CuWO$_6$ are indexed by the commensurate propagation vector $\mathbf{k}=(\tfrac{1}{2},\tfrac{1}{2},0)$ in its native $P\bar{1}$ cell. Rietveld refinement yields a collinear structure with equal-magnitude, antiparallel moments on the crystallographically inequivalent Cu1 and Cu2 sites and an ordered moment of $0.66(3)~μ_{\mathrm B}$ per Cu at 1.5 K. A direct comparison with Sr$_2$CuWO$_6$ is obscured by different crystallographic settings and orientations of the cooperative Jahn-Teller elongation axes. Hence, we introduce a common crystallographic supercell through which effects of symmetry lowering from tetragonal to triclinic in the double perovskite are explored: Apparently different magnetic propagation vectors map onto the same supercell wave vector, revealing a common magnetic structure stabilized by tungsten-mediated, second-neighbor interactions. Mean field calculations further show that tetragonal symmetry preserves the degeneracy of four magnetic $\mathbf{k}$-domains in Sr$_2$CuWO$_6$, whereas the triclinic splitting of symmetry-related exchange pathways in Ca$_2$CuWO$_6$, most strongly within the Cu2 network, selects a single $\mathbf{k}$-domain. These results establish the magnetic ground state of Ca$_2$CuWO$_6$ and show how symmetry breaking selects a given ordered state without changing the underlying magnetic motif of the Sr analogue.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“neutron powder diffraction”（中子粉末衍射）和“Rietveld refinement”（Rietveld精修），属于实验手段；同时包含“Mean field calculations”（平均场计算）作为辅助理论分析，但主体为实验研究。；研究对象：三斜双钙钛矿化合物 Ca₂CuWO₆ 的准二维反铁磁基态，并与四方相 Sr₂CuWO₆ 进行直接对比，研究对称性降低对磁结构选择的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Ca₂CuWO₆ 在 T_N ≈ 32 K 以下呈现共线反铁磁序，传播矢量为 k = (½, ½, 0)，Cu1 和 Cu2 位点具有等大小、反平行的磁矩（1.5 K 时有序磁矩为 0.66(3) μ_B/Cu）。通过构建共同超胞，发现四方到三斜的对称性降低并未改变潜在的磁结构基序，而是通过劈裂对称性关联的交换路径（尤其在 Cu2 网络中）选择单一 k 域，从而打破 Sr₂CuWO₆ 中四重 k 域简并。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Ca₂CuWO₆ 在 T_N ≈ 32 K 以下呈现共线反铁磁序，传播矢量为 k = (½, ½, 0)，Cu1 和 Cu2 位点具有等大小、反平行的磁矩（1.5 K 时有序磁矩为 0.66(3) μ_B/Cu）。通过构建共同超胞，发现四方到三斜的对称性降低并未改变潜在的磁结构基序，而是通过劈裂对称性关联的交换路径（尤其在 Cu2 网络中）选择单一 k 域，从而打破 Sr₂CuWO₆ 中四重 k 域简并。；创新点：通过引入共同超胞框架，将四方相 Sr₂CuWO₆ 与三斜相 Ca₂CuWO₆ 的磁结构置于同一参照系下比较，揭示了对称性降低（而非交换相互作用本质改变）如何从简并的磁域中选择单一有序态，阐明了“对称性破缺选择有序态但不改变磁基序”的机制。
papers.method_zh: 中子粉末衍射（确定磁结构）；Rietveld 精修（提取磁矩大小与排列）；构建共同晶体学超胞（对比不同晶格设置下的磁传播矢量）；平均场计算（分析对称性对 k 域简并性的影响）。

papers.title: Lipid Hydrocarbon Tail Structure Governs Interfacial Anchoring and Stripe Morphology in Cholesteric Liquid Crystals
papers.abstract: Liquid crystal-based biosensors exploit the sensitivity of interfacial anchoring to molecular adsorption. Cholesteric liquid crystals are especially useful because their helical structure supports multiple optically distinct textures that evolve with anchoring strength. Here, we compare saturated 1,2-dilauroyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine (DLPC) and unsaturated 1,2-dioleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine (DOPC) monolayers to determine how lipid acyl chain structure governs interfacial organization and director alignment. Mapping stripe spacing across lipid concentration, mixing ratio, cholesteric pitch, and confinement shows that the transition from fingerprint textures toward homeotropic alignment depends on both lipid structure and collective interfacial organization. DLPC produces comparatively regular textures and more readily promotes helix unwinding at high coverage, consistent with more spatially uniform collective anchoring. DOPC-containing interfaces show greater morphological heterogeneity, consistent with strong local anchoring from longer tails together with less uniform organization arising from cis-unsaturation. FRAP measurements provide complementary information on fluorescent-probe mobility, which becomes strongly restricted at high lipid concentration for both systems. Variations in pitch and film thickness further modulate the response, producing coexisting regular, distorted, and lipid-enriched textures. Together, these results show that lipid acyl chain structure regulates cholesteric anchoring through its effects on local interactions, collective interfacial organization, and mobility, providing design principles for responsive liquid-crystal interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“FRAP measurements”（荧光恢复后漂白实验）等实验手段，并系统比较了不同脂质单分子层的实验现象。；研究对象：胆甾相液晶（cholesteric liquid crystals）与两种磷脂单分子层（饱和的DLPC和不饱和的DOPC）构成的界面体系，重点研究脂质酰基链结构（饱和/不饱和、链长）如何调控液晶的界面锚定行为及条纹织构形态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 脂质酰基链结构通过影响局部相互作用、集体界面组织和分子迁移率，决定胆甾相液晶的界面锚定强度与织构形态：饱和短链DLPC产生更均匀的集体锚定并促进螺旋解旋，而不饱和长链DOPC导致强局部锚定但界面组织不均匀，产生更丰富的形态异质性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：脂质酰基链结构通过影响局部相互作用、集体界面组织和分子迁移率，决定胆甾相液晶的界面锚定强度与织构形态：饱和短链DLPC产生更均匀的集体锚定并促进螺旋解旋，而不饱和长链DOPC导致强局部锚定但界面组织不均匀，产生更丰富的形态异质性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可推断其新意在于将脂质酰基链的分子结构（饱和/不饱和、链长）与胆甾相液晶的集体界面锚定行为及织构形态直接关联，揭示了分子尺度结构如何调控介观尺度液晶响应，为设计响应型液晶界面提供分子层面的设计原则。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：偏振光显微镜观察胆甾相液晶织构（指纹织构向垂直锚定转变）、系统改变脂质浓度/混合比例/胆甾相螺距/膜厚进行条纹间距映射、FRAP（荧光恢复后漂白）测量荧光探针迁移率。

papers.title: PCB-Integrated CoPt Micromagnets for Magnetophoresis
papers.abstract: Integration of magnetic material with scalable microfluidic platforms can significantly improve the throughput and precision in biotechnology processes. In this work we have developed a new magnetic platform based on printed circuit board (PCB) technology. Cobalt-Platinum (CoPt) micromagnets are electroplated on copper pads with an arbitrary footprint on a Kapton substrate to enable generation of different magnetic field gradients. The magnets are characterized by XRD and VSM, before and after thermal annealing. The ordered L10 phase appear in XRD results after annealing at 600 °C, and VSM results show around six times increase for in-plane magnetic remanence from 0.24T to 1.4T. The near equiatomic ratios of Co:Pt is confirmed by EDX observations. The performance of these magnets is experimentally validated by trapping magnetic nanoparticles in microfluidic channels. These results are in excellent agreement with FEA models presented in COMSOL Multiphysics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验制备（electroplated）、表征（XRD、VSM、EDX）和性能验证（trapping magnetic nanoparticles）等实验环节，同时包含FEA模拟（COMSOL）作为辅助验证，但主体为实验工作。；研究对象：基于印刷电路板（PCB）技术集成的钴铂（CoPt）微磁体，用于微流控平台中的磁泳（magnetophoresis）应用，即利用磁场梯度捕获磁性纳米颗粒。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Kapton基底上电镀的CoPt微磁体经600°C热退火后形成有序L10相，面内磁剩磁从0.24 T提升至1.4 T（约6倍增强），且该微磁体在微流控通道中能有效捕获磁性纳米颗粒，实验结果与COMSOL有限元模拟高度吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Kapton基底上电镀的CoPt微磁体经600°C热退火后形成有序L10相，面内磁剩磁从0.24 T提升至1.4 T（约6倍增强），且该微磁体在微流控通道中能有效捕获磁性纳米颗粒，实验结果与COMSOL有限元模拟高度吻合。；创新点：将PCB（印刷电路板）技术引入磁性微结构制备，实现任意形状CoPt微磁体在Kapton柔性基底上的可扩展集成，并与微流控平台直接兼容，从而提升生物技术处理中的通量和精度。摘要未突出说明与传统微磁体制备方法（如光刻、溅射）相比的具体优势细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：电镀法在铜焊盘上制备CoPt微磁体；X射线衍射（XRD）表征退火前后的晶体结构；振动样品磁强计（VSM）测量磁性能；能量色散X射线谱（EDX）确认Co:Pt近等原子比；微流控通道中磁性纳米颗粒捕获实验验证性能。计算方法：COMSOL Multiphysics有限元分析（FEA）模拟磁场梯度与颗粒捕获行为。

papers.title: Observation of thermal Hall effect in diamond
papers.abstract: Numerous insulators, including non-magnetic ones, have been unexpectedly found to display a finite thermal Hall signal, which has stimulated debate about its origin. Here, we report on a study of the thermal Hall effect in two diamond single crystals. The transverse thermal conductivity (kappa_xy) was found to peak at a temperature close to that at which the longitudinal thermal conductivity (kappa_xx) reaches its maximum. The measured kappa_xy, with an amplitude of 340 W/(m K) at B = 10 T, is the largest ever observed, while the kappa_xy/kappa_xx ratio follows the phenomenological trend identified in other insulators. Our observation implies the existence of an intrinsic thermal Hall effect in a generic phonon gas. We argue that the rough amplitude of both the thermal Hall angle and the thermal Hall resistivity can be accounted for by simple arguments invoking fundamental constants and quantum-mechanical constraints on solid state cohesion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确报告了“对两块金刚石单晶中热霍尔效应的研究”，并给出了实测数据（如κ_xy在B=10 T时振幅为340 W/(m K)）。；研究对象：非磁性绝缘体金刚石（diamond）单晶中的热霍尔效应（thermal Hall effect），即声子气体在磁场下产生的横向热输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在金刚石单晶中观测到迄今最大的热霍尔信号（κ_xy = 340 W/(m K) @ 10 T），其峰值温度接近纵向热导率κ_xx的峰值温度，表明普通声子气体中存在本征热霍尔效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在金刚石单晶中观测到迄今最大的热霍尔信号（κ_xy = 340 W/(m K) @ 10 T），其峰值温度接近纵向热导率κ_xx的峰值温度，表明普通声子气体中存在本征热霍尔效应。；创新点：首次在金刚石（一种非磁性、简单元素绝缘体）中观测到热霍尔效应，且信号强度为迄今最大；作者提出其幅度可由基本常数和固态内聚的量子力学约束进行简单估算，暗示该效应具有普适性。摘要未突出说明与理论模型的详细对比。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量了金刚石单晶的横向热导率（κ_xy）和纵向热导率（κ_xx）随温度与磁场的变化关系，并分析了κ_xy/κ_xx比值与已有绝缘体数据的唯象规律。摘要未明确说明具体测量装置细节（如磁场方向、温度范围等）。

papers.title: Muonium dynamics as a probe for depth-resolved properties of 4H-SiC
papers.abstract: This study establishes a baseline for muonium (Mu) charge-exchange dynamics in n-type 4H-SiC through a detailed low-energy muon spin rotation (LE-uSR) investigation. Epitaxially grown and ion-implanted samples with nitrogen and phosphorus donors were characterized to assess the effect of carrier concentration and doping method on defect formation. LE-uSR enabled nanometer scale depth profiling of near-surface and implanted regions, revealing variations in charge carrier concentration due to fixed surface charges. The temperature dependence of the diamagnetic fraction and phase provided direct evidence of the Mu0 to Mu- transition, with extracted activation energies consistent with known donor ionization energies. Additionally, high-field uSR was used to analyze the Mu dynamics, and Monte-Carlo simulations to model the Mu0 electron capture process. The simulation results offer a quantitative method to extract free electron concentrations from LE-uSR data, enhancing its capability to characterize the activation of dopants and carrier depth profiles. We demonstrate that LE-uSR is a powerful depth-resolved tool that can provide insights for optimizing the fabrication of reliable SiC devices for power electronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“low-energy muon spin rotation (LE-uSR) investigation”“high-field uSR was used”等实验手段，并辅以Monte-Carlo模拟作为数据分析工具。；研究对象：n型4H-SiC（碳化硅）材料，具体包括外延生长和离子注入的氮/磷掺杂样品，研究其近表面及注入区域的muonium（Mu）电荷交换动力学、载流子浓度深度分布及缺陷形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: LE-uSR能够在纳米尺度上分辨4H-SiC近表面和注入区的载流子浓度变化，并通过温度依赖的顺磁分数和相位直接观测到Mu0到Mu-的转变，其激活能与已知施主电离能一致；结合Monte-Carlo模拟可定量提取自由电子浓度，证明LE-uSR是表征SiC功率器件掺杂激活和载流子深度分布的有效工具。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：LE-uSR能够在纳米尺度上分辨4H-SiC近表面和注入区的载流子浓度变化，并通过温度依赖的顺磁分数和相位直接观测到Mu0到Mu-的转变，其激活能与已知施主电离能一致；结合Monte-Carlo模拟可定量提取自由电子浓度，证明LE-uSR是表征SiC功率器件掺杂激活和载流子深度分布的有效工具。；创新点：首次为n型4H-SiC中的Mu电荷交换动力学建立了基线，并展示了LE-uSR结合Monte-Carlo模拟作为定量提取自由电子浓度和深度分辨载流子分布的新方法，为优化SiC功率电子器件制造提供指导。
papers.method_zh: 低能μ子自旋旋转（LE-uSR）用于纳米尺度深度分辨测量；高场μSR（high-field uSR）用于分析Mu动力学；Monte-Carlo模拟用于建模Mu0电子俘获过程并定量提取自由电子浓度。样品制备涉及外延生长和离子注入（氮、磷掺杂）。

papers.title: Chirality-Selective Phonon Pumping by Ferroelectric Dynamics
papers.abstract: The discovery of chiral phonons has expanded the conventional view of lattice vibrations as passive heat carriers, opening new opportunities for phononic spintronic devices. However, their realization has been largely limited to chiral crystals or to specific regions of momentum space in certain achiral materials. Here, we propose a generic mechanism for generating propagating chiral phonons in an ordinary dielectric through the precession of the electric polarization in an adjacent ferroelectric. The polarization dynamics transfers its intrinsic angular momentum to the lattice via electrostrictive coupling, thereby pumping chirality-selective phonons whose handedness is dictated by that of the polarization precession. For a typical LiNbO$_{3}$$|$Y$_{3}$Al$_{5}$O$_{12}$ bilayer, we find that the pumping efficiency quantified by an interfacial convertance substantially exceeds those of thermally induced chiral-phonon generation in chiral crystals, owing to the strong electrostrictive coupling in ferroelectrics. Our work establishes ferroelectric dynamics as a versatile electrical source of chiral phonons and provides a general route toward electrically programmable chiral-phononic and spintronic functionalities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“propose a generic mechanism”“we find that”等表述，且未提及实验手段，属于理论建模与数值估算。；研究对象：铁电体/普通介电体双层异质结，具体为 LiNbO₃|Y₃Al₅O₁₂（铌酸锂|钇铝石榴石）双层结构中的手性声子产生机制，以及铁电极化进动与晶格角动量耦合的物理过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种普适机制：通过相邻铁电体中电极化进动，经电致伸缩耦合将内禀角动量传递给普通介电体晶格，从而产生传播型手性声子，其手性由极化进动方向决定；在 LiNbO₃|Y₃Al₅O₁₂ 双层中，界面转换效率显著高于手性晶体中热致手性声子的产生效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种普适机制：通过相邻铁电体中电极化进动，经电致伸缩耦合将内禀角动量传递给普通介电体晶格，从而产生传播型手性声子，其手性由极化进动方向决定；在 LiNbO₃|Y₃Al₅O₁₂ 双层中，界面转换效率显著高于手性晶体中热致手性声子的产生效率。；创新点：突破了以往手性声子仅存在于手性晶体或特定非手性材料动量空间区域的限制，提出在普通介电体中通过铁电动力学实现手性声子的电学可控产生，为电可编程手性声子与自旋电子学功能提供了通用路径。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与数值估算。具体包括：基于铁电动力学（极化进动）与电致伸缩耦合的角动量传递模型，计算界面转换效率（interfacial convertance），并与手性晶体中热致手性声子产生效率进行定量比较。摘要未明确说明是否使用第一性原理计算或具体数值方法（如 DFT）。

papers.title: Phase calibration of quantum oscillations in the magnetostrictive coefficient using the topological antiferromagnet YbMnBi$_2$
papers.abstract: The Berry phase accumulated along a cyclotron orbit encodes important information about electronic band topology and is commonly inferred from the phase of quantum oscillations. Measurements of the ac magnetostrictive coefficient have recently emerged as a sensitive thermodynamic probe of quantum oscillations, but the phase offset has not been experimentally calibrated. Here, using the topological antiferromagnet YbMnBi$_2$, we calibrate this offset by directly comparing quantum oscillations in magnetization with those in the ac magnetostrictive coefficient. Measurements of both responses on the same single crystal reveal a single fundamental frequency of approximately 160 T in fields up to 14 T, enabling a direct phase comparison free from ambiguities associated with multiple frequencies. We observe an approximately $π/2$ relative phase shift between the two oscillatory responses, consistent with the Maxwell relation linking the magnetostrictive coefficient to the stress derivative of magnetization. Our results establish the appropriate phase needed to extract cyclotron-orbit phase information from quantum oscillations in the ac magnetostrictive coefficient.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“Measurements of the ac magnetostrictive coefficient”“directly comparing quantum oscillations in magnetization with those in the ac magnetostrictive coefficient”，以及“Measurements of both responses on the same single crystal”，表明是实验测量工作。；研究对象：拓扑反铁磁材料 YbMnBi₂，具体研究其磁化强度与交流磁致伸缩系数中的量子振荡相位。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 YbMnBi₂ 中，磁化强度与交流磁致伸缩系数的量子振荡之间存在约 π/2 的相对相位差，该相位差与联系两者的 Maxwell 关系一致，从而标定了交流磁致伸缩系数中量子振荡的相位偏移。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 YbMnBi₂ 中，磁化强度与交流磁致伸缩系数的量子振荡之间存在约 π/2 的相对相位差，该相位差与联系两者的 Maxwell 关系一致，从而标定了交流磁致伸缩系数中量子振荡的相位偏移。；创新点：首次通过实验标定了交流磁致伸缩系数中量子振荡的相位偏移，为从该热力学探针中提取回旋轨道 Berry 相位提供了必要的相位校准依据。
papers.method_zh: 在同一个单晶样品上，于高达 14 T 的磁场下，同时测量磁化强度和交流磁致伸缩系数的量子振荡，并对两种响应进行直接相位比较。

papers.title: Nuclearity of Copper Clusters on hBN/SiC Heterostructure Modulates Molecular Adsorption
papers.abstract: Defect engineering can transform inert two-dimensional (2D) materials into chemically active and electronically tunable platforms by creating anchoring sites for metal atoms and clusters. Nevertheless, precise control over the formation, thermodynamic and kinetic stability, electronic structure, and chemical reactivity of metal species confined at these defect sites remains a challenge. Here, we use density functional theory (DFT) calculations assisted by machine-learning molecular dynamics (MLMD) simulations to elucidate the stability, electronic structure, and reactivity of Cu clusters anchored at boron vacancies (VB) in hBN/SiC heterostructures. Systematic variation of the Cu-to-vacancy ratio reveals a transition from isolated Cu atoms to multiatom Cu clusters at VB sites, with cluster growth reshaping the stability, electronic structure, and surface reactivity. Our results show that a single VB defect can be passivated by three Cu atoms, which compensate the local charge deficiency and stabilize the defect through Cu-N coordination. Capturing further Cu introduces localized midgap states that could influence the reactivity of the Cu-decorated defect sites. We probe the response of the Cu-decorated surface to chemically relevant gases CO, H2, O2, N2, H2S, and CO2, revealing implications for surface reactivity and stability. The calculations show pronounced cluster-size-dependent reactivity of Cu clusters at VB sites, with CO forming strong Cu-C bonds and O2 undergoing enhanced adsorption and molecular activation. Overall, this work identifies defect-engineered hBN/SiC as a versatile 2D platform for stabilizing Cu clusters and tuning gas-surface reactivity. By correlating Cu nuclearity at VB sites with electronic structure, molecular activation, and environmental robustness, our findings provide design guidelines for nuclearity-dependent metal functionalization of 2D heterostructures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：density functional theory (DFT) calculations、machine-learning molecular dynamics (MLMD) simulations。；研究对象：hBN/SiC异质结中硼空位（VB）缺陷锚定的铜（Cu）团簇，以及其与CO、H2、O2、N2、H2S、CO2等气体分子的吸附相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单个VB缺陷可被三个Cu原子钝化（通过Cu-N配位补偿局域电荷缺失），而进一步增加Cu原子会在带隙中引入局域中间态，并导致Cu团簇对气体分子的吸附活性呈现显著的团簇尺寸依赖性，其中CO形成强Cu-C键，O2被增强吸附并活化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：单个VB缺陷可被三个Cu原子钝化（通过Cu-N配位补偿局域电荷缺失），而进一步增加Cu原子会在带隙中引入局域中间态，并导致Cu团簇对气体分子的吸附活性呈现显著的团簇尺寸依赖性，其中CO形成强Cu-C键，O2被增强吸附并活化。；创新点：将Cu团簇在VB位点的核数（从单原子到多原子团簇）与电子结构、分子活化能力及环境稳定性直接关联，为二维异质结上金属功能化的核数依赖设计提供了指导原则。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，辅以机器学习分子动力学（MLMD）模拟；系统改变Cu与空位比例以研究团簇核数效应；计算气体分子在Cu修饰表面的吸附行为。

papers.title: Exact chemo--thermal Metropolis Brownian engine: chemical leverage, temperature-neutral stall, power optimization, and multicyclic dissipation
papers.abstract: We develop an exactly solvable chemo--thermal extension of the three-state Metropolis Brownian heat engine. The particle moves through the periodic energy sequence $0\to E\to 2E\to0$, performs mechanical work against a load $f$ on every forward step, interacts with two cold links and one hot link, and consumes one fuel molecule of free-energy drop $\muu$ on the hot transition. Local detailed balance gives an exact cycle affinity \begin{equation*} \mathcal A=E\left(\Tc^{-1}-\Th^{-1}\right)+\muu/\Th-f\left(2/\Tc+1/\Th\right), \end{equation*} and the full stationary probabilities and current are obtained without linear-response, weak-driving, or high-barrier approximations. Several results follow. First, the exact stall force is \begin{equation*} \fs=\frac{E(\Th-\Tc)+\Tc\muu}{2\Th+\Tc}. \end{equation*} Second, there is a temperature-neutral chemical compensation point $\muu_*=3E/2$ at which $\fs=E/2$ for every $\Th>\Tc$ and the hot and cold heats both vanish at reversible stall. papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“exactly solvable”（精确可解）、“Local detailed balance”（局域细致平衡）、“obtained without linear-response... approximations”（无需线性响应等近似），属于严格的理论推导与解析计算。；研究对象：一个化学-热耦合的三态Metropolis布朗热机模型。该模型包含周期性势能序列（0→E→2E→0）、机械负载、冷热两个热库以及一个燃料分子（化学能）驱动。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该化学-热布朗引擎具有精确的化学-机械-热耦合关系，存在一个“温度中性”的化学补偿点（μu*=3E/2），在该点处引擎的失速力对所有温度差均为E/2，且可逆失速时冷热库热流同时为零。此外，在固定机械参数下，稳态电流是化学势降μu的严格递增函数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该化学-热布朗引擎具有精确的化学-机械-热耦合关系，存在一个“温度中性”的化学补偿点（μu*=3E/2），在该点处引擎的失速力对所有温度差均为E/2，且可逆失速时冷热库热流同时为零。此外，在固定机械参数下，稳态电流是化学势降μu的严格递增函数。；创新点：该工作将经典的Metropolis布朗热机扩展为化学-热混合驱动，并给出了无需任何近似（如线性响应或弱驱动）的精确解，揭示了化学势与温度梯度之间的非平凡耦合效应（如温度中性补偿点）。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的关联。
papers.method_zh: 采用精确可解的马尔可夫链模型（三态Metropolis动力学），结合局域细致平衡条件推导出精确的循环亲和势、稳态概率和电流表达式。全程未使用线性响应、弱驱动或高势垒近似。

papers.title: Closed-form hard-sphere thermodynamics under nanoscale confinement: from equations of state to unmixing forces
papers.abstract: Equations of state accurately describe hard-sphere thermodynamics but are generally considered to fail under nanoscale confinement. We show that this failure is geometric rather than thermodynamic: a closed-form, parameter-free mapping from apparent to effective packing fraction restores the accuracy of the Carnahan-Starling equation of state and, with it, the entire analytical thermodynamic framework, including free energies, wall pressures, chemical potentials, and the large-cavity surface response. Applied to overlapping anchored hard-sphere droplets, a geometry inherent to biomolecular force generation, it yields unmixing free energies and full distance-dependent force profiles in quantitative agreement with simulations from the dilute regime to above the bulk freezing transition.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要强调“closed-form, parameter-free mapping”“analytical thermodynamic framework”，并与“simulations”对比验证。；研究对象：硬球体系在纳米尺度受限下的热力学性质，以及重叠锚定硬球液滴（overlapping anchored hard-sphere droplets）这一与生物分子力产生相关的几何构型中的去混合力（unmixing forces）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 硬球状态方程在纳米受限下看似失效，其根源是几何效应而非热力学失效；通过一个从表观堆积分数到有效堆积分数的无参数闭式映射，即可恢复Carnahan-Starling状态方程在整个解析热力学框架（自由能、壁压、化学势、大空腔表面响应）中的定量准确性。将该映射应用于重叠锚定硬球液滴，得到的去混合自由能和全程距离依赖力曲线与模拟定量一致，适用范围从稀溶液区一直到体相冻结转变之上。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：硬球状态方程在纳米受限下看似失效，其根源是几何效应而非热力学失效；通过一个从表观堆积分数到有效堆积分数的无参数闭式映射，即可恢复Carnahan-Starling状态方程在整个解析热力学框架（自由能、壁压、化学势、大空腔表面响应）中的定量准确性。将该映射应用于重叠锚定硬球液滴，得到的去混合自由能和全程距离依赖力曲线与模拟定量一致，适用范围从稀溶液区一直到体相冻结转变之上。；创新点：指出硬球状态方程在纳米受限下“失效”的本质是几何映射问题，而非热力学描述本身失效，从而以闭式无参数映射恢复整个解析热力学框架；并将该框架首次应用于重叠锚定硬球液滴体系，定量给出去混合自由能与力曲线。摘要未突出说明与以往几何修正方案的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：提出表观→有效堆积分数的闭式无参数映射，结合Carnahan-Starling状态方程构建解析热力学框架；并用数值模拟（具体模拟方法摘要未明确说明）进行定量验证。

papers.title: Magnetic-configuration design for reliable Heisenberg exchange parameters
papers.abstract: The determination of magnetic exchange interactions is essential for the quantitative description and predictive modeling of magnetic materials. In this work, we present a neighbor-shell-based screening method for selecting magnetic configurations suitable for extracting Heisenberg exchange parameters beyond nearest-neighbor from density functional theory (DFT) calculations. Using only the structure, the proposed approach identifies the linear independence of neighbor-shell contributions before any first-principles calculations instead of relying on trial-and-error generation of magnetic configurations. We apply the proposed approach to two representative classes of magnetic configurations: random spin states and spin spirals, and validate its predictions against direct DFT fitting for Fe and MnF$_2$. We show that only parameters obtained when all relevant neighbor-shell contributions are linearly independent remain transferable to other magnetic configurations. The proposed method provides practical guidance for selecting magnetic configurations for reliable exchange-parameter extraction and may also benefit other neighbor-shell-based models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：density functional theory (DFT) calculations、fitting、screening method。；研究对象：磁性材料中Heisenberg交换参数的提取，具体测试体系为Fe和MnF₂，涉及随机自旋态与自旋螺旋两类磁构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 只有当所有相关近邻壳层贡献线性独立时，提取的交换参数才具有可迁移性（transferable）到其他磁构型；基于结构信息即可在DFT计算前筛选出满足线性独立条件的磁构型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：只有当所有相关近邻壳层贡献线性独立时，提取的交换参数才具有可迁移性（transferable）到其他磁构型；基于结构信息即可在DFT计算前筛选出满足线性独立条件的磁构型。；创新点：在DFT计算之前即可从结构上判定磁构型能否给出线性独立的近邻壳层贡献，避免了传统试错法生成磁构型的盲目性；该方法不仅适用于交换参数提取，也可推广到其他基于近邻壳层的模型。
papers.method_zh: 提出一种基于近邻壳层（neighbor-shell）的筛选方法，仅利用晶体结构判断各近邻壳层贡献的线性独立性，无需试错生成磁构型；将该方法应用于随机自旋态和自旋螺旋两类构型，并通过直接DFT拟合（对Fe和MnF₂）验证预测结果。

papers.title: Nearly Isotropic Quantum-Critical Transport in Single-Crystal CeNiC2
papers.abstract: Pressure-induced superconductivity and $T$-linear resistivity have been reported in polycrystalline CeNiC$_2$, but orientational averaging has left the directional character of the critical scattering unresolved. We report pressure-dependent resistivity of high-quality single crystals for current along each crystallographic axis. These crystals have substantially lower residual resistivity and a slightly higher maximum onset $T_c$ than the polycrystalline sample, placing superconductivity in a cleaner transport regime. Near $P_c \approx 9.5-10$ GPa, the normal-state resistivity becomes nearly $T$-linear along every axis, the fitted residual resistivity is strongly enhanced, and superconductivity forms a narrow dome. For $I \parallel b$, the $T$-linear normal state remains nearly unchanged in magnetic fields up to 9 T applied along $a$ and $c$; the upper critical field is large and only moderately anisotropic. The common evolution along all three axes establishes a nearly isotropic quantum-critical transport regime, inconsistent with a simple low-dimensional spin-fluctuation picture and implicates valence fluctuations as the leading source of critical scattering associated with the superconducting dome.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了压力依赖的电阻率测量、单晶样品制备、磁场下的输运实验等实验内容。；研究对象：单晶CeNiC₂（碳化铈镍）在压力下的量子临界输运行为，具体涉及沿三个晶轴方向的电阻率、超导电性及其与量子临界涨落的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在临界压力P_c ≈ 9.5–10 GPa附近，CeNiC₂单晶沿所有晶轴方向的正常态电阻率均近似呈T线性行为，且残余电阻率显著增强，超导形成窄穹顶结构，表明存在近各向同性的量子临界输运区域，这与低维自旋涨落图像不符，暗示价态涨落是临界散射的主要来源。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在临界压力P_c ≈ 9.5–10 GPa附近，CeNiC₂单晶沿所有晶轴方向的正常态电阻率均近似呈T线性行为，且残余电阻率显著增强，超导形成窄穹顶结构，表明存在近各向同性的量子临界输运区域，这与低维自旋涨落图像不符，暗示价态涨落是临界散射的主要来源。；创新点：首次在单晶CeNiC₂中解析了沿三个晶轴方向的临界散射各向异性，明确了近各向同性的量子临界输运特征，排除了简单低维自旋涨落机制，提出价态涨落作为超导穹顶相关临界散射的主导来源。
papers.method_zh: 高压下沿各晶轴方向的电阻率测量（压力依赖）；单晶生长（获得高质量单晶，残余电阻率低于多晶样品）；磁场下输运测量（磁场沿a和c轴，最高9 T）；上临界场的各向异性分析。

papers.title: Substitution effects in RuO$_2$ single crystals
papers.abstract: RuO$_2$ has emerged as one of the leading candidates for investigating altermagnetism. Recent quantum oscillation and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy measurements found the absence of altermagnetism or antiferromagnetism in pure RuO$_2$ crystals. The continuing debate over intrinsic magnetic order in RuO$_2$ may reflect its proximity to an altermagnetic instability. In this work, we grow single crystals of Ru$_{0.9}$V$_{0.1}$O$_2$ and investigate their structural, transport, and magnetic properties. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy reveals an average V oxidation state near $+4$. The paramagnetic susceptibility remains nearly unchanged up to room temperature, with no evidence of magnetic ordering. Thus, the 10\% V-substitution in RuO$_2$ does not induce altermagnetism. Electronic structure calculations for the V-substituted systems using two methods suggest that a higher level of V-substitution leads to a significant change in the density of states. These findings underscore the potential of nonmagnetic substitution in RuO$_2$ as an attractive candidate for probing altermagnetic transitions and their experimental signatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（含电子结构计算辅助）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“we grow single crystals”“X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy”“paramagnetic susceptibility”等实验手段，同时包含“Electronic structure calculations”作为补充。；研究对象：V（钒）替代掺杂的RuO₂单晶（Ru₀.₉V₀.₁O₂），以及该掺杂对RuO₂中潜在交错磁（altermagnetism）有序的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 10% V替代掺杂的RuO₂单晶在室温以下始终保持顺磁态，未观察到磁有序或交错磁转变；但电子结构计算表明更高V掺杂水平会显著改变态密度，暗示非磁替代掺杂可能成为调控RuO₂交错磁不稳定性的有效途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：10% V替代掺杂的RuO₂单晶在室温以下始终保持顺磁态，未观察到磁有序或交错磁转变；但电子结构计算表明更高V掺杂水平会显著改变态密度，暗示非磁替代掺杂可能成为调控RuO₂交错磁不稳定性的有效途径。；创新点：首次实验探索非磁性V替代对RuO₂交错磁候选材料的影响，发现10%掺杂不足以诱导磁有序，但通过计算预测更高掺杂可显著改变电子结构，为后续通过化学压力/掺杂调控交错磁转变提供了实验与理论依据。（摘要未突出说明更具体的创新细节）
papers.method_zh: 单晶生长（具体方法摘要未明确说明）；X射线光电子能谱（XPS）测定V氧化态；结构、输运和磁性测量（具体如电阻率、磁化率等测量细节摘要未展开）；两种电子结构计算方法（具体方法名称摘要未给出，如DFT或DFT+U等未明确说明）。

papers.title: Characterizing Full Nonequilibrium Dynamics of Simple Exclusion Processes
papers.abstract: The simple exclusion process (SEP) is a paradigmatic model for nonequilibrium transport, yet the rich dynamics of its time-dependent joint distribution over an exponentially large configuration space remain notoriously intractable. Here, we leverage variational autoregressive networks to systematically characterize the nonequilibrium dynamics of symmetric (SSEP), asymmetric (ASEP), and totally asymmetric (TASEP) cases from one to three dimensions. We first validate the approach by reproducing the previous finite-time results for the 1D SSEP and long-time tensor-network results for the 2D SSEP, and then provide richer finite-time dynamics of the SSEP, ASEP, and TASEP in 1D and 2D, and a new finite-time analysis in 3D. Specifically, in 1D, we reveal that finite-time dynamical-activity maps directly correspond to the classical three-phase TASEP steady-state organization, and, in the long-time limit, boundary and bulk effects separately govern the dynamical susceptibility during the crossover from diffusive to ballistic transport. In 2D, we establish a mean-field directional-density criterion, supported by our neural-network calculations, and show that long-time boundary and bulk effects mirror their 1D counterparts.
