In 3D, we uncover new finite-time scaling relations for the active-inactive phase transition of the SSEP, and reveal a broadly consistent scaling exponent of the phase-transition point versus system size, implying that the phase-transition point is asymptotically controlled by the characteristic length scale ($s_c\sim L^{-2}$) regardless of dimension. This work thus establishes a unified framework for characterizing the nonequilibrium dynamics of representative transport systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“variational autoregressive networks”（变分自回归网络）进行数值计算，并对比了“tensor-network results”（张量网络结果），属于计算方法主导的研究。；研究对象：简单排斥过程（SEP）的非平衡动力学，具体包括对称（SSEP）、非对称（ASEP）和全非对称（TASEP）三种情形，覆盖一维到三维体系。物理现象涉及非平衡输运、动力学活性（dynamical activity）、动力学磁化率、扩散-弹道输运交叉以及活性-非活性相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作建立了统一框架，系统刻画了SEP在1D、2D和3D中的有限时间非平衡动力学，揭示了1D中有限时间动力学活性图与TASEP经典三相稳态组织的直接对应关系，并发现相变点随系统尺寸的标度指数在任意维度下均一致（\(s_c\sim L^{-2}\)），表明相变点渐近地由特征长度尺度控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作建立了统一框架，系统刻画了SEP在1D、2D和3D中的有限时间非平衡动力学，揭示了1D中有限时间动力学活性图与TASEP经典三相稳态组织的直接对应关系，并发现相变点随系统尺寸的标度指数在任意维度下均一致（\(s_c\sim L^{-2}\)），表明相变点渐近地由特征长度尺度控制。；创新点：首次将变分自回归网络系统应用于SEP家族（SSEP/ASEP/TASEP）的多维（1D-3D）有限时间非平衡动力学表征；首次给出3D SSEP的有限时间分析；建立了2D中平均场方向密度判据；揭示了相变点标度指数跨维度的一致性（\(s_c\sim L^{-2}\)）。
papers.method_zh: 采用变分自回归网络（variational autoregressive networks）对SEP的含时联合分布进行建模和求解。验证部分包括：复现1D SSEP的已知有限时间结果，以及2D SSEP的长时间张量网络结果。随后将该方法推广至1D、2D和3D的SSEP、ASEP和TASEP有限时间动力学计算。

papers.title: Optical and magneto-optical interactions in Co-doped CeO$_2$ thin films prepared by pulsed laser deposition
papers.abstract: Magnetically doped CeO$_2$ is a dilute magnetic semiconductor, promising for various applications in photonics, but the origin of its ferromagnetic properties is not fully understood. Here, thin films of Ce$_{1-x}$Co$_x$O$_{2-δ}$ prepared by pulsed laser deposition on MgO ($x=0.05$ and $0.10$) and oxidized Si ($x=0.20$) substrates were systematically studied by spectroscopic ellipsometry and magneto-optical spectroscopy. Both diagonal and off-diagonal permittivity-tensor elements were obtained. Diagonal spectra revealed two optical transitions between oxygen and cerium states. Off-diagonal spectra revealed two paramagnetic transitions involving cobalt ions, from which an essential influence of cobalt doping on resulting ferromagnetic properties of CeO$_2$ was inferred. The full permittivity-tensor spectra are provided for further use in prospective modelling of magneto-optical device concepts.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“thin films ... were systematically studied by spectroscopic ellipsometry and magneto-optical spectroscopy”，属于实验测量研究。；研究对象：钴掺杂二氧化铈（Ce₁₋ₓCoₓO₂₋δ）稀磁半导体薄膜，具体为脉冲激光沉积在MgO（x=0.05和0.10）及氧化Si（x=0.20）衬底上的薄膜，研究其光学与磁光性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过光谱椭偏和磁光光谱获得了完整的介电张量（对角和非对角）谱，识别出氧-铈态间的两个光学跃迁，以及涉及钴离子的两个顺磁跃迁，由此推断钴掺杂对CeO₂铁磁性质具有关键影响。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过光谱椭偏和磁光光谱获得了完整的介电张量（对角和非对角）谱，识别出氧-铈态间的两个光学跃迁，以及涉及钴离子的两个顺磁跃迁，由此推断钴掺杂对CeO₂铁磁性质具有关键影响。；创新点：系统给出了钴掺杂CeO₂薄膜的完整介电张量谱（包括对角和非对角元素），为未来磁光器件概念的建模提供了可直接使用的光学常数数据；并通过磁光跃迁直接关联了钴掺杂与铁磁性的来源。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 脉冲激光沉积（PLD）制备薄膜；光谱椭偏法（spectroscopic ellipsometry）获取对角介电张量元素；磁光光谱法（magneto-optical spectroscopy）获取非对角介电张量元素。

papers.title: A Hierarchical Synergistic Deep Learning Framework Integrating Composition, Structure, and Ionic Transport for Solid-State Electrolyte Discovery
papers.abstract: Inorganic solid-state electrolytes must combine high room-temperature ionic conductivity, a wide electrochemical window, excellent electronic insulation, and favorable mechanical compliance. Single models struggle to support reliable multi-objective screening across vast chemical spaces because of training-data distribution mismatch, cross-property dataset heterogeneity, and scarce kinetic transport data. To overcome these limitations, we develop a hierarchical synergistic deep-learning framework that sequentially coordinates efficiency, accuracy, and reliability through four complementary modules. The in-house-developed L-G-DCNN and a multi-fidelity implementation built on DenseGNN serve as compositional and structural experts for thermodynamic coarse screening and multi-property evaluation, respectively; MatterSim and system-specific DeePMD models provide transport pre-assessment and kinetic validation. Systematic benchmarks show that each module outperforms mainstream counterparts in its task, while retrospective validation establishes dual closed-loop verification of module-level accuracy and end-to-end workflow reliability. Applied to 30,364,908 Alex/ICSD-derived candidates, the framework identifies 97 high-performance candidates with room-temperature ionic conductivities of 0.109--59.0 mS/cm, including 94 halides, one borohydride, and two oxides. Consistency with independent experimental data confirms that 76 of the 94 halides fall within reported high-conductivity structural regions. Analysis reveals that Li$^{+}$ jump-network connectivity, rather than the number of geometric Li sites, is the core determinant of room-temperature ionic conductivity. Li-defect engineering effectively enhances oxide transport, whereas the inherent rigidity of the O$^{2-}$ framework suggests a potential upper limit on oxide electrolyte performance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/机器学习文章。关键词：deep-learning framework、multi-fidelity implementation、DeePMD models、systematic benchmarks。；研究对象：无机固态电解质材料，具体涵盖卤化物、硼氢化物和氧化物体系，聚焦于室温离子电导率、电化学窗口、电子绝缘性和力学性能等多目标筛选。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该框架从30,364,908个候选材料中筛选出97个高性能固态电解质候选物（室温离子电导率0.109–59.0 mS/cm），并揭示Li⁺跳跃网络连通性（而非几何Li位点数量）是室温离子电导率的核心决定因素；Li缺陷工程可提升氧化物输运性能，但O²⁻框架的固有刚性可能对氧化物电解质性能设置上限。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该框架从30,364,908个候选材料中筛选出97个高性能固态电解质候选物（室温离子电导率0.109–59.0 mS/cm），并揭示Li⁺跳跃网络连通性（而非几何Li位点数量）是室温离子电导率的核心决定因素；Li缺陷工程可提升氧化物输运性能，但O²⁻框架的固有刚性可能对氧化物电解质性能设置上限。；创新点：提出层级协同的多模块深度学习框架，通过顺序协调效率、精度和可靠性来解决单一模型在多目标筛选中的数据分布失配、跨性质数据集异质性和动力学数据稀缺问题；摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 层级协同深度学习框架，包含四个模块：自研L-G-DCNN（成分专家，用于热力学粗筛）、基于DenseGNN的多保真度模型（结构专家，用于多性质评估）、MatterSim（输运预评估）和体系特化DeePMD模型（动力学验证）。采用回顾性验证建立模块级精度与端到端流程可靠性的双闭环校验。

papers.title: Exchange splitting as a descriptor for giant anomalous Hall and Nernst effects in ferromagnets
papers.abstract: The anomalous Hall effect (AHE) and anomalous Nernst effect (ANE), which describe transverse electrical and thermoelectric responses in magnetic materials, respectively, are promising for spintronic and energy-harvesting applications. Here, we employ high-throughput first-principles calculations to investigate 2251 chemically substituted tetragonal $L1_0$ alloys. Among ferromagnets, enhanced responses emerge preferentially in alloys derived from parent compounds with small exchange splitting: no alloy derived from FePt, the archetypal $L1_0$ ferromagnet, reaches the high-response regime, whereas NiPt- and CoIr-derived alloys occupy it in large numbers. Small exchange splitting keeps majority- and minority-spin bands near the Fermi level, giving chemical substitution more opportunity to modify near-Fermi-level band crossings and amplify the Berry curvature. We predict a giant anomalous Hall conductivity of $2809\,\mathrm{S\,cm^{-1}}$ in (Co$_{0.8}$Fe$_{0.2}$)(Ir$_{0.7}$Pt$_{0.3}$) and a giant anomalous Nernst conductivity of $7.72\,\mathrm{A\,m^{-1}\,K^{-1}}$ in (Ni$_{0.8}$Co$_{0.2}$)(Pt$_{0.7}$Ir$_{0.3}$). Our results identify the exchange splitting of the parent compound as a descriptor for chemical tunability toward giant Berry-curvature-driven transport responses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“high-throughput first-principles calculations”（高通量第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：2251种化学取代的四方L1₀合金，具体包括FePt、NiPt、CoIr等母体衍生物，以及预测的(Co₀.₈Fe₀.₂)(Ir₀.₇Pt₀.₃)和(Ni₀.₈Co₀.₂)(Pt₀.₇Ir₀.₃)合金。物理现象为反常霍尔效应（AHE）和反常能斯特效应（ANE）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 母体化合物的交换劈裂大小可作为预测化学取代能否增强Berry曲率驱动输运响应的描述符：小交换劈裂的母体（如NiPt、CoIr）衍生物更容易进入高响应区，而大交换劈裂的FePt衍生物则不能。预测出巨大反常霍尔电导率2809 S/cm和巨大反常能斯特电导率7.72 A/(m·K)。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：母体化合物的交换劈裂大小可作为预测化学取代能否增强Berry曲率驱动输运响应的描述符：小交换劈裂的母体（如NiPt、CoIr）衍生物更容易进入高响应区，而大交换劈裂的FePt衍生物则不能。预测出巨大反常霍尔电导率2809 S/cm和巨大反常能斯特电导率7.72 A/(m·K)。；创新点：首次提出将母体化合物的交换劈裂大小作为化学可调性的描述符，用于筛选具有巨大Berry曲率驱动输运响应的铁磁合金，为高通量搜索拓扑输运材料提供了新的设计准则。
papers.method_zh: 高通量第一性原理计算（high-throughput first-principles calculations），对2251种L1₀合金进行系统筛选，计算其反常霍尔/能斯特电导率并分析Berry曲率与电子结构的关系。

papers.title: Defect states in three-dimensional diamond photonic band gap crystals
papers.abstract: We perform a theoretical study of defect states within the photonic band gap of three-dimensional diamond crystals composed of point scatterers and doped with substitutional defects. The defects introduce localized states inside the photonic band gap, whose existence conditions and eigenfrequencies are expressed in terms of the on-site Green's function of the ideal defect-free crystal. Off-site Green's functions are also calculated as function of distance and are shown to vanish within approximately two unit cells. Finite-size effects are analyzed by comparing the results obtained in the infinite-crystal limit with numerical simulations based on the coupled-dipole method. The latter not only reproduce the eigenfrequencies of the defect states within the band gap, but also provide their lifetimes originating from the finite crystal size. The lifetimes of the defect states increase exponentially with crystal size, becoming very long for large crystals. In addition to defect states in the three-dimensional photonic band gap, the defects also give rise to strongly detuned states outside the gap, which decouple from the spectrum of the ideal defect-free crystal.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。关键词：theoretical study、coupled-dipole method、numerical simulations。；研究对象：三维金刚石结构光子带隙晶体，由点散射体构成，并掺入替代式缺陷；研究缺陷态在光子带隙内的局域化行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 替代式缺陷在三维金刚石光子带隙内引入局域缺陷态，其存在条件与本征频率可由理想无缺陷晶体的局域格林函数表达；缺陷态寿命随晶体尺寸指数增长，大晶体中寿命极长。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：替代式缺陷在三维金刚石光子带隙内引入局域缺陷态，其存在条件与本征频率可由理想无缺陷晶体的局域格林函数表达；缺陷态寿命随晶体尺寸指数增长，大晶体中寿命极长。；创新点：摘要未突出说明，但可看出其创新在于：将缺陷态性质（存在条件、频率、寿命）与理想晶体格林函数直接关联，并系统分析了有限尺寸效应对缺陷态寿命的影响，同时发现带隙外存在与理想晶体谱退耦的强失谐缺陷态。
papers.method_zh: 基于格林函数的解析理论（局域与非局域格林函数计算），并结合耦合偶极子方法（coupled-dipole method）进行有限尺寸数值模拟，对比无限晶体极限结果。

papers.title: Direct current thermo-mechanical testing: Principles, uncertainty hierarchy, and its role in advanced materials characterisation
papers.abstract: Direct current thermo-mechanical testing (DC-TMT), based on resistive Joule heating, enables rapid heating and cooling, steep thermal gradients and simultaneous mechanical loading, making it a powerful tool for probing deformation, phase transformations, oxidation-assisted damage and creep under conditions inaccessible to conventional furnace-based methods. Despite its growing use, DC-TMT lacks formal standardisation and is often misinterpreted as equivalent to bulk isothermal testing, overlooking intrinsic differences in thermal and mechanical fields. This review addresses that gap by consolidating four decades of research on specimen geometry, temperature measurement, strain characterisation and environmental control, and by classifying uncertainty sources as dominant, secondary and conditional. Evidence from modelling and experiment shows that temperature gradients, heating rate and gauge representativeness govern the reliability of inferred material behaviour. Applications across aluminium, steels, nickel-based superalloys, titanium alloys, hardmetals, zirconium alloys, shape memory alloys and additively manufactured systems are critically assessed. The review highlights domains where DC-TMT provides reproducible mechanistic insight and conditions where direct equivalence with bulk data is not warranted. Implications include the need for transparent reporting, multi-sensor temperature validation and integration with electro-thermal modelling to enable rigorous, mechanism-focused interpretation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章（Review）。判断依据关键词：“review”、“consolidating four decades of research”、“critically assessed”。；研究对象：直流电热-力学测试（DC-TMT）技术本身，及其在多种材料体系（铝、钢、镍基高温合金、钛合金、硬质合金、锆合金、形状记忆合金及增材制造系统）中的变形、相变、氧化辅助损伤和蠕变行为表征。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: DC-TMT虽能实现常规炉体加热无法达到的快速升降温、陡峭热梯度和同步力学加载，但其结果不能简单等同于体块等温测试；温度梯度、加热速率和标距段代表性是决定推断材料行为可靠性的主导因素。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：DC-TMT虽能实现常规炉体加热无法达到的快速升降温、陡峭热梯度和同步力学加载，但其结果不能简单等同于体块等温测试；温度梯度、加热速率和标距段代表性是决定推断材料行为可靠性的主导因素。；创新点：首次系统性地将DC-TMT的不确定度来源按主导、次要和条件性进行层级分类，并明确界定了该方法在哪些条件下能提供可重复的机理洞察、在哪些条件下不能与体块数据直接等效——填补了该领域缺乏正式标准化和系统性认知的空白。
papers.method_zh: 该综述整合了四十年研究，对试样几何设计、温度测量、应变表征和环境控制进行了系统梳理，并基于建模与实验证据对不确定度来源进行了分级（主导、次要、条件性）。摘要未提及具体的第一性原理或唯象计算细节。

papers.title: Parity-controlled electron-hole interference in exciton-phonon coupling
papers.abstract: We demonstrate that exciton-phonon coupling in polar semiconductors is governed by a parity-controlled interference selection rule. By performing an exact multipole expansion of the excitonic form factor and validating it against numerical integration of hydrogenic envelope functions, we show that the long-range infrared divergence of the Fröhlich interaction is exactly canceled for elastic scattering between excitonic states of the same parity. The ground-state exciton is thereby protected from long-wavelength polar phonons by destructive electron-hole interference. In contrast, transitions between states of opposite parity exhibit constructive interference, preserving a finite, robust coupling to macroscopic polar fields independent of band-structure details. Mass asymmetry between the electron and hole activates higher-order multipole terms in the elastic channel but leaves the constructive inelastic channel essentially unaffected. The selection rule is dimensionally invariant, applying to bulk and two-dimensional systems alike, and naturally explains the anomalously weak phonon dressing observed in halide perovskites as well as the strong phonon sidebands in transition-metal dichalcogenides. Our framework provides a universal, analytically exact criterion for exciton-phonon coupling strength, offering a design principle for engineering excitonic materials with tailored phonon interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“demonstrate”“exact multipole expansion”“validating against numerical integration”“selection rule”等理论推导与验证关键词，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：极性半导体中激子-声子耦合的物理机制，具体涵盖卤化物钙钛矿（halide perovskites）和过渡金属二硫化物（transition-metal dichalcogenides）两类材料体系，以及体相和二维系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 激子-声子耦合受宇称控制的干涉选择定则支配：同宇称激子态之间的弹性散射中，Fröhlich相互作用的红外发散被精确抵消（相消干涉），基态激子受长波极性声子保护；而异宇称态之间的跃迁呈相消干涉，保持有限且稳健的耦合强度。该选择定则具有维度不变性，可解释卤化物钙钛矿中异常弱的声子 dressing 和过渡金属二硫化物中强的声子伴线。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：激子-声子耦合受宇称控制的干涉选择定则支配：同宇称激子态之间的弹性散射中，Fröhlich相互作用的红外发散被精确抵消（相消干涉），基态激子受长波极性声子保护；而异宇称态之间的跃迁呈相消干涉，保持有限且稳健的耦合强度。该选择定则具有维度不变性，可解释卤化物钙钛矿中异常弱的声子 dressing 和过渡金属二硫化物中强的声子伴线。；创新点：提出了一个解析精确、普适的激子-声子耦合强度判据（宇称控制的干涉选择定则），首次将激子内电子-空穴干涉效应与Fröhlich相互作用的红外行为系统联系起来，并统一解释了不同材料体系中截然相反的声子耦合强度现象。摘要未突出说明与具体实验数据的定量对比。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架为激子包络函数的精确多极展开（exact multipole expansion of the excitonic form factor），并与氢原子型包络函数的数值积分结果进行交叉验证。具体分析了电子-空穴质量不对称性对多极项的影响，以及选择定则在二维和三维系统中的普适性。

papers.title: Non-Hermitian topological Euler insulators
papers.abstract: Topological Euler insulators emerge in multiband systems with real Bloch Hamiltonians and wavefunctions. Their fragile topologies are characterized by the Euler class of degenerate bands and protected by the $PT$ or $C_2T$ symmetry in two dimensions, which go beyond the tenfold $K$-theory classification of topological matter. In this work, we extend the conception of topological Euler insulators to non-Hermitian systems and propose a theoretical framework to unlock their nontrivial Euler topology. Focusing on two-dimensional, three-band non-Hermitian lattice models with symmetric Hamiltonians, we formulate a comprehensive description of their topological Euler bands, entanglement spectrum and bulk-boundary correspondence. Three typical models of non-Hermitian Euler insulators are constructed and investigated explicitly to illustrate our theory. Unique topological phase transitions and anomalous edge-band overlaps with non-Hermitian origins are further identified. Our study establishes the presence of topological Euler bands in non-Hermitian systems and unveils their intriguing physical characteristics, thereby broadening the existing territory of topological matter in non-Hermitian open systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“theoretical framework”“formulate”“illustrate our theory”等表述，属于理论建模与分类研究。；研究对象：非厄米（non-Hermitian）拓扑Euler绝缘体，具体为二维、三带、具有对称哈密顿量的非厄米晶格模型，其拓扑性质由Euler类表征，受PT或C₂T对称性保护。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将拓扑Euler绝缘体的概念从厄米系统推广到非厄米系统，证明非厄米系统中同样存在非平凡的Euler拓扑能带，并揭示了由非厄米性导致的独特拓扑相变和反常的边界-能带重叠现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：将拓扑Euler绝缘体的概念从厄米系统推广到非厄米系统，证明非厄米系统中同样存在非平凡的Euler拓扑能带，并揭示了由非厄米性导致的独特拓扑相变和反常的边界-能带重叠现象。；创新点：首次将Euler拓扑绝缘体拓展至非厄米体系，建立了非厄米Euler拓扑的理论描述框架，并发现了非厄米起源的独特拓扑相变与反常边界能带重叠，突破了传统十重K理论分类的范畴。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架构建与模型分析：针对二维三带非厄米晶格模型，系统描述了拓扑Euler能带、纠缠谱和体-边界对应关系，并构造了三个典型模型进行具体研究。

papers.title: Dynamical development of long-range spatial coherence in non-equilibrium bosonic condensation
papers.abstract: Development of spontaneous coherence is one of the hallmarks of bosonic condensation in a variety of physical systems, such as cold atoms, confined photons, and hybrid light-matter quasiparticles like exciton polaritons in semiconductors. While spatial coherence is well understood once a steady-state condensate has been established, its temporal evolution as the condensate forms is largely unexplored. Here, we explore the dynamical formation of a non-equilibrium, driven-dissipative exciton-polariton condensate through both time-resolved experiments and numerical modeling. Our study reveals that the spatial coherence is established through two distinct stages. The early-time stage is interaction-driven and features transient oscillations in spatial coherence. This stage is followed by a steady-state regime characterized by a spatially-uniform high degree of coherence that extends over the entire size of the system and persists over time. These stages of spatial coherence development occur in both free flowing and confined exciton-polariton systems that undergo a quench - rapid growth of the condensate starting from two different initial settings. Our study offers a deep insight into the process by which long-range spatial coherence is established in a non-equilibrium bosonic condensate.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+数值模拟）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“time-resolved experiments and numerical modeling”。；研究对象：非平衡驱动-耗散激子极化激元凝聚体（exciton-polariton condensate），包括自由流动和受限两种体系，研究其在淬火（quench）过程中空间相干性的动力学建立过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非平衡玻色凝聚体的空间相干性通过两个不同阶段建立：早期为相互作用驱动的瞬态相干振荡阶段，随后进入覆盖整个系统尺寸、随时间持续的高相干稳态阶段。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非平衡玻色凝聚体的空间相干性通过两个不同阶段建立：早期为相互作用驱动的瞬态相干振荡阶段，随后进入覆盖整个系统尺寸、随时间持续的高相干稳态阶段。；创新点：首次系统研究凝聚体形成过程中空间相干性的时间演化（而非仅稳态特性），揭示了两阶段建立机制，并证明该机制在自由流动和受限体系中均成立。摘要未突出说明与具体理论框架或实验技术相关的创新。
papers.method_zh: 时间分辨实验（time-resolved experiments）结合数值建模（numerical modeling）。摘要未明确说明具体实验技术（如动量/空间分辨光谱）或数值方法（如Gross-Pitaevskii方程或量子动力学模拟）的细节。

papers.title: Interpretable physics-informed retrieval-augmented generation language model for end-to-end inorganic crystal synthesis planning
papers.abstract: Synthesis planning for inorganic materials requires predicting both synthesizability and viable routes by linking microscopic thermodynamic stability with macroscopic synthesis methods, precursors, and processing conditions. Here, we develop an interpretable Physics-Informed Retrieval-Augmented Generation Language Model (PIRAG-LM) for end-to-end inorganic crystal synthesis planning. We construct a material-centered Structured Synthesis Knowledge Base (SSKB) containing route-level records for 13,820 experimentally synthesized inorganic crystals. PIRAG-LM retrieves historical precedents using chemical, structural, and thermodynamic similarity, then employs a structured LLM reasoning module to propose routes, precursors, and processing conditions and assess thermodynamic feasibility, kinetics, and accessibility. It achieves 91.4% accuracy in synthesis-method prediction, compared with 72.1% for the LLM alone, and generalizes to materials reported after the knowledge cutoff. Because the framework relies on retrieval rather than parametric memorization, its performance can be improved by expanding the SSKB without retraining the language model. Guided by PIRAG-LM, we experimentally synthesize five new compounds: BaMo0.3In0.7O2.95, BaNb0.4In0.6O2.9, Hg[B(CN)4]2, CoCo(CN)6, and SrNb2Fe2(PO4)6, via solid-state and solution routes. These results demonstrate an interpretable machine-learning approach that helps bridge computational materials discovery and experimental realization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（机器学习方法开发 + 实验合成验证）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“develop a ... Language Model”的计算/建模工作，以及“we experimentally synthesize five new compounds”的实验验证。；研究对象：无机晶体材料的合成规划，具体涉及13,820种实验合成的无机晶体，以及五种新化合物：BaMo0.3In0.7O2.95、BaNb0.4In0.6O2.9、Hg[B(CN)4]2、CoCo(CN)6、SrNb2Fe2(PO4)6。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开发了一种可解释的物理信息检索增强生成语言模型（PIRAG-LM），在合成方法预测上达到91.4%的准确率（远超纯LLM的72.1%），并能泛化到知识截止日期之后报道的材料；该模型指导实验合成了五种新化合物。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开发了一种可解释的物理信息检索增强生成语言模型（PIRAG-LM），在合成方法预测上达到91.4%的准确率（远超纯LLM的72.1%），并能泛化到知识截止日期之后报道的材料；该模型指导实验合成了五种新化合物。；创新点：将物理信息（化学、结构、热力学相似性）融入检索增强生成框架，实现端到端的无机晶体合成规划；框架依赖检索而非参数记忆，因此可通过扩展SSKB提升性能而无需重新训练语言模型，且具备可解释性。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 构建了以材料为中心的结构化合成知识库（SSKB），包含13,820种无机晶体的路线级记录；PIRAG-LM利用化学、结构和热力学相似性检索历史先例，再通过结构化LLM推理模块提出合成路线、前驱体和加工条件，并评估热力学可行性、动力学和可及性。实验验证采用固相和溶液法合成新化合物。

papers.title: Quantum geometric signatures of Link-Unlink transitions and nonlinear Hall response in Hopf-link semimetals
papers.abstract: Quantum geometry, comprising of quantum metric and Berry curvature, plays a significant role in the electronic transport properties of solids. In this work, we theoretically investigate the quantum geometric properties of a Hopf-link semimetal, a distinct topological class that is charecterized by a nodal link-unlink transition. We compute the interband optical conductivity of the Hopf link, which effectively distinguishes between linked and trivial phases. While recent studies establish quantum metric dipole-mediated scattering-free nonlinear Hall effect, this effect becomes even more fascinating in systems where the Berry-curvature-dipole contribution to nonlinear Hall conductivity vanishes. Owing to the underlying $PT$ symmetry of the Hopf-link semimetal, the Berry curvature and its corresponding contribution to the nonlinear Hall effect are entirely suppressed. Consequently, by introducing an appropriate perturbation, a finite nonlinear Hall conductivity emerges solely due to the quantum metric in the Hopf semimetal. Notably, this purely intrinsic, symmetry-driven nonlinear response remains entirely unmixed with extrinsic components.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“theoretically investigate”“we compute”等表述，属于理论计算研究。；研究对象：Hopf-link半金属（Hopf-link semimetal），一种具有节点链环-解链环（link-unlink）拓扑相变的新型拓扑半金属，重点关注其量子几何性质（量子度规与贝里曲率）及非线性霍尔响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Hopf-link半金属中，由于体系具有PT对称性，贝里曲率及其对非线性霍尔效应的贡献被完全抑制；通过引入适当微扰，可产生仅由量子度量（quantum metric）驱动的纯本征非线性霍尔电导，且该响应与外在散射机制完全无关。此外，带间光导率可有效区分链环相与平庸相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Hopf-link半金属中，由于体系具有PT对称性，贝里曲率及其对非线性霍尔效应的贡献被完全抑制；通过引入适当微扰，可产生仅由量子度量（quantum metric）驱动的纯本征非线性霍尔电导，且该响应与外在散射机制完全无关。此外，带间光导率可有效区分链环相与平庸相。；创新点：首次在Hopf-link半金属中展示了一种“纯量子度量”驱动的非线性霍尔效应——即在贝里曲率贡献完全为零的情况下，仅靠量子度量即可产生非线性霍尔响应，且该响应为纯本征、无外在混合。这为量子度量在输运现象中的独立可观测性提供了新范例。
papers.method_zh: 理论计算框架：基于量子几何理论，计算Hopf-link半金属的带间光导率（interband optical conductivity）和非线性霍尔电导率，分析量子度量偶极子（quantum metric dipole）与贝里曲率偶极子（Berry-curvature dipole）的贡献，并利用PT对称性分析来分离本征与非本征响应。

papers.title: Realization of Air-Stable Two-Dimensional Superconductor Nb2Pd3Te5 With Quasi-One-Dimensional Pair Density Modulation
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) superconductors provide a fertile platform for exploring reduced-dimensional superconductivity and emergent quantum phenomena. Incorporating quasi-one-dimensional (quasi-1D) structural motifs into 2D superconductors offers a powerful route to engineer strong electronic anisotropy, enabling unconventional superconducting states and anisotropic superconducting transport functionalities. However, such systems remain rarely realized. Here we report the realization of a 2D superconductor Nb2Pd3Te5, exhibiting an intrinsic quasi-1D pair density modulation. Monolayer and bilayer Nb2Pd3Te5 is synthesized via van-der-Waals epitaxy. Using ultralow-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy, we observe the quasi-1D crystal structure and superconductivity below ~0.6 K with a pronounced quasi-1D pair density modulation. Remarkably, both monolayer and bilayer Nb2Pd3Te5 show strong air stability. Our findings establish atomically 2D Nb2Pd3Te5 as a robust and promising platform for exploring novel low-dimensional quantum phenomena and anisotropy-enabled superconducting devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“synthesized via van-der-Waals epitaxy”以及“ultralow-temperature scanning tunneling microscopy/spectroscopy”等实验手段。；研究对象：二维超导体 Nb₂Pd₃Te₅，特别是其单层和双层薄膜，以及其中准一维的库珀对密度调制（pair density modulation）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功制备了空气稳定的单层和双层二维超导体 Nb₂Pd₃Te₅，其在约 0.6 K 以下表现出超导电性，并伴随显著的准一维库珀对密度调制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功制备了空气稳定的单层和双层二维超导体 Nb₂Pd₃Te₅，其在约 0.6 K 以下表现出超导电性，并伴随显著的准一维库珀对密度调制。；创新点：首次在原子级薄的二维超导体中实现了本征的准一维库珀对密度调制，且该材料具有优异的空气稳定性，为各向异性超导器件和低维量子现象研究提供了新平台。
papers.method_zh: 范德华外延（van-der-Waals epitaxy）生长薄膜；超低温扫描隧道显微镜/扫描隧道谱（STM/STS）用于表征晶体结构、超导能隙及库珀对密度调制。

papers.title: Multiple pattern formation in quorum sensing of density enhanced motility
papers.abstract: Using Langevin dynamics simulations, I investigate nonequilibrium systems of particles following a density-enhanced motility (DEM) rule: particles are passive below a critical local density and active above it. This mechanism represents an inverse of the conventional quorum-sensing rule. I explore specifically quorums much larger than particle size and at two levels of activity. Above critical values of the density, quorum size, and activity, the system undergoes phase separation into low- and high-energy regions. The passive particles organize into distinct spatial patterns, including holes, stripes, and labyrinthine structures, while the active particles form a gas. I characterize the resulting steady states and identify the qualitative mechanisms governing the selection of different morphological regimes. I further discuss the relevance of these results to biological systems governed by analogous quorum-sensing mechanisms and to biological systems exhibiting related forms of spatial organization. Finally, I present directions for future investigation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“Langevin dynamics simulations”（朗之万动力学模拟）。；研究对象：遵循“密度增强迁移率”（density-enhanced motility, DEM）规则的粒子非平衡系统，即低于临界局域密度时粒子为被动（passive），高于临界密度时变为活性（active）。该机制是传统群体感应（quorum sensing）规则的逆过程。研究聚焦于远大于粒子尺寸的“群体”（quorum）尺寸，以及两个活性水平下的相分离行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当密度、群体尺寸和活性超过临界值后，系统发生相分离，形成低能和高能区域；被动粒子自组织为多种空间图案（孔洞、条纹、迷宫结构），而活性粒子形成气态。研究刻画了稳态特征，并识别了决定不同形态区域选择的定性机制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当密度、群体尺寸和活性超过临界值后，系统发生相分离，形成低能和高能区域；被动粒子自组织为多种空间图案（孔洞、条纹、迷宫结构），而活性粒子形成气态。研究刻画了稳态特征，并识别了决定不同形态区域选择的定性机制。；创新点：提出并研究了传统群体感应规则的“逆”机制（密度增强迁移率），并系统考察了群体尺寸远大于粒子尺寸时的多图案形成（孔洞、条纹、迷宫）及其形态选择机制。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 朗之万动力学（Langevin dynamics）模拟，用于研究非平衡粒子系统的集体行为与稳态图案形成。

papers.title: Beyond linear stability: Heterogeneity-induced fingering of crack fronts
papers.abstract: We investigate the stability of elastic interfaces beyond the linear regime by considering penny-shaped crack fronts propagating through toughness heterogeneities. Using fracture mechanics simulations, we drive crack fronts through arrays of obstacles with tunable toughness contrast. At low contrast, the crack front stiffness remains finite and stabilizes front perturbations. Above a critical threshold, however, the stiffness vanishes and the front destabilizes into long fingers that evolve into daughter cracks propagating between obstacles while the original crack remains pinned. Near threshold, the crack front response displays the characteristic square-root scaling behavior of classical saddle-node bifurcations. Yet, our analysis reveals a fundamentally different mechanism: the stable energy-minimizing crack-front configuration disappears without colliding with an unstable counterpart. Instead, the instability originates from a global loss of Griffith-compatible equilibria governed by the nonlocal interactions along the crack front. Beyond fracture mechanics, these findings point toward a broader class of collective global bifurcations in nonlocal elastic interfaces and may help rationalize the brittle-to-quasibrittle transition in heterogeneous solids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用断裂力学模拟”（fracture mechanics simulations），并结合理论分析（如Griffith相容平衡、鞍结分岔标度行为）。；研究对象：异质固体中裂纹前沿的失稳现象，具体为在韧性非均匀介质中传播的硬币形（penny-shaped）裂纹前沿，以及由非均匀性诱导的指状分叉（fingering）和子裂纹形成。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当韧性对比度超过临界阈值时，裂纹前沿的刚度消失，前沿失稳形成长指状结构，进而演化为在障碍物之间传播的子裂纹，而原始裂纹保持钉扎。该失稳并非经典鞍结分岔（稳定与不稳定解碰撞），而是源于Griffith相容平衡态的全局消失，由裂纹前沿的非局域相互作用主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当韧性对比度超过临界阈值时，裂纹前沿的刚度消失，前沿失稳形成长指状结构，进而演化为在障碍物之间传播的子裂纹，而原始裂纹保持钉扎。该失稳并非经典鞍结分岔（稳定与不稳定解碰撞），而是源于Griffith相容平衡态的全局消失，由裂纹前沿的非局域相互作用主导。；创新点：揭示了一种不同于经典鞍结分岔的失稳机制——稳定能量极小构型在未与不稳定构型碰撞的情况下消失，而是由于非局域相互作用导致Griffith相容平衡态的全局缺失。该机制可能推广至非局域弹性界面的集体全局分岔，并有助于理解脆性-准脆性转变。
papers.method_zh: 断裂力学模拟（fracture mechanics simulations），通过可调韧性对比度的障碍物阵列驱动裂纹前沿，分析前沿刚度、失稳阈值及近阈值的平方根标度行为。

papers.title: Splay-induced charging of ferroelectric droplets in highly non-uniform electric fields
papers.abstract: Ferroelectric sessile droplets on a superhydrophobic surface can be put into motion by highly non-uniform electric fields, in a direction that depends on the field sign. This indicates that droplets carry a non-vanishing electrostatic charge, which we interpret as acquired through contact electrification at the interface with the superhydrophobic substrate. This phenomenon is not observed in the presence of a uniform or quasi-uniform electric field, suggesting that droplets charging is favored in highly nonuniform fields able to induce localized distortions of the ferroelectric polarization, in turn producing localized charge accumulation sites. Electrostatic charging is thus understood as a splay-induced contact electrification and interpreted as a strategy to minimize the accumulated charge. Electrophoretic-like motion is observed in about 30% of the experiments, meaning that splay-induced charging requires the proper combination of conditions such as droplets size, distance from the field source, freshness of the substrate coating and other experimental details that are not easily quantified. When charging does not occur, effects related to droplet polarization such as dielectrophoresis, ejection of polarized fluid jets and electrostriction-like deformations are observed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验观察（“Ferroelectric sessile droplets... can be put into motion”），并给出了实验统计结果（“observed in about 30% of the experiments”）。；研究对象：超疏水表面上的铁电液滴（ferroelectric sessile droplets），以及它们在高度非均匀电场下的充电与运动行为。具体物理现象包括接触起电（contact electrification）、电泳运动（electrophoretic-like motion）、介电泳（dielectrophoresis）和电致伸缩（electrostriction）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 高度非均匀电场能诱导铁电液滴产生由“splay”（展曲）形变引起的静电充电，从而使液滴表现出依赖于电场方向的电泳式运动；该充电现象是接触起电的结果，且仅在约30%的实验条件下发生。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：高度非均匀电场能诱导铁电液滴产生由“splay”（展曲）形变引起的静电充电，从而使液滴表现出依赖于电场方向的电泳式运动；该充电现象是接触起电的结果，且仅在约30%的实验条件下发生。；创新点：首次提出“splay-induced contact electrification”（展曲诱导的接触起电）机制，将铁电体极化场的局部畸变（splay）与液滴宏观充电行为联系起来，并指出该充电过程是系统最小化累积电荷的一种策略。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：在超疏水表面上放置铁电液滴，施加高度非均匀电场（对比均匀/准均匀电场），观察液滴运动方向与形态变化，并统计充电发生的概率。摘要未提及具体材料制备或表征手段（如显微镜类型、电极构型等）。

papers.title: Distinct Surface and Bulk Superconductivity in the Kagome Superconductor SrSn$_3$
papers.abstract: Surface and bulk superconductivity may possess fundamentally different superconducting properties in quantum materials with nontrivial electronic structures, yet their superimposed spectroscopic signatures often prevent direct experimental access to each superconducting channel. Here we reveal, in epitaxial films of the kagome superconductor SrSn$_3$, distinct surface and bulk superconducting channels with markedly different superconducting gaps, upper critical fields, and vortex-core electronic states by tuning the tunneling junction resistance in scanning tunneling spectroscopy. The surface superconductivity is characterized by a thickness-independent superconducting gap and an enhanced upper critical field, whereas the bulk superconducting channel exhibits a larger superconducting gap that decreases with reducing film thickness and a much lower upper critical field. Within magnetic vortex cores, robust non-split zero-bias conductance peaks are observed exclusively in the surface superconducting channel, while pronounced zero-bias suppression is consistently associated with the bulk superconducting channel. These findings demonstrate that the vortex-core electronic structure depends sensitively on the underlying superconducting channel, providing new insight into vortex-bound states in topological quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“扫描隧道谱学”“外延薄膜”“调节隧穿结电阻”等实验手段。；研究对象：笼目超导体 SrSn₃ 的外延薄膜，具体研究其表面超导与体超导两种通道的物理性质差异。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 SrSn₃ 薄膜中，表面超导与体超导具有明显不同的超导能隙、上临界场和涡旋芯电子态：表面超导能隙与厚度无关且上临界场增强，体超导能隙更大但随厚度减小而降低且上临界场较低；涡旋芯中，表面超导通道呈现稳健的非劈裂零偏压电导峰，而体超导通道则表现为明显的零偏压抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 SrSn₃ 薄膜中，表面超导与体超导具有明显不同的超导能隙、上临界场和涡旋芯电子态：表面超导能隙与厚度无关且上临界场增强，体超导能隙更大但随厚度减小而降低且上临界场较低；涡旋芯中，表面超导通道呈现稳健的非劈裂零偏压电导峰，而体超导通道则表现为明显的零偏压抑制。；创新点：首次在单一材料中通过隧穿结电阻调控，将表面与体超导通道的谱学信号分离，并揭示涡旋芯电子态对超导通道类型的敏感依赖，为拓扑量子材料中的涡旋束缚态研究提供了新视角。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道谱学（STS），通过调节隧穿结电阻来区分表面与体超导通道；样品为外延薄膜，并系统改变薄膜厚度进行对比测量。

papers.title: High-throughput Discovery of Magnetic Rare Earth Transition Metal Alloys
papers.abstract: We present an accelerated materials discovery framework that combines diffusion-based crystal structure generation with hierarchical screening to identify new rare-earth--transition-metal magnets simultaneously achieving high magnetization and thermodynamic stability. Using this workflow, we systematically explored over 3000 binary (R-T) and ternary (R-T-T$'$) compositions spanning R~$\in \{\text{Y, Sm}\}$, T~$\in \{\text{Fe, Co, Ni}\}$, and T$' \in \{\text{Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Cu, Zn}\}$, and filtered approximately 240{,}000 generated crystal structures through machine-learning interatomic potential prescreening and spin-polarized density functional theory validation. We identify 300+ low-energy magnetic candidates within 0.1~eV/atom above the convex hull at the DFT level, including 5 thermodynamically stable phases. The highest saturation magnetization reaches ${\sim}1.8$~T in Fe-rich binary and ternary phases (SmFe$_{12}$, YFe$_{12}$, YFe$_{18}$Ti and Sm$_2$Fe$_{16}$Mn). Symmetry analysis reveals that the majority of ternary candidates are subgroup derivatives of known binary prototypes through Wyckoff site splitting that accommodates T$'$ substitution. Site-resolved magnetic moment analysis further shows that Mn aligns ferromagnetically with the Fe sublattice with minimal magnetization loss, whereas Cr couples antiferromagnetically, providing systematic guidance for dopant selection. These findings demonstrate a generalizable strategy for targeted magnetic materials discovery and suggest that extending generative searches to larger unit cells ($>$20 atoms) with higher Fe fractions is a promising route toward stable phases with saturation magnetization exceeding 1.8~T.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“diffusion-based crystal structure generation”“machine-learning interatomic potential prescreening”“spin-polarized density functional theory validation”等计算与生成式方法关键词。；研究对象：稀土-过渡金属（R-T）磁性合金，具体包括二元（R-T）和三元（R-T-T'）体系，其中R ∈ {Y, Sm}，T ∈ {Fe, Co, Ni}，T' ∈ {Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Cu, Zn}。研究目标是同时实现高磁化强度与热力学稳定性的永磁材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过高通量生成与筛选，识别出300余个能量低于凸包0.1 eV/atom的低能磁性候选相，其中5个为热力学稳定相；Fe-rich二元及三元相（如SmFe₁₂、YFe₁₂、YFe₁₈Ti、Sm₂Fe₁₆Mn）的饱和磁化强度最高可达约1.8 T。此外，Mn与Fe亚晶格呈铁磁耦合且磁化损失极小，而Cr呈反铁磁耦合，为掺杂元素选择提供了系统指导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过高通量生成与筛选，识别出300余个能量低于凸包0.1 eV/atom的低能磁性候选相，其中5个为热力学稳定相；Fe-rich二元及三元相（如SmFe₁₂、YFe₁₂、YFe₁₈Ti、Sm₂Fe₁₆Mn）的饱和磁化强度最高可达约1.8 T。此外，Mn与Fe亚晶格呈铁磁耦合且磁化损失极小，而Cr呈反铁磁耦合，为掺杂元素选择提供了系统指导。；创新点：将扩散模型驱动的晶体结构生成与层级筛选相结合，实现针对稀土-过渡金属磁性合金的高通量发现；系统揭示了三元候选相作为已知二元原型通过Wyckoff位点分裂衍生而来的结构关系，并给出了掺杂元素（Mn vs Cr）磁耦合行为的明确对比。摘要未突出说明与已有生成式材料发现框架相比的具体算法改进。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于扩散模型的晶体结构生成框架，结合层级筛选流程：先通过机器学习原子间势（MLIP）进行预筛选，再用自旋极化密度泛函理论（DFT）对约24万个生成结构进行验证。还进行了对称性分析（Wyckoff位点分裂）和位点分辨磁矩分析。

papers.title: Grain Boundary Engineering Effect on Vortex Matter in Superconducting Films
papers.abstract: Grain boundaries (GBs) in polycrystalline superconducting films act as a double-edged sword: they can pin vortices or degrade superconductivity through Josephson-like weak-link coupling. Here, we demonstrate that sputtering pressure tunes GB coupling in NbTiN films and visualize its consequences for vortex matter. The 5 mTorr film exhibits dispersed grain orientations and a two-step resistive transition under field, signaling intergranular weak-link behavior. In contrast, the 7 mTorr film develops a (111) texture, a single-step transition, higher critical current density, a second magnetization peak, and a δl-type pinning response consistent with improved GB coupling. Cryogenic magnetic force microscopy reveals a spatially heterogeneous, cluster-like vortex configuration in the 5 mTorr film, whereas the 7 mTorr film hosts a more uniform distribution with enhanced local order. These results establish a connection between deposition-controlled GB connectivity, macroscopic weak-link transport, and microscopic vortex organization, providing a practical route to tailor vortex pinning in polycrystalline superconducting films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“demonstrate”“visualize”“Cryogenic magnetic force microscopy reveals”等实验性表述，涉及薄膜制备、输运测量和显微成像。；研究对象：多晶超导薄膜NbTiN中的晶界（Grain Boundaries）及其对涡旋物质（vortex matter）的钉扎与输运行为的影响，具体关注溅射气压调控晶界耦合强度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节溅射气压（5 mTorr vs 7 mTorr）可有效调控NbTiN薄膜的晶界耦合：5 mTorr薄膜呈现弱连接行为（两步电阻转变、簇状涡旋分布），而7 mTorr薄膜具有(111)织构、单步转变、更高临界电流密度、第二磁峰和δl型钉扎响应，对应更均匀的涡旋排列和增强的局域有序性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节溅射气压（5 mTorr vs 7 mTorr）可有效调控NbTiN薄膜的晶界耦合：5 mTorr薄膜呈现弱连接行为（两步电阻转变、簇状涡旋分布），而7 mTorr薄膜具有(111)织构、单步转变、更高临界电流密度、第二磁峰和δl型钉扎响应，对应更均匀的涡旋排列和增强的局域有序性。；创新点：将沉积参数（溅射气压）控制的晶界连通性与宏观弱连接输运行为、微观涡旋组织直接关联起来，建立了从工艺到微观涡旋排列的完整因果链，为多晶超导薄膜的涡旋钉扎工程提供了实用调控途径。
papers.method_zh: 磁控溅射制备NbTiN薄膜（不同溅射气压）；电阻-温度/磁场输运测量（用于判断转变台阶和临界电流密度）；磁化测量（观测第二磁峰）；低温磁力显微镜（MFM）直接成像涡旋空间分布；通过织构分析（(111)取向）表征晶界结构。

papers.title: Electric excitation of spin resonance in altermagnetic and antiferromagnetic conductors
papers.abstract: We predict electric-dipole spin resonance (EDSR) in altermagnetic conductors: in a magnetic field ${\mathbf H}_\perp$, perpendicular to the magnetization axis, an AC electric field will induce a \textit{spin} resonance peak above the lower threshold frequency $ω_- = 2H_\perp$. In sufficiently clean samples, this peak shall be clearly visible on the background of ohmic absorption. EDSR can thus serve as a diagnostic of altermagnetism in conducting materials and as a means to distinguish it from higher-symmetry antiferromagnetic order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要使用“We predict”（我们预测）等理论预言性表述，未提及实验手段或数值计算。；研究对象：交变磁（altermagnetic）导体和反铁磁导体中的电偶极自旋共振（EDSR）现象，具体为在垂直于磁化轴的磁场 H⊥ 下，交流电场激发自旋共振的物理过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在交变磁导体中，交流电场可在磁场 H⊥ 下激发自旋共振峰，其频率下限为 ω₋ = 2H⊥；在足够干净的样品中，该共振峰可在欧姆吸收背景上清晰显现，可作为区分交变磁序与高对称反铁磁序的诊断手段。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在交变磁导体中，交流电场可在磁场 H⊥ 下激发自旋共振峰，其频率下限为 ω₋ = 2H⊥；在足够干净的样品中，该共振峰可在欧姆吸收背景上清晰显现，可作为区分交变磁序与高对称反铁磁序的诊断手段。；创新点：首次预言交变磁导体中存在电偶极自旋共振（EDSR），并提出利用该效应作为探测交变磁有序的实验探针，同时提供了一种与普通反铁磁序区分的新途径。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体理论框架，但根据内容推断为基于对称性分析和有效哈密顿量的解析理论模型（如自旋-轨道耦合下的电偶极跃迁矩阵元计算）。摘要未给出具体方法名称。

papers.title: Metastable magnetic domains and the anomalous $B_\parallel=0$ resistance peak in twisted double bilayer graphene
papers.abstract: In graphene moirés, valley polarization gives rise to orbital magnetism, manifested as an anomalous Hall effect and resulting in Barkhausen jumps in longitudinal resistance when changing domain configurations modify quasiparticle scattering. Beyond a simple picture of polarized domains, however, spin and valley textures within and between the domains are less well understood, as is the effect of these textures on transport. In the valley-polarized quarter-metal state of twisted double bilayer graphene, a sharp and metastable peak in longitudinal resistance often appears at zero in-plane magnetic field, whose microscopic origin has yet to be identified. Here, we show that this peak depends on the configuration of domains of orbital magnetism, which is itself set by the gate-voltage trajectory used to enter the ordered state and by the magnetic field --- particularly the in-plane component --- present during that trajectory. The sensitivity of the effect to in-plane magnetic field components points to spin, linked to valley polarization through spin-orbit coupling, as the key degree of freedom in both the domain formation and the resistance peak.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了实验观测现象（电阻峰、磁滞跳变），并涉及通过栅压轨迹和磁场调控的实验过程。；研究对象：扭转双层石墨烯（twisted double bilayer graphene）中的谷极化四分之一金属态（quarter-metal state），具体研究其轨道磁性畴结构、自旋-谷纹理，以及纵向电阻在零面内磁场下出现的亚稳峰。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 零面内磁场下的尖锐亚稳电阻峰取决于轨道磁性畴的构型，而该构型由进入有序态时的栅压轨迹和磁场（尤其是面内分量）决定；自旋通过自旋-轨道耦合与谷极化关联，是畴形成和电阻峰的关键自由度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：零面内磁场下的尖锐亚稳电阻峰取决于轨道磁性畴的构型，而该构型由进入有序态时的栅压轨迹和磁场（尤其是面内分量）决定；自旋通过自旋-轨道耦合与谷极化关联，是畴形成和电阻峰的关键自由度。；创新点：首次将零面内磁场电阻峰的微观起源与轨道磁性畴的亚稳构型及自旋-谷耦合联系起来，指出面内磁场分量对畴形成和输运的敏感影响，超越了简单的极化畴图像。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如输运测量装置、磁场方向控制方式等），仅提及通过栅压轨迹和磁场（含面内分量）调控进入有序态的过程，并测量纵向电阻。

papers.title: Signatures of a ferro-Josephson effect in twisted graphene
papers.abstract: When a spin-polarized current is driven across a magnetic domain wall, the resulting spin-transfer torque could, beyond a critical threshold, set the wall's moments into precession. This precession would modulate the Berry curvature experienced by electrons traversing the wall, producing an electromotive force that is topological in nature, proportional to the precession frequency, mapping precisely onto the DC Josephson effect and leading to the name ferro-Josephson effect. We report signatures consistent with this effect in a twisted graphene van der Waals heterostructure, where spin and valley textures are linked by exchange, Hund's coupling, and spin-orbit interactions. Tuned to fillings where the isospin degeneracy is spontaneously broken, the samples develop a sharp peak in the longitudinal resistance within a fraction of a millitesla of $B_\parallel=0$---a peak that disappears as the current is reduced toward zero. In differential resistance the feature resolves into sharp resonances that disperse with $B_\parallel$ on microtesla and picoampere scales. We argue that these arise from the current-driven precession of spin-domain-wall moments, in competition with the in-plane anisotropy set by a minuscule applied field, and that they establish nonlinear transport as a sensitive probe of isospin domain-wall dynamics at energy scales far below $k_BT$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“We report signatures consistent with this effect in a twisted graphene van der Waals heterostructure”，并描述了电阻测量、微分电阻等实验观测。；研究对象：扭转石墨烯范德华异质结中的自旋畴壁动力学与非线性输运现象，具体为自旋极化电流驱动磁畴壁进动所产生的“铁磁约瑟夫森效应”（ferro-Josephson effect）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在扭转石墨烯异质结中，当同位旋简并自发破缺时，纵向电阻在平行磁场B∥=0附近（毫特斯拉量级内）出现尖锐峰，且该峰随电流减小而消失；微分电阻中呈现随B∥在微特斯拉和皮安培尺度上色散的尖锐共振。作者认为这些特征源于电流驱动的自旋畴壁磁矩进动，与极小的面内各向异性场竞争，确立了非线性输运作为探测远低于k_BT能量尺度的同位旋畴壁动力学的灵敏手段。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在扭转石墨烯异质结中，当同位旋简并自发破缺时，纵向电阻在平行磁场B∥=0附近（毫特斯拉量级内）出现尖锐峰，且该峰随电流减小而消失；微分电阻中呈现随B∥在微特斯拉和皮安培尺度上色散的尖锐共振。作者认为这些特征源于电流驱动的自旋畴壁磁矩进动，与极小的面内各向异性场竞争，确立了非线性输运作为探测远低于k_BT能量尺度的同位旋畴壁动力学的灵敏手段。；创新点：首次在扭转石墨烯体系中观测到与铁磁约瑟夫森效应一致的输运特征，将自旋转移力矩驱动的畴壁进动与DC约瑟夫森效应在拓扑电磁动势层面建立映射，并展示了非线性输运对极低能量尺度（远低于k_BT）同位旋畴壁动力学的探测能力。
papers.method_zh: 低温输运测量：纵向电阻随平行磁场B∥的精细扫描（分辨率达毫特斯拉以下），以及微分电阻随电流和磁场的测量（微特斯拉和皮安培尺度）。具体材料为扭转石墨烯范德华异质结，通过调节填充因子使同位旋简并自发破缺。

papers.title: Dynamical and conformational behavior of a polymer in a crowded solution
papers.abstract: We investigate the structure and dynamics of a polymer in a fluid containing mobile spherical colloidal crowders of radius $R$. We compare and contrast the behavior with Langevin dynamics (LD) and lattice--Boltzmann molecular dynamics (LBMD), the latter incorporating long-range hydrodynamic interactions. Both the colloid size relative to the monomer radius $r$ and the volume fraction $φ$ are varied to determine how crowding modifies polymer behavior. Increasing volume fraction induces polymer compaction, with the mechanism strongly dependent on the size ratio $R/r$. Small colloids primarily modify the short-wavelength polymer conformation, causing self-avoiding-walk-like behavior to persist to shorter length scales, whereas large colloids reduce the effective long-wavelength Flory exponent, indicating degraded solvent quality consistent with a confinement-blob picture. Polymer diffusion exhibits distinct behavior in LD and LBMD. In LD, diffusion decreases rapidly and depends strongly on $R/r$; a phenomenological scaling involving $\ln(1+R/r)$ captures this size dependence, and additional scaling with $R_g$ reduces scatter, indicating polymer-scale correlations induced by crowding. In contrast, LBMD diffusion follows an effective-medium-like exponential dependence on concentration, governed by hydrodynamic coupling. Rouse-mode analysis identifies three regimes: scaling breakdown at low volume fraction, Zimm-like behavior at intermediate density in both LD and LB, and at high density hydrodynamic screening in LB with confinement-dominated dynamics in LD.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用Langevin动力学（LD）和格子玻尔兹曼分子动力学（LBMD）进行模拟。；研究对象：聚合物在含移动球形胶体拥挤剂（半径R）的流体中的结构与动力学行为，重点考察胶体尺寸比R/r和体积分数φ对聚合物构象、扩散及链段弛豫的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 拥挤诱导聚合物压缩的机制取决于胶体尺寸比：小胶体改变短波长构象（自避行走行为延伸至更短尺度），大胶体降低长波长Flory指数（等效于限制-团簇图像中的溶剂质量下降）。扩散行为在LD与LBMD中截然不同：LD中扩散随浓度快速下降且依赖R/r（可用ln(1+R/r)标度描述），LBMD中扩散呈有效介质型指数衰减，由流体动力学耦合主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：拥挤诱导聚合物压缩的机制取决于胶体尺寸比：小胶体改变短波长构象（自避行走行为延伸至更短尺度），大胶体降低长波长Flory指数（等效于限制-团簇图像中的溶剂质量下降）。扩散行为在LD与LBMD中截然不同：LD中扩散随浓度快速下降且依赖R/r（可用ln(1+R/r)标度描述），LBMD中扩散呈有效介质型指数衰减，由流体动力学耦合主导。；创新点：系统对比了有无流体动力学相互作用下拥挤对聚合物构象与动力学的不同影响，揭示了扩散行为在两种模拟方法中的标度规律差异（LD中依赖R/r的标度律与LBMD中有效介质型指数依赖），并识别出Rouse模式分析中的三个动力学区域（低浓度标度失效、中等浓度Zimm-like行为、高浓度流体动力学屏蔽/限制主导）。
papers.method_zh: Langevin动力学（LD）模拟（不含流体动力学相互作用）与格子玻尔兹曼分子动力学（LBMD）模拟（含长程流体动力学相互作用），系统变化胶体半径R与单体半径r之比以及体积分数φ，并进行Rouse模式分析。

papers.title: Dynamical splitting and a nodal Bose liquid in 2d chiral XYZ model
papers.abstract: We study a class of Hamiltonians with a structure that we call "dynamical splitting": the Hamiltonian terms can be divided into two sets acting on the same degrees of freedom such that every term in one set commutes with every term in the other, although terms within either set do not all commute. This structure yields an algebraic duality to effective degrees of freedom on which the two parts of the Hamiltonian act disjointly, enabling exact diagonalization on lattices with approximately twice as many spins as usually accessible. We exploit it in the "chiral XYZ model", a geometrically frustrated spin-$1/2$ model on the triangular lattice which was previously introduced as a special limit of a Majorana-Hubbard model. This model also possesses anticommuting noncontractible line symmetries, which enforce an exact, topology-dependent degeneracy between locally indistinguishable states. We first study a $\mathbb{Z}_N$ clock generalization and find, at large $N$, a gapless ground state with three subsystem-symmetry-protected nodal lines. Exploiting dynamical splitting and the subsystem symmetries, we carry out exact diagonalization of the $N=2$ model on lattices up to $9\times9$ spins. The many-body gap and bipartite entanglement provide strong evidence for a gapless state consistent with the large-$N$ nodal structure: the entanglement scales as $L\log L$ and exhibits $1+1$-dimensional CFT-like chord scaling on cylinders. Finally, we study instabilities and proximate phases. In particular, we find evidence that a subsystem-symmetry-preserving deformation drives a finite coupling transition to a gapped phase with $\mathbb Z_2 \times \mathbb Z_2$ topological order.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及哈密顿量构造、代数对偶、精确对角化（exact diagonalization）、能隙与纠缠熵计算等理论方法，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：二维手性XYZ模型（chiral XYZ model），即三角晶格上几何阻挫的自旋-1/2模型，是Majorana-Hubbard模型的一个特殊极限；同时研究了其\(\mathbb{Z}_N\)钟模型推广形式。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该模型在\(N=2\)时表现出无能隙基态，其节点结构与大\(N\)极限下的三条子系统对称性保护的节线一致；此外，保持子系统对称性的形变可驱动有限耦合相变，进入具有\(\mathbb{Z}_2 \times \mathbb{Z}_2\)拓扑序的有能隙相。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该模型在\(N=2\)时表现出无能隙基态，其节点结构与大\(N\)极限下的三条子系统对称性保护的节线一致；此外，保持子系统对称性的形变可驱动有限耦合相变，进入具有\(\mathbb{Z}_2 \times \mathbb{Z}_2\)拓扑序的有能隙相。；创新点：提出“动力学分裂”这一通用哈密顿量结构，并利用其实现远超常规尺寸的精确对角化；首次在二维手性XYZ模型中揭示子系统对称性保护的三条节线及其无能隙基态，并发现其与\(\mathbb{Z}_2 \times \mathbb{Z}_2\)拓扑序之间的相变。
papers.method_zh: 利用“动力学分裂”（dynamical splitting）结构实现代数对偶，将哈密顿量分解为两组互相对易的项，从而在约两倍于常规尺寸的晶格（最大\(9\times9\)自旋）上进行精确对角化；结合多体能隙、二分纠缠熵（\(L\log L\)标度）及圆柱几何上的1+1维CFT型弦标度分析；并研究子系统对称性保护的节线及形变驱动的相变。

papers.title: Origin of High-Temperature Antiferromagnetic Order in a van der Waals Material
papers.abstract: While Van der Waals (vdW) itinerant antiferromagnets with high Neel temperatures (TN) are highly desirable for spintronics, they remain relatively scarce. Here, we unravel the physical origin of the unusually high TN (= 250 K) in the newly identified vdW compound (Fe0.65Co0.35)4GeTe2. The substitution of Co in Fe4GeTe2 induces layer-selective Fe-Co ordering and stabilizes a robust antiferromagnetic (AFM) state primarily driven by Co moments. The AFM order is further strengthened by enhanced electronic correlations of quasi-localized Co 3d-states at the Fermi level, giving rise to an itinerant-localized duality of the 3d electrons. This interplay generates strong magnetic correlations well above TN and stabilizes low-temperature spin canting with a possible nontrivial Berry curvature. Our results establish (Fe0.65Co0.35)4GeTe2 as a rare material bridging fundamental magnetic interactions with potential applications in AFM spintronics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与理论计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中提及“unravel the physical origin”（揭示物理起源）、“induce”（诱导）等机制性分析，以及“establish...as a rare material”（确立为一种稀有材料）的结论性表述，暗示了实验合成表征与理论计算（如电子结构分析）的协同研究。；研究对象：范德瓦尔斯（vdW） itinerant 反铁磁材料 (Fe0.65Co0.35)4GeTe2，及其高温反铁磁有序（TN = 250 K）的物理起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Co 取代 Fe 诱导了层选择性 Fe-Co 有序，稳定了主要由 Co 磁矩驱动的反铁磁态；该反铁磁序因费米能级上准局域 Co 3d 态的增强电子关联而进一步强化，形成巡游-局域二象性，并在远高于 TN 的温度下产生强磁关联，同时稳定了低温自旋倾斜（可能伴随非平庸贝里曲率）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Co 取代 Fe 诱导了层选择性 Fe-Co 有序，稳定了主要由 Co 磁矩驱动的反铁磁态；该反铁磁序因费米能级上准局域 Co 3d 态的增强电子关联而进一步强化，形成巡游-局域二象性，并在远高于 TN 的温度下产生强磁关联，同时稳定了低温自旋倾斜（可能伴随非平庸贝里曲率）。；创新点：首次在 vdW 化合物中通过 Co 取代实现层选择性原子有序，从而获得高达 250 K 的尼尔温度，并揭示了巡游-局域二象性在稳定高温反铁磁序中的关键作用，为 vdW 反铁磁自旋电子学提供了新材料平台。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验手段（如中子衍射、X射线吸收谱等）或计算方法（如DFT+U、动力学平均场理论等），仅提及了电子关联、费米能级态密度、贝里曲率等概念，暗示使用了第一性原理电子结构计算与磁性测量。具体手段需查阅原文。

papers.title: Finite relaxation protocols with minimal dissipation
papers.abstract: Work extraction from nonequilibrium systems is a major challenge across biological, chemical, physical, and engineering systems. Idealized protocols generally require a quasistatic relaxation stage in which the Hamiltonian is gradually adjusted through a continuum of intermediaries. Here, we consider protocols restricted to a finite number $N$ of intermediary Hamiltonians, consisting of a sequence of quench-relax steps. We determine the sequence of quenches that minimizes the dissipated work, which can be expressed in terms of a recurrence involving the Lambert function. The optimal sequence converges to the Fisher-Rao geodesic, saturating known leading-order dissipation bounds at large $N$. We obtain lower bounds on work extraction from a nonequilibrium distribution as a function of its Fisher-Rao distance to equilibrium. We extend and apply the framework in two simple models: (i) an optical trap experiment, showing that the optimal intermediary distribution can be bimodal even for unimodal initial and final distributions, and (ii) an enzyme-catalyzed reaction, showing that that accounting for relaxation time in addition to dissipation can favor barrier-lowering.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及“确定最优序列”“下界”“框架”等理论推导与优化表述，未提及实验或数值模拟细节。；研究对象：非平衡系统的功提取与耗散最小化问题，具体应用于两个模型：(i) 光镊实验体系；(ii) 酶催化反应体系。核心物理现象为有限步数弛豫协议中的耗散与功提取。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在仅允许有限数量N个中间哈密顿量的“淬火-弛豫”协议中，最优淬火序列可由含Lambert函数的递推关系确定，该序列在大N极限下收敛至Fisher-Rao测地线，并饱和已知的领头阶耗散下界；同时给出了从非平衡分布提取功的下界（作为其到平衡态Fisher-Rao距离的函数）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在仅允许有限数量N个中间哈密顿量的“淬火-弛豫”协议中，最优淬火序列可由含Lambert函数的递推关系确定，该序列在大N极限下收敛至Fisher-Rao测地线，并饱和已知的领头阶耗散下界；同时给出了从非平衡分布提取功的下界（作为其到平衡态Fisher-Rao距离的函数）。；创新点：首次针对有限N步（而非准静态连续）弛豫协议给出严格最优淬火序列的解析递推形式，并揭示其与Fisher-Rao测地线的联系；发现最优中间分布可呈双峰（即使初末分布均为单峰），以及考虑弛豫时间可改变酶反应中势垒降低的偏好。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于有限N步淬火-弛豫协议的变分优化，利用Lambert函数递推求解最优序列；结合Fisher-Rao信息几何分析收敛行为与耗散下界。应用模型：(i) 光镊实验——分析最优中间分布形态；(ii) 酶催化反应——同时考虑弛豫时间与耗散对势垒的影响。

papers.title: Tuning Dirac-Rashba and Double Dirac Cone Surface States of Topological Crystalline Insulator Pb$_{1-x}$Sn$_{x}$Se by Transition Metal Adsorbate
papers.abstract: The electronic structure of topological insulator/magnetic metal (TI/MM) interfaces is of great importance for understanding of exotic spin-dependent phenomena and realization of advanced spin-orbitronic devices. Here, we employ a model system of submonolayer transition metal (TM) deposited on the surface of a topological crystalline insulator (TCI) of Pb$_{1-x}$Sn$_{x}$Se to systematically map out the modification of the surface electronic structure by angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) as a function of coverage. For the polar (111) Pb$_{1-x}$Sn$_{x}$Se surface, we observe the coexistence of the Dirac topological surface states (TSS) and Rashba-split surface states (RSS) induced by the combined effects of inversion-symmetry breaking, surface band bending and orbital angular momentum effects. In particular, we demonstrate very large Rashba splittings can be obtained and the Rashba parameter ($α_R$) can be tuned over a remarkably wide range from 0 to 3.5 eV ${\cdot}$ $\mathring{\mathrm{A}}$, depending on the type and coverage of the TM adatoms. Model-Hamiltonian calculations corroborate the experimental findings and reveal that this coexistence results from the filling of the TSS by the surface doping caused by the TM. In contrast, for the nonpolar (001) surface exhibiting a double Dirac cone topological surface state, the inversion symmetry is preserved and hence no Rashba-split surface states emerge. Instead, surface charge imbalance induces dephasing of the wave functions of the double Dirac cones that diminishes the momentum-space separation between them. These findings shed light on novel phenomena occurring at the topological insulator / transition metal interface, offering a versatile platform for future spintronic and quantum devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（结合模型哈密顿量计算）。判断依据：摘要明确使用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）作为主要实验手段，并辅以模型哈密顿量计算进行佐证。；研究对象：拓扑晶体绝缘体 Pb₁₋ₓSnₓSe 的极性 (111) 表面与非极性 (001) 表面，以及亚单层过渡金属（TM）吸附物对其表面电子结构的调控。具体物理现象包括 Dirac 拓扑表面态（TSS）、Rashba 劈裂表面态（RSS）以及双 Dirac 锥表面态的演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在极性 (111) 表面，过渡金属吸附可同时诱导 Dirac 拓扑表面态与 Rashba 劈裂表面态共存，且 Rashba 参数 α_R 可在 0 至 3.5 eV·Å 的极宽范围内连续可调；在非极性 (001) 表面，表面电荷失衡导致双 Dirac 锥波函数退相干，减小了其在动量空间的分离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在极性 (111) 表面，过渡金属吸附可同时诱导 Dirac 拓扑表面态与 Rashba 劈裂表面态共存，且 Rashba 参数 α_R 可在 0 至 3.5 eV·Å 的极宽范围内连续可调；在非极性 (001) 表面，表面电荷失衡导致双 Dirac 锥波函数退相干，减小了其在动量空间的分离。；创新点：首次系统展示了在拓扑晶体绝缘体 Pb₁₋ₓSnₓSe 表面通过过渡金属吸附实现 Rashba 参数从零到 3.5 eV·Å 的宽范围连续调控，并揭示了极性与非极性表面上截然不同的表面态调控机制（Rashba 劈裂 vs. 双 Dirac 锥退相干）。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）系统测量不同过渡金属种类及覆盖度下的表面电子结构；理论上采用模型哈密顿量计算对实验观测进行验证与解释。

papers.title: Thermalization packets and optimal ice cubes
papers.abstract: Relaxation toward equilibrium is usually accelerated by modifying the environment or by cooling a system further from equilibrium. Here we introduce a distinct strategy: thermalization packets, auxiliary systems prepared in advance and later coupled to a target system to accelerate its relaxation toward a prescribed thermal state. Thus, thermalization packets trade preparation effort for reduced waiting time. When the objective is cooling, we colloquially refer to such packets as ice cubes. Unlike ordinary coolants, thermalization packets are characterized not only by their temperature or heat capacity, but also by their microscopic preparation. We define perfect and optimal packets by their ability to suppress the slowest relaxation mode of the coupled dynamics: perfect packets eliminate it entirely, while optimal packets minimize its amplitude. We show that, under generic conditions, perfect packets exist among thermal preparations near equilibrium. Surprisingly, for asymptotic relaxation, the optimum among thermal preparations is generally not the coldest packet: cooling the packet beyond the slow-mode-cancelling optimum restores a nonzero slow mode and can therefore slow relaxation, yielding a packet analog of the Mpemba effect. We demonstrate the concept in exactly solvable Metropolis dynamics, a minimal two-qubit model, and a boundary-coupled interacting Ising-spin system. We also extend the framework to packets optimized for finite readout times. Finally, we show that the perfect-packet contour can connect the trivial bath-equilibrium point to a nontrivial strong Mpemba or strong inverse-Mpemba point.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中涉及理论概念构建（thermalization packets）、解析可解模型（exactly solvable Metropolis dynamics）、最小模型（minimal two-qubit model）以及数值模拟（boundary-coupled interacting Ising-spin system），未提及实验手段。；研究对象：开放量子/经典系统的弛豫动力学，具体研究如何通过预先制备的辅助系统（称为“热化包”，冷却场景下称为“冰块”）加速目标系统向预定热态的弛豫过程。涉及体系包括Metropolis动力学、两量子比特模型和边界耦合的相互作用Ising自旋链。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出“热化包”策略：通过预先制备辅助系统并耦合到目标系统，可加速其弛豫；存在“完美包”（完全抑制最慢弛豫模）和“最优包”（最小化最慢模振幅）。在热制备条件下，完美包在近平衡态普遍存在；但渐近弛豫的最优热制备包并非最冷包——过度冷却会恢复非零慢模并减慢弛豫，产生类似Mpemba效应的“包类比”。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出“热化包”策略：通过预先制备辅助系统并耦合到目标系统，可加速其弛豫；存在“完美包”（完全抑制最慢弛豫模）和“最优包”（最小化最慢模振幅）。在热制备条件下，完美包在近平衡态普遍存在；但渐近弛豫的最优热制备包并非最冷包——过度冷却会恢复非零慢模并减慢弛豫，产生类似Mpemba效应的“包类比”。；创新点：首次提出“热化包”这一通用弛豫加速策略，将制备代价与等待时间进行权衡；发现热制备包的最优冷却点并非最冷态，揭示冷却过度反而减慢弛豫的“包Mpemba效应”；并证明完美包轮廓可连接平凡浴平衡点与非平凡强Mpemba/强逆Mpemba点。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与解析求解：利用慢模抑制条件定义完美/最优包；在可精确求解的Metropolis动力学、最小两量子比特模型以及边界耦合的相互作用Ising自旋系统中进行演示；并扩展到有限读出时间优化的情形。

papers.title: The Effects of Inter-Valley Coupling of Dirac Fermions near Four Dimensions
papers.abstract: We analyze the criticality of an Ising Gross-Neveu-Yukawa (GNY) theory of $N_ψ$ Dirac fermion valleys with intra- and inter-valley interactions, using a renormalization-group analysis in $4-ε$ space-time dimensions to one-loop order. The conventional GNY fixed point of decoupled valleys is unstable against inter-valley fluctuations which are naturally present if the symmetry breaking is driven by short-ranged interactions. At the new fixed point, the critical exponents differ from the conventional GNY universality. Most importantly, Lorentz invariance is broken due to interference effects resulting from the relative rotation between valley coordinate frames. In the limit of large $N_ψ$ the critical fixed point with finite inter-valley coupling remains stable but Lorentz invariance is asymptotically restored.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：renormalization-group analysis、one-loop order、fixed point、critical exponents。；研究对象：四维时空附近的狄拉克费米子体系，具体为具有N_ψ个谷（valley）的Ising Gross-Neveu-Yukawa（GNY）理论，关注谷内与谷间相互作用对量子临界性的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 传统上谷间解耦的GNY不动点在谷间涨落（由短程相互作用驱动的对称性破缺自然引入）下是不稳定的；新的不动点具有不同于常规GNY普适类的临界指数，且由于谷坐标系之间的相对旋转导致的干涉效应，洛伦兹不变性被破坏。在大N_ψ极限下，具有有限谷间耦合的临界不动点仍然稳定，但洛伦兹不变性渐近恢复。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：传统上谷间解耦的GNY不动点在谷间涨落（由短程相互作用驱动的对称性破缺自然引入）下是不稳定的；新的不动点具有不同于常规GNY普适类的临界指数，且由于谷坐标系之间的相对旋转导致的干涉效应，洛伦兹不变性被破坏。在大N_ψ极限下，具有有限谷间耦合的临界不动点仍然稳定，但洛伦兹不变性渐近恢复。；创新点：揭示了谷间耦合对GNY量子临界性的非微扰影响，特别是洛伦兹不变性在临界点的破坏及其在大N_ψ极限下的渐近恢复——这一机制在常规GNY普适类中不存在。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用4-ε空间-时间维度下的重整化群分析，计算至单圈阶（one-loop order），并考察大N_ψ极限行为。

papers.title: Micromechanical statistical model links induced nematic order to mechanical response in fiber networks
papers.abstract: Contractile cells and external loads reorganize the fibrous extracellular matrix, aligning and compacting fibers over distances far exceeding a cell's size, strongly affecting bioprocesses such as wound healing, angiogenesis and tumor invasion. We develop a continuum micromechanical theory that links, at every material point, the load-induced orientational order to the mechanical response that the reoriented network then exhibits. The network is described statistically, by the probability density of fiber orientations, and deforms affinely, so that a single-fiber stress-strain law is carried into the network stress, with the deformation set self-consistently by mechanical equilibrium. Critical to realistic biological relevant conditions, this theory allows both geometrical and material nonlinearities. Applied to a two-dimensional network under uniaxial stretch, the theory collapses onto a single anisotropy parameter that governs the orientation distribution, the nematic order, the Poisson ratio, and the densification of fibers. Our theory reveals that induced order and densification are highly positively correlated, and in the case of uniaxial stretch they collapse onto a nearly universal curve, independent of the single-fiber stiffness behavior. For a contracting cell, we find that buckling controls how far nematic orientational order and densification propagate. We find an algebraic decay of deformations with distance and solve for the dependence of the power-law exponent on the buckled-reduced stiffness of a single fiber. We validate our theory by comparison with non-affine discrete fiber-network simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含与离散纤维网络模拟的对比验证）。关键词：continuum micromechanical theory、statistical model、non-affine discrete fiber-network simulations。；研究对象：纤维网络（细胞外基质）在收缩细胞或外部载荷作用下诱导的向列（nematic）取向有序及其力学响应，涉及纤维重排、压实和屈曲等力学-结构耦合现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该理论揭示：在单轴拉伸下，诱导的纤维取向有序与致密化高度正相关，并几乎落在一条与单纤维刚度行为无关的普适曲线上；在收缩细胞情形下，纤维屈曲控制向列有序和致密化的传播距离，变形随距离呈代数衰减，幂律指数由单纤维屈曲后刚度决定。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该理论揭示：在单轴拉伸下，诱导的纤维取向有序与致密化高度正相关，并几乎落在一条与单纤维刚度行为无关的普适曲线上；在收缩细胞情形下，纤维屈曲控制向列有序和致密化的传播距离，变形随距离呈代数衰减，幂律指数由单纤维屈曲后刚度决定。；创新点：该理论在每一个材料点将载荷诱导的取向有序与重取向网络随后表现出的力学响应直接联系起来，并允许几何与材料双重非线性，适用于生物相关的大变形条件；发现有序-致密化普适曲线及屈曲控制的代数衰减规律。摘要未突出说明与以往连续介质模型的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一个连续介质微力学统计理论：用纤维取向的概率密度描述网络，假设仿射变形，将单纤维应力-应变关系带入网络应力，并通过力学平衡自洽确定变形场。该理论同时允许几何非线性和材料非线性。通过与非仿射离散纤维网络模拟对比进行验证。

papers.title: Carrier-Resolved Attosecond Valley Polarimetry of Monolayer MoS$_2$
papers.abstract: In recent years, all-optical writing and switching of valley polarization in two-dimensional semiconductors has been demonstrated on femtosecond timescales. Reading this polarization out on the same timescale, carrier by carrier, has so far remained out of reach. Employing semiconductor Bloch equation simulations of monolayer MoS$_2$, we show that attosecond transient absorption closes this gap by turning the Mo $4p$ semicore edge into a quantitative valley polarimeter. We find that pump-enabled core-to-valence absorption probes the holes while core-to-conduction bleaching probes the electrons, so that a single spectrum identifies each carrier by its photoabsorption energy. The hole channel, Pauli-blocked in equilibrium, emerges background-free. Its circular dichroism reverses sign with the pump helicity, and its normalized magnitude is proportional to the valley polarization. Finally, we show that scanning the probe delay clocks the few-femtosecond write in real time. Thus, attosecond core-level dichroism is a carrier-sensitive, quantitative probe of the creation and evolution of valley polarization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Employing semiconductor Bloch equation simulations”（采用半导体布洛赫方程模拟），属于理论计算研究。；研究对象：单层MoS₂（monolayer MoS₂）中的谷极化（valley polarization）超快动力学，具体关注Mo 4p半芯能级（semicore edge）附近的瞬态吸收过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用阿秒瞬态吸收光谱（attosecond transient absorption）可将Mo 4p半芯能级转化为定量谷偏振计，实现对单层MoS₂中空穴和电子谷极化的逐载流子分辨测量，并实时记录数飞秒尺度的谷极化写入过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用阿秒瞬态吸收光谱（attosecond transient absorption）可将Mo 4p半芯能级转化为定量谷偏振计，实现对单层MoS₂中空穴和电子谷极化的逐载流子分辨测量，并实时记录数飞秒尺度的谷极化写入过程。；创新点：首次提出利用阿秒瞬态吸收光谱实现逐载流子（carrier-by-carrier）分辨的谷偏振读出，突破了此前谷极化只能在飞秒时间尺度上写入但无法在同一时间尺度上逐载流子读出的限制。具体创新包括：单一光谱即可区分空穴和电子（通过不同光吸收能量）；空穴通道在平衡态下被泡利阻塞，可无背景探测；圆二色性符号随泵浦螺旋度反转，归一化幅度正比于谷极化度。
papers.method_zh: 半导体布洛赫方程（Semiconductor Bloch Equations, SBE）模拟，用于计算单层MoS₂的阿秒瞬态吸收光谱，分析泵浦-探测过程中的芯级-价带吸收（core-to-valence absorption）和芯级-导带漂白（core-to-conduction bleaching）通道。

papers.title: Convergence of the conformal Ward identity in the derivative expansion approximation
papers.abstract: Conformal invariance is expected to be an emergent property of many systems in their critical regime. However, approximation schemes generically spoil this property. This is in particular the case of the derivative expansion, a widely used approximation scheme in the framework of the functional renormalization group. In this article, we consider Ward identities associated with conformal invariance in the 3-d Ising universality class with truncations at order 4 (next-to-next-to-leading order) in the derivative expansion, with $Z_2$ invariant composite operators. Our results confirm that the regulating functions which yield a small breaking of conformal invariance also present a small sensitivity of the universal critical exponents with the choice of this regulating function. We also show that, in the vicinity of regulator-parameter values for which the conformal constraints are best satisfied, the breaking of conformal invariance reduces as the order of the derivative expansion is increased, providing a new indication of the convergence of this approximation scheme.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要涉及“functional renormalization group”（泛函重整化群）、“derivative expansion”（导数展开）、“Ward identities”（Ward恒等式）等理论框架与近似方案。；研究对象：三维Ising普适类（3-d Ising universality class）中的共形不变性，以及导数展开近似下共形Ward恒等式的收敛行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在导数展开的4阶截断（NNLO）下，使共形对称性破缺较小的调节函数，其对普适临界指数的影响也较小；且在共形约束最优的调节参数附近，随着导数展开阶数增加，共形对称性破缺减小，表明该近似方案趋于收敛。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在导数展开的4阶截断（NNLO）下，使共形对称性破缺较小的调节函数，其对普适临界指数的影响也较小；且在共形约束最优的调节参数附近，随着导数展开阶数增加，共形对称性破缺减小，表明该近似方案趋于收敛。；创新点：首次在导数展开的NNLO阶次下系统检验共形Ward恒等式的收敛性，并给出调节函数选择与普适临界指数敏感性之间的关联，为导数展开近似的可靠性提供了新的收敛性证据。
papers.method_zh: 泛函重整化群（FRG）框架下的导数展开近似，截断至4阶（next-to-next-to-leading order），并考虑具有Z₂对称性的复合算符，通过共形Ward恒等式检验共形不变性的破缺程度。

papers.title: Probing bulk superconductivity in centrosymmetric Te-doped PtBi$_2$ single crystals
papers.abstract: The Weyl semimetal $γ$-PtBi$_2$ has been shown to be one of the most promising novel materials, recently proposed as a topological i-wave superconductor. A crucial requirement for observing this physics is the absence of inversion symmetry in its trigonal $P31m$ crystal structure. Centrosymmetry has been reported to be readily restored in the $P\overline{3}m1$ structure upon electron doping, partially substituting Bi with as little as 2% Te. In this work, we synthesized Te-doped PtBi$_{2-x}$Te$_{x}$ samples and thoroughly investigated the bulk superconductivity of selected single crystals with nominal composition PtBi$_{1.96}$Te$_{0.04}$, exhibiting the highest superconducting volume fraction of $\sim100$%. Single crystal XRD measurements confirm the centrosymmetric $P\overline{3}m1$ structure in our samples, whereas bulk superconductivity with a critical temperature of $T_\mathrm{c} \approx 2.4\,$K was observed in magnetization and specific heat measurements. The upper critical fields for two different orientations were determined as $H^{\parallel}_{\mathrm{c2}}(0)\approx 6.3\,$kOe for in-plane and $H^{\perp}_{\mathrm{c2}}(0)\approx 4.7\,$kOe for out-of-plane magnetic fields. Robust superconductivity was also found in resistance and point contact measurements, where the latter showed a slight enhancement of the critical temperature up to $T_\mathrm{c} \sim 3\,$K. Finally, ARPES measurements corroborate the centrosymmetric structure of our samples, showing a single surface termination and the absence of Fermi arcs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“synthesized”“single crystal XRD measurements”“magnetization and specific heat measurements”“resistance and point contact measurements”“ARPES measurements”等实验手段。；研究对象：中心对称Te掺杂PtBi₂单晶（标称组分为PtBi₁.₉₆Te₀.₀₄），具体研究其体超导电性及其与晶体结构（P̄3m1）的关联。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在中心对称P̄3m1结构的Te掺杂PtBi₂单晶中观测到体超导电性，临界温度T_c≈2.4 K，且该结构下不存在费米弧，与原先非中心对称γ-PtBi₂中提出的拓扑i-wave超导态形成对比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在中心对称P̄3m1结构的Te掺杂PtBi₂单晶中观测到体超导电性，临界温度T_c≈2.4 K，且该结构下不存在费米弧，与原先非中心对称γ-PtBi₂中提出的拓扑i-wave超导态形成对比。；创新点：首次在中心对称P̄3m1结构的Te掺杂PtBi₂中系统表征体超导电性，并明确该结构下不存在拓扑表面态（费米弧），为区分中心对称与非中心对称体系中超导配对对称性提供了实验依据。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 单晶X射线衍射（XRD）确定晶体结构；磁化率和比热测量确认体超导及T_c；上临界场H_c2(0)通过不同磁场方向（面内/面外）的输运或磁化测量确定；电阻测量和点接触（point contact）谱学进一步验证超导性；角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）确认表面终止和费米弧缺失。

papers.title: Intercalation of Alkali Metal into WTe2, the Crystal Structure of A0.5WTe2 and Observation of a Metal-to-Semiconductor Transition
papers.abstract: We explore the cationic intercalation of tungsten ditelluride (WTe2) with potassium (K), rubidium (Rb), and cesium (Cs), yielding intercalation compounds of the form A0.5WTe2 (A = K, Rb, Cs). Structural characterization was performed using powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD), while diffuse reflectance infrared Fourier transform (DRIFT) spectroscopy and temperature-dependent conductivity measurements were employed to investigate the electronic properties. Density functional theory (DFT) calculations were carried out to support the experimental findings and to provide insight into the intercalation mechanisms and the resulting material characteristics. All synthesized compounds display semiconducting behavior with narrow band gaps, emphasizing the influence of alkali metal intercalation on the electronic structure and transport properties of WTe2. These results advance the fundamental understanding of property modulation in transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs) and highlight their potential for electronic device applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：摘要中同时涉及实验合成与表征（PXRD、DRIFT光谱、电导率测量）以及DFT计算。；研究对象：碱金属（K、Rb、Cs）插层二碲化钨（WTe2）形成的A0.5WTe2插层化合物，以及插层引起的金属-半导体转变现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 所有合成的A0.5WTe2（A = K, Rb, Cs）化合物均表现出窄带隙半导体行为，表明碱金属插层将原始WTe2的金属性转变为半导体性，显著调控了其电子结构和输运性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：所有合成的A0.5WTe2（A = K, Rb, Cs）化合物均表现出窄带隙半导体行为，表明碱金属插层将原始WTe2的金属性转变为半导体性，显著调控了其电子结构和输运性质。；创新点：系统研究了K、Rb、Cs三种碱金属插层WTe2的晶体结构，并首次观察到插层诱导的金属-半导体转变，为过渡金属二硫族化物（TMDCs）中通过插层实现电子性质调控提供了新途径。（摘要未突出说明更具体的创新细节）
papers.method_zh: - 实验：粉末X射线衍射（PXRD）用于结构表征；漫反射红外傅里叶变换（DRIFT）光谱和变温电导率测量用于电子性质研究。

papers.title: High-pressure phase transitions in the quantum spin liquid candidate Na2Co2TeO6 probed by Raman spectroscopy
papers.abstract: The quasi-2D magnet Na2Co2TeO6 (NCTO) is a candidate for a Kitaev Quantum Spin Liquid (KQSL) state. Pressure-tuning in such materials is of interest as a potential method to tune the Kitaev exchange interactions, which are strongly dependent on bond geometry. Here we report a Raman spectroscopic study of NCTO inside a diamond anvil cell (DAC) with pressure applied up to 16.3 GPa. Based on the changes in the Raman modes, this pressure range is divided into three regions. The appearance and disappearance of several modes and changes in the polarization dependence of the representative modes, most prominently above 13.8 GPa, point to pressure-induced phase transitions in this material.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Raman spectroscopic study”（拉曼光谱研究）以及“diamond anvil cell”（金刚石压砧）等实验手段。；研究对象：准二维磁性材料 Na₂Co₂TeO₆（NCTO），一种 Kitaev 量子自旋液体（KQSL）候选材料，以及其在高压下的结构相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 0–16.3 GPa 压力范围内，NCTO 的拉曼模式出现多次出现与消失，且代表性模式的偏振依赖关系发生显著变化（尤其在 13.8 GPa 以上），表明该材料在高压下发生了压力诱导的结构相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 0–16.3 GPa 压力范围内，NCTO 的拉曼模式出现多次出现与消失，且代表性模式的偏振依赖关系发生显著变化（尤其在 13.8 GPa 以上），表明该材料在高压下发生了压力诱导的结构相变。；创新点：首次利用拉曼光谱系统研究了 NCTO 在高压下的相变行为，将压力范围划分为三个区域，并明确指出 13.8 GPa 以上存在显著的结构转变，为压力调控 Kitaev 交换相互作用提供了实验依据。（摘要未突出说明更多创新细节。）
papers.method_zh: 高压拉曼光谱学（Raman spectroscopy），结合金刚石压砧（DAC）装置，压力最高施加至 16.3 GPa；同时测量了拉曼模式的偏振依赖关系以追踪结构变化。

papers.title: Delta-Function Kicks are Optimal for Rapidly Driven Inertial Stochastic Systems
papers.abstract: Optimal control helps guide our understanding of stochastic thermodynamics, leading to universal properties and geometric formulations. Among the initially surprising properties of optimal control, not only discrete jumps but delta function kicks have been shown to be necessary to minimize dissipation in specific example systems. Using a short-time approximation, I show that delta-function kicks are universally optimal for minimizing dissipation in inertial stochastic systems, including active and quantum dynamics under general constraints. Fundamentally stemming from basic kinematics, delta-function kicks are required to achieve linear scaling of work with short protocol durations compared to the quadratic scaling without the kicks. This implies a diverging (infinite) ratio of saved work in the short-time limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中出现“short-time approximation”“show that”“theoretically”等理论推导关键词，且未提及实验或数值模拟手段。；研究对象：惯性随机系统（inertial stochastic systems），包括有源（active）和量子动力学系统，在快速驱动（rapidly driven）条件下的最优控制与最小耗散问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在短时近似下，δ函数脉冲（delta-function kicks）是惯性随机系统中最小化耗散的普适最优控制形式；它能使功随协议时长线性标度（而无脉冲时为二次标度），从而在短时极限下节省功的比值发散（趋于无穷）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在短时近似下，δ函数脉冲（delta-function kicks）是惯性随机系统中最小化耗散的普适最优控制形式；它能使功随协议时长线性标度（而无脉冲时为二次标度），从而在短时极限下节省功的比值发散（趋于无穷）。；创新点：将此前在特定示例系统中发现的δ函数脉冲最优性推广为惯性随机系统的普适结论，并揭示其源于基本运动学（basic kinematics），同时涵盖有源与量子动力学。摘要未突出说明与已有最优控制几何框架的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 短时近似（short-time approximation）解析推导，结合随机热力学与最优控制理论框架，分析一般约束下的惯性随机动力学（含活性与量子情形）。

papers.title: Persistence length of short homopolymeric single-stranded DNA sequences in polyvalent cations
papers.abstract: We used simulations of short single stranded DNA (ssDNA) homopolymers, based on the sequence dependent Three Interaction Site (TIS) model, to calculate the persistence length ($l_p$) in polyvalent cations. The TIS model accounts for stacking interactions and electrostatic interactions are treated using the Coulomb potential. We find that $l_p$ for $\mathrm{dT_{30}}$ (T is thymine) and $\mathrm{dA_{30}}$ (A is adenine) is quantitatively fit using $l_p = l_p^0 + λκ^{-1}$ ($l_p^0$ is the bare persistence length, $λ$ is a dimensionless constant, and $κ$ is the inverse Debye length) in the divalent cations $\mathrm{Mg^{2+}}$ and $\mathrm{Ca^{2+}}$. The dependence of $l_p$ on $κ$ is surprising because it was derived for long flexible polyelectrolytes in which the charges interact via the Debye-Hückel potential. The $l_p^0$ values are 0.4 nm and 1.1 nm for polyT and polyA, respectively. Strikingly, $l_p$ is almost independent of the tetravalent spermine concentration. There is no clear theoretical explanation although simulations suggest that the number of spermine molecules that bind to the ssDNA saturates at a small value. A qualitative picture, based on the restrictions of access to the phosphate groups due to volume exclusion of the anisotropic structure of $\mathrm{Spm^{4+}}$, rationalizes the simulation results. The predicted dependence of $l_p$ in spermine awaits experimental test.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“We used simulations”（使用模拟），基于TIS模型进行计算。；研究对象：短同聚单链DNA（ssDNA）序列（dT₃₀和dA₃₀）在多价阳离子（Mg²⁺、Ca²⁺、Spm⁴⁺）溶液中的持久长度（persistence length, l_p）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在二价阳离子（Mg²⁺、Ca²⁺）中，ssDNA的持久长度满足l_p = l_p⁰ + λκ⁻¹的关系（polyT的l_p⁰=0.4 nm，polyA的l_p⁰=1.1 nm）；而在四价精胺（Spm⁴⁺）中，l_p几乎不随浓度变化，该现象归因于Spm⁴⁺各向异性结构对磷酸基团的体积排阻效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在二价阳离子（Mg²⁺、Ca²⁺）中，ssDNA的持久长度满足l_p = l_p⁰ + λκ⁻¹的关系（polyT的l_p⁰=0.4 nm，polyA的l_p⁰=1.1 nm）；而在四价精胺（Spm⁴⁺）中，l_p几乎不随浓度变化，该现象归因于Spm⁴⁺各向异性结构对磷酸基团的体积排阻效应。；创新点：发现二价阳离子中l_p对κ的依赖关系与长柔性聚电解质理论（Debye-Hückel势）的预测一致，但该关系意外地适用于短链；首次通过模拟揭示四价精胺中l_p几乎不依赖浓度的反常行为，并提出基于体积排阻的定性解释。摘要未突出说明与已有实验或理论工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于序列依赖的三位点（Three Interaction Site, TIS）模型的分子模拟。TIS模型包含堆积相互作用（stacking interactions），静电相互作用采用库仑势（Coulomb potential）处理。

papers.title: Raman magnon spectroscopy of local interactions and ground state selection in $\mathrm{Sr_2IrO_4}$
papers.abstract: Competing and coupled spin and charge interactions in quantum materials lead to a variety of ordered states where local configurations preferentially influence the long-range order. When these interactions are finely balanced in energy, disorder and fluctuations play an outsized role. Raman scattering is particularly well-suited to revealing the underlying physics in such situations because of its sensitivity to local environments and ability to reveal overall symmetries. We perform angle-resolved Raman polarization measurements on single crystals of the correlated, layered magnet, \ce{Sr2IrO4}, where the Mott insulating ground state arises from strong spin-orbit coupling. We characterize the symmetries of both the phonon and magnon modes through comprehensive measurements in both the $ab$-plane and out-of-plane geometries from 10 to 700 cm$^{-1}$, and trace the evolution of these modes in both configurations to 12 GPa in a diamond anvil cell with perforated diamonds. Pressure does not significantly alter the lattice as the phonon modes shift linearly under compression, but at the same time the magnon modes become position dependent and spread over a range of wavenumbers. We attribute this magnetic heterogeneity to pressure-enhanced variations in the weak interlayer interactions, which may locally favor competing magnetic stacking configurations, and compare our experimental results to the predictions of linear spin wave calculations. Our results demonstrate that Raman-active magnons amplify $μ$eV-scale interactions responsible for ground-state selection into easily measurable spectral changes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“Raman scattering measurements”“angle-resolved Raman polarization measurements”“diamond anvil cell”等实验手段，并涉及与线性自旋波计算的对比。；研究对象：自旋轨道耦合导致的Mott绝缘体层状磁体 Sr₂IrO₄（铱酸锶）单晶，重点研究其声子与磁振子（magnon）模式在高压下的行为，以及局域相互作用对基态选择的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高压（至12 GPa）下，Sr₂IrO₄的声子模式随压缩线性移动（晶格未显著改变），但磁振子模式变得随位置依赖并展宽，表明压力增强了弱层间相互作用的局域变化，可能局部偏好竞争的磁堆叠构型。Raman活性磁振子将μeV量级的、决定基态选择的相互作用放大为易于测量的光谱变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高压（至12 GPa）下，Sr₂IrO₄的声子模式随压缩线性移动（晶格未显著改变），但磁振子模式变得随位置依赖并展宽，表明压力增强了弱层间相互作用的局域变化，可能局部偏好竞争的磁堆叠构型。Raman活性磁振子将μeV量级的、决定基态选择的相互作用放大为易于测量的光谱变化。；创新点：利用Raman散射对局域环境的敏感性，首次将高压下磁振子模式的非均匀展宽与弱层间相互作用的压力增强效应联系起来，从而将μeV尺度的基态选择能量尺度转化为可观测的光谱信号。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 角度分辨Raman偏振测量（覆盖ab面及面外几何，波数范围10–700 cm⁻¹），结合金刚石对顶砧（带穿孔金刚石）高压技术（至12 GPa）；实验数据与线性自旋波（linear spin wave）计算结果对比。

papers.title: Directed walks shape a universal square-root law of entropy production rate in nonreciprocal systems
papers.abstract: The entropy production rate (EPR) quantifies irreversibility of a nonequilibrium steady state, yet standard formulas obscure how a complex interaction network generates it. For multivariate Ornstein-Uhlenbeck dynamics on such networks, we express the EPR as a quadratic form in antisymmetric matrices measuring the nonreciprocity of aggregate directed walks at every length, and, equivalently, as two weighted-walk quantities: pairs of directed walks sharing both endpoints, and directed closed walks. For diagonalizable interactions, an exact correspondence translates these walk quantities into eigenvalues and biorthogonal eigenvector overlaps.
